translation.en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day , and taught it the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Moses u thoh ïa kata ka jingrwai bad u hikai ïa ka ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: The ark , and the staves thereof , with the mercy seat , and the veil of the covering ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki jingbah ïa ka , ka jingtap jong ka , bad ka jingkah kaba kah ïa ka ;

translation.en: And cried with a loud voice , as when a lion roareth : and when he had cried , seven thunders uttered their voices .
translation.kha: bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ki sing . Hadien ba u la pyrta jam , ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la jubab da ka jingkyrhuh .

translation.en: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ha Israel ïa kaba la pynkyntang khnang khlem kyndon ha nga ka long ka jong me .

translation.en: To whom then will ye liken God ? or what likeness will ye compare unto him ?
translation.kha: Badno lah ban nujor ïa U Blei ? Kumno phi lah ban batai kaei ba u long ?

translation.en: And tookest thy broidered garments , and coveredst them : and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them .
translation.kha: Pha la shim ïa ki jaiñ ba la suh syntiew kiba nga lah ai ha pha bad pha buh ïa ki halor ki durblei , bad pha ainguh ïa ki durblei da ka umphniang Olib bad ka jingiwbih kaba nga la lah ai ha pha .

translation.en: And when she looked , behold , the king stood by a pillar , as the manner was , and the princes and the trumpeters by the king , and all the people of the land rejoiced , and blew with trumpets : and Athaliah rent her clothes , and cried , Treason , Treason .
translation.kha: Hangta ka la ïohi ïa u syiem thymmai uba ïeng hajan ki rishot ba don ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ , kumba long ka rukom . La ker sawdong ïa u da ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki nongput turoi , bad ki paidbah ki ïarisa da ka jingkmen bad put ïa ki turoi . Ka Athalaïah ka tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bad ka pyrta ,  Ka Jingshetkylla . Ka Jingshetkylla !

translation.en: The precious sons of Zion , comparable to fine gold , how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers , the work of the hands of the potter !
translation.kha: Ki samla shynrang jong ka Seïon ki la long kiba kordor ïa ngi kum ka ksiar , hynrei mynta la ñiew ïa ki kum ïa ki khiew dewbyrtha bymdondor .

translation.en: Who answered , Give me a blessing  ; for thou hast given me a south land  ; give me also springs of water . And he gave her the upper springs , and the nether springs .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga kwah katto katne ki pukri um . Ka jaka ba phi ai ïa nga ka don ha ka ri ryngkhiang .  Kumta u Kaleb u ai ha ka ïa ki umpohliew kiba haneng bad kiba harum .

translation.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt , Jacob and his sons : Reuben , Jacob s firstborn .
translation.kha: Ki dkhot jong ka ïing ka sem u Jakob kiba leit ryngkat bad u sha Ijipt ki long u khun nyngkong jong u , u Reuben ,

translation.en: Six days thou shalt labour , and do all thy work :
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi phin trei bad phin leh ïa ka kam jong phi baroh ,

translation.en: But he sent ambassadors to him , saying , What have I to do with thee , thou king of Judah ? I come not against thee this day , but against the house wherewith I have war : for God commanded me to make haste : forbear thee from meddling with God , who is with me , that he destroy thee not .
translation.kha: Kane ka thma kaba nga ïaleh kam don jingïadei ei ei bad phi , ko syiem ka Judah . Ngam shym la wan ban ïaleh ïa phi , hynrei ban ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong nga , bad U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban pynstet . U Blei u don ha ka liang jong nga , wat ïeng pyrshah ïa nga , ïoh un pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , that ye should not be their bondmen  ; and I have broken the bands of your yoke , and made you go upright .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba phin ym long shuh ki mraw . Nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka bor kaba pynpoh ïa phi , bad nga la pynlah ïa phi ban ïaid ha ka burom .

translation.en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand  ; because the  Lord  was with him , and that which he did , the  Lord  made it to prosper .
translation.kha: U nongap byndi um donkam ban khmih ei ei shuh ïa kaba u Joseph u la shim jingkitkhlieh , namar U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .

translation.en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us , written not with ink , but with the Spirit of the living God ; not in tables of stone , but in fleshy tables of the heart .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shai ba U Khrist da lade hi u la thoh ïa kane ka shithi bad u la phah ïa ka da ngi . Naba la thoh , ym da ka sia hynrei da U Mynsiem jong U Blei uba im , bad ym ha ki mawlyngkniap hynrei ha ki dohnud briew keiñ .

translation.en: The sun to rule by day : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: ïa ka sngi ban synshar mynsngi ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And these were the princes which he had  ; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest ,
translation.kha: bad kine ki long ki rangbah synshar jong u : U lyngdoh : U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Sadok

translation.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered .
translation.kha: Kumta ruh ïa phi , wat ïa ki shñiuh ha ka khlieh jong phi la lah ñiew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Wherefore criest thou unto me ? speak unto the children of Israel , that they go forward :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Balei me kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap ? Ong ïa ki paidbah ba kin nang ïaid shaphrang .

translation.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths , and reverence my sanctuary : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam bad burom ïa ka jaka ha kaba ïa nga la mane . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair , and of wearing of gold , or of putting on of apparel  ;
translation.kha: Wat ai ba phin pynitynnat ïa lade na kaba shabar , kum kaba kumno ba sad ïa u shñiuh , lane kaba deng ki jingdeng baremdor , lane ki jaiñ ba phi riam .

translation.en: All the labour of man is for his mouth , and yet the appetite is not filled .
translation.kha: Ngi trei ïa ki kam jong ngi baroh tang ban ïoh ei ei ban bam , hynrei ngim ju dap .

translation.en: Ye shall not tempt the  Lord  your God , as ye tempted him in Massah .
translation.kha: Wat tynjuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kumba phi la leh ha Massah .

translation.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors : the one owed five hundred pence , and the other fifty .
translation.kha: La don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shahram ha u nongai ram ,  U Jisu u la sdang .  Uwei u la shahram na u , sanspah tylli ki sbai rupa , bad uwei pat u la shahram na u , sanphew .

translation.en: But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him , Behold , thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohi ïa kane , ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ha khmih , ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Aiñ jong ngi na ka bynta ki synran jong me ban leh ïa kane ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey : for I will not go up in the midst of thee  ; for thou art a stiffnecked people : lest I consume thee in the way .
translation.kha: Phin ïaleit sha ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap . Hynrei ngan ym leit ryngkat bad phi , namar phi long ki briew kiba mutlop , ïoh ba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa phi ha lynti .

translation.en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there , that they feared not the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  sent lions among them , which slew some of them .
translation.kha: Haba ki dang leit sdang ban shong hangta , kim shym la mane ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta u phah ïa ki sing , kiba pynïap katto katne na ki .

translation.en: But your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , them will I bring in , and they shall know the land which ye have despised .
translation.kha: Phi ong ba ki khun ki kti jong phi kin shah kem , hynrei ngan wallam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba phi , phi la kyntait , bad kan long ka jaka shong jaka sah jong ki .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying , What seest thou ? And I said , I see a seething pot  ; and the face thereof is toward the north .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga ,  Sa kaei pat me ïohi ?  u la kylli . Nga jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa u khiew uba thnam ha ka phang bashatei , bad u la jan hap sha kane ka liang .

translation.en: Save when there shall be no poor among you  ; for the  Lord  shall greatly bless thee in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri kaba u ai ha phi . Yn ym don uwei ruh uba duk na ki para jait jong phi ,

translation.en: And Mordecai came again to the king s gate . But Haman hasted to his house mourning , and having his head covered .
translation.kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit phai pat sha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem katba u Haman u pynstet ban leit sha la ïing , u da tap ïa la ka khmat ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: None calleth for justice , nor any pleadeth for truth : they trust in vanity , and speak lies  ; they conceive mischief , and bring forth iniquity .
translation.kha: Phi kiew sha ka ïingbishar , hynrei phim shym ïoh ka jingbishar hok ha ka liang jong phi . Phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler ban jop ïa ka jingmudui jong phi . Phi pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong phi ban pynmong ïa kiwei .

translation.en: Who is he that saith , and it cometh to pass , when the Lord commandeth it not ?
translation.kha: Tang ïa ka mon ka jong U Trai hi la ju ïai pyndep .

translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against your pillows , wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly , and I will tear them from your arms , and will let the souls go , even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Nga isih ïa ki jingteh kti kiba phi pyndonkam ha ka jingpyrshang jong phi ban synshar ïa ka jingim bad jingïap . Ngan sloit ïa ki na ki kti jong phi bad pyllaitluid ïa ki briew kiba phi bat synshar .

translation.en: But he that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban sngewsarong u dei ban sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la leh .

translation.en: Whom I would have retained with me , that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel :
translation.kha: Ngan jin da la kwah ban bat ïa u hangne bad nga , katba nga dang don ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba un ïoh ïarap ïa nga ha ka jaka jong me .

translation.en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus , whom thou hast anointed , both Herod , and Pontius Pilate , with the Gentiles , and the people of Israel , were gathered together ,
translation.kha: Naba shisha u Herod bad u Pontios Pilat ki la ïakynduh lang ha kane ka nongbah lem bad ki Jentil bad ki paid Israel pyrshah ïa U Jisu , u shakri bakhuid jong me , ïa uba me la pynlong U Messaïah .

translation.en: Southward it was Ephraim s , and northward it was Manasseh s , and the sea is his border  ; and they met together in Asher on the north , and in Issachar on the east .
translation.kha: Ka ri Ephraim ka don shaphang shathie , bad ka ri Manasseh ka don shaphang shatei , bad ka Duriaw Mediterranian pat ka long u pud jong ki ha ka phang sepngi . Ka ri Asher ka don shaphang shatei lam sepngi , bad ka ri Issakhar shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .

translation.en: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of : but the sorrow of the world worketh death .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingsngewsih ïa kaba la pyndonkam da U Blei ka wanrah ïa ka jingkylla ha ka dohnud kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim — bad kam don ka jingbabe ha kata ! Hynrei ka jingsngewsih ba kynja briew ka ïalam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: But thou shalt in any wise let the dam go , and take the young to thee  ; that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban rah ïa ki khun sim , hynrei phi dei ban pyllait ïa ka kmie jong ki , ba phin ïoh im slem bad manbha .

translation.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain  ; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof .
translation.kha: Ka jinglute borabor ka shim noh ïa ka jingim jong u nonglute — kane ka dei kaba ju jia ha uno uno uba im da ka jingleh jubor .

translation.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes , He saved others  ; himself he cannot save .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la beiñ ïa U Jisu , da kaba ong para ma ki ,  U la pynim ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade !

translation.en: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel , saying , Take heed , and hearken , O Israel  ; this day thou art become the people of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh Lebi , ki ong ha ki Israel baroh ,  Ko phi ki Israel , sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa nga . Mynta ka sngi phi la long ki briew jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ;

translation.en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them , saying , If ye be mine , and if ye will hearken unto my voice , take ye the heads of the men your master s sons , and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time . Now the king s sons , being seventy persons , were with the great men of the city , which brought them up .
translation.kha: U Jehu u pynbud sa kawei pat ka shithi sha ki :  Lada phi don ha ka liang jong nga bad bud ïa ki hukum jong nga , wanrah sha nga ïa ki khlieh jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab ha Jesreel kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi .  Ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab ki don hapoh ka jingsumar jong ki riewpawkhmat jong ka Samaria , kiba la pynheh pynsan ïa ki .

translation.en: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people , neither to repair the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki mynjur ïa kane bad ki mynjur ruh ban nym shim ïa ka jingshna pynbha ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: But the other answering rebuked him , saying , Dost not thou fear God , seeing thou art in the same condemnation ?
translation.kha: Uta uwei pat , pynban , u la kynhied ïa uta , da kaba ong  Hato mem tieng ïa U Blei ? Me la ïoh kajuh ka jingpynrem kumba u la ïoh .

translation.en: And their whole body , and their backs , and their hands , and their wings , and the wheels , were full of eyes round about , even the wheels that they four had .
translation.kha: Ïa ki met , ki ingdong , ki kti , ki thapniang , bad ki shalyntem jong ki , la tap da ki khmat .

translation.en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate : and the Syrians of Zobah , and of Rehob , and Ish–tob , and Maacah , were by themselves in the field .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki la wan mih bad ki ïeng pynkhreh ïaleh ha ka jaka rung sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ki , katba kiwei pat , ki Syria bad ki rangbah na Tob bad Maakah , ki la ïeng pynkhreh ïaleh ha rudnong bym don jingkah ei ei .

translation.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea : therefore my words are swallowed up .
translation.kha: yn shem ba kin kham khia ban ïa u shyiap ka duriaw , kumta ki ktien khlem da pyrkhat jong nga kim dei ban pynlyngngoh ïa phi .

translation.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews , exorcists , took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus , saying , We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Jiw kiba la leit kylleng sawdong ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman ki la pyrshang ruh ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh ïa kane . Ki la ong ha ki mynsiem bymman ,  Nga hukum ïa me ha ka kyrteng U Jisu , ïa uba u Paul u ïalap .

translation.en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten  ; he shall even pour out the blood thereof , and cover it with dust .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u ïoh pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka sim kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , u dei ban da pjiar ïa ka snam bad tap ïa ka da ka khyndew .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust : from heaven shall it come down upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka u slap , U  Trai  un pynkhie ka  erïong pui pui bad ka  erïong shyiap haduh ba phin da jot thiaw .

translation.en: When Jesus heard these things , he marvelled at him , and turned him about , and said unto the people that followed him ,  I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kyndit haba u la ïohsngew ïa kane ; u la phai sawdong bad u la ong ha u paidbah uba bud ïa u ,  nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ka jingngeit kaba kum kane , ym don wat ha Israel ruh !

translation.en: He took also of the seed of the land , and planted it in a fruitful field  ; he placed it by great waters , and set it as a willow tree .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u jingthung ba dang lung na ka ri Israel bad u la thung ïa u ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh , ha kaba ka ju ïai don ka um ban pynlong ïa u ban san .

translation.en: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar .
translation.kha: Un thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ jong u mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh namar ka pop .

translation.en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth , that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures .
translation.kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong u hi u la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lyngba ka ktien jong ka jingshisha , khnang ba ngi dei ban ïoh ïa ka jaka kaba nyngkong hapdeng ki jingthaw baroh .

translation.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land : but he shall stumble and fall , and not be found .
translation.kha: U syiem un wan phai pat sha ki kut ki jong ka ri jong u hi , hynrei un shahjop , bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong u .

translation.en: And I will set my face against that man , and will make him a sign and a proverb , and I will cut him off from the midst of my people  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyrshah ïa u . Ngan pynlong ïa u ka nuksa . Ngan weng ïa u na ka kynhun ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ma phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the children of Israel smote them not , because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel . And all the congregation murmured against the princes .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim lah ban pynïap ïa ki , namar ba ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . U paidbah baroh u la ujor ha ki nongïalam shaphang kane ,

translation.en: Confess your faults one to another , and pray one for another , that ye may be healed . The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to phla ïa la ki pop iwei ha iwei pat , khnang ba yn pynkhiah ïa phi . Ka jingduwai jong u briew uba hok ka don ka bor kaba khraw .

translation.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins  ; and in him is no sin .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u la paw ban bah noh ïa ki pop , bad kam don kano kano ka pop ha u .

translation.en: And the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , which is by the flanks , and the caul above the liver , with the kidneys , it shall he take away ,
translation.kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .

translation.en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial , whose name was Sheba , the son of Bichri , a Benjamite : and he blew a trumpet , and said , We have no part in David , neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to his tents , O Israel .
translation.kha: Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba don ha Gilgal , uwei u riewkai uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka jait Benjamin . U put ïa ka turoi bad u pyrta ,  Weng ïa u Dabid ! Ngin ym bud ïa u ! Ïa noh sha ïing , ko Israel !

translation.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab , and told him : and Ahab went to meet Elijah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Obadaïah u leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ïathuh ha u , bad u Ahab u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Elijah .

translation.en: Which doeth great things past finding out  ; yea , and wonders without number .
translation.kha: Ngim lah ban sngewthuh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw ba u leh bad ïa ki kambah jong u ym don jingkut .

translation.en: Doth not the ear try words ? and the mouth taste his meat ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumba u thylliej u sngewbang ban mad ïa ka jingbam , ki shkor jong me ki sngewtynnat ban ïohsngew ïa ki kyntien .

translation.en: And Jesus called a little child unto him , and set him in the midst of them ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot ïa u khynnah , u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki ,

translation.en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him : but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! it had been good for that man if he had not been born .
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ba un shah leh kumta , hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ïa uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ! Kan jin da kham bha ïa uta u briew lada ym shym la kha ïa u !

translation.en: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him , reading in the book the words of the  Lord  in the  Lord s  house .
translation.kha: Kumta u Barukh u la pule ïa ki ktien U  Trai  ha ka Templ thik kumba nga la ong ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: And your father hath deceived me , and changed my wages ten times  ; but God suffered him not to hurt me .
translation.kha: Pynban i la shukor ïa nga bad pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong nga la shiphew sien . Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ba in pynmynsaw ïa nga .

translation.en: And when the multitude heard this , they were astonished at his doctrine .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: Again I say unto you , That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask , it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad nga ong shuh shuh ha phi : Ha man ba ar ngut na phi , phi ïamynjur shaphang kaei kaei kaba phi ïa-pan , yn ai ïa kata ha phi da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: Yet ,  Lord  , thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me : forgive not their iniquity , neither blot out their sin from thy sight , but let them be overthrown before thee  ; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me tip ïa baroh ki jingthmu sniew jong ki ban pynïap ïa nga . Wat ym map ïa ka jingsniew jong ki lane map ïa ka pop jong ki . Bret ïa ki sha tbian ha ka jingshahjop bad leh ïa ki katba me dang bitar .

translation.en: The kings of the earth stood up , and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord , and against his Christ .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la pynkhreh ïa lade , bad ki nongsynshar ki la ïakynduh lang pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ïa U Messaïah jong u .’

translation.en: And ye shall chase your enemies , and they shall fall before you by the sword .
translation.kha: Phin long ki nongjop pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ;

translation.en: And so was also James , and John , the sons of Zebedee , which were partners with Simon . And Jesus said unto Simon ,  Fear not  ; from henceforth thou shalt catch men .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka la long ïa ki paralok jong u Simon , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . U Jisu u la ong ha u Simon ,  Wat sheptieng ; naduh mynta men long u nongtong briew .

translation.en: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingshah shitom kiba phi ïohi da la ki khmat kin pynlamwir ïa phi .

translation.en: And command ye them , saying , Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan , out of the place where the priests  feet stood firm , twelve stones , and ye shall carry them over with you , and leave them in the lodging place , where ye shall lodge this night .
translation.kha: bad hukum ïa ki ban shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , na kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki lyngdoh ki la ïeng . Ong ïa ki ban bah ïa kine ki maw bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba kin sah ha kata ka miet .

translation.en: For the grave cannot praise thee , death can not celebrate thee : they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap uba lah ban ïaroh ïa me ; uba ïap un ym lah ban shaniah ha ka jinglonghok jong me .

translation.en: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm , even in anger , and in fury , and in great wrath .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa me da ka borbah jong nga baroh , da ka jingdom jong nga , da ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad da ka jingingkhong khait jong nga .

translation.en: To deliver their soul from death , and to keep them alive in famine .
translation.kha: U pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingïap ; u ri pynim ïa ki ha ki por ka  nemsniew .

translation.en: Son of man , take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt , and say unto him , Thou art like a young lion of the nations , and thou art as a whale in the seas : and thou camest forth with thy rivers , and troubledst the waters with thy feet , and fouledst their rivers .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ai ka jingmaham bakyntang ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na nga : Me leh kum u sing hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hynrei me long kum u kuratia uba pashait um ha wah . Me pynjngut ïa ka um da ki kjat jong me bad me pyntngit ïa ki wah .

translation.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow : but I will see you again , and your heart shall rejoice , and your joy no man taketh from you .
translation.kha: Kumta kan long bad phi : Mynta phi ïasngewsih , hynrei ngan sa wan khmih pat ïa phi , bad ki dohnud jong phi kin dap da ka jingkmen ; ka jingkmen kaba yn ym don uba lah ban shim noh na phi .

translation.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth , and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way .
translation.kha: U pynlong kiba bieit ïa ki nongïalam jong ki bad u shah ba kin shang kylleng ha ka jingkulmar bad jah lynti ;

translation.en: And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled , saying , How soon is the fig tree withered away !
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la lyngngoh ,  Kumno u dieng Dumbur u tyrkhong stet katta katta ?  Ki la kylli .

translation.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead , and spake unto the sons of Heth , saying ,
translation.kha: U la mihnoh na ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ka metïap jong ka tnga jong u , u la leit sha ki Hit , bad u ong ,

translation.en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la tip ïa kata bad u phah ïa u Joab pyrshah ïa ki lem bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .

translation.en: O come , let us worship and bow down : let us kneel before the  Lord  our maker .
translation.kha: Ale , to ngin ïadem ngon bad mane ïa u ; to ngin ïadem khohsiew ha khmat U  Trai  , U Nongthaw jong ngi !

translation.en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead , they mourned for Aaron thirty days , even all the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U paidlang baroh u la tip ba u Aaron u la ïap , bad ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u haduh u laiphew sngi .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram , out of the mountains of the east , saying , Come , curse me Jacob , and come , defy Israel .
translation.kha: U Balaam u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  U Balak u syiem Moab u la wan ïalam ïa nga Na Syria , na ki lum mihngi . ‘ Ale kren lem na ka bynta jong nga ,’ u ong . ‘ Buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel .’

translation.en: Insomuch that the multitude wondered , when they saw the dumb to speak , the maimed to be whole , the lame to walk , and the blind to see : and they glorified the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la lyngngoh haba ki la ïohi ba ki bymnang kren ki kren , kiba khrew ki koit , kiba dkoh ki ïaid , bad kiba matlah ki ïohi , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka Israel .

translation.en: And they said one to another , Let us make a captain , and let us return into Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  To ngin jied uwei u nongïalam , bad ngin ïaleit phai pat sha Ijipt !

translation.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit  ; let no man stay him .
translation.kha: U briew uba shah pynrem ba u pynïap briew u tih ïa la ka jong ka jingtep kloi katba lah . Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u .

translation.en: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man s table : moreover the dogs came and licked his sores .
translation.kha: da ka jingkyrmen ban bam ïa ki lyngkhot jingbam kiba hap na ka miej jong u riewspah . Wat ki ksew ki ju wan bad jliah ïa ki prum jong u .

translation.en: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod , before it .
translation.kha: bad ki teh ïa ki tduh jong ki ha kita ki ar tylli ki shrong , bad ki pynsnoh ïa ki sha khmat ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod

translation.en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food : we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks .
translation.kha: Ngi la wanrah ruh kham bun ki pisa ban thied jingbam shuh . Ngim tip satia mano ba la buh biang ïa ki pisa jong ngi ha ki byrni jong ngi .

translation.en: Behold , I stand by the well of water  ; and it shall come to pass , that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her , Give me , I pray thee , a little water of thy pitcher to drink  ;
translation.kha: Mynta nga don hangne harud kane ka pukri . Haba ka samla ka wan ban tong um , ngan ong ha ka ba kan ai um ba ngan dih ïa nga na u khiew um jong ka .

translation.en: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up ,
translation.kha: Haba u Gideon u la wan phai na ka thma na ka lynti ka Khim Heres ,

translation.en: Before the decree bring forth , before the day pass as the chaff , before the fierce anger of the  Lord  come upon you , before the day of the  Lord s  anger come upon you .
translation.kha: ha shuwa ba yn beh noh ïa pha kum ïa u stait ba la beh noh da ka lyer , ha shuwa ba ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai  ka wan halor jong pha , ha shuwa ka sngi ha kaba u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u .

translation.en: And when the voice was past , Jesus was found alone . And they kept it close , and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen .
translation.kha: Haba ka sur ka la sangeh , la don tang U Jisu hi marwei . Ki synran jong u ki la sngap jar shaphang kane baroh , bad kim shym ïathuh hano hano ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la lah ïohi .

translation.en: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall , swelling out in a high wall , whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant .
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la shah pynrem . Phi long kum ka kynroh kaba jrong kaba don jingorpait naduh jrong haduh tbian ; kynsan kynsan phin sa kyllon .

translation.en: But the  Lord  sent out a great wind into the sea , and there was a mighty tempest in the sea , so that the ship was like to be broken .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka lyer kaba jur ha ka duriaw , bad ka  erïong ka la long kaba khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ka liengbah ka don ha ka jingma jong ka jingpait jingpra .

translation.en: For Herod had laid hold on John , and bound him , and put him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife .
translation.kha: Naba u Herod u la lah hukum mynshuwa ban kem ïa u Ïoannis , bad u la phah teh kynjri bad set byndi ïa u . U la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ka tnga jong u Philip u para jong u .

translation.en: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u tap ïa ka Ïingjaiñ baroh kawei , bad ka burom batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka pyndap ïa ka .

translation.en: Evil men understand not judgment : but they that seek the  Lord  understand all things .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kim sngewthuh kaei ka jinglehhok , hynrei kito kiba mane ïa U  Trai  ki sngewthuh bha ïa ka .

translation.en: But whatsoever hath a blemish , that shall ye not offer : for it shall not be acceptable for you .
translation.kha: Lada phi ainguh da u jingri uba don kano kano ka jingduna , U  Trai  un ym pdiang .

translation.en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour , and every one to his brother , What hath the  Lord  answered ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Pynban , uwei pa uwei un kylli ïa la ki paralok bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , ‘ Kaei ka jubab kaba U  Trai  u la ai ? Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren ?’

translation.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him , and declare unto you , that God is light , and in him is no darkness at all .
translation.kha: Mynta ka khubor ïa kaba ngi la ïohsngew na U Khun jong u bad pynbna ha phi ka long kane : U Blei u long ka jingshai bad ha u ka jingdum kam don satia .

translation.en: And his lord was wroth , and delivered him to the tormentors , till he should pay all that was due unto him .
translation.kha: U Syiem u la bitar lep , bad u la phah ïa uta u shakri sha byndi ba yn pynshitom ïa u tad haduh ba un da siew pat ïa ka ram baroh .

translation.en: And Shimei said unto the king , The saying is good : as my lord the king hath said , so will thy servant do . And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ko Syiem Kynrad ,  u Shimei u jubab .  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi ong .  Kumta u la sah slem bha ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened , their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah ki pyndap ïa ki khiew shet jong ki da u kpu bakhlem thiat , ki song ïa ki ha ki jaiñ , bad ki bah ïa ki ha la ki tyrpeng .

translation.en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . O ye house of Israel , I will judge you every one after his ways .
translation.kha: Hynrei ko Israel phi ong , ba kaei kaba Nga leh kam long kaba dei . Ngan bishar ïa phi da kaei ba phi leh .

translation.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it  ; it shall not be put out : and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning , and lay the burnt offering in order upon it  ; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ding halor ka duwan dei ban ïai pynmeh bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip noh . Man la ka step u lyngdoh un buh diengïap ha ka , un pynbeit ïa ka jingainguh thang halor jong ka , bad un thang ruh ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah , Thou shalt not do this thing : for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Gedalaïah u la jubab ,  Wat leh ïa kata ! Kaei kaba phi ong shaphang u Ishmael kam long kaba shisha !

translation.en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba hynñiew la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Dan .

translation.en: So Naomi returned , and Ruth the Moabitess , her daughter in law , with her , which returned out of the country of Moab : and they came to Beth–lehem in the beginning of barley harvest .
translation.kha: Kumne keiñ , kumno ba ka Naomi ka wan phai pat na Moab lem bad ka Ruth , ka pyrsa kurim nong Moab . Ka dei hamar ba sdang ka por ot barli ba ki wan poi ha Bethlehem .

translation.en: Now , thou son of man , take up a lamentation for Tyre  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to rwai ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta ka Tyros ,

translation.en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God . For it is written , He taketh the wise in their own craftiness .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingstad pyrthei , ka long ka jingibieit ha khmat U Blei . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pynngat ïa kiba stad ha ki buit jong ki ;

translation.en: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue .
translation.kha: Ka barandi kaba dei ban kup hapoh ka ephod , ka dei ban long kaba da u  saiwul uba jngum .

translation.en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people  ; ( for he was above all the people  ; ) and when he opened it , all the people stood up :
translation.kha: Katba u Esra u ïeng hangta ha ka jaka bakynjang ba kham hajrong ïa u paidbah , ki khmat jong ki , ki peit beit sha u . Tang shu plied ïa ka kitab , baroh ki ïa-ïeng .

translation.en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters , whom thou hast borne unto me , and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured . Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter ,
translation.kha: Nangta pha la shim ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei kiba pha la kha ïa nga bad pha la ainguh ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ha ki bleithaw . Hato kam shym long kaba sniew eh ban ym ïaineh ha nga ,

translation.en: And Elimelech Naomi s husband died  ; and she was left , and her two sons .
translation.kha: u Elimelekh u la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh marwei bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka ,

translation.en: And the contention was so sharp between them , that they departed asunder one from the other : and so Barnabas took Mark , and sailed unto Cyprus  ;
translation.kha: La don ka jingïania kaba tyngeh , bad ki la ïakhlad paralok : U Barnabas u la ïalam ïa u Markos bad u la leit da ka lieng sha Sypros ,

translation.en: And said unto him , Art thou he that should come , or do we look for another ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la kylli ïa u Jisu ,  phi long ma phi uta uba dei ban wan , ne ngin ïakhmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?

translation.en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him , saying , Go and wash in Jordan seven times , and thy flesh shall come again to thee , and thou shalt be clean .
translation.kha: U Elisha u phah ïa u shakri ban ong ha u ban leit bad sait ïa lade hynñiew sien ha ka wah Jordan , bad un ïohkhiah phar na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: So let all thine enemies perish , O  Lord  : but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might . And the land had rest forty years .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongshun jong me baroh kin ïap kumta , A  Trai hynrei ai ba ki paralok jong me kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi kaba mih ! Bad la don ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin , and have omitted the weightier matters of the law , judgment , mercy , and faith : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kaba shiphew wat jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina , u dill , bad u kumin , hynrei phim suidñiew ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai badonkam shisha jong ka Hukum , kum ka jinglehhok bad ka jingisynei bad ka jingbeit . Ïa kine phi dei ban leh , khlem da klet ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Restore , I pray you , to them , even this day , their lands , their vineyards , their oliveyards , and their houses , also the hundredth part of the money , and of the corn , the wine , and the oil , that ye exact of them .
translation.kha: Map noh ïa ki ram kiba ki shah ïa phi — ka pisa , u kew , ka waiñ lane ka umphniang Olib . Pynphai noh shisyndon sha ki ïa ki pynthor , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki khlaw Olib bad ki ïing !

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jotham u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee , and consider thee , saying , Is this the man that made the earth to tremble , that did shake kingdoms  ;
translation.kha: Kiba ïap kin peit seh bad ang ïa me . Kin kylli , ‘ Hato une u dei u briew uba la pynkhih ïa ka pyrthei bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki hima ?

translation.en: For even when we were with you , this we commanded you , that if any would not work , neither should he eat .
translation.kha: Mynba ngi dang don bad phi , ngi ju ïathuh ïa phi ,  Ïa uno uno uba kyntait ban trei yn ym shah ba un bam .

translation.en: And the king said unto Barzillai , Come thou over with me , and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Ale bad nga ha Jerusalem , bad ngan khmih sumar ïa phi .

translation.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart , that I might not sin against thee .
translation.kha: Nga ri khop ïa ka hukum jong me ha la ka dohnud , khnang ba ngan ym leh pop pyrshah ïa me .

translation.en: And those members of the body , which we think to be less honourable , upon these we bestow more abundant honour ; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness .
translation.kha: bad kito ki dkhot met kiba ngi pyrkhat ba kim da myntoi eh , ki long kita kiba ngi dei ban kham sumar ; katba ïa ki dkhot jong ka met ki bym da itynnat eh la kham pynitynnat , ïa kiba ïa ki dkhot met kiba itynnat kim da donkam ïa kane .

translation.en: For what hath the wise more than the fool ? what hath the poor , that knoweth to walk before the living ?
translation.kha: Kumno kiba stad ki kham bit kham biang ban ïa ki bieit ? Kaba bha aïu ïa uba duk ban tip kumno ban ïaksaid ha ka jingim ?

translation.en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council , and bound Jesus , and carried him away , and delivered him to Pilate .
translation.kha: Dang step eh ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh kyrkieh bad ki rangbah nongïalam , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ïa ka Dorbar baroh kawei , bad ki la shna ïa ki jingthmu jong ki . Ki la teh kynjri ïa U Jisu , ki la ïalam noh ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u sha u Pilat .

translation.en: Who hath believed our report ? and to whom is the arm of the  Lord  revealed ?
translation.kha: Ki briew ki jubab ,  Uei uba lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba ngi ïathuh mynta ? Uei uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka kti U  Trai  ha kane ?

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye sought me ? wist ye not that I must be about my Father s business ?
translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki ,  Balei ba phi dei ban wad ïa nga ? Hato phim tip ba nga dei ban don ha ka ïing jong U Kpa jong nga ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when our enemies heard that it was known unto us , and God had brought their counsel to nought , that we returned all of us to the wall , every one unto his work .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki ïohsngew ba ngi la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïasylla , bad ki sngewthuh ba U Blei u la jop ïa ki jingthmu jong ki . Nangta ma ngi baroh ngi leit biang ban tei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: Let no man despise thy youth ; but be thou an example of the believers , in word , in conversation , in charity , in spirit , in faith , in purity .
translation.kha: Wat ai ïano ïano ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me namar ba me long uba dang samla , hynrei to long ka nuksa ïa ki bangeit ha ka ktien , ha ka jinglong jingim , ha ka jingieit , ha ka jingngeit , bad ka jinglongkhuid jong me .

translation.en: And I saw the beast , and the kings of the earth , and their armies , gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse , and against his army .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , bad ïa kita ki kynhun shipai jong ki , kiba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba la shong halor u kulai bad pyrshah ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u .

translation.en: But it shall not be well with the wicked , neither shall he prolong his days , which are as a shadow  ; because he feareth not before God .
translation.kha: hynrei kan ym long bha ïa ki bymman . Ka jingim jong ki ka long kum ka syrngiew , bad kin ïap haba ki dang samla , namar ba kim kohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them .
translation.kha: Haba ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la bitar shla haduh katta katta ba ki la kwah ban phah pynïap ïa ki apostol .

translation.en: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord : and one said unto him , Is all well ? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee ? And he said unto them , Ye know the man , and his communication .
translation.kha: U Jehu u leit phai sha la ki para rangbah shipai , ki kylli ïa u ,  Ka bit ka biang baroh ? Kaei kaba uto u khleh bieit u kwah na phi ?  U Jehu u jubab ,  Phi tip ïa kaei kaba u kwah .

translation.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest , but to them that believed not ?
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ,  Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ïa ki ïa ka jingjahthait  — ïano u kren ? Ïa kita kiba la ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And Joshua called for them , and he spake unto them , saying , Wherefore have ye beguiled us , saying , We are very far from you  ; when ye dwell among us ?
translation.kha: U Joshua u hukum ba yn wallam ha u ïa ki briew jong ka Gibeon , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi shukor ïa ngi bad ïathuh ha ngi ba phi dei kiba na sha jngai , haba phi shong phi sah hangne ?

translation.en: The pins of the tabernacle , and the pins of the court , and their cords ,
translation.kha: ïa ki snar bad ki tyllai jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad ka phyllaw jong ka ;

translation.en: And he bought a parcel of a field , where he had spread his tent , at the hand of the children of Hamor , Shechem s father , for an hundred pieces of money .
translation.kha: U la thied ïa kata ka bynta jong ka madan na ki khun ki siew jong u Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .

translation.en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phah sha u baroh ka rupa na ka Templ bad na ka jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem ;

translation.en: Behold , he findeth occasions against me , he counteth me for his enemy ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem daw ban pyrshah ïa nga bad ban ñiew ïa nga kum u nongshun .

translation.en: And no marvel ; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light .
translation.kha: Ngin lyngngoh lei ïa kata ? Wat u Soitan hi u lah ban thawdur ïa lade ban paw kum u angel ka jingshai !

translation.en: And he left the oxen , and ran after Elijah , and said , Let me , I pray thee , kiss my father and my mother , and then I will follow thee . And he said unto him , Go back again : for what have I done to thee ?
translation.kha: U Elisha u la iehnoh ïa ki masi dab jong u , u la mareh nadien u Elijah , bad u ong ,  Shah ïa nga ba ngan leit doh bad khublei shuwa ïa i pa bad i mei , bad hadien kata ngan sa leit bad phi .  U Elijah u la jubab ,  Phi lah ban leit . Ngam khang ïa phi .

translation.en: Wise men lay up knowledge : but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction .
translation.kha: Kiba stad ki ïoh ïa ka jingtip baroh kaba ki lah ; hynrei haba kiba bieit ki kren , ka jingkulmar ka mih .

translation.en: They change the night into day : the light is short because of darkness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paralok jong nga ki ong ba ka por mynmiet ka dei ka por mynsngi ; ki ong ba ka jingshai ka don hajan , hynrei nga tip nga don ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah laiphew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him , and to every seed his own body .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyndap ïa uta u symbai da ka met kat kumba u sngewbha ; ha uwei pa uwei u symbai ïa la ka met .

translation.en: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn , or of thy wine , or of thy oil , or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock , nor any of thy vows which thou vowest , nor thy freewill offerings , or heave offering of thine hand :
translation.kha: Phim bit ban bam ha ki jaka ba phi shong ïa kata kaba phi wanrah sha U  Trai  , la ka dei kaba shiphew na u kew , na ka waiñ , ne na ka umphniang Olib jong phi ; lane kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi , ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular ha U  Trai  , ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi , lane kiwei kiwei pat ki jingainguh .

translation.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance , and your burden , and your strife ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno tang ma nga marwei nga lah ban kit ïa ka jingkitkhlieh kaba khia ha kaba bishar bad rai ïa ki kam ïakajia hapdeng jong phi ?

translation.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin , he clappeth his hands among us , and multiplieth his words against God .
translation.kha: Ha ki pop jong u , u pyndap da ka jingïaleh pyrshah ; ha khmat jong ngi baroh u beiñ ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And one of his servants said , None , my lord , O king : but Elisha , the prophet that is in Israel , telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u jubab ,  Ko syiem kynrad , ym don uwei ruh . U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u ïathuh ha u syiem ka Israel ïa kaei kaba phi ong wat ha kaba rieh hapoh ka kamra jong phi .

translation.en: And after this , Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre : the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Te u Abraham u la tep ïa ka Sarah ka tnga jong u ha kata ka krem ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And he said , Come with me , and see my zeal for the  Lord . So they made him ride in his chariot .
translation.kha: da kaba ong ,  Wan bad nga bad khmih da lade haduh katno nga long uba la aiti ha U  Trai .  Bad ki la ïashong lang haduh Samaria .

translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  said to Elijah the Tishbite , Arise , go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria , and say unto them , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel , that ye go to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u angel U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Elijah , u nongïathuhlypa na Tishbe , ban leit bad ïashem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad ban kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi leit ban kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron ? Hato ka dei namar ba phi pyrkhat ba ym don blei ha Israel ?

translation.en: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God .
translation.kha: To pyndem ïa lade iwei ha iwei pat namar ka jingsheptieng burom jong phi ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: The right hand of the  Lord  is exalted : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong u ka la wanrah jingjop ïa ngi — ka borbah jong u ha ka thma !

translation.en: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly , who are of thee , to whom the reproach of it was a burden .
translation.kha: kumba kmen ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .  U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynkut ïa ka jingbyrngem ïa ka jingtim bad weng noh ïa ka jinglehrain jong pha .

translation.en: A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish man despiseth his mother .
translation.kha: Ki khun kiba stad ki pynlong ïa ki kpa jong ki ban kmen . Tang kiba bieit ki ñiewbeiñ ïa la ki kmie .

translation.en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry , Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal . And he brought them forth vestments .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u hukum ïa u lyngdoh ba dei khmih ïa ki jaiñkup bakyntang , ban sei shabar ïa ki jaiñkup bad ban ai ïa ki ha ki nongmane .

translation.en: And she called unto her husband , and said , Send me , I pray thee , one of the young men , and one of the asses , that I may run to the man of God , and come again .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khot ïa la u tnga , bad ka ong ha u ,  Phah ïa u shakri hangne lem bad ka kada . Nga donkam ban leit sha u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa . Ngan wan phai kloi katba nga lah .

translation.en: For their heart studieth destruction , and their lips talk of mischief .
translation.kha: Ka jingthaw kulmar ka long baroh ba ki ju pyrkhat ; man la ka por ba ki ang la ki shyntur don mano re mano ban shah pynmong .

translation.en: And Saul came to a city of Amalek , and laid wait in the valley .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha ka nongbah ki Amalek bad ki apthap ha ka phud wah baryngkhiang .

translation.en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin : and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel , and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin .
translation.kha: U Abner u la kren ruh ha ki briew jong ka jait Benjamin , bad nangta u leit sha Hebron ban ïathuh ha u Dabid aïu ki paid Benjamin bad Israel ki la mynjur ban leh .

translation.en: A widow , or a divorced woman , or profane , or an harlot , these shall he not take : but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife .
translation.kha: ym ïa ka riewkynthei , lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , lane kaba la ïaid nuti . Un shongkurim tang bad ka theisotti kaba na ka jait jong u ,

translation.en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .

translation.en: Which way did you come ?
translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti phi wan ?

translation.en: And to you who are troubled rest with us , when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels ,
translation.kha: bad un ai ka jingpyllait ha phi kiba shahshitom bad ha ngi ruh kumjuh . Un leh ïa kane haba U Trai Jisu u mihpaw na bneng lem bad ki angel bakhlaiñbor jong u ,

translation.en: Are ye so foolish ? having begun in the Spirit , are ye now made perfect by the flesh ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi dang sah bieit haduh katta katta! Haba phi la sdang da U Mynsiem U Blei , mynta phi kwah pat ban pynkut da la ka bor hi ?

translation.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence : shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits , and live ?
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki kpa jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei , ki sneng sympat ïa ngi bad ngi burom ïa ki . Katno tam , te , ngi dei ban pyndem ha U Kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi bad ïoh im .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Take heed that no man deceive you .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  To sumar , bad wat shah ïano ïano ruh ban shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land , a sabbath for the  Lord  : thou shalt neither sow thy field , nor prune thy vineyard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew dei ban shu ieh ïa ka khyndew khlem rep , namar ka long ka snem ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ; wat bet ha ki lyngkha jong phi ne khyllad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi .

translation.en: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah , saying , Pray now unto the  Lord  our God for us .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la phah ïa u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah ban ong ïa nga ban duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .

translation.en: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing , he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u tip ei ei , ha ka jingshisha um tip kumba u dei ban tip .

translation.en: For ye have brought hither these men , which are neither robbers of churches , nor yet blasphemers of your goddess .
translation.kha: Phi la wan ïalam ïa kine ki briew hangne , wat haba kim shym la lute ïa ki templ lane ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang ka blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour , they received every man a penny .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah kiba la sdang ban trei ha ka por san baje la ai mar shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: And they brought every man his present , vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and garments , and armour , and spices , horses , and mules , a rate year by year .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew uba wan u wallam ïa u ka jingai sngewbha — ki tiar kiba da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki barandi , ki tiar ïapom , ki jingiwbih , ki kulai , bad ki khashor . Kane ka ïailong kumta man ka snem .

translation.en: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him : thou spakest also with thy mouth , and hast fulfilled it with thine hand , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Me la bat ïa la ka kular kaba me la pynlong ha u Dabid u kpa jong nga ; mynta ha kane ka sngi kawei pa kawei ka ktien me la pyndep ïa ka .

translation.en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .
translation.kha: Ka kmierad jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Absalom .

translation.en: For , lo , I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country : and they shall set themselves in array against her  ; from thence she shall be taken : their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man  ; none shall return in vain .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhih ïa ka kynhun ki hima kiba khlaiñ shaphang shatei bad pynlong ïa ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia . Kin ïeng ryntih ban ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka ri bad ban jop ïa ka . Ki long ki nongbeh mrad batbit , kiba siat khnam bym ju lait na ka sohpdung .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and Aaron , This is the ordinance of the passover : There shall no stranger eat thereof :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait : U nongwei um bit ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ïadei bad ka Niam Ka Jinglait ;

translation.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph s name Zaphenath–paneah  ; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On . And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la ai kyrteng nong Ijipt ïa u Joseph da ka kyrteng Saphenath Paneah , bad u la ai ha u ka tnga , ka Asenath , ka khun jong u Potiphera , u lyngdoh ha ka nongbah Heliopolis .

translation.en: And thou hast said unto me , O Lord  God  , Buy thee the field for money , and take witnesses  ; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Pynban , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , me long ma me uba la hukum ïa nga ban thied ïa ka lyngkha ha ka jingdon lang ki sakhi , wat la ka nongbah ka la jan shah kurup ha ki nong Babilonia .

translation.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife , the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan–aram , the sister to Laban the Syrian .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la sawphew snem ka rta mynba u shongkurim ïa ka Rebekka , ka khun jong u Bethuel ( u nong Aram na ka ri Mesopotamia ) bad ka para jong u Laban .

translation.en: They shall not labour in vain , nor bring forth for trouble  ; for they are the seed of the blessed of the  Lord  , and their offspring with them .
translation.kha: Ki jingtrei ba kin trei kin manbha , bad ki khun jong ki kin ym mad ïa ka jingjynjar . Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ha ki por ki ban wan baroh .

translation.en: Are they not all ministering spirits , sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation ?
translation.kha: Ki angel ki dei kiei , te ? Ki dei ki mynsiem kiba shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ki la phah da u ban ïarap ïa kito kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  went his way , as soon as he had left communing with Abraham : and Abraham returned unto his place .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la dep ïakren bad u Abraham , U  Trai  u la leit noh , bad u Abraham u leit phai sha la ïing .

translation.en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me halor u lum .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Let the  Lord  be so with you , as I will let you go , and your little ones : look to it  ; for evil is before you .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u ong ,  Nga smai da U  Trai  ba lano lano ruh ngan ym shah ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong phi ! Ka paw shai mynta ba phi don ka jingïasylla ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: O  Lord  God of Abraham , Isaac , and of Israel , our fathers , keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people , and prepare their heart unto thee :
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ki la buh ïa kum kane ka jingmane kaba khlaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ki briew jong me bad ki ïai pynlong ïa ki ban ïaineh ha me .

translation.en: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan : and Saul sware , As the  Lord  liveth , he shall not be slain .
translation.kha: U Saul u la sngewïahap ïa kaba u Jonathan u ong bad u smai ha ka Kyrteng U  Trai  ba un ym pynïap ïa u Dabid .

translation.en: Who art thou that judgest another man s servant ? to his own master he standeth or falleth . Yea , he shall be holden up : for God is able to make him stand .
translation.kha: Phi dei uei ban bishar ïa u shakri jong uwei pat ? U dei u Kynrad jong u hi u ban rai lada un jop ne un rem . Bad un jop , namar U Trai u lah ban pynlah ïa u ban jop .

translation.en: And ye shall dwell with us : and the land shall be before you  ; dwell and trade ye therein , and get you possessions therein .
translation.kha: Nangta phi lah ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka ri jong ngi ; phi lah ban shong ban sah hangno hangno kat ha kaba phi kwah , phi lah ban khaïi laitluid , bad ban don la ka jong ka jaka ka puta .

translation.en: And Avim , and Parah , and Ophrah ,
translation.kha: ka Abbim , ka Parah , ka Ophrah ,

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  It is written again , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ruh , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me .’

translation.en: In the way of righteousness is life  ; and in the pathway thereof there is no death .
translation.kha: Ka hok ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim ; ka jingbymman ka long ka lynti sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: Thus did Noah  ; according to all that God commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Noah u la leh ïa kata baroh kat kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: For ye shall go out with joy , and be led forth with peace : the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing , and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands .
translation.kha: Phin mihnoh na Babilon da ka jingkmen ; yn ïalam ïa phi shabar ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk . Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin sawa da ka jingrwai , bad ki dieng kin pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: There was then no king in Edom : a deputy was king .
translation.kha: Ka ri Edom kam shym la don syiem ; la synshar ïa ka da u lyngskor uba la thung da u syiem Judah .

translation.en: Unto whom David said , If thou passest on with me , then thou shalt be a burden unto me :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Lada phi wan bad nga , kan ym ïarap ei ei ïa nga ;

translation.en: If any man think himself to be a prophet , or spiritual , let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew pyrkhat ba u long u nonglamktien jong U Blei , u dei ban tip ba kaei kaba nga thoh sha phi ka long ka hukum U Trai .

translation.en: And that servant , which knew his lord s will , and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will , shall be beaten with many stripes .
translation.kha: U shakri uba tip aïu u kynrad jong u , u kwah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u bym shym la pynkloi ïa lade bad leh ïa ka , un shah pynshitom da ka jingsympat kaba jur .

translation.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife : and Jacob went in unto her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka ai ïa ka Bilhah ha u tnga jong ka , bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .

translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua lem bad ka kynhun shipai , u leit phai pat sha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal .

translation.en: Hold your peace , let me alone , that I may speak , and let come on me what will .
translation.kha: Sngap jar bad ailad ïa nga ban kren , bad to ai ba ki jingmih nangta kin long kumba ki long .

translation.en: And of Benjamin he said , The beloved of the  Lord  shall dwell in safety by him  ; and the  Lord  shall cover him all the day long , and he shall dwell between his shoulders .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Benjamin u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jait ba U  Trai  u ieit bad ïada ; U ïada ïa ki baroh shi sngi , Bad u shong hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: This evil people , which refuse to hear my words , which walk in the imagination of their heart , and walk after other gods , to serve them , and to worship them , shall even be as this girdle , which is good for nothing .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew basniew ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga . Ki la long kiba mutlop bad bymman kumba ki la ju long , bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei ki blei . Kumta te , ki la long kum kine ki patlun lyngkot ki bym long shuh ban pyndonkam .

translation.en: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish , and said unto their brethren , Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod , and teraphim , and a graven image , and a molten image ? now therefore consider what ye have to do .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki rangbah san ngut kiba la leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri sawdong ka Laish ki ong ha la ki paralok ,  Hato phi tip ba hangne ha kawei na kine ki ïing ka don ka bleithaw da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa ? Ki don ruh kiwei ki bleithaw bad ka ephod . Kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngin leh ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux : to whom Paul entered in , and prayed , and laid his hands on him , and healed him .
translation.kha: Ka jingdonkam u briew ïa ka jingpynim

translation.en: And said , Hitherto shalt thou come , but no further : and here shall thy proud waves be stayed ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ka ,  Haduh hangne phan ïoh poi , bad ym palat ! Hangne ki jingat phyllung bakhlaiñ jong pha ki dei ban sangeh .

translation.en: When therefore he was risen from the dead , his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them  ; and they believed the scripture , and the word which Jesus had said .
translation.kha: Kumta haba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ki synran jong u ki la kynmaw ba u la lah ong ïa kane , bad ki la ngeit ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain , and his soul within him shall mourn .
translation.kha: U sngew tang ïa ka jingpang ha ka met jong u hi bad ki jingkhuslai ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u .

translation.en: But cleave unto the  Lord  your God , as ye have done unto this day .
translation.kha: Pynban , to ïaineh ha U  Trai  , kumba phi la leh haduh mynta .

translation.en: For afore the harvest , when the bud is perfect , and the sour grape is ripening in the flower , he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks , and take away and cut down the branches .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba yn lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , haba ki syntiew ki la hap lut bad ba ki sohwaiñ ki la ih , u nongshun un pynjot ïa ki nong Sudan da kaba suk kumba ka tari ka ot ïa ki tnat na u dieng sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And the feast of harvest , the firstfruits of thy labours , which thou hast sown in the field : and the feast of ingathering , which is in the end of the year , when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phi sdang ban ot .  Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka por synrai , haba phi kheit ïa u soh na ki brisoh jong phi .

translation.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers , against the chief of the butlers , and against the chief of the bakers .
translation.kha: U la bitar eh ïa ki ,

translation.en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers  ; that they do not rise , nor possess the land , nor fill the face of the world with cities .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingpynïap kan sdang ! Ki khun shynrang jong une u syiem kin ïap namar ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ym don mano mano na ki u ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei lane tap ïa ka da ki nongbah .

translation.en: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease  ; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkut noh ïa ki jingrwai jong pha baroh , bad ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki sur tem na ki duitara jong pha .

translation.en: And a certain woman , which had an issue of blood twelve years ,
translation.kha: La don ka briew kaba don ka jingpang mihsnam kaba jur la khat-ar snem ,

translation.en: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain , so was the appearance of the brightness round about . This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the  Lord . And when I saw it , I fell upon my face , and I heard a voice of one that spake .
translation.kha: Ka shai baroh sawdong da ka jingshai kaba phyrnai kaba don lut ha ka baroh ki rong jong u simpyllieng . Kane ka long ka jingshai kaba thaba kaba pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Haba nga la ïohi ïa kane , nga kyllon kram da pyllup ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: Remember these , O Jacob and Israel  ; for thou art my servant : I have formed thee  ; thou art my servant : O Israel , thou shalt not be forgotten of me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel to kynmaw ïa kane ; kynmaw ba phi long u shakri jong nga . Nga la thaw ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , bad ngan ym klet ïa phi .

translation.en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the  Lord  , every man and woman , whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work , which the  Lord  had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel baroh , shynrang bad kynthei , kiba sngewkynduh ki wallam mon sngewbha ïa ka jingainguh jong ki sha U  Trai  na ka bynta kata ka kam kaba u la hukum ïa u Moses ban leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Write this for a memorial in a book , and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua : for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh ha ka jingthoh shaphang kane ka jingjop ban pynsah jingkynmaw . Ïathuh ruh ha u Joshua ba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek .

translation.en: Even all nations shall say , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land ? what meaneth the heat of this great anger ?
translation.kha: Te ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan sa kylli , ‘ Balei keiñ U  Trai  u la leh haduh katne ïa ka ri jong ki ? Na ka daw aïu mo ba u bitar shla haduh katne ?’

translation.en: And Judah spake unto him , saying , The man did solemnly protest unto us , saying , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Judah u ong ha u ,  Uta u briew u la maham tyngeh ïa ngi ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don ryngkat lem bad ngi .

translation.en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper , as he sat at meat , there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious  ; and she brake the box , and poured it on his head .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing u Simon , u briew uba pang  ñiangthohlieh . Katba U Jisu u dang bam , kawei ka kynthei ka la wan shapoh ryngkat bad ka dabi alabastar ba la dap da ka jingsleh iwbih baremdor haduh katta katta na u nard bakynsai . Ka la pynpait ïa ka dabi bad ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka khlieh U Jisu .

translation.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment : and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity .
translation.kha: Kam don jingbishar hok ha kaba u sakhi u thmu ban pynmong ïano ïano . Ki riewbymman ki ieit ïa ka jingmad kaba sniew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down to see the city and the tower , which the children of men builded .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la wan hiar ban khmih ïa kata ka nongbah bad ïa uta u mot uba ki la lah tei ,

translation.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him : he is filled full with reproach .
translation.kha: La ngi la shah tied bad shah ibeiñ , ngi dei ban pdiang ïa ka baroh .

translation.en: There be the princes of the north , all of them , and all the Zidonians , which are gone down with the slain  ; with their terror they are ashamed of their might  ; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword , and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit .
translation.kha: Ki khun syiem baroh na shaphang shatei ki don hangta , bad kumta ruh ki nong Sidon . Ka bor jong ki shisien ka pynphriang ïa ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei mynta ki leit hiar ha ka jingjahburom bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma bad ki la thiah ha ka jingjahthait , khlem otsher . Ki ïoh bynta ïa ka jingjahburom bad kito kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Thus speak unto the Levites , and say unto them , When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance , then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the  Lord  , even a tenth part of the tithe .
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki Lebi ,  Haba phi ïohpdiang na ki Israel ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew ba U  Trai  u ai ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi , phi dei ban wanrah ïa kaba shiphew na kata kum ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad u thang ïa ka jingiwbih suhsieng halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water .
translation.kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa ka snam kum ka jingbam ; pynban , theh noh ïa ka ha ka khyndew kumba theh ïa ka um .

translation.en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest s office for every thing of the altar , and within the veil  ; and ye shall serve : I have given your priest s office unto you as a service of gift : and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phin pyndep ïa ka jingkitkhlieh ka jinglong lyngdoh kaba ïadei bad ka duwan bad kaei kaba don ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kine kiei kiei ki long ki jingkitkhlieh jong me , naba nga la ai ha me ïa ka kam lyngdoh kum ka jingai sngewbha . Uno uno uwei pat u briew u bym bit bym biang uba wan hajan kita ki tiar kiba kyntang un shah pynïap .

translation.en: And the beast was taken , and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him , with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast , and them that worshipped his image . These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone .
translation.kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la ring koidi , lem bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler uba la leh ki kambah ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . ( Ka la long da kito ki kambah ba u la shukor ïa kito kiba la don ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ïa kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u mradkhlaw . ) Ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler la bret im sha ka pung ding kaba klang da u kyndok .

translation.en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria , which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the  Lord  to anger , Josiah took away , and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth–el .
translation.kha: Ha man ka nongbah jong ka Israel , u syiem Josaïah u la pyntwa ïa baroh ki jaka mane thala kiba la tei da ki syiem Israel , kiba la pynkhih bitar ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa baroh kito ki duwan kumba u la leh ha Bethel .

translation.en: Let the priests take it to them , every man of his acquaintance : and let them repair the breaches of the house , wheresoever any breach shall be found .
translation.kha: Man u lyngdoh u dei ban kitkhlieh ïa ka pisa ba wanrah da kito kiba u shakri , bad ïa ka pisa dei ban pyndonkam ha kaba shna pynbha ïa ka Templ , katba donkam .

translation.en: I made haste , and delayed not to keep thy commandments .
translation.kha: Khlem pynslem nga la pynstet ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years , and begat Salah :
translation.kha: Haba u Arpakhshad u la dap laiphew san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Shelah ;

translation.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke  ; yet do I not forget thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga long u bymmyntoi kum ka lwa snieh waiñ ba la bret ; pynban ngam shym la klet ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob . Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount : and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sher dara halor u lum , bad u Laban u la sher dara lem bad la ki kur ki jait ha ka ri lum Gilead .

translation.en: By faith Jacob , when he was a dying , blessed both the sons of Joseph  ; and worshipped , leaning upon the top of his staff .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa U Jakob ha shuwa ba un ïap ban kyrkhu ïa uwei pa uwei u khun shynrang jong u Joseph . U la shan ha ka tduh u diengduh jong u bad u la mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses that selfsame day , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king s meat , nor with the wine which he drank : therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself .
