translation.kha: U Daniel u la kut jingmut ban ym shah ïa lade ban long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam da kaba bam ïa ka jingbam bad dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka ïingbishar syiem , kumta u la kyrpad ïa u Ashkenas ban ïarap ïa u ,

translation.en: But Naaman was wroth , and went away , and said , Behold , I thought , He will surely come out to me , and stand , and call on the name of the  Lord  his God , and strike his hand over the place , and recover the leper .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Naaman u la leit noh ha ka jingbitar , da kaba ong ,  Nga pyrkhat ba la kumno kumno un wan mih shabar sha nga , un duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , un khaweh ïa la ka kti halor ki jaka ba don jingpang , bad pynkhiah ïa nga !

translation.en: Let the work of this house of God alone  ; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place .
translation.kha: Wat don ha ka Templ bad wat tuklar ïa ka jingtei ïa ka . Ai ba u lat ka Judah bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw kin tei pat ïa ka Templ U Blei ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .

translation.en: And the princes of Succoth said , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thine army ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth ki ong ,  Balei ngin ai jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong phi ? Phim pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna .

translation.en: And goeth out from Beth–el to Luz , and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth ,
translation.kha: Na Bethel u suh sha Lus , da kaba ïaid ter ter sha Ataroth Addar , ha kaba shong ki Arkhit .

translation.en: Behold , their valiant ones shall cry without : the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba shlur ki pan jingïarap . Ki nongkit  tiensyiem kiba pyrshang ban wallam ka jingsuk ki ïam sngewsih kthang .

translation.en: If you know the answer to this question , please tell me .
translation.kha: Lada phi tip ka jubab iakane ka jingkylli , sngewbha iathuh ianga .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will hedge up thy way with thorns , and make a wall , that she shall not find her paths .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan kerkut ïa ka da ki bniap shiah , bad ngan tei da ka kynroh ban khang ïa ka lynti jong ka .

translation.en: Yea , ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath , and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah .
translation.kha: Ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ka jaka kaba shiphew hektar kin pynmih tang san gallon ka waiñ . Shiphew shang u symbai un pynmih tang shi shang u symbai .

translation.en: And Beth–arabah , and Zemaraim , and Beth–el ,
translation.kha: ka Beth Arabah , ka Semaraim , ka Bethel ,

translation.en: And what he hath seen and heard , that he testifieth  ; and no man receiveth his testimony .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi bad la ïohsngew , pynban ym don ba pdiang ïa ka khubor jong u .

translation.en: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew u bymkohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai baroh jong U Blei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: He therefore that despiseth , despiseth not man , but God , who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba kyntait ïa kane ka jinghikai , um kyntait ïa u briew , hynrei ïa U Blei , uba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u .

translation.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation , and said , Sirs , ye know that by this craft we have our wealth .
translation.kha: Kumta u la khot lang ïa ki baroh lem bad kiwei pat kiba ïatrei kum kajuh ka jingtrei bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ko rangbah , phi tip ba ka jingmanbha jong ngi ka wan na kane ka kam .

translation.en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom , and shall return into his own land .
translation.kha: u syiem ka Syria un hiarthma ïa ka Ijipt , hynrei un shah pynbor ban kynran .

translation.en: Now when Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan , the son of Saul , was come unto David , he fell on his face , and did reverence . And David said , Mephibosheth . And he answered , Behold thy servant !
translation.kha: Haba u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul , u wan poi , u la dem ngon ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom . U Dabid u ong ,  Mephibosheth !  bad u jubab ,  Nga hangne , ko Kynrad .

translation.en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka sngi hi ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïasylla ïa ka ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: ( 2 Peter 2 :4 ) Jehovah forbids trying to inquire of the dead . —Read Deuteronomy 18 :10 , 11 .
translation.kha: ( 2 Petros 2 :4 ) U Jehobah u khang pyrshah ïa ngi ban ïa kren bad kiba ïap .—Pule Deuteronomi 18 :10 , 11 .

translation.en: Because I have called , and ye refused  ; I have stretched out my hand , and no man regarded  ;
translation.kha: Nga ïai pyrta ïa phi , nga da khot sngewbha ba phin wan , hynrei phim sngap . Phim shahshkor satia ïa nga .

translation.en: And both Jesus was called , and his disciples , to the marriage .
translation.kha: Ka kmie U Jisu ka la don hangta bad ïa U Jisu bad ki synran ruh la khot sngewbha sha ka jingkyntiew kurim .

translation.en: And if ye take this also from me , and mischief befall him , ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
translation.kha: Lada phin shim noh na nga mynta sa ïa une , bad lada ka jia ei ei ïa u , ngan sa shu ïap sngewsih artat ba nga la tymmen .’

translation.en: We acknowledge , O  Lord  , our wickedness , and the iniquity of our fathers : for we have sinned against thee .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , A  Trai  ; ngi phla ïa la ki pop bad ïa ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: There is a league between me and thee , and between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold  ; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .
translation.kha: To ngin ïalong paralok , kumba la long ki kpa jong ngi . Kane ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ki jingai sngewbha ïa phi . Mynta , pyndkut noh ïa ka jingïadei paralok jong phi bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel , khnang ba un hap weng noh ïa ki shipai jong u na ka hima jong nga .

translation.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel , and said unto them , Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families , and kill the passover .
translation.kha: U Moses u khot ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi baroh phin jied ïa la u khunlangbrot ne u khunblang bad pynïap ïa u , khnang ba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kin ïoh ban rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: He increaseth the nations , and destroyeth them : he enlargeth the nations , and straiteneth them again .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki hima kiba khlaiñ bad kiba khraw , hynrei nangta u jop thiaw bad pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance to them .
translation.kha: Kaba bud harum ka long ka jingïathuh ba kumno ïa ka ri Kanaan kaba ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la pynbynta hapdeng ki paid Israel . U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad ki nongïalam jong ki longïing jong ki jait Israel ki pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng ki paidbah .

translation.en: Again , when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed , and doeth that which is lawful and right , he shall save his soul alive .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , u pyllait ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: How do the servants help the congregation to function smoothly ?
translation.kha: Kumno ki nongïarap ki ïarap ïa ka balang ba kan ïaid beit ?

translation.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms , yet do they imagine mischief against me .
translation.kha: Wat la dei ma nga uba pynheh pynsan bad pynlong ïa ki kiba khlaiñ , ki ïasuhbuit sniew pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof , and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it : for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee .
translation.kha: Katba nang bun snem , ka dor kan kham heh ; bad katba nang khyndiat ki snem , ka dor kan kham rit , namar la pynshongdor ïa ka khyndew ha ka jinglah ban pynmih bun ki soh .

translation.en: The small and great are there  ; and the servant is free from his master .
translation.kha: Baroh ki don hangta , kiba pawnam bad ki bym don ba ithuh , bad ki mraw , khatduh ki la laitluid .

translation.en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled , which he spake , signifying what death he should die .
translation.kha: ( Kane ka la jia , khnang ba ki ktien jong U Jisu kin urlong da shisha , ki ktien kiba u pyndonkam mynba u la pynpaw ïa ka jingïap kaba kumno u dei ban ïap . )

translation.en: Destruction upon destruction is cried  ; for the whole land is spoiled : suddenly are my tents spoiled , and my curtains in a moment .
translation.kha: Kawei ka jingjot ka bud hadien kawei pat , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la iehnoh ha ka jingjot . Kynsan kynsan la pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi , ïa ki pyrda jong ki la tar lyngkhot .

translation.en: Who by him do believe in God , that raised him up from the dead , and gave him glory  ; that your faith and hope might be in God .
translation.kha: Da u , phi ngeit ha U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap bad la ai ha u ïa ka burom ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit bad ka jingkyrmen jong phi la pynskhem ha U Blei .

translation.en: Therefore , they began searching for an understanding of the Bible’s original teachings , and Jehovah blessed them with spiritual insight .
translation.kha: Namarkata , ki la sdang ban wad ïa ka jingsngewthuh katkum ki jinghikai tynrai jong ka Baibl bad U Jehobah u la ïarap ïa ki ban sngewthuh ïa ka .

translation.en: That thou mayest bear thine own shame , and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done , in that thou art a comfort unto them .
translation.kha: Phan sngewlehrain ïa lade bad ka jingjahburom jong pha kan pyn-i ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha haduh katno ki long kiba bit babiang .

translation.en: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my work .
translation.kha: Hangta ki tynjuh bad ïit ïa nga , wat haba ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: But Abijah waxed mighty , and married fourteen wives , and begat twenty and two sons , and sixteen daughters .
translation.kha: U Abijah , pynban , u la nang kham khlaiñbor . U la don khatsaw ngut ki tnga bad u long u kpa ïa ki arphew ar ngut ki khun shynrang bad khathynriew ngut ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands ? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong nga bad nga ngi la leh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki hima ? Hato ki blei jong kano kano ka hima ki pyllait ïa la ki briew na u patsha ka Assyria ?

translation.en: For there is no respect of persons with God .
translation.kha: Naba ym don ba burom ia u briew ba im bad u Blei

translation.en: Not unto us , O  Lord  , not unto us , but unto thy name give glory , for thy mercy , and for thy truth s sake .
translation.kha: Tang sha me hi , A  Trai  , tang sha me hi ! bad ym sha ngi , ba dei ban ai ïa ka burom namar ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingïaineh jong me .

translation.en: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion , and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment , and by the spirit of burning .
translation.kha: Da la ka bor U  Trai  un bishar bad pynkhuid ïa ka jaitbynriew bad sait noh ïa ka jingpalat jong ka Jerusalem , bad ïa ka snam kaba la pynmih noh hangta .

translation.en: Neither shall they say , Lo here ! or , lo there ! for , behold , the kingdom of God is within you .
translation.kha: Ym don u ban ong , ‘ Ha khmih , ka don hangne !’ lane ‘ Ka don hangtai !’ ; namar ka Hima U Blei ka don hapoh jong phi .

translation.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself , even as he is pure .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba don ïa kane ka jingkyrmen ha U Khrist , u ri khuid ïa lade , kumba U Khrist u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Elihoreph and Ahiah , the sons of Shisha , scribes  ; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , the recorder .
translation.kha: Ki sekretari ka ïingbishar : U Elihoreph bad u Ahijah , ki khun jong u Shisha Uba khmih ïa ki dulir : U Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Enter not into the house of mourning , neither go to lament nor bemoan them : for I have taken away my peace from this people , saith the  Lord  , even lovingkindness and mercies .
translation.kha: Mem dei ban rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba don ka jingïambriew . Wat ym ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jongno jongno . Ngan ym kyrkhu shuh ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jingsuk lane pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei .

translation.en: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered  ; so will I seek out my sheep , and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom kumba u nongaplangbrot u sumar bha ïa la ki langbrot kiba la sakma bad u wallam lang ïa ki pat . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka sha kiba la pynsakma ïa ki ha kata sngi ka jingdum bad jingjot .

translation.en: They smote also the tents of cattle , and carried away sheep and camels in abundance , and returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki tur ïaleh ruh ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki katto katne ki nongaplangbrot , ki kurup ïa shibun ki langbrot bad ki ut . Nangta ki leit phai sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: What is there to eat ?
translation.kha: Don aiu ban bam ?

translation.en: According to their deeds , accordingly he will repay , fury to his adversaries , recompence to his enemies  ; to the islands he will repay recompence .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u kat kum ki jingleh jong ki , wat ïa kito kiba shong sha ki ri kiba jngai .

translation.en: If God will not withdraw his anger , the proud helpers do stoop under him .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar U Blei ka ïaineh . U pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong u kiba ïarap ïa u Rahab , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw , uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land , and removed all the idols that his fathers had made .
translation.kha: U beh noh na ka ri ïa ki nuti shynrang bad kynthei baroh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thala , bad u weng noh ïa ki bleithaw baroh ba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la thaw .

translation.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children , because he was the son of his old age : and he made him a coat of many colours .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki khun shynrang jong u baroh , namar ba la kha ïa u haba u la tymmen . U la suh ïa u kawei ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti .

translation.en: And when they had this done , they inclosed a great multitude of fishes : and their net brake .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la pynhiar ïa ki bad ki la ngat shibun tylli ki dohkha bad ki jar ki la jan kad .

translation.en: The locusts have no king , yet go they forth all of them by bands  ;
translation.kha: Ki puit : kim don syiem , hynrei ki mih ryntih kynhun kynhun .

translation.en: And all the people arose as one man , saying , We will not any of us go to his tent , neither will we any of us turn into his house .
translation.kha: U paidbah baroh u ïeng tylli lang kawei bad u ong ,  Yn ym don na ngi , la u sah ha la ka ïingjaiñ ne ha la ïing ban leit sha la ïing .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  It is not for you to know the times or the seasons , which the Father hath put in his own power .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa ki por bad ki jingjia la buh da U Kpa ha ka bor jong u hi , bad kam dei ïa phi ban tip lano kin jia long .

translation.en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprung up , and choked them :
translation.kha: Khyndiat na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki bniap dieng shiah , kiba la san bad kjap noh ïa ki jingthung .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Smite with thine hand , and stamp with thy foot , and say , Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel ! for they shall fall by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Khyrwait ïa la ki kti ! kyrdem ïa la ki kjat ! kyang da ka jingsngewsih namar ki jingsniew baroh , kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki Israel ki la leh . Kin ïap ha ka thma , da ka  nemsniew bad da ka jingpang .

translation.en: Now the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the son of Amittai , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah u khun jong u Amittai .

translation.en: Lift up thyself , thou judge of the earth : render a reward to the proud .
translation.kha: Me long u nongbishar ïa ki briew baroh ; A to ïeng bad ai ha kiba sarong ïa kaei kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !

translation.en: And Jeroboam said to his wife , Arise , I pray thee , and disguise thyself , that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam  ; and get thee to Shiloh : behold , there is Ahijah the prophet , which told me that I should be king over this people .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Da riam pher ïa lade ban ym don ba ithuh ïa phi bad leit sha Shiloh , ha kaba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa u shong u sah , uta uba ong ba ngan sa long u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: Then said Saul unto his servants , Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit , that I may go to her , and enquire of her . And his servants said to him , Behold , there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Khie wad ka kynthei kaba kren byrtong , bad ngan leit kylli na ka .   Don kawei ka nongkren byrtong ha Endor ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth  ; not any of her vows , or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul , shall stand : and the  Lord  shall forgive her , because her father disallowed her .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u kpa jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata ka kular . U  Trai  un map ïa ka , namar ba u kpa jong ka , u khang ba kan bat ïa kata .

translation.en: And God said to Solomon , Because this was in thine heart , and thou hast not asked riches , wealth , or honour , nor the life of thine enemies , neither yet hast asked long life  ; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself , that thou mayest judge my people , over whom I have made thee king :
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u Solomon ,  Me la jied ïa kaba dei . Ha ka jaka ka jingpan ïa ka spah lane ka jingkynshew lane ka nam lane ka jingïap jong ki nongshun jong me lane wat ka jingjlan jong ka jingim jong me , me la pan ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip khnang ba me lah ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , kiba halor jong ki nga la thung syiem ïa me .

translation.en: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you , and there remained but wounded men among them , yet should they rise up every man in his tent , and burn this city with fire .
translation.kha: Wat la men jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Babilonia baroh kawei , ba tang ki rangbah ba la mynsaw kin sah , kiba thiah ha la ki ïingjaiñ , kito ki rangbah kin dang ïeng bad thang ïa kane ka nongbah ha ban da ing khoit .

translation.en: Whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Rise up and walk ?
translation.kha: Hato ka kham suk ban ong , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong phi ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ to ïeng joit bad ïaid ?’

translation.en: Peter answered and said unto him , Though all men shall be offended because of thee , yet will I never be offended .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me da lei lei , wat la baroh kiwei pat ki leh kumta !

translation.en: Behold , every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee , saying , As is the mother , so is her daughter .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa kane ka proberb shaphang jong pha , ko Jerusalem : ‘ Kumba long ka kmie , kumta ruh ka khun .’

translation.en: For then shall be great tribulation , such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time , no , nor ever shall be .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingjynjar ha kata ka por kan kham shyrkhei ban ïa kano kano kaba la ju jia , naduh kaba sdang jong ka pyrthei haduh kane ka sngi . Lymne ba yn don pat kano kano kum kane .

translation.en: And the younger of them said to his father , Father , give me the portion of goods that falleth to me . And he divided unto them his living .
translation.kha: Uba kham rit u la ong ha u , ‘ Ko pa to ai mynta ha nga ïa ka bhah jong nga na ka jingdon jingem .’ Kumta uta u briew , u la pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u hapdeng ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Kum u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: I know Ephraim , and Israel is not hid from me : for now , O Ephraim , thou committest whoredom , and Israel is defiled .
translation.kha: Nga tip ka Israel ka long kumno — kam lah ban rieh na nga . Ka la long ka bymïaineh , bad ki briew jong ka kim long kiba bit ban mane ïa nga .

translation.en: But now it is come upon thee , and thou faintest  ; it toucheth thee , and thou art troubled .
translation.kha: Mynta ka wan jia sa ha me ban don ha ka jynjar , bad me dum ka buit ka stad ban ïaleh ïa ka .

translation.en: And that he was buried , and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures :
translation.kha: ba la tep ïa u bad ba la pynmihpat ïa u hadien lai sngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;

translation.en: And he made the holy anointing oil , and the pure incense of sweet spices , according to the work of the apothecary .
translation.kha: U shna ruh ïa ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang bad ïa ka jingiwbih suhsieng , ïa kaba la khleh lang kumba khleh jingiwbih .

translation.en: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever , who created heaven , and the things that therein are , and the earth , and the things that therein are , and the sea , and the things which are therein , that there should be time no longer :
translation.kha: bad u la smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei , uba im junom la junom , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , bad ïa kata ka duriaw , bad baroh kiba don ha ki . Uta u angel u la ong ,  Yn ym don jingpynslem shuh !

translation.en: Now some are puffed up , as though I would not come to you .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na phi , phi la sngewsarong namar phi la pyrkhat ba ngan ym wan ban jngoh ïa phi .

translation.en: Jehovah cares about people who love what is true and good .
translation.kha: U Jehobah u phikir ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa kaei kaba dei bad ka babha .

translation.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people , a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive  ; of a stammering tongue , that thou canst not understand .
translation.kha: Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa ki nongwei kiba hangamei kiba kren da ka ktien kaba phim sngewthuh .

translation.en: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek , and went and smote Israel , and possessed the city of palm trees .
translation.kha: U Eglon u la ïasoh lang bad ki Ammon bad ki Amalek ; kine ki la jop ïa ki Israel bad ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai .

translation.en: And they did not receive him , because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew hangta kim kwah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ka la paw shai ba u la don ha ka lynti sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation , Solomon my son , whom alone God hath chosen , is yet young and tender , and the work is great : for the palace is not for man , but for the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u pynbna ha baroh kiba ïalumlang ,  U Solomon u khun jong nga u dei ma u uba U Blei u la jied , hynrei u dang samla bad dang duna ka jingtbit . Ka kam ban leh ka long kaba khraw , namar kane kam dei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ki briew hynrei ka Templ na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei .

translation.en: Lest they drink , and forget the law , and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted .
translation.kha: haba ki dih , ki klet noh ïa ki aiñ bad ki lyndet noh ïa ki hok jong ki briew kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: From above the horse gate repaired the priests , every one over against his house .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki lyngdoh , ka tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba kiew shaphang shatei na ka Khyrdop Kulai , uwei uwei u tei ha khmat ka ïing jong u hi .

translation.en: And as Paul was to be led into the castle , he said unto the chief captain , May I speak unto thee ? Who said , Canst thou speak Greek ?
translation.kha: Katba ki shipai ki la mut ban ïalam artat ïa u Paul sha ka kut shipai , u la kren ha u rangbah ai hukum :  Nga lah mo ban ong ei ei ha me ?   Me kren Grik , hato ym dei kumta ?  u rangbah shipai u la kylli .

translation.en: So there went one on horseback to meet him , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu said , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me . And the watchman told , saying , The messenger came to them , but he cometh not again .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u leit sha u Jehu bad ong ïa u ,  U syiem u kwah ban tip la phi wan ne em kum u paralok .   Kata kam dei ka kam jong me !  u Jehu u jubab .  Bud nadien jong nga .  Uta u nongap phira uba don ha ka jaka ap phira u la ïathuh ba u nonglamktien u la poi sha ka kynhun hynrei u khlem wan phai .

translation.en: And all the people went their way to eat , and to drink , and to send portions , and to make great mirth , because they had understood the words that were declared unto them .
translation.kha: Kumta u paidbah u leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih da kaba kmen bad ïasam ïa kaei kaba ki don bad kiwei pat , namar ki la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la pule ha ki .

translation.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about  ; the snares of death prevented me  ;
translation.kha: Ka jingma jong ka jingïap ka don sawdong jong nga , bad ka jingtep ka pynap la ka jingriam ïa nga .

translation.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil  ; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment :
translation.kha: Wat ïabud lang bad kiba bun paid haba ki leh ïa ka bymdei , ne haba ki ai sakhi ban pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed , and , behold , a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven  ;
translation.kha: Katba nga dang pyrkhat shaphang ka jingïohipaw , nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba wan hiar na bneng , uba la kloi bad uba peitngor .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Abraham s servant heard their words , he worshipped the  Lord  , bowing himself to the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u shakri jong u Abraham u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u dem ngon bad u mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands , that they should not worship devils , and idols of gold , and silver , and brass , and stone , and of wood : which neither can see , nor hear , nor walk :
translation.kha: Kiba sah na u bynriew , baroh kito kiba ym shym la pynïap noh da kine ki jingïapthem , kim shym la phai noh na kaei kaba ki hi ki la pynlong . Kim shym la sangeh ban mane ïa ki ksuid , lane ïa ki blei ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , u maw , bad da ka dieng , ki bym lah ban ïohi , ne ïohsngew , ne ïaid .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the  Lord  shall bring his oblation unto the  Lord  of the sacrifice of his peace offerings .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wallam ïa ka jingainguh ïasyllok u dei ban wanrah ruh shi bynta na ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , da kaba wanrah hi ïa ka da la ki kti kum ka jingainguh bam .

translation.en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt , so will I plead with you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynrem ïa phi kumba nga la pynrem ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul , in whose stead thou hast reigned  ; and the  Lord  hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son : and , behold , thou art taken in thy mischief , because thou art a bloody man .
translation.kha: Me la knieh ïa ka hima jong u Saul , bad mynta U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa me namar ka jingpynïap ïa kiba bun na ka longïing jong u Saul . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka hima ha u Absalom , u khun jong me , bad me la jot , ma me u nongpynïap briew !

translation.en: And many believed on him there .
translation.kha: Bad bun ki briew hangta ki la ngeit ha u .

translation.en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites , the inhabitants of the land : which spake unto David , saying , Except thou take away the blind and the lame , thou shalt not come in hither : thinking , David cannot come in hither .
translation.kha: Ka poi ka por haba u Syiem Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki Jebus , kiba shong hangta , ki pyrkhat ba u Dabid um lah ban jop ïa ka nongbah , bad kumta ki ong ha u ,  Men ym ïohrung hangne da lei lei ; wat kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki lah ban khang ïa me .

translation.en: And David spake to the men that stood by him , saying , What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine , and taketh away the reproach from Israel ? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine , that he should defy the armies of the living God ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa ki rangbah kiba ïeng hajan jong u ,  Un ïoh aïu uta u briew uba pynïap ïa une u Philistia bad uba pyllait ïa ki Israel na kane ka jingjahburom ? Nalor kata , uei une u Philistia bymngeit uba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong U Blei uba im ?

translation.en: Man s goings are of the  Lord   ; how can a man then understand his own way ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thmu ïa ka lynti jong ngi ; kumno te uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa ka phang ba ka jingim jong u ka thew ?

translation.en: Bind up the testimony , seal the law among my disciples .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki nongbud jong nga , phi dei ban sumar bad pynneh ïa ki khubor kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga .

translation.en: Rejoice , O ye nations , with his people : for he will avenge the blood of his servants , and will render vengeance to his adversaries , and will be merciful unto his land , and to his people .
translation.kha: Phi ki jaitbynriew , ïaroh ïa ki briew U  Trai  ; naba u pynshitom ïa kito baroh kiba pynïap ïa ki . U pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong u , bad u map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong u .

translation.en: But as God hath distributed to every man , as the Lord hath called every one , so let him walk . And so ordain I in all churches .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïai im kat kum ka jingai jong U Blei ïa phi , bad kumba phi la long mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Kane ka long ka jinghikai ïa kaba nga ai ha ki balang baroh .

translation.en: And under their hand was an army , three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred , that made war with mighty power , to help the king against the enemy .
translation.kha: Hapoh jong ki don lai lakh hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut ki shipai kiba lah ban ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta u syiem pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong u .

translation.en: And Naomi said , Turn again , my daughters : why will ye go with me ? are there yet any more sons in my womb , that they may be your husbands ?
translation.kha: Ko ki khun kynthei jong nga , phi dei ban leit phai noh ,  ka Naomi ka jubab .  Balei phi kwah ban wan bad nga ? Hato phi mut ngan dang ïoh khun shynrang biang na ka bynta jong phi ban shongkurim ?

translation.en: Receive us ; we have wronged no man , we have corrupted no man , we have defrauded no man .
translation.kha: To pdiang ïa ngi ha ki dohnud jong phi . Ngim shym la leh bymdei ïano ïano ; ngim shym la pynjot ïano ïano , lymne ngim shym la pyrshang ban shim kabu ïano ïano .

translation.en: On the morrow , as they went on their journey , and drew nigh unto the city , Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , katba ki dang don ha lynti bad ba ki la jan poi hajan Joppa , u Petros u la leit sha ka tnum jong ka ïing ha ka por shiteng sngi ban duwai .

translation.en: But the priests the Levites , the sons of Zadok , that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me , they shall come near to me to minister unto me , and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood , saith the Lord  God  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Hynrei kito ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jait Lebi kiba hiarpateng na u Sadok pat , ki la shakri hok ïa nga ha ka Templ mynba kiwei pat ki paid Israel ki la phai noh na nga . Kumta mynta ki long ma ki , ki ban shakri ïa nga bad wan ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ban ai ïa nga ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia .

translation.en: Now before the feast of the passover , when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father , having loved his own which were in the world , he loved them unto the end .
translation.kha: Ka la dei shi sngi ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Jisu u la tip ba ka kynta ka la poi ban iehnoh ïa kane ka pyrthei bad ban leit sha U Kpa . U la ju ieit borabor ïa kito kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba long ki jong u hi , bad u la ieit ïa ki haduh kaba kut .

translation.en: This is the  Lord s  doing  ; it is marvellous in our eyes .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh da U  Trai  ; A katno ka long kaba itynnat ban khmih !

translation.en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded : and they let them go .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab kumba U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki , bad kita ki briew ki la shah ïa ki ban leit .

translation.en: He then having received the sop went immediately out : and it was night .
translation.kha: U Judas u la pdiang ïa u kpu bad mar kumta u la mihnoh shabar . Ka la long ka por mynmiet .

translation.en: Nevertheless God , that comforteth those that are cast down , comforted us by the coming of Titus ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei , uba pynshlur ïa kita kiba la duh jingkyrmen , u la pynshlur ïa ngi da ka jingwan u Titos .

translation.en: That we also may be like all the nations  ; and that our king may judge us , and go out before us , and fight our battles .
translation.kha: khnang ba ngin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ba u syiem jong ngi hi un synshar ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi sha ka thma , bad un ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi .

translation.en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread , for every table  ; and likewise silver for the tables of silver :
translation.kha: na ka bynta ki miej kiba da ka rupa bad na ka bynta kawei kawei ka miej kaba da ka ksiar ha kaba yn ïa ki kpu ban ainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there , and the owls shall dwell therein : and it shall be no more inhabited for ever  ; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka Babilon kan long kaba shongksuid bad ba don ki mynsiem bymman , bad ki sim bymkhuid . Ki briew kin ym shong shuh hangta lano lano ruh , lymne ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .

translation.en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle : and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn , and next unto him Abinadab , and the third Shammah .
translation.kha: Lai ngut ki khun kiba nyngkong jong u ki la leit lang bad u Saul sha ka thma . Uba nyngkong eh u dei u Eliab , uba bud u dei u Abinadab , bad uba lai u dei u Shammah .

translation.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule : but the slothful shall be under tribute .
translation.kha: Ka jingtrei shitom kan ai bor ïa phi ; kaba leh jaipdeh kan pynlong mraw ïa phi .

translation.en: My son , eat thou honey , because it is good  ; and the honeycomb , which is sweet to thy taste :
translation.kha: Ko khun , bam ïa ka ngap , ka long kaba bha . Bad kumba ka ngap na ka rewngap ka long kaba thiang ha u thylliej jong phi ,

translation.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , u im khatsan snem palat ïa u Jehoash u syiem Israel .

translation.en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns : but the way of the righteous is made plain .
translation.kha: Lada phi jaipdeh , phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingeh kylleng , hynrei haba phi long uba trei minot , phin ym shem jingeh .

translation.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant , O  Lord  , according unto thy word .
translation.kha: Me la bat ïa la ka kular , A  Trai  , bad me long uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands , burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt , whither ye be gone to dwell , that ye might cut yourselves off , and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad da kaba kñia ha kiwei ki blei hangne ha Ijipt , ha kaba phi la wan ban shong ban sah ? Hato phi leh ïa kane ban pynjot ïa lade , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei kin ñiewbeiñ ïa phi bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim ?

translation.en: He should never hit his wife or mistreat her in any way .
translation.kha: Um dei ban shoh ban dat lane leh bein ïa ka .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark , every man in the chambers of his imagery ? for they say , The  Lord  seeth us not  ; the  Lord  hath forsaken the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u la kylli ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi aïu ki rangbah Israel ki ïaleh ha kaba rieh ? Baroh ki ïamane ha ka kamra kaba dap da ki dur bleithaw . Ka jingpynksan jong ki ka long : ‘ U  Trai  um ïohi ïa ngi ! U la iehnoh ïa ka ri .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And when they looked , they saw that the stone was rolled away : for it was very great .
translation.kha: Ha lynti ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei u ban pyntyllun na ka bynta jong ngi ïa u maw na ka jingkhang ban rung sha ka jingtep ?  ( U la long u maw uba heh shibun . ) Te ki la khmih bad ki la ïohi ba ïa u maw la lah pyntyllun noh .

translation.en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty , and floods upon the dry ground : I will pour my spirit upon thy seed , and my blessing upon thine offspring :
translation.kha: Ngan ai um ïa ka ri basliang bad pynlong ïa ki wahduid ban tuid ha ka khyndew ba-tyrkhong . Ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki khun jong phi bad ka jingkyrkhu jong nga ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi .

translation.en: And the sons of Jether  ; Jephunneh , and Pispah , and Ara .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jether ki long u Jephunneh , u Pispa , bad u Ara ,

translation.en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years , and begat Jared :
translation.kha: Haba u Mahalalel u la dap hynriewphew san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Jared ,

translation.en: But in vain they do worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
translation.kha: Kam myntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ba ki hikai ïa ki rukom ki briew kumba ki dei ki hukum jong nga !’

translation.en: Behold , all souls are mine  ; as the soul of the father , so also the soul of the son is mine : the soul that sinneth , it shall die .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u briew ka dei ka jong nga , ka jingim jong ka kmie , u kpa bad kumjuh ruh ka jong i khun . U briew uba leh pop u dei uta u ban ïap .

translation.en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand , then I will utterly destroy their cities .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la smai ha U  Trai  :  Lada me shah ïa ngi ban jop ïa kine ki briew , ngin pynkyntang lut khlem kyndon ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong jong ki sha me bad ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ki .

translation.en: In the light of the king s countenance is life  ; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain .
translation.kha: Ka jingshem sngewbha u syiem ka long kum ki lyoh kiba wanrah slap ha ka por pyrem — don ka jingim hangta .

translation.en: He is proud , knowing nothing , but doting about questions and strifes of words , whereof cometh envy , strife , railings , evil surmisings ,
translation.kha: U don ka jingkwah kaba sniew ban ïoh ïasaidnia bad ïakajia shaphang ki ktien , bad kane ka wanrah ïa ka jingpihuiñ , ka jingïania , ka jingkrenbeiñ , ka jingsuba sniew , bad ka jingïai-ïasaidnia na ki briew kiba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad ki bym don shuh ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: And the sight of the glory of the  Lord  was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  ka la wan hiar ha uta u lum . Ïa ki Israel , ka jingshai ka i kum ka ding kaba ing ha kliar jong u lum . U lyoh u la tap ïa u lum hynriew sngi lynter , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew U  Trai  u la khot ïa u Moses na u lyoh .

translation.en: Thou shalt sow , but thou shalt not reap  ; thou shalt tread the olives , but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil  ; and sweet wine , but shalt not drink wine .
translation.kha: Phin bet ïa u kew , hynrei phin ym ïoh ban ot . Phin khem ïa ka umphniang na ki soh Olib , hynrei phin ym lah da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka . Phin ïoh shna ïa ka waiñ , hynrei phin ym ïoh dih da lei lei ïa ka .

translation.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people , I find no fault in this man .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pilat u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki paidbah ,  Ngam shem kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa une u briew .

translation.en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually  ; they shall not be shut day nor night  ; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles , and that their kings may be brought .
translation.kha: Bad sngi bad miet ki khyrdop jong pha kin plie , kumta ba ki syiem jong ki jaitbynriew kin wanrah sha pha ïa ka spah jong ki .

translation.en: The days of visitation are come , the days of recompence are come  ; Israel shall know it : the prophet is a fool , the spiritual man is mad , for the multitude of thine iniquity , and the great hatred .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ka la poi , ka por ha kaba ki briew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei hok . Haba kata ka jia , ki Israel kin tip ïa ka !  Une u nongïathuhlypa ,  phi ong ,  u dei uba bieit . Une u briew uba ïoh mynsiem u dei uba lamwir .  Phi ki briew phi isih jur ïa nga namar ba la jyllei eh ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: And answered them , saying ,  Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit , and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Lada uno uno na phi u don u khun ne u masi dab uba jia ryngkhat u hap hapoh ka pukri ha ka sngi Sabbaton , hato phin ym tan ïa u shisyndon shabar ha ka sngi Sabbaton hi ?

translation.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me : but I have not forgotten thy law .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki la buh ka jingriam ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym klet ïa ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall : but the righteous shall flourish as a branch .
translation.kha: Kito kiba shaniah ha ka spah jong ki , kin hap kum ki sla jong ka synrai , hynrei kiba hok kin roi kyrhai kum ki sla jong ka lyiur .

translation.en: And Leah also with her children came near , and bowed themselves : and after came Joseph near and Rachel , and they bowed themselves .
translation.kha: nangta ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka ki la wan , bad khatduh eh , u Joseph bad ka Rakhel ki la wan bad ki nguh .

translation.en: And Isaac gave up the ghost , and died , and was gathered unto his people , being old and full of days : and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha ka jinglong tymmen ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u , u Iso bad u Jakob ki la tep ïa u .

translation.en: It seemed good to me also , having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first , to write unto thee in order , most excellent Theophilus ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko rangbah badonburom , namar ba nga , nga pule bniah biang biang ïa kine kiei kiei baroh naduh ka jingsdang jong ki , nga la pyrkhat ba kan long kaba bha ban thoh ryntih ïa ka jingïathuh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks , two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams ,
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u langbrot ,

translation.en: These be the heads of their fathers  houses : The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel  ; Hanoch , and Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi : these be the families of Reuben .
translation.kha: U Reuben , u khun nyngkong jong u Jakob , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : U Hanokh , u Pallu , u Hesron , bad u Karmi ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki .

translation.en: So they poured out for the men to eat . And it came to pass , as they were eating of the pottage , that they cried out , and said , O thou man of God , there is death in the pot . And they could not eat thereof .
translation.kha: La ai ïa kata ka syrwa ha ki rangbah ban bam , hynrei mar ïamad ïa ka ki pyrta jam ha u Elisha ,  Ka dei kaba long bih !  — bad kim shym bam ïa ka .

translation.en: So David and Abishai came to the people by night : and , behold , Saul lay sleeping within the trench , and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster : but Abner and the people lay round about him .
translation.kha: Kumta ynda la miet u Dabid bad u Abishai ki leit rung shapoh ka jaka shong dara u Saul bad ki shem ïa u Saul ba u dang ïohthiah hapdeng kata ka jaka shong dara , bad hajan ka khlieh jong u la sieh ïa u sum jong u ha khyndew ; u Abner bad ka kynhun shipai ki dang ïohthiah lut sawdong jong u .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Bring of the fish which ye have now caught .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wallam katto katne tylli ki dohkha kiba phi dang shu ngat .

translation.en: Yea , a man may say , Thou hast faith , and I have works : shew me thy faith without thy works , and I will shew thee my faith by my works .
translation.kha: Hynrei don u ban ong ,  Uwei u briew u don ka jingngeit , uwei pat u don da ki kam .  Ka jubab jong nga ka long  To pyn-i ha nga kumno uno uno u lah ban don ka jingngeit khlem ki kam . Ngan sa pyn-i ïa phi ïa ka jingngeit jong nga da ki kam .

translation.en: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day , Behold , such is our expectation , whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria : and how shall we escape ?
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki briew kiba shong shi lynter ka rud duriaw jong ka Philistia kin ong , ‘ Khmih ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki briew kiba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na u patsha jong ka Assyria ! Kumno ngin ïohlait im ?’

translation.en: Behold , I will do a new thing  ; now it shall spring forth  ; shall ye not know it ? I will even make a way in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert .
translation.kha: To khmih ïa kaba thymmai kaba ngan leh . Ka la jia lypa — phi lah ban ïohi ïa ka mynta ! Ngan pynlong ïa ka lynti lyngba ka ri khlaw bad ïa ki wahduid ngan ai ïa phi na ka um hangta .

translation.en: And they that are Christ s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts .
translation.kha: Bad kita kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu ki la pynïap ïa ka jinglong ba kynja briew lem ïa ki jingthrew bad ki jingkwah brai jong ka baroh .

translation.en: Whithersoever the spirit was to go , they went , thither was their spirit to go  ; and the wheels were lifted up over against them : for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .
translation.kha: Kita ki jingthaw ki leit kat shaba ki mon bad ki shalyntem ruh ki leit ryngkat bad ki ; namar kita ki jingthaw ki pynïaid ïa ki .

translation.en: And let it be , when these signs are come unto thee , that thou do as occasion serve thee  ; for God is with thee .
translation.kha: Haba kine kiei kiei kin jia , leh ïa kaba U Blei u ïalam ïa me ban leh .

translation.en: Then Pilate said unto them , Why , what evil hath he done ? And they cried out the more exceedingly , Crucify him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ka kam sniew kaba u la leh ?  U Pilat u la kylli . Ki la ïa-pyrta kham jam ,  Sahnarphna ïa u !

translation.en: And fell down on his face at his feet , giving him thanks : and he was a Samaritan .
translation.kha: U la dem khrup ïa lade ha khyndew ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la ainguh ïa u . Uta u briew u dei u nong Samaria .

translation.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written , The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up .
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kynmaw ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ka jingsngew shitrhem jong nga ïa ka ïing jong me , a Blei , ka ing hapoh jong nga kum ka ding .

translation.en: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made , in praise , and in name , and in honour  ; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God , as he hath spoken .
translation.kha: Un kyntiew ïa phi ha khlieh eh ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ba u la thaw , bad phi pat phin ïaroh bad ai burom ïa ka kyrteng jong u . Phi phin long ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: And Sarai Abram s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian , after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan , and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la ai ïa ka Hagar ha u ba kan long ka tnga kliar jong u . ( Kane ka la jia hadien ba u Abram u la shong la sah shiphew snem ha ka ri Kanaan . )

translation.en: And he spake unto the congregation , saying , Depart , I pray you , from the tents of these wicked men , and touch nothing of theirs , lest ye be consumed in all their sins .
translation.kha: U ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kynriah na ki ïingjaiñ jong kine ki riewbymman bad wat ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ka jong ki , ïoh phi shah pynjot lang bad ki namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And he said , I will send thee a kid from the flock . And she said , Wilt thou give me a pledge , till thou send it ?
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa phi kawei ka blang lud na ka kynhun jong nga ,  u jubab .  Ñiuma , lada phin ai ei ei ha nga ban buh kum ka jingkular haduh ba phin da phah ïa ka blang ,  ka ong .

translation.en: And Abner said to Joab , Let the young men now arise , and play before us . And Joab said , Let them arise .
translation.kha: U Abner u ong ha u Joab ,  To ngin shah katto katne na ki samla shynrang na kawei kawei ka liang ban ïakhun ïa ka jingïakob da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki atiar .   Ka biang ,  u Joab u jubab .

translation.en: As I was in the days of my youth , when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle  ;
translation.kha: Kito ki long ki sngi mynba nga dang dap kyrhai bad ka jinglong paralok U Blei ka ïada ïa ka ïing jong nga .

translation.en: To them which were in Beth–el , and to them which were in south Ramoth , and to them which were in Jattir ,
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka sha ki briew ha Bethel , sha ki briew ha Ramah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Judah , bad sha ki briew ha ki nongrit Jattir ,

translation.en: By whom we have received grace and apostleship , for obedience to the faith among all nations , for his name :
translation.kha: Lyngba jong u , U Blei u la ai ïa nga ka kabu ban long u apostol na ka bynta U Khrist , khnang ban ïalam ïa ki briew na ki jaitbynriew baroh ban ngeit bad ban kohnguh .

translation.en: Lord  , when thou wentest out of Seir , when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom , the earth trembled , and the heavens dropped , the clouds also dropped water .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , mynba me mihnoh na ki lum jong ka Seir , Haba me la mihnoh na ka thain Edom , Ka khyndew ka khynñiuh bad u slap u hap na sahit bneng . Ho-oid , la theh ïa ka um na ki lyoh .

translation.en: But the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Look not on his countenance , or on the height of his stature  ; because I have refused him : for the  Lord  seeth not as man seeth  ; for man looketh on the outward appearance , but the  Lord  looketh on the heart .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Wat pynleit jingmut katno u jrong ka rynïeng bad katno u bhabriew , namar nga la kyntait ïa u ; naba ngam bishar kumba bishar ki briew . U briew u peit ïa ka dur kaba shabar , hynrei nga , nga peit ïa ka dohnud .

translation.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews : and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon .
translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , la rahbor ïa nga na ka ri jong ki Hebru ; bad wat hangne ha Ijipt ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba nga dei hok ban shah set byndi .

translation.en: And he said , What hast thou done ? the voice of thy brother s blood crieth unto me from the ground .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Balei me leh ïa kane ka kam kaba shyrkhei ? Ka snam u para jong me ka ud ha nga na khyndew kum ka sur kaba khot ïa ka jingpynhiarkput .

translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an Hebrew  ; and I fear the  Lord  , the God of heaven , which hath made the sea and the dry land .
translation.kha: Nga dei u Hebru ,  u Jonah u la jubab .  Nga mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ka bneng , uba la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .

translation.en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the  Lord s  offering : and every man , with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service , brought it .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba lah ban ai da ka rupa ne da ka rnong ki wallam kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  , bad baroh kiba don ïa ka dieng akasia ïa kaba lah ban pyndonkam , ki wallam ïa ka .

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah , that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah , and took them .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw ba u Hesekaïah u la long u Syiem ka Judah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah bad u la knieh ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them , nor serve them : for I the  Lord  thy God am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me  ;
translation.kha: Wat dem lane mane ïa kano kano ka bleithaw , naba nga , nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ngam lah shah ïano ïano ba pyrshah ïa nga . Nga wallam ka jingpynshitom ha kito kiba isih ïa nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng bynriew .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all the people were clean passed over , that the ark of the  Lord  passed over , and the priests , in the presence of the people .
translation.kha: Haba baroh ki la ïadon sha kawei pat ka liang , kita ki lyngdoh bad ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ki jam ha shuwa uta u paidbah .

translation.en: Ashkelon shall see it , and fear  ; Gaza also shall see it , and be very sorrowful , and Ekron  ; for her expectation shall be ashamed  ; and the king shall perish from Gaza , and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah Ashkelon kan ïohi ïa kane bad kan sheptieng . Ka nongbah Gasa kan ïohi ïa kane bad kan shah ka jingshitom bakhraw . Kumta ruh kan long ka Ekron , bad ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ka yn pynkhynñiuh . Ka Gasa kan duh noh ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa ka Ashkelon yn ieh kynjah .

translation.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump .
translation.kha: Khyndiat u thiat u pynsieb ïa ka shi lyngngun u kpu .

translation.en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the  Lord s  hand , that made all the earth drunken : the nations have drunken of her wine  ; therefore the nations are mad .
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka long kum ka khuri ksiar ha ka kti jong nga , ba pynlong ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ban buaid . Ki jaitbynriew ki dih ïa ka waiñ bad ki kylla khleh bieit .

translation.en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , did they bring them out by their means .
translation.kha: Ki pynbiang kulai bad kali ïapom ïa ki syiem Hit bad Syria , da kaba die ïa ki kali ïapom hynriewspah ki sbai rupa kawei bad ïa ki kulai shispah sanphew uwei .

translation.en: For if Abraham were justified by works , he hath whereof to glory ; but not before God .
translation.kha: Lada ïa u la ñiew ka hok bad U Blei da kiei kiba u la leh , un don ei ei ban sngewsarong shaphang kata — hynrei ym ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: I , even I , am the  Lord   ; and beside me there is no saviour .
translation.kha: Nga hi marwei nga long U  Trai  , uba tang marwei uba lah ban pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: And said unto them ,  Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me : for he that is least among you all , the same shall be great .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa une u khynnah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ruh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga . Naba uta uba rit tam napdeng jong phi baroh u long uba khraw tam .

translation.en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel , and say unto the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury , because ye have borne the shame of the heathen :
translation.kha: Kumta to ïathuhlypa ha ka ri Israel ; ïathuh ha ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha ki wahduid bad ki jaka them , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ka jingbitar lep namar ka rukom ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ki la krenbeiñ bad pynpoh ïa ki .

translation.en: If you do not have a proper sewage disposal system , toilet wastes should be buried .
translation.kha: Lada phim don ki jaka leit shabar kiba paka , dei ban shu tep ïa ka jakhlia .

translation.en: The crown of the wise is their riches : but the foolishness of fools is folly .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba stad la ainong da ka spah , hynrei ïa kiba bieit la tip da ki jingleh bieit jong ki .

translation.en: Continue in prayer , and watch in the same with thanksgiving ;
translation.kha: To ïaineh skhem ha ka jingduwai , bad to sharai haba phi duwai , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee , a land flowing with milk and honey , that thou shalt keep this service in this month .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kular skhem ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ba un ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus . Ynda u la wallam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam man ka snem ha u bnai uba nyngkong .

translation.en: O Lord , thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul  ; thou hast redeemed my life .
translation.kha: Me la wan ban pyllait ïa nga , A Trai , bad me la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong nga .

translation.en: Until the day break , and the shadows flee away , turn , my beloved , and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether .
translation.kha: ki dieng Kedar kin long ki bim jong ka ïing jong ngi , bad ki dieng Kseh-Sypress kin long ka sad .

translation.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey , and increaseth the transgressors among men .
translation.kha: Ki ap ïa phi kum ki nonglute bad ki long ka daw ïa kiba bun ki rangbah ban ym long ïaineh .

translation.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps  ; as a prince would I go near unto him .
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ha U Blei ïa baroh kaba nga la leh , bad ngan ïeng da kaba sngew shlur ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah , and the great pride of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumne kan long kumno ba ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsarong jong ka Judah bad ïa ka jingsarong bakhraw jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then a spirit passed before my face  ; the hair of my flesh stood up :
translation.kha: Ka lyer ka beh jai jai ïa ka khmat jong nga , bad u shñiuh u ïeng treng da kaba khaw-eit .

translation.en: Listen , O isles , unto me  ; and hearken , ye people , from far  ; The  Lord  hath called me from the womb  ; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki hima ba don sha jngai , phi ki briew bashong sha jngai bah ! Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U  Trai  u la jied ïa nga bad thung ïa nga ban long u shakri jong u .

translation.en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men .
translation.kha: Pyrkhat halor kiei kiei kiba u Job u ong ; phin ïohi ba u kren kum u riewbymman .

translation.en: This matter is by the decree of the watchers , and the demand by the word of the holy ones : to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will , and setteth up over it the basest of men .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingrai jong ki angel kiba la kloi bad kiba peitngor . Kumta te , shah ba ki briew baroh ha kylleng ban tip ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u don ka bor halor jong ki hima ki briew bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied — wat ha ki bym da paw eh na ki briew .’

translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I have chosen  ; my beloved , in whom my soul is well pleased : I will put my spirit upon him , and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Une hangne u long u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jied , uta uba nga ieit , bad ha uba nga sngewbha eh . Ngan phah ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor u , bad un pynbna ïa ka jingbishar jong nga ha ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto you , saith the  Lord  , that I will punish you in this place , that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil :
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jingpynshisha ba ngan pynshitom ïa phi ha kane ka jaka bad ba ka jingkular jong nga ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha phi kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: Whether he have gored a son , or have gored a daughter , according to this judgment shall it be done unto him .
translation.kha: Dei ban bud ïa kane kajuh ka aiñ lada uta u masi kyrtong u pynïap ïa u khynnah shynrang ne ïa ka khynnah kynthei .

translation.en: And he spread it before me  ; and it was written within and without : and there was written therein lamentations , and mourning , and woe .
translation.kha: Kata ka kti ka la plied ïa ka kot kli , bad nga la ïohi ba ka don ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang — la thoh hangta ka jingïambriew bad ka jingsngewsih kthang bad ka jingpait dohnud bad ka jingud .

translation.en: So king Solomon sent , and they brought him down from the altar . And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon : and Solomon said unto him , Go to thine house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khot ïa u Adonijah bad phah patan ïa u na ka duwan . U Adonijah u la leit sha u syiem bad u la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Me lah ban leit noh sha ïing .

translation.en: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother , and said , There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day .
translation.kha: U paid Israel u la sngewsih na ka bynta la ki para na ka jait Benjamin bad ki ong ,  Ha kane ka sngi ki Israel ki la duh noh ïa kawei na ki jait .

translation.en: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes  letter was read before Rehum , and Shimshai the scribe , and their companions , they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews , and made them to cease by force and power .
translation.kha: Tang shu pule ïa kane ka shithi na u Artakserksis ha u Rehum bad u Shimshai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki leit kyrkieh sha Jerusalem bad pynbor ïa ki Jiw ban sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the voice of harpers , and musicians , and of pipers , and trumpeters , shall be heard no more at all in thee  ; and no craftsman , of whatsoever craft he be , shall be found any more in thee  ; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka sur jingtem jong ki duitara bad ka sur jong ki nongrwai , jong ki nongput ïa ka tangmuri bad ïa ka turoi , yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ïa uno uno u nongtrei ha kano kano ka kam yn ym shem shuh ha pha ; bad ïa ka jingsawa jong u mawtylliat yn ym ïohsngew shuh !

translation.en: The desire of a man is his kindness : and a poor man is better than a liar .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingjahburom ban long uba khwan myntoi ; ki briew kiba duk ki kham bha ban ïa ki nongshukor .

translation.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them : so they were before Judah , and the ambushment was behind them .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Jeroboam u la dep phah katto katne na ki kynhun jong u ban apthap ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Judia na shadien , katba kiba sah ki tur ïa ki na sha khmat .

translation.en: Even men , and women , and children , and the king s daughters , and every person that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Jeremiah the prophet , and Baruch the son of Neriah .
translation.kha: Nangta u Johanan bad ki rangbah shipai baroh ki la shim noh ïa baroh kiba dang sah ha Judah sha Ijipt , lem bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la sakma kylleng : ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki khun kynthei jong u syiem . Ki la ïalam ïa baroh kiba u Nebusaradan u rangbah ai hukum u la ieh hapoh ka jingpeit u Gedalaïah , ba kynthup ïa u Barukh bad ïa nga .

translation.en: We should not say our prayers from memory or read them from a prayer book .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban duwai da kaba spel lyndet lane pule na ka kot jingduwai .

translation.en: And God said unto him , I am God Almighty : be fruitful and multiply  ; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee , and kings shall come out of thy loins  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u ong ha u ,  Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . To nang ïoh bun ki khun ki kti . Ki jaitbynriew kin hiarpateng na me , bad men long u kpa tymmen jong ki syiem .

translation.en: And Saul armed David with his armour , and he put an helmet of brass upon his head  ; also he armed him with a coat of mail .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ka jingkieng atiar ha u Dabid ban phong ; ïa ka tupia rnong u buh ha ka khlieh jong u Dabid , bad ïa ka jingphong atiar la pynkup ha u .

translation.en: And they shall call them , The holy people , The redeemed of the  Lord  : and thou shalt be called , Sought out , A city not forsaken .
translation.kha: Yn khot ïa phi ,  Ki Briew ki bakhuid jong U Blei ,   Ki briew kiba U Trai u la pyllait im ;  Ïa ka Jerusalem yn khot  Ka nongbah kaba U Blei u ieit .   Ka nongbah kaba U Blei um shym la iehnoh .

translation.en: The words of the wise are as goads , and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies , which are given from one shepherd .
translation.kha: Ki jingong jong ki briew kiba stad ki long kum ki dieng banep kiba ki nongap langbrot ki pyndonkam ha kaba ïalam lynti ïa ki langbrot , bad ki proberb kiba la lum ki neh slem kum ki preg kiba la sah pynskhem . Ki long kiba la ai da U Blei , U Nongap Langbrot jong ngi baroh .

translation.en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob , neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel : the  Lord  his God is with him , and the shout of a king is among them .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi lypa ïa ka lawei jong ki Israel , Kan ym don ka jingkordit ne jinglanot ïa ki . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u don ryngkat bad ki , Ki pynbna ba ma u , u long u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus , whom I have begotten in my bonds :
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad na ka bynta u Onesimos , uba long u khun jong nga hi ha U Khrist ; ba mynba ngi la don ha ka byndi nga la long u kpa jong u ha ka mynsiem .

translation.en: Hear  ; for I will speak of excellent things  ; and the opening of my lips shall be right things .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ki ktien donburom tam jong nga , baroh kaba nga kren ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that day , that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Bad ha kata ka por ha ka them Jesreel ngan pynjot noh thiaw ïa ka bor jong ka kynhun shipai ki Israel .

translation.en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods , O Judah  ; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing , even altars to burn incense unto Baal .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la don shibun bah ki blei kumba ki la don ki nongbah , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la pynïeng katta tylli ki duwan na ka bynta ki jingkñia sha uta u blei Baal ba-ijli kat ka jingdon ki lynti hapoh ka nongbah .

translation.en: And Jacob kissed Rachel , and lifted up his voice , and wept .
translation.kha: Te u la doh ïa ka bad u la sdang ïam namar ka jingkmen .

translation.en: For there was a tabernacle made  ; the first , wherein was the candlestick , and the table , and the shewbread  ; which is called the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Ïingjaiñ la pynïeng , ka bynta kaba ha khmat , ïa kaba la khot ka Jaka Bakyntang . Ha ka la buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ka miej lem bad u kpu ïa uba la ainguh sha U Blei .

translation.en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth–benoth , and the men of Cuth made Nergal , and the men of Hamath made Ashima ,
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Babilon ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw jong u blei Sukkoth Benoth ; ki briew ka Kuth , ki bleithaw jong u Nergal ; ki briew ka Hamath , ki bleithaw jong u Ashima ; ki briew ka Ibbah .

translation.en: And he made the vessels which were upon the table , his dishes , and his spoons , and his bowls , and his covers to cover withal , of pure gold .
translation.kha: U shna ïa ki khiew da ka ksiar nylla ban buh ha kata ka miej : ki pliang , ki khiew , ki khuri bad ki dabor rit ban pyndonkam ha ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .

translation.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness , and the princes with their lies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ki shukor ïa u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u da ki buit bymman jong ki .

translation.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead .
translation.kha: ha ka jingkyrmen ba ïa nga hi yn sa pynmihpat na kiba ïap .

translation.en: But they held their peace : for by the way they had disputed among themselves , who should be the greatest .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la jubab ïa u , namar ha lynti ki la ïatainia para ma ki shaphang uei uba khraw tam .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that Elijah the prophet came near , and said ,  Lord  God of Abraham , Isaac , and of Israel , let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel , and that I am thy servant , and that I have done all these things at thy word .
translation.kha: Ha ka kynta jong ka jingainguh ha ka por nohphai sngi , u Elijah nongïathuhlypa u wan sha ka duwan bad u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , U Blei u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , pynshisha mynta ba me long U Blei ki Israel bad ba nga long u shakri jong me bad ba nga la leh ïa kane baroh kat kum ka hukum jong me .

translation.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi wat ki shipai bashlur tam kin pynhap ïa la ki tiar ïapom bad kin mareh .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto them , I will not rule over you , neither shall my son rule over you : the  Lord  shall rule over you .
translation.kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Ngan ym long u nongsynshar jong phi , lymne u khun jong nga . U  Trai  un long u nongsynshar jong phi .

translation.en: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus , which was laid at his gate , full of sores ,
translation.kha: La don ruh u briew uba duk uba kyrteng , u Lasaros , uba la dap da ki prum , ïa uba la ju wallam sha ka jingkhang jong u briew uba riewspah ,

translation.en: Ye serpents , ye generation of vipers , how can ye escape the damnation of hell ?
translation.kha: Phi ki bseiñ bad ki khun ki bseiñ ! Kumno phi khmih lynti ban lait na ka jingshah pynrem sha ka dujok ?

translation.en: For all the sins of Baasha , and the sins of Elah his son , by which they sinned , and by which they made Israel to sin , in provoking the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki bad namar ba ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop , u Baasha bad u khun jong u , u Elah , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And the scripture was fulfilled , which saith , And he was numbered with the transgressors .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom la pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  U la don bynta ha ka kupar ki nongpalat .

translation.en: Four tables were on this side , and four tables on that side , by the side of the gate  ; eight tables , whereupon they slew their sacrifices .
translation.kha: Kumta la don saw tylli ki miej hapoh ka kamra bad saw tylli shabar , baroh lang ki don phra tylli ha kiba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban kñia .

translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel , but every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Ym pat don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por ; uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .

translation.en: Which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Amos , which was the son of Naum , which was the son of Esli , which was the son of Nagge ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Mattathias , u khun jong u Amos , u khun jong u Nahum , u khun jong u Esli , u khun jong u Naggai ,

translation.en: Unto you , O men , I call  ; and my voice is to the sons of man .
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , u khunbynriew ; nga khot ïa uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah , and came to Samaria , and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Menahem u khun jong u Gadi u leit na Tirsah sha Samaria , u pynïap ïa u Shallum , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And the sons of Ham  ; Cush , and Mizraim , and Put , and Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Ham — u Kush , u Ijipt , u Libya , bad u Kanaan — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .

translation.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive , what thank have ye ? for sinners also lend to sinners , to receive as much again .
translation.kha: Bad lada phi leh ai kylliang ïa kito na kiba phi kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ai kylliang ïa ki nongpop , ban ïoh pat katjuh !

translation.en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart , and of a good conscience , and of faith unfeigned :
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong kane ka hukum ka long ban pynkhih ïa kata ka jingieit kaba wan na ka dohnud kaba sngur , ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , bad ka jingngeit bashisha .

translation.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath , when thou comest to my kindred  ; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath .
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka lad ïa me ba men lait na kaba me la smai : lada me leit sha ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad ki kyntait ïa me , te men laitluid .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , there is a place by me , and thou shalt stand upon a rock :
translation.kha: hynrei don kawei ka jaka hangne hajan jong nga , ha kaba me lah ban ïeng halor u mawsiang .

translation.en: Jesus answered them , and said ,  My doctrine is not mine , but his that sent me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba nga hikai kam dei na ka jinghikai jong nga hi , hynrei ka wan na U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Which the children of Aaron , being of the families of the Kohathites , who were of the children of Levi , had : for theirs was the first lot .
translation.kha: ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , kiba dei na ka kur Kohath , kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi . Ka bynta jong ki ka dei kaba nyngkong eh ban pyndep .

translation.en: And all the spoil of these cities , and the cattle , the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves  ; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword , until they had destroyed them , neither left they any to breathe .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la shim ïa ki markordor baroh bad ïa ki jingri jingdup na kine ki nongbah bad ki la buh ïa ki na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ; ym don uwei ruh uba lait im .

translation.en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men , and keep the paths of the righteous .
translation.kha: Kumta phi dei ban bud nuksa ïa ki briew kiba bha bad im ka jingim kaba hok .

translation.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them , Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki kylli ,  Balei phi leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum jong ngi ka ong ba phim lah ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
