translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him  ; and he was sore wounded of the archers .
translation.kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur , bad u hi u la shah siat da ki khnam u nongshun , bad u la mynsaw jur .

translation.en: Damascus is waxed feeble , and turneth herself to flee , and fear hath seized on her : anguish and sorrows have taken her , as a woman in travail .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki long kiba tlot bad ki la phet ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki don ha ka jingud bad jingjynjar kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married : for he had married an Ethiopian woman .
translation.kha: U Moses u la shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kush bad ka Miriam bad u Aaron ki wad dong ïa u na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: For so it was , that the children of Israel had sinned against the  Lord  their God , which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt , from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and had feared other gods ,
translation.kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh namar ki Israel ki leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la pyllait im ïa ki na u syiem ka Ijipt bad la ïalam noh bak ïa ki na Ijipt .

translation.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children , in that he hath raised up Jesus again  ; as it is also written in the second psalm , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee .
translation.kha: Bad ngi don hangne ban wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha sha phi : Ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ba un leh , u la pyndep mynta na ka bynta jong ngi , kiba long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , da kaba pynmihpat ïa U Jisu . Kumba la thoh ha ka Salm kaba ar :   ‘ Me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .’

translation.en: They have mouths , but they speak not : eyes have they , but they see not :
translation.kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban kren ; bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  I will ask you one thing  ; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good , or to do evil ? to save life , or to destroy it ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga kylli ïa phi : Aïu ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Ban ïarap ne ban pynmynsaw ? Ban pynim ïa ka mynsiem briew ne ban pynjot ïa ka ?

translation.en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way ? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt , as thou wast ashamed of Assyria .
translation.kha: Phi la pyntat-dor ïa lade da kaba phai sha ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Yn pynnoh mynsiem ïa phi da ka Ijipt , kumba phi la long da ka Assyria .

translation.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians , to catch him in his words .
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot na ka kynhun u Herod , la phah sha U Jisu ban riam ïa u da ki jingkylli :

translation.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter , enquire who in it is worthy  ; and there abide till ye go thence .
translation.kha: Haba phi poi sha ka nongbah ne ka nongrit , leit rung shapoh bad wad ïa uno uno uba mon ban pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , bad sah bad u tad ynda phi mihnoh na kata ka jaka .

translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee ? wherefore camest thou not unto me ? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour ?
translation.kha: U Balak u ong ha u ,  Balei phim wan mynba nga la phah khot ïa phi ha kaba nyngkong ? Phi tharai ngam lah ban ai bainong kaba biang ïa phi ?

translation.en: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters  vessel that is broken in pieces  ; he shall not spare : so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth , or to take water withal out of the pit .
translation.kha: Phin sa pra kum u khra , uba la phret jin haduh ba ym don shuh ka lyngkhot , da kaba yn lah ban khat ïa ki rnga bakhluit , lane tong um na ka pung-um .

translation.en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness , which are by Jesus Christ , unto the glory and praise of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pyndap da ki jinglong babha shisha kiba tang U Jisu Khrist u lah ban pynmih , na ka bynta ka burom bad ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains , and of the plains south of Chinneroth , and in the valley , and in the borders of Dor on the west ,
translation.kha: bad sha ki syiem kiba ha ka ri lum ha ka phang shatei , kiba ha Them Jordan shathie na ka Duriaw Galilaïa , kiba ha trai ki lum , bad kiba harud duriaw hajan ka Dor .

translation.en: I will take the cup of salvation , and call upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ka jingainguh waiñ sha U  Trai  , ban ainguh ïa u namar ka jingpynim ïa nga .

translation.en: Then came there two women , that were harlots , unto the king , and stood before him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , ar ngut ki nuti ki la wan bad pynpaw ïa lade ha khmat u Syiem Solomon .

translation.en: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel , as a cloud to cover the land  ; it shall be in the latter days , and I will bring thee against my land , that the heathen may know me , when I shall be sanctified in thee , O Gog , before their eyes .
translation.kha: Men sa tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel kum ka  erïong kaba beh halor ka ri . Haba ka por ka poi , ngan phah ïa me ban hiarthma ïa ka ri jong nga , khnang ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew uei nga long , ban pyn-i ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga da kaei kaba nga leh lyngba jong me .

translation.en: I am verily a man which am a Jew , born in Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel , and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers , and was zealous toward God , as ye all are this day .
translation.kha: Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , hynrei ïa uba la pynheh pynsan hangne ha Jerusalem kum u shah hikai jong u Gamaliel . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka jinghikai bapyrkhing ha ka Hukum jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad nga la long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kumba long ma phi baroh hangne ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And he said , I seek my brethren : tell me , I pray thee , where they feed their flocks .
translation.kha: Nga wad ïa la ki hynmen shynrang , kiba ap sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri jong ki ,  u jubab .  Phi lah ban ïathuh hangno ki ïadon ?

translation.en: So shall he sprinkle many nations  ; the kings shall shut their mouths at him : for that which had not been told them shall they see  ; and that which they had not heard shall they consider .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta bun ki hima kin sngewphylla ïa u , bad ki syiem kin ym lait kren namar ka jingsngew lyngngoh . Kin ïohi bad kin sngewthuh katto katne kaba kim pat ju tip mynno mynno .

translation.en: His flesh is consumed away , that it cannot be seen  ; and his bones that were not seen stick out .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka nang ringswai ; phi lah ban ïohi ïa ki shyieng jong u baroh ;

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass , till all these things be fulfilled .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia ha shuwa ba ki briew kiba im mynta kin ïap baroh .

translation.en: And they truly were many priests , because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death :
translation.kha: Ka don sa kawei pat ka jingïapher : ki la don bun na kito kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , namar ki la ïap bad kim shym lah shuh ban bteng ïa la ka kam .

translation.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ , let us go on unto perfection  ; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works , and of faith toward God ,
translation.kha: Te , to ngin ïaid shaphrang , sha ka jinghikai ïa kiba ïadei bad kiba la san bad ieh shadien jong ngi ïa ki jinghikai banyngkong ka khubor jong ka jingngeit . Ngim dei ban neh sah ha ka nongrim jong ka jingphai noh na ki kam bymseisoh bad ka jingngeit ha U Blei ;

translation.en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die . Believest thou this ?
translation.kha: Hato pha ngeit ïa kane ?

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for the windows from on high are open , and the foundations of the earth do shake .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban lait na ka jingshyrkhei un hap ha ka  liewlep , bad uno uno uba lait na ka  liewlep un ngat ha ka jingriam . U  lapbah un theh na suiñbneng , bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei yn pynkhih .

translation.en: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that , they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh ha ka kut ha Shekhem ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki wad jingïada hapoh ka kut baskhem jong ka templ jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang .

translation.en: And it was so , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet , as she came in at the door , that he said , Come in , thou wife of Jeroboam  ; why feignest thou thyself to be another ? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Ahijah u ïohsngew ba ka rung ha jingkhang , u ong ,  Rung shapoh , nga tip pha dei ka tnga u Jeroboam . Balei pha leh mynleh kumba pha dei da kawei pat ka briew ? Nga don ka khubor kaba sngewsih ïa pha .

translation.en: And the young men that were spies went in , and brought out Rahab , and her father , and her mother , and her brethren , and all that she had  ; and they brought out all her kindred , and left them without the camp of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki leit bad wan ïalam ïa ka Rahab , lem bad ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka , ki hynmen ki para jong ka , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka kiba dang sah . Ki shim ïa ki baroh , ki longïing longsem bad ki mraw , sha ka jaka bashngain hajan ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .

translation.en: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite , the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are within thy gates .
translation.kha: To ïalehkmen ïa ka lem bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi .

translation.en: And great multitudes followed him  ; and he healed them there .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: This witness is true . Wherefore rebuke them sharply , that they may be sound in the faith ;
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw me dei ban sneng tyngeh ïa ki , khnang ba kin don ka jingngeit kaba shisha

translation.en: And he said unto his father , My head , my head . And he said to a lad , Carry him to his mother .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan u pyrta jam sha la u kpa ,  Ka khlieh jong nga ka pang ! Ka khlieh jong nga ka pang !   Bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u ,  u kpa u ong ha u shakri jong u .

translation.en: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good : the enemy shall pursue him .
translation.kha: ki la kyntait ïa kata kaba bha . Namar kane , ki nongshun jong ki kin buddien ïa ki .

translation.en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him , saying , Behold , the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent  ; let thy word therefore , I pray thee , be like one of theirs , and speak thou good .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u rangbah synshar uba la leit ban wallam ïa u Mikaïah u ong ha u ,  Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingjop na ka bynta u syiem , ka bha ba phi ruh phin leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land : for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem Ijipt bad ka kynhun shipai jong u kim ju mih shuh shabar ka Ijipt , namar u syiem Babilonia mynta u synshar ïa baroh ka ri kaba dei jong ka Ijipt , naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaduh ka pud bashatei jong ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil , and anointed him in the midst of his brethren : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon David from that day forward . So Samuel rose up , and went to Ramah .
translation.kha: U Samuel u shim ïa ka umphniang Olib bad u pynsleh ïa u Dabid ha khmat ki hynmen jong u . Hangta hi U Mynsiem U  Trai  u wan borbah ha u Dabid bad u long ryngkat bad u naduh kata ka sngi . Nangta u Samuel u leit phai noh sha Ramah .

translation.en: And he charged them , and said unto them , I am to be gathered unto my people : bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u hukum ïa la ki khun shynrang , u da ong ,  Mynta ba ngan sa leit noh sha ki briew jong nga ha kaba ïap noh , tep ïa nga ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga ha ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha u Ephron , u nong Hit ,

translation.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble , against the day of battle and war ?
translation.kha: Nga la buh pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ki por jingjynjar , bad na ka bynta ki sngi ka jingïaleh thma bad ka thma .

translation.en: And they said one to another , Go to , let us make brick , and burn them thoroughly . And they had brick for stone , and slime had they for mortar .
translation.kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ale ! ngin ïathaw maw-it bad ngin thang pyneh ïa ki .  Kumta ki la ïoh maw-it ban tei , bad ka bsiang ban pyndait lang ïa ki .

translation.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom ? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is ?
translation.kha: Phi ai ka jingai jingmut kaba bha shibun bad phi ïasam ïa ka jingtip bad u briew uba bieit kum ma nga !

translation.en: Until the time that his word came : the word of the  Lord  tried him .
translation.kha: haduh ka por ba ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh lypa , ka la urlong shisha . Ka ktien U  Trai  ka la pynshisha ba um shym bakla .

translation.en: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens :
translation.kha: U Issakhar u long tang kum u kada Uba dem ryngkdung hapdeng la ki jingkit .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his father Manasseh did .
translation.kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Manasseh , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Then the people rejoiced , for that they offered willingly , because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the  Lord  : and David the king also rejoiced with great joy .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ai da ka mon sngewbha sha U  Trai  , bad ki kmen ba ki la ai shibun . U Syiem Dabid ruh u la sngewkmen shikatdei eh .

translation.en: Also of your own selves shall men arise , speaking perverse things , to draw away disciples after them .
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka kynhun jong phi kin ïathuh ki jinglamler ban ïalam noh ïa ki parabangeit ban bud ïa ki .

translation.en: When the princes of Judah heard these things , then they came up from the king s house unto the house of the  Lord  , and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the  Lord s  house .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba lah jia , ki la wan kloi na ka ïingsyiem sha ka Templ bad ki la shong ha ka Khyrdop Bathymmai .

translation.en: And he shall be for a sanctuary  ; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel , for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Namar ka jinglongkhuid baphylla jong nga , nga long kum u maw uba ki briew ki jynthut ; nga long kum ka jingriam ka ban kem ïa ki briew jong ka Judah bad Israel bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free ? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ai ha ki kada khlaw ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ki ? Mano ba pyllait lan ïa ki bad shah ïa ki ban shang ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , The man shall be surely put to death : all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ïa uta u briew dei ban pynïap ; ka kynhun baroh kawei kan lynthem maw ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: Then shall the father of the damsel , and her mother , take and bring forth the tokens of the damsel s virginity unto the elders of the city in the gate :
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong kata ka briew kin leit rah bad pyn-i ïa ki dak ka jinglong sotti jong kata ka briew ha ka ïingbishar jong ki nongïalam shnong .

translation.en: Preach the word ; be instant in season , out of season ; reprove , rebuke , exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine .
translation.kha: ïalap ïa ka khubor , ban ïai kyntu ha kaba pynbna ïa ka (haba dei por ne ha bym dei por) , ban pynkynduh , ban pynbeit bad ban pynshlur , da ka jingïaishah baroh haba me hikai .

translation.en: The wicked are overthrown , and are not : but the house of the righteous shall stand .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki ïakynduh ïa la ka jingkyllon noh bad ym don ba mih pateng na ki , hynrei ki longïing jong kiba hok ki ïai im pateng .

translation.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes : fear the  Lord  , and depart from evil .
translation.kha: Wat buh ka jingpyrkhat ha lade ba phi kham stad ban ïa kaba phi long ; shu kohnguh beit ïa U  Trai  , bad kiar ban leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory , provoking one another , envying one another .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban sngewsarong lane kiba pynbitar iwei ïa iwei pat lane bishni iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Praise ye him , all his angels : praise ye him , all his hosts .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh ki angel jong u , baroh ki shipai bneng jong u .

translation.en: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother , the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , and said unto them , As the  Lord  liveth , who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity ,
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa ki ,  Nga la shim jingsmai ha U  Trai  uba im , uba la pyllait ïa nga na ki jingma baroh !

translation.en: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal , stretched forth over their heads above .
translation.kha: Halor ki khlieh jong kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka tnum ïa kaba la thaw da ki maw-it kiba shat phyrnai .

translation.en: Or darkness , that thou canst not see  ; and abundance of waters cover thee .
translation.kha: Ka wan ka jingdum ba phim lah shuh ban ïohi , bad ka jingshlei ka tyllep ïa phi .

translation.en: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem , and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold .
translation.kha: U Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u kem koidi ïa u bad u pynlong ïa ka Judah ban siew lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa bad laiphew saw kilo ka ksiar kum ka khajna .

translation.en: Who hath heard such a thing ? who hath seen such things ? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day ? or shall a nation be born at once ? for as soon as Zion travailed , she brought forth her children .
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba ju ïohi ne ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kata ? Uei uba la ïohi ïa kaba kum kata ? Lah mo ban kha ïa ka hima tang ha ka shi sngi ? Ka Seïon kam donkam ban shahshitom slem , shuwa ba yn kha ïa ka hima .

translation.en: Make thee bald , and poll thee for thy delicate children  ; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle  ; for they are gone into captivity from thee .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Judah , to khi ïa la u shñiuh ha ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki khun kiba phi ieit . To pynlong ïa lade kiba syllen kum ki pukni , namar ïa ki khun jong phi yn shim noh na phi ban ïalam sha ka jingringmraw .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel , that they turned back from pursuing him .
translation.kha: ki ithuh ba um dei u syiem Israel , bad ki sangeh noh na kaba tur ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt , every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself , because of the counsel of the  Lord  of hosts , which he hath determined against it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Ijipt kin sngewtriem ïa ka Judah ha man ka por ba la pynkynmaw ïa ka kupar kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la khreh na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad da ki waitlam jong ki , kin pynïap ïa kito kiba shong basah ha ki shnong jong ka ha ka ri . Nangta ka Tyros kan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you , that I have set before you life and death , blessing and cursing : therefore choose life , that both thou and thy seed may live :
translation.kha: Nga ai ha phi mynta ban jied napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap , napdeng ka jingkyrkhu U Blei bad ka jingtim U Blei , bad nga khot ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ban sakhi ïano phi jied . Jied ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: How many did you take ?
translation.kha: Katno tylli phi shim ?

translation.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep  ; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger .
translation.kha: Leh jaipdeh lada phi kwah ; ïai thiah sah , hynrei phin shahthngan .

translation.en: For he is not a God of the dead , but of the living : for all live unto him .
translation.kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong kiba ïap , namar ha u baroh ki im .

translation.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue , the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath .
translation.kha: Katba u Paul bad u Barnabas ki dang ïamihnoh na ka synagog , ki paidbah ki la khot sngewbha ïa ki ban wan biang ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud bad ban ïathuh shuh shuh ha ki shaphang kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Pray not for this people for their good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Wat kyrpad ïa nga ban ïarap ïa kine ki briew .

translation.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me : neither will I answer him with your speeches .
translation.kha: U Job u la kren ha phi , ym ha nga , hynrei ngan ym jubab ha ka rukom ba phi la leh .

translation.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the  Lord  in the hand of the sons of David  ; and ye be a great multitude , and there are with you golden calves , which Jeroboam made you for gods .
translation.kha: Mynta phi thmu ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka iktiar syiem kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid . Phi don ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad phi don ki khun masi ksiar kiba u Jeroboam u la shna ba kin long ki blei jong phi .

translation.en: Go not forth hastily to strive , lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof , when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame .
translation.kha: Wat kyrkieh eh ban leit sha ïingbishar halor kaei kaei kaba phi ïohi . Lada uwei pat u nongsakhi hadien u pynshisha ba phi la bakla , kaei nangta phin leh ?

translation.en: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee .
translation.kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me , bad mynta ki tip ba kaei kaei baroh kaba me la ai ha nga ka wan na me .

translation.en: Now therefore , what have I here , saith the  Lord  , that my people is taken away for nought ? they that rule over them make them to howl , saith the  Lord   ; and my name continually every day is blasphemed .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ha Babilonia kajuh hi ka la jia ; phi long kiba shahtehmraw , bad ym shym siewdor ei ei na ka bynta jong phi . Kito kiba synshar halor jong phi ki kop bad ki meng bad ki ïai pynpaw jingbeiñ ïa nga .

translation.en: Where the birds make their nests : as for the stork , the fir trees are her house .
translation.kha: Hangta ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ; ki thring ki shna skum ha ki dieng Kseh

translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba laiphew ar snem , bad u la synshar haduh phra snem ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And he brought him to Jesus . And when Jesus beheld him , he said ,  Thou art Simon the son of Jona : thou shalt be called Cephas ,  which is by interpretation , A stone .
translation.kha: Te u la ïalam ïa u Simon sha U Jisu . U Jisu u la peit ïa u bad u la ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka long u Simon u khun jong u Jona , hynrei yn khot ïa me u Kephas .  ( Kane ka long kumjuh kum ka kyntien  Petros  kaba mut  u mawsiang . )

translation.en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness : he is gracious , and full of compassion , and righteous .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka tyngshaiñ ha kaba dum na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha , na ka bynta kito kiba dap da ka jingisynei , kiba bha sbun bad kiba hok .

translation.en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war : but one sinner destroyeth much good .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka kham lehbha shibun ban ïa ki atiar ïaleh , hynrei uwei u nongpop u lah ban pynduh shibun ka jingbha .

translation.en: And if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , in integrity of heart , and in uprightness , to do according to all that I have commanded thee , and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments :
translation.kha: Lada me pat men shakri ïa nga ha ka jingkhuid dohnud bad ka jingïaid beit , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , bad lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa me ,

translation.en: What then ? notwithstanding , every way , whether in pretence , or in truth , Christ is preached ; and I therein do rejoice , yea , and will rejoice .
translation.kha: Kam lei lei! Nga sngewkmen shaphang kata , katba ïa U Khrist dang ïai ïalap ha ka rukom baroh , la na ki jingthmu bymdei ne badei .

translation.en: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel , even all that fight against her and her munition , and that distress her , shall be as a dream of a night vision .
translation.kha: te baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki hima kiba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah jong ka duwan U Blei , baroh ki tiar ïaleh jong ki bad ki tiar ki tar — baroh kiei kiei — kin jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum kaei kaei ba la shu mutdur mynmiet .

translation.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said , Lord , wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven , and consume them , even as Elias did ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jakob bad u Ïoannis kiba long ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane , ki la ong ,  Ko Trai , hato me kwah ïa ngi ban kyrpad ïa ka ding ban hiar na bneng ban pynjot ïa ki kumba u Elijah u la leh ?

translation.en: The  Lord  is a man of war : the  Lord  is his name .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u khla-ka-wait ; Ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the frogs shall come up both on thee , and upon thy people , and upon all thy servants .
translation.kha: Kin rynsied ha me , ha ki briew jong me , bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong me baroh .’

translation.en: ( Ephesians 6 :1-3 ) He expects parents to instruct and correct their children .
translation.kha: ( Ephesos 6 :1-3 ) U khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: And king Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest , saying , Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering , and the evening meat offering , and the king s burnt sacrifice , and his meat offering , with the burnt offering of all the people of the land , and their meat offering , and their drink offerings  ; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering , and all the blood of the sacrifice : and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by .
translation.kha: Nangta u hukum ïa u Uriah :  Pyndonkam ïa kane ka duwan baheh jong nga na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang mynstep bad ïa ki jingainguh bam janmiet , na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang bad jingainguh bam jong u syiem bad ki briew , bad na ka bynta ki jingainguh waiñ jong ki briew . Theh halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad baroh ïa kiba la kñia . Hynrei ieh ïa ka duwan rnong na ka bynta jong nga ban pyndonkam ïa kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Of these things put them in remembrance , charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit , but to the subverting of the hearers .
translation.kha: To pynkynmaw ïa ki briew jong me ïa kane , bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingkyntu bajai jai ha khmat U Blei ba kin ym ïa-wohnia halor ki kyntien ba ki ïakren . Kam long kaba pynmyntoi , hynrei tang ban pynjot ïa ki briew kiba sngap .

translation.en: Which maketh Arcturus , Orion , and Pleiades , and the chambers of the south .
translation.kha: U Blei u sdien ïa ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng — ka Dngiem Heh    , u Orion    bad ki Pleïades    , bad ki khlur shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Surely against me is he turned  ; he turneth his hand against me all the day .
translation.kha: Bad u la ïai sympat ïa nga da ki jingtied bym don jingisynei .

translation.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd , and fetched a calf tender and good , and gave it unto a young man  ; and he hasted to dress it .
translation.kha: Nangta u mareh sha ka kynhun jingri , u shim uwei u khun masi uba dang lung bad uba dap doh , bad u ai ha u shakri , uba pynstet ban leit shet .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Thou must prophesy again before many peoples , and nations , and tongues , and kings .
translation.kha: Te la ïathuh ïa nga ,  Sa shisien pat ka dei ïa me ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei sha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki syiem .

translation.en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers : and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer , and the king s friend :
translation.kha: U khlieh jong ki lat ka distrik : U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Nathan U nongai jingmut ïa u syiem : U Sabud , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Nathan

translation.en: And I punished them oft in every synagogue , and compelled them to blaspheme  ; and being exceedingly mad against them , I persecuted them even unto strange cities .
translation.kha: Bunsien nga la phah pynshitom ïa ki ha ki synagog baroh bad pyrshang ban pynlong ïa ki ban len ïa la ka jingngeit . Nga la bitar haduh katta katta ïa ki ba nga da leit sha ki nongbah nongwei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: Does not your heart yearn for the peace , happiness , and prosperity seen there ?
translation.kha: Hato ka mynsiem jong phi ka kwah ne em ïa ka jingsuk lane ka jingkmen bad ka jingpahuh pahai kumba phi ïohi hangtei .

translation.en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt , and great pain shall be in Ethiopia , when the slain shall fall in Egypt , and they shall take away her multitude , and her foundations shall be broken down .
translation.kha: Kan don ka thma ha Ijipt bad ka jingjynjar bah ha Sudan . Kiba bun ha Ijipt kin shah pynïap ; ka ri kan shah pynjot bad kan shah ieh ha ki jingjot .

translation.en: The great day of the  Lord  is near , it is near , and hasteth greatly , even the voice of the day of the  Lord  : the mighty man shall cry there bitterly .
translation.kha: Ka sngi bakhraw jong U  Trai  ka la jan — ka la jan eh bad ka wan kloi ! Kata kan long ka sngi kaba kthang , namar wat ki shipai kiba shlur tam kin kyang jam ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !

translation.en: Yea , they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him , and his army shall overflow : and many shall fall down slain .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut bajan eh jong u kin pynjot ïa u . Ïa kiba bun ki shipai jong u yn pynïap , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u yn pyndam noh .

translation.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth , and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth :
translation.kha: Wat sngewkmen haba u nongshun jong phi u ïakynduh ïa ka jingjot , bad wat lehkmen haba u jynthut .

translation.en: And again , Esaias saith , There shall be a root of Jesse , and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles ; in him shall the Gentiles trust .
translation.kha: Nangta , u Isaïah u ong ,  Uba hiarpateng na u Jesse un wanpaw ; un wan ban synshar ïa ki Jentil , bad kin buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki ha u .

translation.en: For we are saved by hope : but hope that is seen is not hope : for what a man seeth , why doth he yet hope for ?
translation.kha: Naba ka long da ka jingkyrmen ba ïa ngi la pynim ; hynrei lada ngi ïohi kaei kaba ngi ap kyrmen , te kam da long shisha ka jingkyrmen . Naba uei uta uba kyrmen ïa kaei kaba u ïohi ?

translation.en: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof  ; and the border about it shall be half a cubit  ; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about  ; and his stairs shall look toward the east .
translation.kha: Ka bynta ba hapdeng ruh ka long sawdong , hynñiew mitar ka jingjrong ha kawei pa kawei ka liang , bad ka rmiang ha ka tduh bashabar kaba long arphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong . ( Ka nur ka long sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang . ) Ki kyrdon ban kiew shalor ka duwan ki don ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How say they that Christ is David s son ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno lah ban ong ba U Messaïah un dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?

translation.en: And the king said unto them , What seemeth you best I will do . And the king stood by the gate side , and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  u syiem u jubab . Nangta u ïeng harud jong ka khyrdop katba ki rangbah jong u ki dang ïaid sha khmat ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut .

translation.en: Wherefore he called that place Beer–sheba  ; because there they sware both of them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Beersheba , namar dei hangta ba baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingsmai .

translation.en: Yet a little sleep , a little slumber , a little folding of the hands to sleep :
translation.kha: Dem kai shipor bad thiah lada phi sngewkwah . Kli ïa la ki kti ban jahthait shiphang ;

translation.en: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall .
translation.kha: Kito kiba pyrkhat ba ki ïeng skhem , kan kham bha ba ki sumar ba ïoh ki kyllon .

translation.en: I the  Lord  have spoken it : it shall come to pass , and I will do it  ; I will not go back , neither will I spare , neither will I repent  ; according to thy ways , and according to thy doings , shall they judge thee , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban leh ei ei . Ngan ym ieh kumto ïa ki pop jong pha lane pyn-i jingsngewlem ne jingisynei . Phan shah pynshitom namar kaei kaba pha la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: He shall recount his worthies : they shall stumble in their walk  ; they shall make haste to the wall thereof , and the defence shall be prepared .
translation.kha: La phah khot ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam ; ki jynthut katba ki dang tur sha khmat . Ki nongtur ïaleh ki tur sha ka kynroh bad ki pynap ïa ki stieh na ka bynta u dieng pynpra kynroh .

translation.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it , neither shall it be valued with pure gold .
translation.kha: U mawkordor Topas babha tam bad ka ksiar banylla kim lah ïanujor bad ka dor jong ka jingstad .

translation.en: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat .
translation.kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .

translation.en: When they fast , I will not hear their cry  ; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation , I will not accept them : but I will consume them by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence .
translation.kha: Wat lada ki shahjingit , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki jingkyang jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap ; bad wat lada ki ai ïa nga ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bam , ngan ym sngewbha ïa ki . Pynban ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .

translation.en: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly , which shall go up and come into thine house , and into thy bedchamber , and upon thy bed , and into the house of thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thine ovens , and into thy kneadingtroughs :
translation.kha: Ka wah Nile kan jyllei da ki jakoid kat haduh ba kin kynthih na wah bad rung shapoh ïingsyiem jong me , sha kamra thiah jong me bad halor jingthiah jong me , sha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me , bad wat ha ki jaka shet kpu jong me bad ki khiew shet kpu jong me .

translation.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them , nor serve them : for I the  Lord  thy God am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me ,
translation.kha: Wat dem ne mane ïa kano kano ka bleithaw , naba nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ngam lah shah ba phin mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Nga pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng .

translation.en: They are exalted for a little while , but are gone and brought low  ; they are taken out of the way as all other , and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta shipor , u briew uba sniew u roi u par , hynrei u tyrkhong pat kum u ñiut , kum ki kop kew ïa kiba la ot noh .

translation.en: But what saith the answer of God unto him ? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men , who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jubab ba U Blei u la ai ïa u ?  Nga la buh na ka bynta jong nga , hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki bym shym la mane ïa u blei thala , u Baal .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which shall take it .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ruh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan ai noh ïa ka nongbah ha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , bad kin kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel , Because ye despise this word , and trust in oppression and perverseness , and stay thereon :
translation.kha: Hynrei kane ka dei kaei kaba U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel u ong :  Phi kyntait ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi bad phi shaniah ha ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingshukor .

translation.en: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment , an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary : it shall be an holy anointing oil .
translation.kha: bad shna ïa ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang ba la khleh lang kum ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: And they arose , and went to Ziph before Saul : but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon , in the plain on the south of Jeshimon .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mihnoh bad leit phai sha Siph ha shuwa jong u Saul . U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki don ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon , ha kawei ka them bakynjah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri khlaw Judia .

translation.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough : turn you northward .
translation.kha: ba ngi la kham pynlut por da kaba ïaid sakma ha kata ka ri lum bad ba ngi la dei ban leit shaphang shatei .

translation.en: But as soon as this thy son was come , which hath devoured thy living with harlots , thou hast killed for him the fatted calf .
translation.kha: Hynrei une u khun jong phi u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka jingdon jingem jong phi ha ki nuti , bad haba u wan phai pat sha ïing , phi pynïap na ka bynta jong u ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid !’

translation.en: As the whirlwind passeth , so is the wicked no more : but the righteous is an everlasting foundation .
translation.kha: Ki  erïong ki wan , bad ki bymman ki shah rong noh ; hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki shngain borabor .

translation.en: How did you sleep ?
translation.kha: Kumno phi thiah ?

translation.en: If a man die , shall he live again ? all the days of my appointed time will I wait , till my change come .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïap noh , hato u lah mo ban im pat ? Hynrei ngan ap ïa ki aïom kiba kham bha , ban ap haduh ka por jong ka jingjynjar kan wai noh .

translation.en: Though hand join in hand , the wicked shall not be unpunished : but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban tip skhem ba ki riewbymman kin shah pynshitom , hynrei kiba hok kin lait .

translation.en: And he looked , and , behold , there was a cake baken on the coals , and a cruse of water at his head . And he did eat and drink , and laid him down again .
translation.kha: U la peit sawdong bad u ïohi shi lyngkhot u kpu bad shi khiew ka um hajan ka khlieh jong u . U la bam bad dih um , bad u la thiah biang .

translation.en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
translation.kha: kum U Khun U Briew , u bym shym la wan ba un shah shakri , hynrei ban shakri bad aiti ïa la ka jingim ban siewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun .

translation.en: Dare any of you , having a matter against another , go to law before the unjust , and not before the saints ?
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi u don ka jingïakajia bad uwei pat u parabangeit , kumno phi nud ban leit ha khmat ki nongbishar bymngeit ha ka jaka ban ailad ïa ki briew U Blei ban pynbeit ïa kata ka kam ?

translation.en: And I will make all my mountains a way , and my highways shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Ngan shna ïa ka surok bah halor ki lumbah bad pynkhreh ïa ka lynti ba ki briew jong nga kin ïaid .

translation.en: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number , and bind them in thy skirts .
translation.kha: Pynsah katto katne ki shñiuh bad song ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ki jaiñkup jong me .

translation.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water , which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father  ; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham : and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them .
translation.kha: U la tih biang sa shisien ïa ki pukri ïa kiba la tih ha ka por jong u Abraham ïa kiba ki Philistia ki la set khyndew noh hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham . U Isaak u la ai kijuh ki kyrteng ïa kita ki pukri kumba u kpa jong u , u la khot ïa ki .

translation.en: For the truth s sake , which dwelleth in us , and shall be with us for ever .
translation.kha: namar ka jingshisha ka ïaisah ha ngi bad kan long lem bad ngi junom .

translation.en: Watch ye therefore , and pray always , that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass , and to stand before the Son of man .
translation.kha: Da husiar bad duwai borabor ba phin don ka jingkhlaiñ ban leit ha ka jingshngain lyngba kito kiei kiei ki ban sa jia bad ban ïeng ha khmat jong U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: Then said he unto the disciples ,  It is impossible but that offences will come : but woe unto him , through whom they come !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Kiei kiei kiba pynlong ïa ki briew ban hap ha ka pop ki dei ban jia , hynrei katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa uta uba pynlong ïa ki ban jia !

translation.en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire , and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women : and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot , and thou also shalt give no hire any more .
translation.kha: Kin thang duh ïa ki ïing jong pha bad shah ïa ki paid kynthei ban ïohi ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong pha . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ban sangeh ban long ka nuti bad pynlong ïa pha ban sangeh ban ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki nongleh-ieit jong pha .

translation.en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka khyndew da ka bor jong u ; da ka jingstad jong u , u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad u la pyiar pynïar ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit bad ïeng ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ

translation.en: The princes digged the well , the nobles of the people digged it , by the direction of the lawgiver , with their staves . And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah :
translation.kha: Ka pukri ba la tih da ki khun syiem Bad da ki nongïalam u paidbah , La tih da u diengsynshar syiem Bad da ki diengduh jong ki .  Na kata ka ri khlaw ki la mihnoh sha Mattanah ,

translation.en: Arise , get you up unto the wealthy nation , that dwelleth without care , saith the  Lord  , which have neither gates nor bars , which dwell alone .
translation.kha: ‘ To wan , ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa kito ki briew kiba sngewshngain bad sngewskhem ! Ka nongbah jong ki , kam don ki khyrdop ne ki tala bad kam don jingïada ei ei .’

translation.en: Or if his sin , wherein he hath sinned , come to his knowledge  ; he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a male without blemish :
translation.kha: kumta mar ïatip ïa kata ka pop , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy , and whom he will he hardeneth .
translation.kha: Kumta te , U Blei u isynei ïa uno uno uba u kwah , bad u pyneh dohnud ïa uno uno uba u kwah .

translation.en: And he made curtains of goats  hair for the tent over the tabernacle : eleven curtains he made them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki shna ïa ka jingtap jong ka Ïingjaiñ na ki khatwei tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang .

translation.en: The soul that sinneth , it shall die . The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father , neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son : the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him , and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him .
translation.kha: Ka dei ïa uta uba leh pop ban ïap . U khun um dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong u kpa jong u , lymne u kpa namar ka pop jong u khun jong u . Yn ai bainong ïa u briew uba bha namar ka jinglehbha , bad u briew uba sniew un shahshitom namar ka jingsniew kaba u leh .

translation.en: And the men rose up from thence , and looked toward Sodom : and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way .
translation.kha: Te kita ki briew ki ïamihnoh nangta , bad ki leit sha ka jaka na kaba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka Sodom ; bad u Abraham u leit on lynti ïa ki .

translation.en: Make ye him drunken : for he magnified himself against the  Lord  : Moab also shall wallow in his vomit , and he also shall be in derision .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pynbuaid ïa ka Moab , namar ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ka Moab kan syntuid ha la ka prie , bad ki briew kin rkhie .

translation.en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews  speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall , to affright them , and to trouble them  ; that they might take the city .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki pyrta ïa kane ha ka ktien Hebru khnang ban pynsheptieng bad pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba don ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah , te kan long kaba kham suk ban knieh ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come , and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Haba u Hesekaïah u la ïohi ïa u Sennakherib ba u thmu ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem ruh ,

translation.en: Men shall clap their hands at him , and shall hiss him out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka lyer ka kyrhuh ha ki katba ki dang ïaphet , da kaba pynsheptieng ïa ki da ka bor pynjot .

translation.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u phah ktien sha ka Rakhel bad ka Leah ba kin ïakynduh ïa u ha lyngkha ha kaba ki jingri jong u ki don .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year , in the first month , the first day of the month , the waters were dried up from off the earth : and Noah removed the covering of the ark , and looked , and , behold , the face of the ground was dry .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong mynba u Noah u la dap hynriewspah wei snem , ka um ka la rngad noh na ka khyndew . U Noah u lied noh ïa ka jingtap jong kata ka lieng , u khmih sawdong , bad u ïohi ba ka khyndew ka la nang rkhiang .

translation.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand , and took the knife to slay his son .
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka tari ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , God is mighty , and despiseth not any : he is mighty in strength and wisdom .
translation.kha: Katno U Blei u long uba khlaiñ ! um ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano ; ym don kano kano kaba um lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Pyrshang ban tip ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .

translation.en: All true Christians must witness to others .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Khristan bashisha ki dei ban ïalap ha kiwei pat .

translation.en: God sent Jesus to preach the good news of the Kingdom .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u Jisu ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha shaphang ka Hima .

translation.en: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan , the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron , and said unto them , Come near , carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp .
translation.kha: U Moses u khot ïa u Mishael bad ïa u Elsaphan , ki khun jong u Ussiel , u kñi jong u Aaron , bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ale shane bad ïarah noh ïa kine ki met jong ki parakha jong phi na ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang bad buh ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And if ye shall say , What shall we eat the seventh year ? behold , we shall not sow , nor gather in our increase :
translation.kha: Hynrei lah ban don uba kylli hato yn ïoh bam da-ei ha kata ka snem kaba hynñiew , lada ym lah ban bet ban thung lane ban ot ban lum ïa ki soh .

translation.en: Then answered Haggai , and said , So is this people , and so is this nation before me , saith the  Lord   ; and so is every work of their hands  ; and that which they offer there is unclean .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ong ,  U  Trai  u ong ba kata kajuh kaei kaei ka treikam ha ki briew jong kane ka hima bad ha baroh kiei kiei ba ki pynmih ; bad baroh ba ki ai ha ka duwan ka long ba la pyntngit .

translation.en: I have trodden the winepress alone  ; and of the people there was none with me : for I will tread them in mine anger , and trample them in my fury  ; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments , and I will stain all my raiment .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Nga la ïuh ïa ki jaitbynriew kum ki sohwaiñ , bad ym don uwei ruh u ba la wan ban ïarap ïa nga . Nga la ïuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar , bad ka snam jong ki ka la bit lut ha ki jaiñphong jong nga .

translation.en: He built Eloth , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .
translation.kha: ( Dei hadien ka jingïap jong u Amasaïah , ba u Ussaïah u la ïohknieh biang ïa ka Elath bad tei thymmai pat ïa ka nongbah . )

translation.en: Being confident of this very thing , that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga sngewskhem ba U Blei , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kam babha ha phi , un ïai trei ha phi haduh ba yn da pyndep ïa ka ha kata ka Sngi jong U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Ye mountains , that ye skipped like rams  ; and ye little hills , like lambs ?
translation.kha: Phi ki lumbah , balei phi ryngkoh kum ki blang ? Phi ki lumrit , balei phi kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot ?

translation.en: And the women answered one another as they played , and said , Saul hath slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglehkmen jong ki , kita ki kynthei ki ïaphawar ,  U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , bad u Dabid da ki phew hajar .

translation.en: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself ; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church .
translation.kha: Uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher u ïarap tang ïa lade , hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u ïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Soitan uba hap kum ka leilieh na bneng .

translation.en: And the rest , some on boards , and some on broken pieces of the ship . And so it came to pass , that they escaped all safe to land .
translation.kha: bad kiba sah kin bud nadien , da kaba snoh ha ki lyntang lane ha kino kino ki lyngkhot kiba la pait jong ka lieng . Bad kane ka la long kumno ngi baroh ngi la lait im sha ryngkew .

translation.en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul . Remember my bonds . Grace be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: Da ka kti jong nga hi nga thoh ïa kane :  Ki jingai khublei na u Paul .  Wat klet ïa ki kynjri jong nga ! To ai ba ka jingaiei jong U Blei kan long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him : but the Jews cried out , saying , If thou let this man go , thou art not Caesar s friend : whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar .
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la pyrshang ban thaw lad ban pyllait ïa U Jisu . Hynrei u paidbah u la pyrta biang ,  Lada me pyllait ïa u , kata ka mut ba mem dei u paralok jong u Patsha ! Uno uno uba kam ba u dei u syiem u long u nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u Patsha !

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  He it is , to whom I shall give a sop , when I have dipped it .  And when he had dipped the sop , he gave it to Judas Iscariot , the son of Simon .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ngan wieh katto katne u kpu ha ka sos bad ngan ai ha u , uta ha uba nga ai ; u dei uta u briew .  Kumta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , u la wieh ha ka , bad u la ai ha u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot .

translation.en: Then there arose a reasoning among them , which of them should be greatest .
translation.kha: Ka jingïania ka la mih hapdeng ki synran ha kaba ïadei badno napdeng jong ki , uba long uba khraw tam .

translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  answered and said , O  Lord  of hosts , how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah , against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years ?
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me la bitar ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah haduh hynñiewphew snem mynta . Slem sa katno kan long ha shuwa ba men pyn-i ha ki ka jingisynei ?

translation.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober , to love their husbands , to love their children ,
translation.kha: Ki dei ban hikai ïa kaei kaba bha , khnang ba ki lah ban hikai ïa ki kynthei ba dang kham samla ban ieit ïa la ki tnga bad ki khun ,

translation.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels  ; but he took on him the seed of Abraham .
translation.kha: Namar ka shai kdar , ba ym dei ïa ki angel ba u ïarap . Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U ïarap ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham .

translation.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia , All the kingdoms of the earth hath the  Lord  God of heaven given me  ; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem , which is in Judah . Who is there among you of all his people ? The  Lord  his God be with him , and let him go up .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka hukum jong u Syros , u Patsha ka ri Persia . U  Trai  , U Blei ka Bneng , u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad u la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong u ha Jerusalem kaba ha Judah . Mynta , ma phi baroh kiba long ki briew jong U Blei , khie leit shata , bad to ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi .

translation.en: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time , every man to his tribe and to his family , and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por kiwei pat ki Israel ki mihnoh nangta , bad man u rangbah u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jait bad sha la ka longïing bad sha la ki jingdon jingem .

translation.en: And Ehud came unto him  ; and he was sitting in a summer parlour , which he had for himself alone . And Ehud said , I have a message from God unto thee . And he arose out of his seat .
translation.kha: Nangta , katba u syiem u dang shong hangta marwei ha la ka kamra shong pyngngad halor tnum ïing , u Ehud u la leit sha u , bad u ong ,  Nga don ka khubor na U Blei sha phi .  U syiem u la ïeng joit .

translation.en: And they came and besought them , and brought them out , and desired them to depart out of the city .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad pan map na ki ; nangta ki la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar jong ka byndi bad ki la kyrpad ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: For which cause we faint not ; but though our outward man perish , yet the inward man is renewed day by day .
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw ngim ju duh jingkyrmen . Wat la ki met ba kynja doh jong ngi ki la nang pyut noh , pynban , ïa ki met ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi la nang pynthymmai na kawei ka sngi sha kawei ka sngi .

translation.en: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast burned this roll , saying , Why hast thou written therein , saying , The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land , and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u syiem ,  Me la thang ïa ka kot kli , bad me la kylli ïa u Jeremaïah balei ba u la thoh ba u syiem ka Babilonia un wan bad pynjot ïa kane ka ri bad pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki mrad jong ka .

translation.en: But Rab–shakeh said unto them , Hath my master sent me to thy master , and to thee , to speak these words ? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall , that they may eat their own dung , and drink their own piss with you ?
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Hato me pyrkhat ba dei tang ma me bad u syiem kiba u nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ong ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Em , nga kren ruh ha ki briew kiba shong halor ka kynroh , ki ban hap bam ïa ka jakhlia bad ban dih ïa ka um pynjhieh , kumba me men hap leh .

translation.en: Wherefore say , Behold , I give unto him my covenant of peace :
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ha u ba ngan pynlong ka jutang bad u ka ban neh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed , that thou shalt sow the ground withal  ; and bread of the increase of the earth , and it shall be fat and plenteous : in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures .
translation.kha: Man ba phi bet ïa ki symbai jong phi , U  Trai  un phah slap ban pynlong ïa ki ban san bad ai ïa phi ka jingot kaba bun , bad ki jingri jong phi kin don shibun ki jaka bam phlang .

translation.en: And to this agree the words of the prophets  ; as it is written ,
translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïamynjur tylli bad kane . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :

translation.en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth : therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities .
translation.kha: Na baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei , phi long tang kawei kaba nga la ithuh bad sumar . Kata ka long kaei kaba la pynlong ïa ki pop jong phi kiba shyrkhei , bad kata ka long balei ba nga dei ban pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim , because there was much water there : and they came , and were baptized .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis ruh u dang pynbaptis ha Ainon , ka bym da jngai na Salim , namar ba ka la don shibun ka um ha kata ka jaka . Ki briew ki la ïaleit sha u , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they have made you desolate , and swallowed you up on every side , that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen , and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers , and are an infamy of the people :
translation.kha: To ïathuhlypa , nangta , bad to pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong . Mynba ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan ki la kurup bad lute ïa ki lumbah ka Israel , baroh ki la krenbeiñ ïa ka Israel .

translation.en: Now concerning spiritual gifts , brethren , I would not have you ignorant .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki jingai na U Mynsiem Bakhuid . Nga kwah ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong ki , ko parabangeit jong nga .

translation.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose , that he might know your estate , and comfort your hearts ;
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba nga phah ïa u sha phi , khnang ba un ai mynsiem ïa phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi kumno ngi baroh hangne ngi ïalong .

translation.en: And Elisha said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , surely , were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , I would not look toward thee , nor see thee .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , uba nga shakri , nga smai ba ngam don ei ei bad phi lada ngam burom ïa u paralok jong phi , u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah .

translation.en: And thou mourn at the last , when thy flesh and thy body are consumed ,
translation.kha: Phin thiah ryngkat bad ka jingud shuwa ba phin ïap , ka doh bad ki dohksah jong phi kin ringswai , bad phin ong ,

translation.en: And in the seventh month , on the first day of the month , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work : it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynñiew phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam . Ha kata ka sngi put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: But ye have despised the poor . Do not rich men oppress you , and draw you before the judgment seats ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phim ñiewburom ïa kiba duk ! Kiei kita kiba khñiot beiñ ïa phi bad ba ïalam ïa phi ha khmat ki nongbishar ? Kiba riewspah keiñ !

translation.en: Hath he smitten him , as he smote those that smote him ? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him ?
translation.kha: Ïa ka Israel ym shym pat la pynshitom jur da U  Trai  kumba la leh ïa ki nongshun jong ka , lymne kam shym la duh shibun ki rangbah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel , which took it on the second day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein , according to all that he had done to Libnah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor ka Lakhish ha ka sngi kaba ar jong ka thma . Kumba ki la leh ha Libnah , kim shym iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: Thou that art full of stirs , a tumultuous city , a joyous city : thy slain men are not slain with the sword , nor dead in battle .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah baroh kawei ka don ha ka jingkhihwin , la pyndap da ka jingsawa bad ka jingshongshit . Ki rangbah jong phi kiba la ïap ha kane ka thma kim shym ïap ha ka jingïaleh .

translation.en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds :
translation.kha: Uba riewspah u don shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot ,

translation.en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts , he answering said unto them ,  What reason ye in your hearts ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi pyrkhat kum ïa kita kiei kiei ?

translation.en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king , and had neither dressed his feet , nor trimmed his beard , nor washed his clothes , from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace .
translation.kha: Nangta u Mephibosheth , u ksiew jong u Saul , u wan hiar ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem . Um shym la sait ïa la ki kjat , lane khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh , lane sait ïa la ki jaiñ , naduh ka por ba u syiem u la iehnoh ïa ka Jerusalem haduh ba un da wan phai pat ha ka jingjop .

translation.en: But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people , which had nothing , in the land of Judah , and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time .
translation.kha: U la iehnoh ha Judah katto katne na ki briew kiba duk tam , ki bym don jaka puta , bad u la ai ïa ki , ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki lyngkha .

translation.en: And they said , There is no hope : but we will walk after our own devices , and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart .
translation.kha: Kin jubab , ‘ Em , balei ngin leh kumta ? Ngi baroh ngin ïailong kiba mutlop bad kiba sniew kumba ngi kwah ban long .’

translation.en: But when king David heard of all these things , he was very wroth .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Dabid u la ïohsngew ïa kaba la jia , u la bitar lep .

translation.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices great abundance , and precious stones : neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon .
translation.kha: Ka ai sngewbha ïa u syiem Solomon ki jingai kiba ka la wanrah : palat saw hajar kilo ka ksiar bad shikatdei eh ki musla bad ki mawkordor . Ym pat ju don musla kiba bha kum kita kiba ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ai ha u syiem Solomon .

translation.en: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years :
translation.kha: U la im laispah hynriewphew san snem .

translation.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra dei ban otsher ïa uta u khunlung .

translation.en: Wilt thou believe him , that he will bring home thy seed , and gather it into thy barn ?
translation.kha: Hato me khmih lynti ïa u ba un wanrah ïa ka jingot jong me , bad ban lum ïa u kew na ka jaka shoh kew jong me ?

translation.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta u Korah u lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei , bad ki la ïeng da kaba phai pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Kynsan kynsan ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon U  Trai  ka paw ha ka kynhun baroh kawei ,

translation.en: And he said , What shall I give thee ? And Jacob said , Thou shalt not give me any thing : if thou wilt do this thing for me , I will again feed and keep thy flock :
translation.kha: Ngan siew aïu ïa me ?  u Laban u kylli . U Jakob u jubab ,  Ngam donkam bainong ei ei . Ngan ïai bteng ban sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri jong phi lada phi mynjur ïa kane ka jingai jingmut :

translation.en: Wherefore should the heathen say , Where is now their God ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ki jaitbynriew kin kylli ïa ngi ,  Hangno U Blei jong phi ?

translation.en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide : and as soon as the sun was down , Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree , and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city , and raise thereon a great heap of stones , that remaineth unto this day .
translation.kha: U la phasi ïa u syiem jong ka Ai ha uwei u dieng bad u ieh ïa ka met jong u hangta haduh janmiet . Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai hukum ban weng noh ïa kata ka metïap , bad la bret ïa ka ha ka jaka rung sha ka khyrdop ka nongbah . Ki la tap ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang sah hangta mynta .

translation.en: Then said I , What come these to do ? And he spake , saying , These are the horns which have scattered Judah , so that no man did lift up his head : but these are come to fray them , to cast out the horns of the Gentiles , which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ,  Kine ki rangbah ki la ïawan ban leh aïu ?  U la jubab ,  Ki la ïawan ban pyntriem bad pynkyllon ïa ki hima kiba la pynlwet khoit ïa ka ri Judah bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak .
translation.kha: Pynban , to sumar , ban ym shah ba ka jinglaitluid ka jingleh jong phi kan pynlong ïa kito kiba tlot ha ka jingngeit ba kin hap ha ka pop .

translation.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed , they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kim jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad leit bad phi sha ka thma , kin ïoh ïa la ka bhah jong ka jingïohkynti ha ka ri Kanaan , kumba phi ïoh .

translation.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool .
translation.kha: tad ynda nga buh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .’

translation.en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands  ; every one after his tongue , after their families , in their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Japheth , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .

translation.en: Ye have plowed wickedness , ye have reaped iniquity  ; ye have eaten the fruit of lies : because thou didst trust in thy way , in the multitude of thy mighty men .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynban phi la bet ïa kaba sniew bad ïoh ot ïa ka jingot jong ka . Phi la bam ïa ki soh ba la pynmih da ka jingshukor jong phi .  Namar ba phi shaniah ha ki kali thma jong phi bad ha ka jingbun paid ki shipai jong phi ,

translation.en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer  ; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them .
translation.kha: Ki jait Ephraim kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Geser , bad kumta kita ki Kanaan ki ïaishong hangta hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: For he that hath , to him shall be given : and he that hath not , from him shall be taken even that which he hath .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba don ei ei yn ai shuh , bad na u briew u bym don ei ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kata kaba khyndiat kaba u don .

translation.en: And he said unto them that stood by , Take from him the pound , and give it to him that hath ten pounds .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha kito kiba ïa-ïeng hangta , ‘ To shim noh ïa ka sbai ksiar na u bad ai ïa ka ha u shakri uba don shiphew tylli ki sbai .’

translation.en: Upon my right hand rise the youth  ; they push away my feet , and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction .
translation.kha: Une u paidbhur u tur pyrshah ïa nga ; ki pynher krad ïa nga ; ki pynkhreh ïa ka jingïaleh kaba kut jong ki .

translation.en: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whose heart the  Lord  had put wisdom , even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it :
translation.kha: U Moses u la khot ïa u Besalel , ïa u Oholiab , bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba tbit ha kiba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka jingnang bad kiba kloi mon sngewbha ban ïarap , bad u ong ïa ki ban sdang trei noh ïa kata ka kam .

translation.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle , that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan : but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ha ka sngi ïaleh thma , ym don mano mano na ki shipai Israel uba don waitlam lane sum , lait noh u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u .

translation.en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites , and will give them in possession , that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka ri shyiap ba sha mihngi ban jop ïa ka Moab , lem bad ka Ammon , khnang ba ka Moab kan ym long shuh ka hima .

translation.en: And Balaam went with Balak , and they came unto Kirjath–huzoth .
translation.kha: Kumta u Balaam u la leit ryngkat bad u Balak sha ka shnongrit Husoth ,

translation.en: And he brought back all the goods , and also brought again his brother Lot , and his goods , and the women also , and the people .
translation.kha: U wan ïalam pat ruh ïa u Lot , u pyrsa jong u lem bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u , ryngkat ruh bad ïa ki kynthei bad ïa kiwei pat ki koidi .

translation.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old : these were the years of the life of Sarah .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka la im shispah arphew hynñiew snem .

translation.en: For he was astonished , and all that were with him , at the draught of the fishes which they had taken :
translation.kha: Ma u bad kiwei pat kiba don lem bad u ki la sngewphylla ïa ka jingbun palat ki dohkha kiba ki la ïoh tong .

translation.en: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints , and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus : and when I saw her , I wondered with great admiration .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kata ka briew ba ka la buaid da ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei , bad da ka snam jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la ïaineh skhem ha U Jisu . Haba nga la ïohi ïa ka , nga la sngewkyndit shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called unto Moses , and said , Go ye , serve the  Lord   ; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed : let your little ones also go with you .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses , bad u la ong ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  ; wat ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh ki lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi . Hynrei ki langbrot , ki blang bad ki masi jong phi ki dei ban don hangne .

translation.en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be , blessed shall she be above women in the tent .
translation.kha: Kaba donbok tam na ki kynthei ka dei ka Jael , Ka tnga jong u Heber u jait Ken ; Kaba donbok tam na ki kynthei kiba shong ha ki dara .

translation.en: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish : and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel :
translation.kha: Baroh kiba na ka longïing jong u Ahab bad ki khun ki ksiew ki dei ban ïap ; ngan sar lin ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong u , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh .

translation.en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite : for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite .
translation.kha: U Sisera u phet ïap sha ka dara jong ka Jael , ka tnga jong u Heber u jait Ken , namar u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor u don ha ka jingïasuk bad ka longïing jong u Heber .

translation.en: And David said unto Nathan , I have sinned against the  Lord . And Nathan said unto David , The  Lord  also hath put away thy sin  ; thou shalt not die .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ,  U Dabid u la ong . U Nathan u jubab ,  U  Trai  u map ïa phi ; phin ym ïap .

translation.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God .
translation.kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ban hap ha ki kti jong U Blei uba im !

translation.en: But the  Lord  is in his holy temple : let all the earth keep silence before him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ha ka Templ bakhuid jong u ; to ai ba uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un sngap jar ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: In that day shall the branch of the  Lord  be beautiful and glorious , and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba U  Trai  un pynlong ïa uwei pa uwei u jingthung bad u dieng ha ka ri ban long uba heh bad ba-itynnat . Baroh ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin dap da ka jingkmen bad jingsarong ha ki mar rep ba ka ri ka pynmih .

translation.en: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near  ; for them the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to minister unto him , and to bless in the name of the  Lord   ; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried :
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh Lebi ruh kin leit lang shata , namar dei ma ki , ki ban rai ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingïania bad ka jingïashoh . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la jied ïa ki ban shakri ïa u bad kyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim , to the top of Pisgah , and built seven altars , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa u sha ka madan Sophim kaba ha khlieh u Lum Pisgah . Hangta ruh u la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad u la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei na ki .

translation.en: Wherefore hear the word of the  Lord  , ye scornful men , that rule this people which is in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta , phi ki briew ba leh meng kiba synshar hangne ha Jerusalem halor kane ka jaitbynriew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong .

translation.en: Trust ye not in a friend , put ye not confidence in a guide : keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom .
translation.kha: Wat ngeit ïa la u paramarjan ne shaniah ha la u paralok . Da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi kren wat ha la ka tnga .

translation.en: Now therefore send quickly , and tell David , saying , Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness , but speedily pass over  ; lest the king be swallowed up , and all the people that are with him .
translation.kha: U Hushai u bynrap ,  Pynkloi , mynta ! phah khubor sha u Dabid ban ym sahmiet ha ki jaka jam wah ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ban jam mar mar ïa ka Jordan , ba kumta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh kin ym shah kem bad shah pynïap .

translation.en: I will go before thee , and make the crooked places straight : I will break in pieces the gates of brass , and cut in sunder the bars of iron :
translation.kha: Nga da lade ngan pynkhreh ïa ka lynti jong me , ngan pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bad ki lumrit . Ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdop rnong bad pynkheiñ ïa ki nar-khang jong ki .

translation.en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee  ; they seek thee not  ; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy , with the chastisement of a cruel one , for the multitude of thine iniquity  ; because thy sins were increased .
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong phi ki la klet noh ïa phi ; kim salia shuh ïa phi . Nga la tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u nongshun ; ka jingshah pynshitom jong phi ka la long kaba eh namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka long kaba khraw .

translation.en: And Goshen , and Holon , and Giloh  ; eleven cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Goshen , ka Holon , bad ka Giloh : khatwei tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself ; and the wife see that she reverence her husband .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka thew ruh ïa phi : Man u shynrang u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba ïa lade , bad man ka kynthei ka dei ban ñiewburom ïa la u tnga .
