translation.en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen ? a day for a man to afflict his soul ? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush , and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him ? wilt thou call this a fast , and an acceptable day to the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Haba phi shahjingit , phi pynshitom ei ïa lade ; phi pyndem ngon ïa la ka khlieh kum u phlang , bad phriang ïa ki jaiñ khain bad u dpei ban thiah hangta . Hato ka dei kata kaba phi khot ka jingshah jingit ? Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha ïa kata ?

translation.en: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword , that with it he should smite the nations : and he shall rule them with a rod of iron : and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God .
translation.kha: Na ka shyntur jong u la mih ka waitlam kaba nep , da kata un jop ïa ki jaitbynriew . Un synshar halor jong ki da u diengduh nar , bad ïuhroit ïa ka waiñ hapoh ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei U Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust  ; my skin is broken , and become loathsome .
translation.kha: La sop ïa ka met jong nga da ki ksaiñ , bad la tap ïa ka da ki prum ; ka ksuit ka mih na ki prum jong nga .

translation.en: And he taught them many things by parables , and said unto them in his doctrine ,
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam da ki pharshi ban hikai shibun kiei kiei ïa ki , da kaba ong ha ki :

translation.en: And the priests  custom with the people was , that , when any man offered sacrifice , the priest s servant came , while the flesh was in seething , with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand  ;
translation.kha: lane ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih shaphang kaei ba ki lyngdoh ki lah ban dawa na ki briew . Pynban haba uno uno u briew u kñia ïa ka jingainguh , u shakri u lyngdoh u ju wan bad u proh lai pnat ha la ka kti ha ka por ba dang shet ïa ka doh ;

translation.en: And if the priest shall look , and , behold , the plague be not spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada hadien ba u la khmih bha ïa ka , u lyngdoh u shem ba kata ka jingbthuh kam shym pur ,

translation.en: Then the king said , Cause Haman to make haste , that he may do as Esther hath said . So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared .
translation.kha: U syiem nangta u hukum ba u Haman un wan kloi , khnang ba kin lah ban leit kum ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong ka Esther . Te u syiem bad u Haman ki leit sha ka jingkhawai ka Esther .

translation.en: My friends scorn me : but mine eye poureth out tears unto God .
translation.kha: Ki paralok jong nga ki krenbeiñ ïa nga ; ki khmat jong nga ki pynmih ïa ki ummat sha U Blei .

translation.en: Cry yet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad  ; and the  Lord  shall yet comfort Zion , and shall yet choose Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U angel u la bthah ruh ïa nga ban pynbna :  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ki nongbah jong u kin manbha biang bad ba sa shisien pat un ïarap ïa ka Jerusalem bad kam ïa ka nongbah kum ka jong u hi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take thee Joshua the son of Nun , a man in whom is the spirit , and lay thine hand upon him  ;
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u briew uba lah , bad buh ïa ki kti jong me halor ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus , I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la apil ; u la kyrpad ba yn buh ïa u hapoh u nongap phira bad ban shah ba u Patsha un rai ïa ka kam jong u . Kumta nga la ai ki hukum ban buh ïa u hapoh ka jingap phira tad haduh ba nga lah ban phah ïa u sha u Patsha .

translation.en: And Adamah , and Ramah , and Hazor ,
translation.kha: ka Adamah , ka Ramah , ka Hasor ,

translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished , and rose up in haste , and spake , and said unto his counsellors , Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire ? They answered and said unto the king , True , O king .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan u Nebukhadnessar u la rynsied da kaba ïeng ha ka jinglyngngoh . U la kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar ,  Hato ym dei ba ngi la khum lai ngut ki rangbah bad bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang ?  Ki la jubab ,  Ho-oid , ngi la leh kumta , ko Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: They saw not one another , neither rose any from his place for three days : but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim ïohi shuh parabriew , bad ym don uwei ruh uba mih na la ïing ha kita ki sngi . Hynrei ha ka jaka ba ki Israel ki shong , ka don ka jingshai .

translation.en: ( For that righteous man dwelling among them , in seeing and hearing , vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds  ; )
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba bha u la im hapdeng jong ki , bad man la ka sngi u shah ïa ka jingkordit haba u la ïohi bad la ïohsngew ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .

translation.en: For ever , O  Lord  , thy word is settled in heaven .
translation.kha: Ka ktien jong me , A  Trai  , kan neh junom ; ka long kaba neh bymjukut ha bneng .

translation.en: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the  Lord  , and out of the house of the king , and of the princes , and gave it unto the king of Assyria : but he helped him not .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahas u shim ïa ka ksiar na ka Templ , na ka ïingsyiem bad na ki ïing jong ki nongïalam jong ki briew , bad u ai ïa ka ha u patsha , hynrei wat kane kam shym la ïarap .

translation.en: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness , thee and all the fish of thy rivers : thou shalt fall upon the open fields  ; thou shalt not be brought together , nor gathered : I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven .
translation.kha: Ngan bret ïa me bad ïa kito ki dohkha baroh sha ka ri shyiap . Ka met jong me kan hap ha khyndew bad kan sah khlem tep ïa ka . Ngan ai ïa ka ha ki sim bad ki mrad ban long jingbam ïa ki .

translation.en: The waters made him great , the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants , and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field .
translation.kha: Ka don ka um kaba pynsan ïa u , bad ki wah napoh khyndew ki bsa ïa u , ki ai um ïa ka jaka ha kaba u san , bad ki phah ïa ki wahduid sha ki dieng baroh jong ka khlaw .

translation.en: Say thou unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem , and all the house of Israel that are among them .
translation.kha: ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki . Kane ka khubor ka dei na ka bynta u khun syiem uba synshar ha Jerusalem bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh kiba shong basah hangta .

translation.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless , they take the widow s ox for a pledge .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki kada kiba dei jong ki khunswet , bad bat ïa u masi kyrtong jong ka riewkynthei haduh ba kan da dep siew ïa ka ram jong ka .

translation.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine  ; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt  ; and the famine shall consume the land  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata , yn don ka  nemsniew ha ki hynñiew snem , bad yn klet noh ïa kita ki snem kiba pahuh , namar ka  nemsniew kan sa pynjot ïa ka ri .

translation.en: He brought me forth also into a large place : he delivered me , because he delighted in me .
translation.kha: U la ïarap ïa nga ban lait na ka jingma ; u la pyllait im ïa nga namar u la sngewbha eh ïa nga .

translation.en: Happy are thy men , happy are these thy servants , which stand continually before thee , and that hear thy wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki tnga jong phi katno ki long kiba donbok ! Bad ki shakri jong phi katno ki long kiba donbok , ki don ryngkat bad phi borabor bad ban ïohlad ban ïohsngew ïa ki kyntien jingstad jong phi !

translation.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields , or a dead body , or a bone of a man , or a grave , shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ktah ïa u briew uba la shah pynïap lane uba ïap hi shabar lane lada uno uno u ktah ïa ka shyieng briew lane ïa ka jingtep , ki long ki bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah , and made themselves a king .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ba u Jehoram u synshar , ki Edom ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ki la long ka hima kaba laitluid .

translation.en: They shall call the people unto the mountain  ; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness : for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas , and of treasures hid in the sand .
translation.kha: Ki khot sngewbha ïa ki nongwei sha u lum jong ki , Bad hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh kiba biang . Ki ïohlum spah na duriaw , Bad na u shyiap harud duriaw .

translation.en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God , who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uta uba la pynkhreh ïa ngi na ka bynta kane ka jingpynkylla dur , bad u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u kum ka jingbahkhlieh ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: The young men saw me , and hid themselves : and the aged arose , and stood up .
translation.kha: ki samla ki kynriah harud tang shu ïohi ïa nga , bad ki riewtymmen ki ïeng ban pyn-i ka jingburom ïa nga .

translation.en: Turn , O backsliding children , saith the  Lord   ; for I am married unto you : and I will take you one of a city , and two of a family , and I will bring you to Zion :
translation.kha: Ko ki briew bymïaineh , to wan noh ; phi long ki jong nga . Ngan shim iwei na phi na kawei kawei ka shnong bad ar ngut na kawei kawei ka kur , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha u lum Seïon .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house , lest thou be a cursed thing like it : but thou shalt utterly detest it , and thou shalt utterly abhor it  ; for it is a cursed thing .
translation.kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka bleithaw sha la ïing ïoh ba kajuh ka jingtim kan ngat sa ha phi ruh . Phi dei ban isih bad ibeiñ ïa kine ki bleithaw , namar ki long kiba la tim da U  Trai .

translation.en: And when much people were gathered together , and were come to him out of every city , he spake by a parable :
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïai wan sha U Jisu na kawei ka shnong hadien kawei pat ; bad haba u paidbah babun u la ïalumlang , U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi :

translation.en: And he put forth the form of an hand , and took me by a lock of mine head  ; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven , and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem , to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north  ; where was the seat of the image of jealousy , which provoketh to jealousy .
translation.kha: U la kner kaei kaei kaba i kum ka kti bad u shim trait ïa nga na u  ñiuhkhlieh . Te ha kane ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah artet ïa nga ha ka lyer bad u ïalam ïa nga sha Jerusalem . U la rah ïa nga sha ka jaka rung kaba kham hapoh jong ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , ha kaba la don ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingpynbitar ïa U Blei .

translation.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee , which is the sea of Tiberias .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa ( ïa kaba ju la khot ruh , ka duriaw Tiberias ) .

translation.en: If he say thus , It is well  ; thy servant shall have peace : but if he be very wroth , then be sure that evil is determined by him .
translation.kha: Lada i ong , ‘ Ka biang’ kan ym jia ei ei ïa nga ; hynrei lada i bitar , phin tip ba i la kut jingmut ban pynsniew ïa nga .

translation.en: For we would not , brethren , have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia , that we were pressed out of measure , above strength , insomuch that we despaired even of life :
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit , ïa kata ka jingjynjar kaba ngi la ïohmad ha ka probins    jong ka Asia . Ki jingkit ba la buh halor jong ngi ki la long kiba khraw bad kiba khia kat haduh ba ngi la duh jingkyrmen ban dang im .

translation.en: That the hypocrite reign not , lest the people be ensnared .
translation.kha: Kam don kano kano kaba ki jaitbynriew ki lah ban leh ban khang ïa ki nongbanbeiñ ki bym don blei ban synshar halor jong ki .

translation.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron : and he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , With these shalt thou push the Syrians , until thou have consumed them .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Khenaanah , u shna ïa ki reng nar bad u ong ha u Ahab ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Da kine phin ïaleh ïa ki nong Syria bad phin jop thiaw ïa ki .’

translation.en: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy .
translation.kha: La don palat sawphew ngut kiba la thmu lang ïa kane .

translation.en: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him , Give us seven days  respite , that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel : and then , if there be no man to save us , we will come out to thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Jabesh ki ong ,  Ai por ïa ngi hynñiew sngi ban phah nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Israel . Te lada ym don u ban wan ïarap ïa ngi , ngin aiti ïa lade ha phi .

translation.en: Let him that stole steal no more : but rather let him labour , working with his hands the thing which is good , that he may have to give to him that needeth .
translation.kha: U briew uba ju tuh u dei ban sangeh noh ban tuh bad to un sdang ban treikam khnang ba un kamai ïa ka jingim hok na ka bynta ïa lade bad ba u lah ban ïarap ïa kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: Then will the  Lord  be jealous for his land , and pity his people .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta la ka ri ; u la don ka jingisynei ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria  ; they prophesied in Baal , and caused my people Israel to err .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka pop jong ki nongïathuhlypa ka Samaria ki la kren ha ka kyrteng u Baal bad ki la ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And this commandment have we from him , That he who loveth God love his brother also .
translation.kha: Ka hukum kaba U Khrist u la ai ha ngi ka long kane : Uno uno uba ieit ïa U Blei u dei ban ieit ïa la u parabriew ruh .

translation.en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree , behold , then an angel touched him , and said unto him , Arise and eat .
translation.kha: U la thiah ha trai u dieng bad u la ïohthiah . Kynsan kynsan u angel u la ktah ïa u bad ong ,  Khie noh bad bam .

translation.en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy , we shall also bear the image of the heavenly .
translation.kha: Kumba ngi kup ïa ka dur u briew ïa uba la thaw na ka dewmet , kumta ngin kup ïa ka dur u Briew uba na bneng .

translation.en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead , he said , Blessed be the  Lord  , that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal , and hath kept his servant from evil : for the  Lord  hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head . And David sent and communed with Abigail , to take her to him to wife .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba u Nabal u la ïap , u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! U la pynhiarkput ïa u Nabal namar ba u la ñiewbeiñ ïa nga , bad ba u la khang ïa nga u shakri jong u na kaba leh bakla . U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Nabal namar ka jingbymman jong u .  Nangta u Dabid u phah ka jingtyrwa sha ka Abigail ban ïakyntiew kurim .

translation.en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , saying , Speak unto the elders of Judah , saying , Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house ? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king , even to his house .
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kata kaba ki Israel ki la ïakren ka poi ha u Dabid . Kumta u la phah ïa u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ban kylli ïa ki nongïalam Judah ,  Balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïarap ban wallam biang ïa u syiem sha ka ïingsyiem jong u ?

translation.en: And they shall come , and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys , and in the holes of the rocks , and upon all thorns , and upon all bushes .
translation.kha: Kin ïaboi ha ki them khohruh khohram bad ha ki krem ha ki mawsiang , bad kin tap ïa kawei pa kawei ka bniap shiah bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaka pynbamphlang .

translation.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost , and prophesied , saying ,
translation.kha: Ïa U Sekharaïah , u kpa jong u Ïoannis la pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad u la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei :

translation.en: Defraud ye not one the other , except it be with consent for a time , that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer ; and come together again , that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency .
translation.kha: Wat ju kyrngah iwei ïa iwei pat , lait noh tang haba phi la ïamynjur shuwa ban leh kumta shipor khnang ba phi lah ban pynlut ïa ka por jong phi ha ka jingduwai ; hynrei nangta ban phai biang sha ka jingïadei para ma phi . Ha kane ka rukom yn ïada ïa phi na ki jingpynshoi jong u Soitan namar ka jingbymlah jong phi ban synshar ïa lade .

translation.en: He maketh the storm a calm , so that the waves thereof are still .
translation.kha: U pynjai jai ïa ka  erïong kaba jur , bad ki jingat phyllung ki long jai jai .

translation.en: Every word of God is pure : he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him .
translation.kha: U Blei u bat man la ka kular ba u pynlong . U long kum ka stieh ïa baroh kiba wad ïa ka jingïada jong u .

translation.en: Let us choose to us judgment : let us know among ourselves what is good .
translation.kha: Ka shong ha ngi ban rai ïa ka kam .

translation.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John ,
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la nang ïoh kham bun ki synran bad u la nang pynbaptis kham bun ban ïa u Ïoannis .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Write ye this man childless , a man that shall not prosper in his days : for no man of his seed shall prosper , sitting upon the throne of David , and ruling any more in Judah .
translation.kha: Ïa une u briew la pynrem ba un duh noh ïa la ki khun , Un long u briew u ban ym jop shuh . Un ym don ki khun ki ksiew jong u ki ban synshar ha Judah kum ki nonghiarpateng u Dabid . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Families are wise to seek Jehovah’s advice , which he provides through his Word .
translation.kha: Ki longïing longsem kiba stad ki wad ïa ki jinghikai jong U Jehobah kiba u la ai lyngba ka Ktien jong u .

translation.en: And then shall he depart from thee , both he and his children with him , and shall return unto his own family , and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return .
translation.kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , ma u bad ki khun ki kti jong u kin ïamihnoh na phi bad kin leit phai sha la ka jong ka longïing bad sha ka jaka ki kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: And they laid hands on her  ; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king s house : and there was she slain .
translation.kha: Ki kem ïa ka , ki rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka Khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .

translation.en: And Saul went on this side of the mountain , and David and his men on that side of the mountain : and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul  ; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them .
translation.kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki don ha kawei ka liang jong u lum , la pynïakhlad na u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , kiba don ha kawei pat ka liang . Ki la pynstet ban phet krad na u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u , kiba nang kham hajan ïa ki bad kiba la jan ïohkem ïa ki .

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem  ; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew na ka jait Benjamin kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Jebus kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , bad ki Jebus ki dang shong hangta bad ki paid Benjamin naduh kata ka por .

translation.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance , and begin not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kita kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la phai noh na ki pop jong phi . Bad wat sdang ban ong hapdeng jong phi hi ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham !

translation.en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts , and they had thirty cities , which are called Havoth–jair unto this day , which are in the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang kiba shong halor ki laiphew tylli ki kada . Ki don laiphew tylli ki nongbah ha ka ri Gilead , ïa kiba la dang khot ki nongrit u Jair .

translation.en: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon , and the king s mother , and the king s wives , and his officers , and the mighty of the land , those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon , lem bad ka kmie jong u Jehoïakhin , ki tnga jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka Judah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that day , saith the  Lord  , that the heart of the king shall perish , and the heart of the princes  ; and the priests shall be astonished , and the prophets shall wonder .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka sngi ki syiem bad ki rangbah synshar kin duh ka jingshlur jong ki ; ki lyngdoh kin kyndit bad ki nongïathuhlypa kin lyngngoh .

translation.en: O  Lord  , for thy servant s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all this greatness , in making known all these great things .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon bad ka jingthmu jong me ban leh ïa kane ha nga bad ban pyn-i ha nga ïa ka jingkhraw jong nga ha ki por ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David  ; and Saul became David s enemy continually .
translation.kha: Kumta u nang kham tieng shuh shuh ïa u Dabid bad u kylla long u nongshun jong u katba u dang im .

translation.en: And this continued by the space of two years  ; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus , both Jews and Greeks .
translation.kha: Kane ka la neh ar snem , ba kumta baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka probins jong ka Asia , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .

translation.en: O Lord  God  , thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness , and thy mighty hand : for what God is there in heaven or in earth , that can do according to thy works , and according to thy might ?
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Trai Nongsynshar , me la pyn-i ha la u shakri dang tang ïa kaba sdang jong ki kam kiba khraw bad kiba phylla jong me . Ym don blei ha bneng ne ha khyndew uba lah ban leh ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba me , me la leh !

translation.en: Can two walk together , except they be agreed ?
translation.kha: Hato ar ngut ki briew ki ju sdang ïaleit jingleit lang khlem da pynkhreh ban ïakynduh ?

translation.en: For I tell you , that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba bun ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki syiem ki la kwah ban ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi , bad ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew , hynrei kim shym la ïohsngew .

translation.en: A servant will not be corrected by words : for though he understand he will not answer .
translation.kha: Phim lah ban pynbeit ïa u shakri tang da kaba kren ïa u . U lah ban sngewthuh ïa phi , hynrei un ym pynleit jingmut .

translation.en: The God of my rock  ; in him will I trust : he is my shield , and the horn of my salvation , my high tower , and my refuge , my saviour  ; thou savest me from violence .
translation.kha: U Blei jong nga u long ka jingïada jong nga ; bad nga shngain bad u , U ïada ïa nga kum ka stieh ; u da ïa nga bad ri pynim ïa nga . U long u nongpynim jong nga . U ïada ïa nga bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingumsnam .

translation.en: Then said he , These are the two anointed ones , that stand by the Lord of the whole earth .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Kine ki long ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba U Blei u la jied bad pynsleh ba kin shakri ïa u , U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

translation.en: And the sons of Ulam  ; Bedan . These were the sons of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh .
translation.kha: bad u Ulam u don uwei u khun uba kyrteng u Bedan . Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , bad u ksiew jong u Manasseh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake by his servants the prophets , saying ,
translation.kha: Lyngba ki shakri jong u , ki nongïathuhlypa U  Trai  u ong ,

translation.en: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain , and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches :
translation.kha: Ki sim kin wan bad dem ha u dieng uba la khyllem , bad ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid halor ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say .
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid un hikai ïa phi ha kata ka por ïa kaei ba phin ong .

translation.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la nang leit sha Jerikho bad u dang ïaid lyngba jong ka .

translation.en: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling , so is he that giveth honour to a fool .
translation.kha: Kaba ïaroh ïa uno uno uba long mutlop ka long kumba teh ïa u maw ha ka jri siat sim .

translation.en: And say , If we had been in the days of our fathers , we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets .
translation.kha: bad phi kam ba lada phi la im ha kata ka por jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , phin ym da la leh ïa kaei kaba ki la leh bad pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Be of good courage , and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people , and for the cities of our God : and let the  Lord  do that which is good in his sight .
translation.kha: To long khlaiñ bad long shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongbah jong U Blei jong ngi . Bad to ai ba yn pyndep ïa ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: Just get up .
translation.kha: Shu khie joit .

translation.en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God . But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did , he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka bor bakhraw jong U Blei . Ki briew ki dang sngewphylla ha kaei kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , haba u ong ha ki synran jong u ,

translation.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you , I will put more to your yoke : my father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ I pa i la buh ha phi ïa ki jingkit kiba khia ; nga ngan nang pynkhia shuh shuh . I la sympat ïa phi da u shabuk , hynrei nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk kulai !’

translation.en: When those went , these went  ; and when those stood , these stood  ; and when those were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up over against them : for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .
translation.kha: Kumta man ka teng ba ki jingthaw ki ïaid ne sangeh ne kiew sha suiñ , ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead , in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites , and of Og king of Bashan  ; and he was the only officer which was in the land .
translation.kha: U Geber u khun jong u Uri : ka thain Gilead , kaba la synshar da u Sihon u syiem Amor bad u Og u syiem Bashan . Nalor kine khat-ar ngut , la don uwei u lat halor ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: If any man have ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: And because iniquity shall abound , the love of many shall wax cold .
translation.kha: Haduh katta kan long ka jingsaphriang jong ka jingsniew ba ka jingieit jong ki briew kiba bun kan man khriat .

translation.en: I loathe it  ; I would not live alway : let me alone  ; for my days are vanity .
translation.kha: Ngan keiñ noh , nga la thait ban im Ieh ïa nga marwei . Ka jingim jong nga kam don jingmut .

translation.en: And he began again to teach by the sea side : and there was gathered unto him a great multitude , so that he entered into a ship , and sat in the sea  ; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sdang biang ban hikai harud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah uba la ïalum sawdong jong u , u la bun haduh katta katta ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka . Ka lieng ka don ha ka um , bad u paidbah u la ïeng ha ryngkew harud ka um .

translation.en: If I be wicked , woe unto me  ; and if I be righteous , yet will I not lift up my head . I am full of confusion  ; therefore see thou mine affliction  ;
translation.kha: Ngan tang shu leh pop , nga la don ka jingjynjar bad me , hynrei haba nga ïaid hok , ngam ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh . Nga long uba jynjar bad la tap da ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish : the stock is a doctrine of vanities .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki long kiba mutlop bad kiba bieit . Aïu ki lah ban nang na ki bleithaw dieng ?

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah , and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Benjamin ki wan mih shabar na kata ka nongbah , bad shuwa ban kut kata ka sngi ki la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki shipai Israel .

translation.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest , O  Lord  , and teachest him out of thy law  ;
translation.kha: A  Trai  , katno suk long u briew uba me hikai , uta ha uba me hikai ïa ka aiñ jong me !

translation.en: And when he hath taken away the multitude , his heart shall be lifted up  ; and he shall cast down many ten thousands : but he shall not be strengthened by it .
translation.kha: Un sngewsarong ïa la ka jingjop bad ïa ki shipai kiba bun kiba u la lah pynïap , hynrei un ym neh sah ban jop .

translation.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram  ; and the elders of Israel followed him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , ki la leit sha u Dathan bad u Abiram .

translation.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience , when your obedience is fulfilled .
translation.kha: Bad hadien ba phi la pynshisha ïa ka jinglong baïaineh ba-pura jong phi , ngin kloi ban pynshitom ïa kano kano ka jingleh ka bymïaineh .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Behold , I will melt them , and try them  ; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people ?
translation.kha: Namar kane U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan phrang ïa ki briew jong nga kum ïa ka nar bad buh ïa ki ha ka jingtynjuh . Ki briew jong nga ki la leh ïa kaba sniew — sa kaei pat kaba nga lah ban leh bad ki ?

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw it , he abhorred them , because of the provoking of his sons , and of his daughters .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kata , u bitar da shisha , bad u kyntait ïa la ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

translation.en: We are thine : thou never barest rule over them  ; they were not called by thy name .
translation.kha: Me ñiew ïa ngi kumba mem ju long u nongsynshar jong ngi , kumba ngim pat la ju long ki briew jong me .

translation.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan , and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah , which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite , before Mamre .
translation.kha: ki la bah ïa ka met jong u sha Kanaan bad ki tep ïa ka ha kata ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha ha Makhpelah , sha mihngi na Mamre , kaba u Abraham u la thied na u Ephron u jait Hit ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .

translation.en: But oh that God would speak , and open his lips against thee  ;
translation.kha: A katno nga thrang ba U Blei un jubab ïa me !

translation.en: And it came to pass after three days , that the officers went through the host  ;
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi , ki nongïalam ki leit kylleng ka jaka shong dara ,

translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter , and James , and John , and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves : and he was transfigured before them .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi hadien , U Jisu u la shim bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis , bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lum uba jrong , ha kaba ki la ïalong tang ma ki hi . Haba ki dang ïakhmih , ka jingkylla dur ka la wan ha U Jisu ,

translation.en: According to the word of the  Lord  they gave him the city which he asked , even Timnath–serah in mount Ephraim : and he built the city , and dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , ki ai ha u ïa ka nongbah kaba u la pan : ka Timnath Serah , kaba ha ri lum Ephraim . U la tei thymmai ïa ka nongbah , bad u shongduh hangta .

translation.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels  ; thou crownedst him with glory and honour , and didst set him over the works of thy hands :
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa u khampoh khyndiat ban ïa ki angel , me la pynphong pansngiat ïa u da ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom , bad me la pynlong ïa u ban synshar halor kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum : We have such an high priest , who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens  ;
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba kongsan na kine kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kren ka long ba ngi don kum uta U Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong ka khet ba kynja blei kaba ha bneng .

translation.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Repent , and turn yourselves from your idols  ; and turn away your faces from all your abominations .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : To phai noh bad ieh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi .

translation.en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king , she came to the people into the house of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Haba ka Athalaïah ka ïohsngew ïa ka jingrisa jong ki paidbah ïa u syiem , ka la pynkloi sha ka Templ , ha kaba ki paidbah ki la ïalumlang .

translation.en: And Elisha died , and they buried him . And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year .
translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u . Man la ka snem ki kynhun jong ki Moab ki ju wan tur thma ïa ka ri Israel .

translation.en: The lips of the righteous feed many : but fools die for want of wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki pynmyntoi ïa kiba bun ki briew , hynrei phin pynïap ïa lade da ka jingmutlop .

translation.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us , and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad wat shah ba un pynkohnguh ïa phi ban shaniah ha U  Trai . Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi , bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Assyria na kaba kurup ïa ka nongbah jong phi .

translation.en: Now rise up , said I , and get you over the brook Zered . And we went over the brook Zered .
translation.kha: Nangta ngi jam sha shiliang ka wah Sered kumba U  Trai  u la ong ïa ngi .

translation.en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number , or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves : but they measuring themselves by themselves , and comparing themselves among themselves , are not wise .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha ngin ym nud ban pynïaryngkat ïa lade lane ïanujor ïa lade bad kito kiba pynkiew skong palat ïa lade . Katno kiba mutlop ki long! Ki buh ïa la ki jong ki kyndon ban thew ïa lade , bad ki bishar ïa lade da la ki jong ki jingthew!

translation.en: He teareth himself in his anger : shall the earth be forsaken for thee ? and shall the rock be removed out of his place ?
translation.kha: Phi nang pynmynsaw ïa lade da ka jingbitar jong phi . Hato ka khyndew kan long jaka kynjah namar ba phi bitar ? Hato U Blei un pynkhih ïa ki lumbah ban pynhun ïa phi ?

translation.en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra , impotent in his feet , being a cripple from his mother s womb , who never had walked :
translation.kha: Ha Lystra , la don u briew uba dkhoh naduh ba dang kha bad u bym pat ju lah ban ïaid .

translation.en: I will go down now , and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it , which is come unto me  ; and if not , I will know .
translation.kha: Ngan da leit hiar ban shem la kita ki jingkynnoh ïa kiba nga la ïohsngew ki long ne em kiba shisha .

translation.en: One of the servants of the high priest , being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off , saith , Did not I see thee in the garden with him ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba don jingïadei bad u briew ïa uba u Petros u la lah mait ïa ka shkor jong u , u la kren .  Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa me bad u ha kata ka kper ?  u la kylli .

translation.en: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the  Lord  of hosts , and to the prophets , saying , Should I weep in the fifth month , separating myself , as I have done these so many years ?
translation.kha: bad ban kylli ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa ïa kane ka jingkylli :  Hato ngin nang bteng ban ïambriew namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka Templ , da kaba shahjingit ha u bnai uba san kumba ngi la ju leh la bun bun snem mynta ?

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes , to stand to minister in the name of the  Lord  , him and his sons for ever .
translation.kha: Na ki jait jong phi baroh , U  Trai  u la jied ïa ka jait Lebi ban shakri ïa u kum ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .

translation.en: Now the queen , by reason of the words of the king and his lords , came into the banquet house : and the queen spake and said , O king , live for ever : let not thy thoughts trouble thee , nor let thy countenance be changed :
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u syiem ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba la pynmih da u syiem bad ki rangbah donburom jong u bad ka la rung sha ka kamra jingkhawai . Ka la ong ,  To u syiem un im junom ! Sngewbha wat da khih khuslai than bad wat da lieh blaid blaid .

translation.en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , O ye righteous : for praise is comely for the upright .
translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba hok , to risa jam da ka jingkmen ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: And he spake to his disciples , that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude , lest they should throng him .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la bun haduh katta katta ba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ban pynkhreh da ka lieng na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba ki briew kin ym tur kyrthep ïa u .

translation.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above , and cometh down from the Father of lights , with whom is no variableness , neither shadow of turning .
translation.kha: Ka jingai kaba bha baroh bad kaba janai baroh ka wan na bneng ; ka wan hiar na U Blei , u Nongpynlong ïa ki jingshai ba kynja bneng , u bym ju kylla lane pynlong jingdum da ka jingpynphai .

translation.en: He looseth the bond of kings , and girdeth their loins with a girdle .
translation.kha: U pynhiar khet ïa ki syiem bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki koidi ;

translation.en: The firstfruit also of thy corn , of thy wine , and of thine oil , and the first of the fleece of thy sheep , shalt thou give him .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ki soh nyngkong na u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad u  saiwul jong phi .

translation.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this , she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she , and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms .
translation.kha: Wat la ka Oholibah , ka para jong ka , ka ïohi ïa kane , ka kham shlur bad kham long nuti ban ïa kaba ka Oholah ka la ju long .

translation.en: My breath is corrupt , my days are extinct , the graves are ready for me .
translation.kha: Ka jingkut jong ka jingim jong nga ka la jan . Ngam sngewlah ring mynsiem bha shuh ; ym don ei ei shuh kaba sah na ka bynta jong nga , sa tang ka jingtep .

translation.en: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries , and against great kingdoms , of war , and of evil , and of pestilence .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren slem bah mynshuwa , ha shuwa ka por jong nga bad jong phi , ki la ïathuhlypa shaphang kata ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ïa ka jingpang ki ban wan ha ki jaitbynriew babun bad ha ki hima bakhrawbor .

translation.en: Then said David , O  Lord  God of Israel , thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah , to destroy the city for my sake .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga la ïohsngew ba u Saul u pynkhreh ban wan sha Keilah bad ban pynjot ïa ka namar jong nga , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And he took away the strange gods , and the idol out of the house of the  Lord  , and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the  Lord  , and in Jerusalem , and cast them out of the city .
translation.kha: U pynkynriah na ka Templ ïa ki blei nongwei bad ïa ka durblei kaba u la buh hangta , bad ki duwan ki blei thala kiba la don halor u lum ha kaba ka Templ ka la ïeng bad ha kiwei ki jaka ha Jerusalem ; u kit lut ïa kine kiei kiei shabar ka nongbah bad u bret lut ïa ki .

translation.en: His mouth is most sweet : yea , he is altogether lovely . This is my beloved , and this is my friend , O daughters of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To khie , ko lyer Bashatei . Ko lyer Bashathie , to beh halor ka kper jong nga ; pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiwbih . Ai ba uba ieit jong nga un wan sha ka kper jong u bad bam ïa uba bha tam na ki soh jong ka .

translation.en: And I prayed unto the  Lord  my God , and made my confession , and said , O Lord , the great and dreadful God , keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him , and to them that keep his commandments  ;
translation.kha: Nga la duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga bad nga la phla ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga . Nga la ong ,  A Trai U Blei , me long uba khraw , bad ngi pyndonburom ïa me . Me long uba bat ïa la ka jutang bad me pyn-i ka jingieit baneh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa me bad leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .

translation.en: Take a few minutes each week to examine one of the following lessons and to answer the review questions .
translation.kha: Man la ka taïew , peitbniah katto katne minit ïa kawei na kine ki lynnong bad jubab biang ïa ki jingkylli harum .

translation.en: And Ephron answered Abraham , saying unto him ,
translation.kha: U Ephron u jubab ,

translation.en: And the men which were expressed by name rose up , and took the captives , and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them , and arrayed them , and shod them , and gave them to eat and to drink , and anointed them , and carried all the feeble of them upon asses , and brought them to Jericho , the city of palm trees , to their brethren : then they returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki saw ngut ki rangbah la thung ban pynbiang ïa ki koidi da ki jaiñ na ki mar ba la lute . Ki ai ha ki ïa ki jaiñ bad ki juti ban phong , ki ai ïa ki ka bam ka dih kaba biang , bad ki tah da ka umphniang Olib ïa ki jingmong jong ki . Ïa kito kiba tlot palat ban ïaid ki pynshong ha ki kada , bad ïa baroh ki koidi la ïalam biang sha ka ri Judia ha Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai . Nangta ki Israel ki wan phai sha la ïing sha Samaria .

translation.en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself , and that he may be unto thee a God , as he hath said unto thee , and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
translation.kha: khnang ba U  Trai  un pynskhem ïa phi mynta kum ki briew jong u bad ba un long U Blei jong phi , kumba u la kular ïa phi bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .

translation.en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue , wherein we were born ?
translation.kha: Kumno , te , ba baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ka ktien tynrai jong ngi hi ?

translation.en: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp , whither thou shalt go forth abroad :
translation.kha: Phi dei ban buh ka jaka ha kaba phi lah ban leit shabar    kham jngai ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: And this I speak for your own profit ; not that I may cast a snare upon you , but for that which is comely , and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa kane namar nga kwah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam shym pyrshang ban buh ha phi ïa ki jingpyrkhing . Pynban , nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba biang , bad ban aiti lut ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai khlem kano kano ka jingteh .

translation.en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah : and she sent and called Jacob her younger son , and said unto him , Behold , thy brother Esau , as touching thee , doth comfort himself , purposing to kill thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka Rebekka ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingthmu jong u Iso , ka la phah khot ïa u Jakob bad ka ong ,  To shahshkor , u Iso u hynmen jong me u thmu ban siew kylliang bad ban pynïap ïa me .

translation.en: And she said unto Elijah , What have I to do with thee , O thou man of God ? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance , and to slay my son ?
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u Elijah ,  A u briew jong U Blei , balei me leh ïa kane ha nga ? Hato me wan hangne ban pynkynmaw ïa U Blei ïa ki pop jong nga bad pynjia ïa ka jingïap u khun jong nga ?

translation.en: Her wise ladies answered her , yea , she returned answer to herself ,
translation.kha: Ki paralok bastad ki phai ktien ïa ka , Bad ka ïai-ong shi ong kumta ha lade ,

translation.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour : other men laboured , and ye are entered into their labours .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa phi ban ot ha kata ka lyngkha kaba phim shym la trei ; kiwei ki la trei hangta , bad phi ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki .

translation.en: But as it is written , To whom he was not spoken of , they shall see : and they that have not heard shall understand .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa kito ha kiba ym pat shym la ïathuh shaphang jong u kin ïohi , bad kito ki bym pat shym la ïohsngew kin sngewthuh .

translation.en: Now I rejoice , not that ye were made sorry , but that ye sorrowed to repentance : for ye were made sorry after a godly manner , that ye might receive damage by us in nothing .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga kmen — ym namar ba nga la pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei namar ba ka jingsngewsih jong phi ka la pynlong ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut . Ïa kata ka jingsngewsih la pyndonkam da U Blei , bad kumta ngim shym la pynmong ei ei ïa phi .

translation.en: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest , The king hath commanded me a business , and hath said unto me , Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee , and what I have commanded thee : and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga wan hangne na ka bynta ka kam u syiem . U ong ïa nga ban ym don mano mano ban tip ïa kaei kaba u la phah ïa nga ban leh . Shaphang ki briew jong nga pat , nga la ïapynbeit ba kin ïakynduh ïa nga ha kawei ka jaka .

translation.en: But ye turned and polluted my name , and caused every man his servant , and every man his handmaid , whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure , to return , and brought them into subjection , to be unto you for servants and for handmaids .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi kylla pat ïa ka jingmut jong phi bad phi pynjahburom ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la shim pat ïa ki mraw ïa kiba phi la pyllaitluid kumba ki la kwah , bad phi la pynlong mraw jubor biang ïa ki .

translation.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam ha ka shisnem ban pyndonburom ïa nga .

translation.en: And it shall be , when he shall be guilty in one of these things , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing :
translation.kha: Haba u briew u hap ha ka jingpynrem , u dei ban phla ïa kata ka pop ,

translation.en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet , and yielded up the ghost : and the young men came in , and found her dead , and , carrying her forth , buried her by her husband .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ka la kyllon ha ki kjat jong u bad ka la ïap . Ki samla shynrang ki la wan shapoh bad ki la ïohi ba ka la ïap , kumta ki la bah noh ïa ka shabar bad la tep ïa ka ha syndah u tnga jong ka .

translation.en: Though he were a Son , yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la u la long U Khun U Blei , u la nang ban kohnguh da kaba u la shahshitom .

translation.en: Whose ways are crooked , and they froward in their paths :
translation.kha: ki briew kiba kynriang ki bym lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age , being ( as was supposed ) the son of Joseph , which was the son of Heli ,
translation.kha: Haba u Jisu u la sdang ïa la ka kam , u la dap kumba laiphew snem ka rta . U la long u khun , kumta ki briew ki la pyrkhat , jong u Joseph , uba long u khun jong u Heli ,

translation.en: Now as soon as it was day , there was no small stir among the soldiers , what was become of Peter .
translation.kha: Haba ka step ka la poi , ka la don ka jingkulmar jingmut kaba jur hapdeng ki nongap phira — kaei kaba la jia ha u Petros ?

translation.en: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the  Lord  had shewed me .
translation.kha: bad nga la ïathuh ïa kiba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la lah pyn-i ha nga .

translation.en: Why , seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty , do they that know him not see his days ?
translation.kha: Balei ba U Blei um buh ka por na ka bynta ka jingbishar , ka sngi jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u ?

translation.en: And when he humbled himself , the wrath of the  Lord  turned from him , that he would not destroy him altogether : and also in Judah things went well .
translation.kha: Namar ba u pyndem ha U  Trai  , ka jingbitar U  Trai  kam shym pynjot thiaw ïa u , bad kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless , hearing a voice , but seeing no man .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit ryngkat bad u Saul ki la sangeh , khlem kren wat shikyntien ruh ; ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur hynrei kim lah ban ïohi ïano ïano ruh .

translation.en: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah : and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the  Lord  , which he had spoken unto him , upon a roll of a book .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la khot ïa u Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah bad nga la ong ïa u ban thoh katba nga dang ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la lah ong ha nga . Bad u Barukh u la thoh ïa ka baroh ha ka kot kli .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when David was come to the top of the mount , where he worshipped God , behold , Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent , and earth upon his head :
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la poi ha ka kliar jong u lum , ha kaba don ka jaka mane Blei , u Hushai , u nong Arkhit uba dei u paralok bajan jong u , u la ïakynduh ïa u da kaba phong ki jaiñ kiba la kad bad ka khyndew ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees , and the other Pharisees , he cried out in the council , Men and brethren , I am a Pharisee , the son of a Pharisee : of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question .
translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la ïohi ba katto katne na ka kynhun ki dei ki Saddusi bad kiwei pat ki Pharisi , u la kren jam ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko ki para nong Israel ! Nga dei u Pharisi , u khun jong ki Pharisi . Nga don ha ka jingshah bishar hangne namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ba kiba ïap kin mihpat !

translation.en: And he pressed upon them greatly  ; and they turned in unto him , and entered into his house  ; and he made them a feast , and did bake unleavened bread , and they did eat .
translation.kha: U ïai kyrpad jur ïa ki , bad khatduh ki la leit ryngkat bad u sha ka ïing jong u . U Lot u la hukum ïa la ki shakri ban shet kpu bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka bam kaba bang na ka bynta kine kiba shah khot sngewbha . Haba la dep khreh , ki la ïabam ruh .

translation.en: Thou shalt betroth a wife , and another man shall lie with her : thou shalt build an house , and thou shalt not dwell therein : thou shalt plant a vineyard , and shalt not gather the grapes thereof .
translation.kha: Phin ïatehktien bad ka samla — hynrei uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka . Phin tei ïa ka ïing — hynrei phin ym ïoh shong ha ka . Phin thung ka bri sohwaiñ — hynrei phin ym ïoh bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: And the men arose , and went away : and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land , saying , Go and walk through the land , and describe it , and come again to me , that I may here cast lots for you before the  Lord  in Shiloh .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki la leit ban jurip ïa ka ri hadien ba u Joshua u la ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Khie ïaid ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa ka , bad wan phai pat sha nga . Nangta , hangne ha Shiloh ngan ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong phi da kaba kynting sbai .

translation.en: While he yet talked to the people , behold , his mother and his brethren stood without , desiring to speak with him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren ha ki briew mynba ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong u ki la wan poi . Ki la ïeng shabar , ki da kyrpad ban ïoh kren ïa u .

translation.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me , and keep my commandments .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong nga ha ki hajar ki pateng bynriew jong kito kiba ieit ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: There is nothing from without a man , that entering into him can defile him : but the things which come out of him , those are they that defile the man .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba lah ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u kat kum ka jinglehniam . Pynban , ka long kaei kaba mih shabar na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: And Moses cried unto the  Lord  , saying , What shall I do unto this people ? they be almost ready to stone me .
translation.kha: U Moses u la duwai jur ha U  Trai  , bad u ong ,  Aïu nga lah ban leh bad kine ki briew ? Mynta ki khreh sa ban lynthem maw ïa nga !

translation.en: And Chesed , and Hazo , and Pildash , and Jidlaph , and Bethuel .
translation.kha: u Khesed , u Haso , u Pildash , u Jidlaph , bad u Bethuel , u kpa jong ka Rebekka .

translation.en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the  Lord  build the ruined places , and plant that that was desolate : I the  Lord  have spoken it , and I will do it .
translation.kha: Te ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan kiba la lait im kin ïoh tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot , bad nga la thung ïa kata kaba la long shrah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan sa leh .

translation.en: If we say that we have not sinned , we make him a liar , and his word is not in us .
translation.kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim shym la leh pop , ngi pynlong ïa U Blei ba u lamler bad ka ktien jong u kam don ha ngi .

translation.en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him . Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him , If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews , before whom thou hast begun to fall , thou shalt not prevail against him , but shalt surely fall before him .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ka tnga bad baroh ki paralok ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la jia ha u . Nangta ma ka bad kito ki paralok bastad jong u ki ong ha u ,  Phi la sdang ban duh bor ha u Mordekai . U dei u Jiw , bad phim lah ban jop ïa u . Da shisha un sa jop ïa phi .

translation.en: Moreover Job continued his parable , and said ,
translation.kha: U Job u sdang ban kren biang .

translation.en: Arise therefore , and get thee down , and go with them , doubting nothing : for I have sent them .
translation.kha: Kumta to khreh bad leit hiar , bad wat sngewlehrain ban leit bad ki , naba nga la phah ïa ki .

translation.en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul , that he might loose him : wherefore he sent for him the oftener , and communed with him .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u da kyrmen ba u Paul un ai khyndiat ka pisa ïa u ; bad na kane ka daw u ju phah khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u .

translation.en: And ye shall overthrow their altars , and break their pillars , and burn their groves with fire  ; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods , and destroy the names of them out of that place .
translation.kha: Pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki bad pynpait pharia ïa ki maw blei jong ki . Thang ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah bad mait ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , khnang ba kin ym mane shuh ha kito ki jaka .

translation.en: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves : but for father , or for mother , or for son , or for daughter , for brother , or for sister that hath had no husband , they may defile themselves .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh um dei ban long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam da kaba ktah ïa ka metïap , lait noh kaba dei ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u , lane ki khun jong u lane ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u lane ki kynthei kiba shi para bad u ki bym pat shongkurim .

translation.en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim  ; which conceived , and bare him a son .
translation.kha: Kumta u Hosia u la shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Gomer , ka khun jong u Diblaim . Hadien ba la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ki ,

translation.en: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself , that his heart turn not away : neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold .
translation.kha: U syiem um dei ban long uba bun tnga , namar kata kan pynphai noh ïa u na U  Trai  ; bad um dei ruh ban pynriewspah ïa lade da ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

translation.en: So by his miracles Jesus showed on a small scale what will take place on earth under the Kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Kumta da ki kam bha U Jisu u pyni khyndiat , ia ka nuksa kaei ka ban sa long pat hapoh ka hima u Blei .

translation.en: And , behold , the whole city came out to meet Jesus : and when they saw him , they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei uwei baroh na ka shnong ki la ïamih ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu ; bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ba un leit noh na ka thain jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people went out into the field  ; and they told Abimelech .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Abimelekh u lap ba ki paid Shekhem ki la pynkhreh ban leit sha lyngkha ;

translation.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father : and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh , the elders of his house , and all the elders of the land of Egypt ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u la leit ban tep ïa la u kpa . Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , ki bakhraw batri na ka ïing jong u , bad ki bakhraw batri jong ka ri Ijipt , ki ïaleit ryngkat bad u Joseph .

translation.en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea  ; and of the Thessalonians , Aristarchus and Secundus  ; and Gaius of Derbe , and Timothy  ; and of Asia , Tychicus and Trophimus .
translation.kha: U Sopater , u khun jong u Pyrrhos , uba na Beria , u la leit lem bad u ; kumta ruh u Aristarkhos bad u Sekundos , na Thessaloni ; u Gaïos na Derbe ; u Tukhikos bad u Trophimos , na ka probins    jong ka Asia ; bad u Timothi .

translation.en: Is it in the early morning before starting your day’s work or later in the evening after the children have gone to bed ?
translation.kha: Hato , ha ka por mynstep ne ynda la miet haba la thiah ki khun ?

translation.en: I will therefore that the younger women marry , bear children , guide the house , give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully .
translation.kha: Te ngan kham lah ba ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla kin shongkurim , kin don ki khun ki kti , bad sumar ïa la ki ïing , khnang ban ym ailad ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ban kren sniew ïa ngi .

translation.en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord , nor of me his prisoner : but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God ;
translation.kha: Kumta wat sngewlehrain , ban sakhi na ka bynta U Trai jong ngi , lymne ban sngewlehrain ïa nga , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist . Pynban , to shim ïa la ka bynta ha kaba shahshitom na ka bynta ka Khubor Babha , kumba U Blei u ai ïa me ka bor ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked , therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north :
translation.kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam jong nga pyrshah ïa baroh na shatei haduh shathie .

translation.en: Is this your joyous city , whose antiquity is of ancient days ? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn .
translation.kha: Hato kane kan long ka nongbah bakmen jong ka Tyros , ïa kaba la tei naduh mynbarim ? Hato kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba la phah ïa ki nongshong shnong sha shiliang ka duriaw ban buhai shnong ?

translation.en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her , all the beasts of the nations : both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it  ; their voice shall sing in the windows  ; desolation shall be in the thresholds : for he shall uncover the cedar work .
translation.kha: Kan long ka jaka ha kaba ki kynhun jingri , ki masi , bad ki mrad ba bun jait kin dem . Ki dkhoh kin shong ha ki jingjot jong ka bad kin pah na ki jingkhangïit . Ki tyngab kin pah ha ki khmat jingkhang . Ïa ki dieng Kedar jong ki jingtei jong ka yn sloit noh .

translation.en: And there they preached the gospel .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha .

translation.en: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth , because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah , for that which he did in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei ban sngewtriem ha ki namar kaei kaba u Manasseh u khun jong u Hesekaïah u la leh ha Jerusalem mynba u long u syiem ka Judah .

translation.en: Salute Herodion my kinsman . Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus , which are in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Herodion , u para Jiw , bad ïa ki parabangeit kiba ha ka longïing jong u Narkissos .

translation.en: And if ye shall despise my statutes , or if your soul abhor my judgments , so that ye will not do all my commandments , but that ye break my covenant :
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , bad phi pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad phi , ngan pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have sold yourselves for nought  ; and ye shall be redeemed without money .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew ,  Mynba phi la long ki mraw , ym shym la siew pisa na ka bynta jong phi ; ha kajuh ka rukom yn ym siew ei ei ban pyllaitluid ïa phi .

translation.en: For my name s sake will I defer mine anger , and for my praise will I refrain for thee , that I cut thee not off .
translation.kha: Khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , nga pyntud ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha lade ; nga bat noh ïa ka bad ban ym pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: We will pass over armed before the  Lord  into the land of Canaan , that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka hukum jong U ngin jam sha ka ri Kanaan bad leit sha ka thma , khnang ba ngi lah ban bat ïa ka jingïohkynti jong ngi hangne ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Whence comest thou ? Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba me la lah leh ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon , as much as thou shalt need : and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa  ; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ki lum Lebanon ngin khet ïa ki dieng Kedar baroh katba phi donkam , ngin teh ïa ki ha ki bur , bad pynkie ïa ki ha ka duriaw shaduh Joppa . Na kata ka jaka phi lah ban kit ïa ki sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: For this cause the king was angry and very furious , and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon .
translation.kha: Ha kata , u syiem u la bitar shla bad u la hukum ban pynïap khoit ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem ha Babilon .

translation.en: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth  ; and he had two horns like a lamb , and he spake as a dragon .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw , uba la wan kiew napoh ka khyndew . U la don ar tylli ki reng kum ki jong u khunlangbrot , bad u la kren kum u Ïakjakor .

translation.en: James , a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ , to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad , greeting .
translation.kha: Na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai : Ka jingai khublei ïa baroh ki briew jong U Blei ba la pynsakma sha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face , and I will shew the nations thy nakedness , and the kingdoms thy shame .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa pha , ko Ninebeh ! ngan sloit lyngkhuit ïa pha bad ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ïohi ïa pha , ban ïohi ïa pha ha ka jinglehrain jong pha baroh .

translation.en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel : eighteen years , all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites , which is in Gilead .
translation.kha: Haduh khatphra snem ki la banbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh kiba shong ha ka ri ki Amor ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan ha Gilead .

translation.en: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury , and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego : therefore he spake , and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated .
translation.kha: Te u Nebukhadnessar u la bitar , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka la kiew sawlep da ka jingbitar ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban pynkhluit ïa ka lawar ding hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .

translation.en: I make a decree , that all they of the people of Israel , and of his priests and Levites , in my realm , which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem , go with thee .
translation.kha: Nga hukum ba ha baroh kawei ka hima jong nga , baroh ki Israel , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ïa kat kita kiba kwah , la ai jingbit ban leit bad me sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices , of pure myrrh five hundred shekels , and of sweet cinnamon half so much , even two hundred and fifty shekels , and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels ,
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jingiwbih musla kiba kynsai tam — hynriew kilo ka mirr ba la pynum , lai kilo ka siasia kaba sma iwbih , lai kilo ka um pai kaba iwbih ,

translation.en: And Pharaoh said , Go up , and bury thy father , according as he made thee swear .
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Khie leit , tep ïa la u kpa , kumba phi la kular ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And Saul sware to her by the  Lord  , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing .
translation.kha: Mynta u Saul u pynlong ka jingsmai kaba kyntang ha ka ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , nga kular ba phin ym shah pynshitom ei ei namar ba phi leh ïa kane ,  u ong ha ka .

translation.en: Bath–sheba therefore went unto king Solomon , to speak unto him for Adonijah . And the king rose up to meet her , and bowed himself unto her , and sat down on his throne , and caused a seat to be set for the king s mother  ; and she sat on his right hand .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit sha u syiem ban ïakren bad u na ka bynta u Adonijah . U syiem u la ïeng joit ban khublei ïa la ka kmie , bad u nguh ïa ka . Nangta u shong ha la ka khet , bad la wan buh sa kawei shapoh ha kaba ka la shong sha ka liang ka mon jong u .

translation.en: Pass through the host , and command the people , saying , Prepare you victuals  ; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan , to go in to possess the land , which the  Lord  your God giveth you to possess it .
translation.kha: ban rung sha ka jaka shong dara bad ban ong ha u paidbah ,  Pynkhreh jingbam katto katne , namar ha ki lai sngi phin leit jam ïa ka wah Jordan ban ïohkynti ïa ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: But they shall serve the  Lord  their God , and David their king , whom I will raise up unto them .
translation.kha: Pynban , kin shakri ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , uba ngan pynshong ha ka khet kum u syiem .

translation.en: Where their worm dieth not , and the fire is not quenched .
translation.kha: Hangta ‘ ki ksaiñ kiba bam ïa ki , kim ju ïap , bad ka ding kaba thang ïa ki , kam ju lip .’

translation.en: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns , and in Aroer and her towns , and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon , three hundred years ? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time ?
translation.kha: La laispah snem ki Israel ki la shong ha Heshbon bad ha Aroer , bad ha ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki , bad ha ki nongbah baroh kiba harud ka wah Arnon . Balei baroh shi katta mem shym la shim pat ïa ki ?

translation.en: But if the ministration of death , written and engraven in stones , was glorious , so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance ; which glory was to be done away :
translation.kha: Ïa ka Hukum la oh dur da ki dak halor ki mawlyngkniap , bad ka burom U Blei ka la wan hiar mynba la ai ïa ka . Wat la ka jingtyngshaiñ ha ka durkhmat u Moses ka la sdang ban lip noh , ka la long kaba khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ki paid Israel kim shym lah ban peit shlip ïa la ki khmat ha u .

translation.en: But they understood not this saying , and it was hid from them , that they perceived it not : and they feared to ask him of that saying .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki synran kim shym tip aïu kane ka kit jingmut . La buhrieh ïa ka na ki , khnang ba kin ym lah ban shemphang ïa ka , bad ki la sheptieng ban kylli ïa u shaphang kane .

translation.en: And all the men of Shechem gathered together , and all the house of Millo , and went , and made Abimelech king , by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo ki ïalumlang bad leit sha u dieng Sning bakyntang ha Shekhem , ha kaba ki la thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: Now thanks be unto God , which always causeth us to triumph in Christ , and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingnguh ki long sha U Blei! Naba ha U Khrist ngi long borabor kiba la ïalam da U Blei kum ki koidi ha ka jingïaid lynti ka jingjop U Khrist . U Blei u pyndonkam ïa ngi ba kata ka jingtip ïa U Khrist kan saphriang kylleng kum ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: The table , and all the vessels thereof , and the shewbread ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki khiew ki pliang jong ka , bad ïa u kpu ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei ;

translation.en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Go ye into the city , and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water : follow him .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la phah ar ngut na ki ryngkat bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit sha ka nongbah , bad uwei u briew uba kit ïa u khiew um , un ïakynduh ïa phi .

translation.en: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord , and hast said , By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains , to the sides of Lebanon  ; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof , and the choice fir trees thereof : and I will enter into the height of his border , and the forest of his Carmel .
translation.kha: Me la phah ïa ki shakri jong me ban kob sarong ïa nga ba da baroh ki kali ïapom jong me men jop ïa ki lum bajrong tam ka Lebanon . Me kob sarong ba hangta me pom lut ïa ki dieng Kedar bajrong tam bad ïa ki dieng Kseh bakynsai tam , bad me la poi sha ki bynta barben tam jong ki khlaw .

translation.en: And he shall take the cedar wood , and the hyssop , and the scarlet , and the living bird , and dip them in the blood of the slain bird , and in the running water , and sprinkle the house seven times :
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa uta u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u tnat Hissop , ïa u  saiwul saw , bad ïa kata ka sim kaba dang im , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap bad ha kata ka um sngur , bad un synreit hynñiew sien ïa kata ka ïing .

translation.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel , Whereby shall I know this ? for I am an old man , and my wife well stricken in years .
translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u la ong ha u angel ,  Da kumno ngan tip lada kane ka long kumta ? Nga long u briew batymmen , bad ka tnga jong nga ruh ka la tymmen .

translation.en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the  Lord  seven days in the year . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations : ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka hynñiew sngi . Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban bud ïa kane ka hukum pateng la pateng .

translation.en: This was done thrice : and the vessel was received up again into heaven .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad nangta ïa kata kaei kaei la shim noh pat sha bneng .

translation.en: But he spake of the temple of his body .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Templ kaba U Jisu u kren ka long shaphang ka met jong u .

translation.en: And if she vowed in her husband s house , or bound her soul by a bond with an oath  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim ka kular ban kiar na kano kano ,

translation.en: Beginning from the baptism of John , unto that same day that he was taken up from us , must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uwei pat u dei ban ïasoh bad ngi kum u sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong u Trai Jisu . U dei ban long uwei na ki rangbah uba don hapoh ka kynhun jong ngi ha ka por baroh ba U Trai Jisu u dang leit kylleng bad ngi , da kaba sdang naduh ka por ba u Ïoannis u ïalap ïa ka khubor ka jingpynbaptis haduh ka sngi ba ïa U Jisu la shim noh sha bneng na ngi .

translation.en: Behold , I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands  ; thy walls are continually before me .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ngam lah ban klet ïa pha ! Nga la thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong pha ha ki lynghoh kti jong nga .

translation.en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin , in the strife of the congregation , to sanctify me at the water before their eyes : that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin .
translation.kha: namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh pyrshah ïa ka hukum jong nga ha ka ri khlaw Sin . Haba u paidbah baroh u ïakren khñium ïa nga ha Meribah , phi la kyntait ban pynpaw ïa ka burom kaba kyntang ka jong nga ha khmat jong ki .  ( Ka Meribah ka dei ka umpohliew ha Kadesh ha ka ri khlaw Sin . )

translation.en: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh jong nga ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah kiba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pyn-i ha nga .

translation.en: Then was the king exceeding glad for him , and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den . So Daniel was taken up out of the den , and no manner of hurt was found upon him , because he believed in his God .
translation.kha: U syiem u la kmen shikatdei bad u la ai hukum ba yn tan noh ïa u Daniel na ka thliew . Kumta ki la tan ïa u shajrong bad ki la ïohi ba um shym la mynsaw ei ei , namar u la shaniah ha U Blei .

translation.en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah  ; We have a strong city  ; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan haba ki briew kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha ri Judah : Ka nongbah jong ngi ka long kaba skhem ! U Blei da lade hi u ïada ïa ki kynroh jong ka !

translation.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar , he said ,  It is finished :  and he bowed his head , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la dih ïa kata ka waiñ bad u la ong ,  La pyndep !  Nangta u la noh lyngngeh la ka khlieh bad u la ïap .

translation.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers , our houses to aliens .
translation.kha: Ka jingdon jingem jong ngi ka don ha ki kti jong ki riewphylla ; ki nongwei ki shong ki sah ha ki ïing jong ngi .

translation.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother , his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness .
translation.kha: Lada phi tim ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ka jingim jong phi kan kut kum ka sharak kaba lip noh ha kaba dum .
