translation.en: Hold fast the form of sound words , which thou hast heard of me , in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: To batskhem ïa ki ktien bashisha , kiba la pyniohsngew da nga , ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit kiba long ha U Khrist Jisu

translation.en: And Isaac said unto his son , How is it that thou hast found it so quickly , my son ? And he said , Because the  Lord  thy God brought it to me .
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Kumno keiñ khun phi stet katta katta ban ïoh ïa ka ?  U Jakob u jubab ,  Namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïarap ïa nga ban lap ïa ka .

translation.en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia , confirming the churches .
translation.kha: U la leit lyngba ka Syria bad ka Kilikia , u da pynkhlaiñ ïa ki balang .

translation.en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders , with the whole church , to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas  ; namely , Judas surnamed Barsabas , and Silas , chief men among the brethren :
translation.kha: Nangta ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang lem bad ka balang hi baroh kawei , ki la ïakut ban jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah na ka kynhun bad phah ïa ki sha Antiokh lem bad u Paul bad u Barnabas . Ki la jied ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da ki riewngeit , u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Barsabbas , bad u Silas ,

translation.en: And Sarai said unto Abram , Behold now , the  Lord  hath restrained me from bearing : I pray thee , go in unto my maid  ; it may be that I may obtain children by her . And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai .
translation.kha: Balei mem leit thiah bad ka mraw jong nga ? Lehse ka , ka lah ban ïoh khun ïa nga .  U Abram u la mynjur ïa kaei ba ka Sarai ka ong .

translation.en: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others .
translation.kha: bad phi tip ïa lade ba phi la ibeiñ ïa kiwei ki briew bun bunsien .

translation.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day  ; for I know not the numbers thereof .
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh shaphang ka jingbha jong me ; baroh shi sngi ngan kren shaphang ka jingpynim jong me , wat la ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Will he make a covenant with thee ? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever ?
translation.kha: Hato un ïateh kular bad me bad kular ban shakri ïa me junom ?

translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ,  phin ym ban shuh ïa kane ka proberb ha Israel .

translation.en: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and twined linen .
translation.kha: Ha ka rmiang jong ka la pynpur ïa ki dur soh Pomkranet da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad da ka linen bani .

translation.en: When men are cast down , then thou shalt say , There is lifting up  ; and he shall save the humble person .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynhiar ïa kiba sarong bad u pyllait im ïa uba sngewrit .

translation.en: But even a whole month , until it come out at your nostrils , and it be loathsome unto you : because that ye have despised the  Lord  which is among you , and have wept before him , saying , Why came we forth out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: hynrei baroh shi bnai , haduh ba kan da mihnoh shabar na ki shkor jong phi , haduh ba phin da sngewjli ïa ka . Kane kan jia namar ba phi la kyntait ïa U  Trai  uba don hangne hapdeng jong phi bad ba phi la ïakhñium ha u ba phim dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Ijipt .’

translation.en: But because I have said these things unto you , sorrow hath filled your heart .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi , ki dohnud jong phi ki la dap da ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba san la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Asher .

translation.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not ? for riches certainly make themselves wings  ; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven .
translation.kha: Ka pisa jong phi kan jah noh tang ha ka shikhyllipmat , kum kaba don thapniang bad ka her noh kum ka pukni .

translation.en: Egypt shall be a desolation , and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness , for the violence against the children of Judah , because they have shed innocent blood in their land .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt kan kylla long ka ri shyiap , bad ka Edom kan long ha ka jingjot lehnoh-ei , namar ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri Judah bad pynïap ïa ki briew balui lui jong ka .

translation.en: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering , and , behold , it was burnt : and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar , the sons of Aaron which were left alive , saying ,
translation.kha: U Moses u la kylli bniah shaphang uta u  langsohmoh ba la ai kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad u la tip ba la lah thang noh ïa u . Kane ka la pynlong ïa u ban bitar ïa u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , bad u kylli ïa ki ,

translation.en: Their Redeemer is strong  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name : he shall thoroughly plead their cause , that he may give rest to the land , and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei u ban pyllait ïa ki u long uba khlaiñ — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ma u hi da lade un bahkhlieh na ka bynta jong ki bad un wallam ïa ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ka jingjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka Babilonia .

translation.en: And there came a man from Baal–shalishah , and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits , twenty loaves of barley , and full ears of corn in the husk thereof . And he said , Give unto the people , that they may eat .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por , u briew u la wan na Baal Shalishah , u da wanrah ïa u Elisha arphew tylli ki kpu ba la shet na u barli uba nyngkong ba la ot ha kata ka snem , bad katto katne ki sohkew ba dang shu ot . U Elisha u ong ïa u shakri jong u ban ai bam ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa da kane ,

translation.en: And the servants of Achish said unto him , Is not this David the king of the land ? did they not sing one to another of him in dances , saying , Saul hath slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem ki ong ha u Akhish ,  Hato une um dei u Dabid , u syiem jong ka ri jong u ? Une u dei u briew uba shaphang jong u ki kynthei ki phawar , katba ki dang shad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar .’

translation.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard , lest at any time we should let them slip .
translation.kha: Namar kata ngi dei ban kham batskhem ïa kita ki jingshisha ïa kiba ngi la ïohsngew , kumta ba ngin ym shah rong noh .

translation.en: Satan did not want Adam and Eve to obey Jehovah .
translation.kha: U Soitan um kwah ba u Adam bad ka Im kin kohnguh ïa U Jehobah .

translation.en: These things ye shall do unto the  Lord  in your set feasts , beside your vows , and your freewill offerings , for your burnt offerings , and for your meat offerings , and for your drink offerings , and for your peace offerings .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingainguh waiñ , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok ba phi dei ban ai sha U  Trai  ha ki Jingkhawai Niam ba la buh . Kine ki long nalor kito ki jingainguh kiba phi ai ha kaba pyndep ïa ka jingkular lane kum ki jingainguh mon sngewbha .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem , and every man with his staff in his hand for very age .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki tymmen shynrang bad kynthei , kiba la tymmen haduh katta ba ki pyndonkam ïa ki diengduh haba ki ïaid , kin shong ha ki jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: And the child grew , and was weaned : and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned .
translation.kha: U khunlung u la nang san , bad ha ka sngi ba la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , u Abraham u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw .

translation.en: Their feet run to evil , and they make haste to shed innocent blood : their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity  ; wasting and destruction are in their paths .
translation.kha: Borabor phi thmu ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew , bad phim lah ap ban leh ïa kata . Phim ju sngew ei ei ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ; ka jingduh bad ka jingpynjot ki wan jia kat shaba phi leit .

translation.en: Let your loins be girded about , and your lights burning  ;
translation.kha: Long ba la kloi na ka bynta kano kano kaba wan , kiba la khreh na ka bynta ban leh ei ei bad kiba la thang ïa ki sharak jong phi ,

translation.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth , the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air ,
translation.kha: u mrad lane ka sim ,

translation.en: For he testifieth , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Men long u lyngdoh shi junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: ( Acts 20 :28 ) These elders are spiritually mature men who take the lead in the congregation and shepherd , “not under compulsion , but willingly before God  ; not for love of dishonest gain , but eagerly .”
translation.kha: ( Kam 20 :28 ) Kine ki rangbah balang ki long kiba la ih bha ha ka jinglong mynsiem ; ki ïalam ïa ka balang bad sharai “ym da kaba leh jubor , hynrei da la ka mon sngewbha hi ; ym da kaba khwan myntoi hynrei da ka jingsngew la kloi .”

translation.en: And heal the sick that are therein , and say unto them , The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
translation.kha: pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ha kata ka shnong , bad ong ha ki briew hangta , ‘ Ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi .’

translation.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times , and anointed the altar and all his vessels , both the laver and his foot , to sanctify them .
translation.kha: U shim ruh khyndiat na kata ka umphniang bad u synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha ka duwan bad ki tiar jong ka baroh , bad ha ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka , khnang ban pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days , when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place .
translation.kha: U khun jong u Aaron u ban mih pli ïa u kum u lyngdoh bad uba leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ban shakri ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang u dei ban phong ïa kine ki jaiñ hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: Yea , the Almighty shall be thy defence , and thou shalt have plenty of silver .
translation.kha: Ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un long ka ksiar jong phi , ai ba un long ka rupa , ba la kynton jrong na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Behold , thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth  ; and from thy face shall I be hid  ; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth  ; and it shall come to pass , that every one that findeth me shall slay me .
translation.kha: Me la beh noh ïa nga na ka khyndew bad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong me . Ngan long u nongphetwir ha ka pyrthei , bad uno uno uba lap ïa nga un pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia , they came to Pamphylia .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka thain jong ka Pisidia , ki la wan poi ha Pamphylia .

translation.en: And because I doubted of such manner of questions , I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these matters .
translation.kha: Ngam sngewlah ban rai kumno ngan lah ban ïoh jingtip halor kine kiei kiei , kumta nga la kylli ïa u Paul lada u mon ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ba yn shah bishar hangta halor kine ki jingkynnoh .

translation.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge  ; every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki briew ki long mutlop bad kumba ïap ; kito kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki lyngngoh ngaiñ namar ki blei ba ki shna ki long kiba shu thok bad khlem jingim .

translation.en: For God shall cast upon him , and not spare : he would fain flee out of his hand .
translation.kha: kan beh halor jong ki khlem jingisynei katba ki pyrshang katba don la ka bor ban lait im .

translation.en: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this ,
translation.kha: Ka jubab jong nga haba kito ki ba wohnia ïa nga , ka long kumne :

translation.en: For whosoever shall keep the whole law , and yet offend in one point , he is guilty of all .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pynkheiñ ïa kawei ka hukum u long uba shah pynrem ha kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: At our meetings , we gather together , not with mere acquaintances , but with a group of close friends .
translation.kha: Ha ki jingïalang jong ngi , ngi ïalumlang , ym bad ki briew kiba ngi shu ithuh hynrei bad ki paralok ba ïajan .

translation.en: And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Make this valley full of ditches .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Tih nur-um ha kylleng kane ka phud um baryngkhiang .

translation.en: Look unto the heavens , and see  ; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou .
translation.kha: To khmied sha ka suiñbneng ! Peit katno ka jingjngai jong ki lyoh !

translation.en: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Arise , and take up thy bed , and walk ?
translation.kha: Hato ka long kaba kham suk ban ong ha une u briew uba la ïapshiliang , ‘ Ïa ki pop jong me la map’ ne ban ong , ‘ To ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to ïaid’ ?

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: bad nangta U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga

translation.en: The young lions roared upon him , and yelled , and they made his land waste : his cities are burned without inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ki la kyrhuh ha u kum u sing , ki la pynkylla ri shyiap ïa ka ri jong u , bad ki shnong jong u ki don ha ka jingjot jingpra , kiba la shah iehnoh khoit .

translation.en: Behold , I say , how they reward us , to come to cast us out of thy possession , which thou hast given us to inherit .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba ki siew kylliang ïa ngi — ki wan ban beh krad ïa ngi shabar na ka ri kaba me la ai ha ngi .

translation.en: When did you last visit your village ?
translation.kha: Mynno phi poi khatduh sha ka shnong lajong ?

translation.en: Moreover four thousand were porters  ; and four thousand praised the  Lord  with the instruments which I made , said David , to praise therewith .
translation.kha: saw hajar ngut ban ap phira , bad saw hajar ngut ban ïaroh ïa U  Trai  da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingtem jingput ba la pynbiang da u syiem na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu .

translation.en: What knowest thou , that we know not ? what understandest thou , which is not in us ?
translation.kha: Kam don ei ei kaba me tip ïa kaba ngim tip .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness , by the fountain in the way to Shur .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la ïashem ïa ka Hagar harud ka umpohliew ha ka ri shyiap ha ka lynti sha Shur bad u ong ,

translation.en: So it came to pass , when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ïap lut ,

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain , and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand .
translation.kha: Uba ar ha ka kyrdan u dei u Jehohanan uba don ar lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki shipai ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god , that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword : and they escaped into the land of Armenia . And Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u dang mane ha ka templ jong u blei jong u , u Nisrokh , ar ngut na ki khun jong u , u Adrammelekh bad u Shareser , ki pynïap ïa u da ki waitlam , bad nangta ki phet ïap sha ka ri Ararat . Uwei pat na ki khun shynrang jong u , u Esarhaddon , u long u patsha ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And Joab sent to Tekoa , and fetched thence a wise woman , and said unto her , I pray thee , feign thyself to be a mourner , and put on now mourning apparel , and anoint not thyself with oil , but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead :
translation.kha: kumta u phah khot ïa ka kynthei kaba sian kaba shong ha Tekoa . Haba ka la wan poi , u ong ha ka ,  Leh mynleh kumba phi don ha kaba ïambriew ; kup ïa ki jaiñ ïambriew , bad wat sad ïa la u shñiuh . Leh kum ka briew kaba la ïambriew la slem bah .

translation.en: The ransom of a man s life are his riches : but the poor heareth not rebuke .
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah ki hap ban pyndonkam ïa la ka pisa ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , hynrei ym don ba byrngem ïa uba duk .

translation.en: And the number of them that lapped , putting their hand to their mouth , were three hundred men : but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water .
translation.kha: La don laispah ngut ki rangbah kiba tong um da ki kti jong ki bad jliah ïa ka ; baroh kita kiwei pat ki dem khohsiew ban dih um .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Put forth thine hand , and take it by the tail . And he put forth his hand , and caught it , and it became a rod in his hand :
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ,  Dem bad shim ïa u na u tdong .  Kumta u Moses u dem bad u kem ïa u , bad u kylla diengduh pat .

translation.en: And one of the scribes came , and having heard them reasoning together , and perceiving that he had answered them well , asked him , Which is the first commandment of all ?
translation.kha: Uwei u nonghikai ka Hukum uba don hangta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren . U la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u la ai ïa ki Saddusi ka jubab kaba dei , kumta u la wan ha u ryngkat bad ka jingkylli :  Kano ka hukum kaba long kaba kongsan tam na baroh ?

translation.en: For their mother hath played the harlot : she that conceived them hath done shamefully : for she said , I will go after my lovers , that give me my bread and my water , my wool and my flax , mine oil and my drink .
translation.kha: Ma ka hi ka la ong ,  Ngan leit sha kiba ieit ki jong nga — ki pynbiang ïa nga ka jingbam bad ka um , u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen , ka umphniang Olib bad ka waiñ .

translation.en: Abide in me , and I in you . As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself , except it abide in the vine  ; no more can ye , except ye abide in me .
translation.kha: To ïaineh ha nga , bad ngan ïaineh ha phi . Ka tnat kam lah ban seisoh da lade hi ; ka lah ban seisoh tang lada ka ïaineh ha u dieng sohwaiñ . Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phim lah ban seisoh lymda phi ïaineh ha nga .

translation.en: Whosoever cometh to me , and heareth my sayings , and doeth them , I will shew you to whom he is like :
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga bad uba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki — ngan pyn-i ha phi u ïasyriem ïano .

translation.en: What thing soever I command you , observe to do it : thou shalt not add thereto , nor diminish from it .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa phi ; wat pyntam ha ka ne pynduna ei ei na ka .

translation.en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah , and toward all the land of the plain , and beheld , and , lo , the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace .
translation.kha: U khmih shaphang Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ïa kata ka them baroh kawei bad u la ïohi ïa ka tdem kaba mih na khyndew , kum ka tdem na ka lawar ding kaba heh bha .

translation.en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a solemn assembly  ; and ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phin kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam . Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang biang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam . Kata ka long ka sngi mane Blei ; phim dei ban trei ei ei .

translation.en: And herein is that saying true , One soweth , and another reapeth .
translation.kha: Ka jingong ka long kaba shisha , ‘ Uwei u bet , uwei pat u ot .’

translation.en: And it was so , when they came into the midst of the city , that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them , and cast them into the midst of the pit , he , and the men that were with him .
translation.kha: Ki tang shu mar ïapoi hapoh ka nongbah , u Ishmael bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap ïa ki bad ki la bret ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ka pukri .

translation.en: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth  ; their flocks and their herds , their sons and their daughters .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingmane ïa u Baal , u blei ka jinglehrain , ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban duh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad kynhun masi , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei — kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la trei naduh ki por mynbarim .

translation.en: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah , of the goldsmiths . Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries , and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall .
translation.kha: U Ussiel , u khun jong u Harhaïah , u bania , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Hananaïah , u nongshna jingiwbih , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka Kynroh Baïar .

translation.en: And the  Lord  called Samuel again the third time . And he arose and went to Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou didst call me . And Eli perceived that the  Lord  had called the child .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel ha ka sien kaba lai ; u la khie , u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hangta u Eli u sngewthuh ba dei U  Trai  uba la khot ïa uta u khynnah ;

translation.en: All this was done , that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ban pynshisha ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ong :

translation.en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father s brother , and that he was Rebekah s son : and she ran and told her father .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ka ,  Nga dei u ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong phi , u khun jong ka Rebekka .

translation.en: All ye beasts of the field , come to devour , yea , all ye beasts in the forest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa ki ri nongwei ban wan kum ki mradkhlaw bad bam duh ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood :
translation.kha: Ki long kiba kloi ban pynmynsaw bad ban pynïap ;

translation.en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols ? for ye are the temple of the living God ; as God hath said , I will dwell in them , and walk in them ; and I will be their God , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: Kumno ka templ jong U Blei kan don jingïateh bad ki bleithaw ? Naba ngi long ka templ jong U Blei uba im ! Kumba U Blei da lade hi u la ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka ïing jong nga bad ki briew jong nga bad ngan shong hapdeng jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered , lest they die .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew kyrteng ki long hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut .

translation.en: Ye men of Israel , hear these words  ; Jesus of Nazareth , a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs , which God did by him in the midst of you , as ye yourselves also know :
translation.kha: A to shahshkor ïa kine ki kyntien , ko para nong Israel ! U Jisu uba na Nasareth u la long u briew uba ïa ka bor ba kynja blei jong u la pynshisha da kaba shai ha phi da ki kambah bad kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong u . Phi hi phi tip ïa kane , naba ka la jia hangne hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep  ; also fowls were prepared for me , and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine : yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor , because the bondage was heavy upon this people .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi nga ai uwei u masi , hynriew tylli na ki langbrot babha tam , bad bun tylli ki syiar bad man ka shiphew sngi nga pynbiang ka waiñ thymmai . Hynrei nga tip kiei ki jingkit bakhia ki briew ki hap ban shah , kumta ngam shym la dawa ïa ka baibam kaba u lat u don hok ban ïoh .

translation.en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad kito baroh kiba ieit ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi da ka jingieit baneh .

translation.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks , and divers washings , and carnal ordinances , imposed on them until the time of reformation .
translation.kha: namar ba ki ïadei tang bad ka jingbam , ka jingdih bad ki niam ki rukom pynkhuid babun jait . Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ kiba tang shabar , kiba ïadei tang haduh ka por ba U Blei un seng nongrim da kaei kaba thymmai .

translation.en: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses , behold , the skin of his face shone  ; and they were afraid to come nigh him .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad uta u paidbah ki peit ïa u Moses bad ki ïohi ba ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ , kumta ki ïasheptieng ban leit hajan jong u .

translation.en: And Elijah took his mantle , and wrapped it together , and smote the waters , and they were divided hither and thither , so that they two went over on dry ground .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u kli ïa ka , bad u tied ïa ka um da ka ; ka um ka la kad arliang , bad ma u lem bad u Elisha ki la jam sha shiliang ha ka dewryngkhiang .

translation.en: And he said ,  Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God ? or with what comparison shall we compare it ?
translation.kha: Kaei ngin ong , ka Hima U Blei ka long kaba kumno ?  U Jisu u kylli .  Ka pharshi kaba kumno ngin pyndonkam ban batai ïa ka ?

translation.en: And the children of Benjamin did so , and took them wives , according to their number , of them that danced , whom they caught : and they went and returned unto their inheritance , and repaired the cities , and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki leh kumta ; uwei pa uwei na ki u jied ïa ka tnga napdeng ki theisamla kiba shad ha Shiloh bad ïalam noh ïa ki . Nangta ki leit phai sha la ka jaka , ki tei thymmai ïa la ki shnong , bad ki shong hangta .

translation.en: If any man teach otherwise , and consent not to wholesome words , even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ , and to the doctrine which is according to godliness ;
translation.kha: Uno uno uba hikai ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai kaba pher bad um mynjur ïa ki ktien bashisha jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ka jingngeit jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingsarong bad u bymtip ei ei .

translation.en: And fear not them which kill the body , but are not able to kill the soul : but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym lah ban pynïap ïa ka mynsiem ; hynrei to sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba lah ban pynjot ïa ka met bad ka mynsiem ha dujok .

translation.en: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation , when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali , and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , in Galilee of the nations .
translation.kha: Yn ym don kano kano ka lad ïa ki ban lait phet na kane ka por jingjynjar . Ïa ka ri jong ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali la pynjahburom shisien , hynrei ka lawei kan wanrah burom ïa kane ka thain , na ka Mediterranian sha ka phang mihngi sha ka ri ha kawei ka liang jong ka Jordan , bad wat sha Galilaïa hi , ha kaba ki nongwei ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet , and his armourbearer after him : and they fell before Jonathan  ; and his armourbearer slew after him .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u kiew shajrong na ka khim da kaba par da ki kti bad khohsiew , bad u samla u la bud ïa u . U Jonathan u la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad u pynkyllon ïa ki , bad u samla u la pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms , in calling to remembrance the days of her youth , wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka la nang kham long ka nuti ban ïa kaba ka ju long , ka la leh kumba ka la ju leh haba ka dang khynraw , mynba ka la long ka nuti ha Ijipt .

translation.en: But I keep under my body , and bring it into subjection : lest that by any means , when I have preached to others , I myself should be a castaway .
translation.kha: Nga pyneh ïa la ka met da ki jingshahkura bad nga pyndem ïa ka hapoh ka bor synshar lade , ban sumar ïa lade na kaba shah kyntait hadien ba nga la khot ïa kiwei sha ka jingïakhun .

translation.en: Therefore was he hired , that I should be afraid , and do so , and sin , and that they might have matter for an evil report , that they might reproach me .
translation.kha: Ki la pyndonkam ïa u ban pyntieng ïa nga sha ka jingleh pop , khnang ba ki lah ban pynsniew ïa nam babha jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .

translation.en: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter : because that the Lord is the avenger of all such , as we also have forewarned you and testified .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , te , uno uno u briew un ym dei ban leh bymdei ïa la u parabangeit lane shim kabu ïa u . Ngi la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kane mynshuwa , bad ngi maham jur ïa phi ba U Trai un pynshitom ïa kito kiba leh ïa kata .

translation.en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days , nor an old man that hath not filled his days : for the child shall die an hundred years old  ; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed .
translation.kha: Ki khunlung kin ym ïap shuh haba ki dang khunlung , bad baroh ki briew kin im haduh ba ki la pura bha ka rta . Kito kiba im kumba shispah snem yn ñiew ïa ki ba ki dang samla . Ban ïap shuwa ïa kata pat kan dei ka dak ba nga la pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And Pilate wrote a title , and put it on the cross . And the writing was , JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la thoh ïa ka jingthoh bad la phah wah halor ka diengphna .  U Jisu u nong Nasareth , U Syiem ki Jiw  , ka long kaei kaba u la thoh .

translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice according to that which I command thee .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun ,  la bteng ka Rebekka ,  shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei ba nga ong .

translation.en: Being born again , not of corruptible seed , but of incorruptible , by the word of God , which liveth and abideth for ever .
translation.kha: Naba lyngba ka ktien ba-im bad ba bymjukut jong U Blei la pynkha pat ïa phi kum ki khun jong uta u bymïap shuh , u bym dei u briew .

translation.en: And the children of Israel set forward , and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la nang ïaid bad ki sher dara ha ki pyntha jong ka Moab sha mihngi jong ka Jordan bad marpyrshah ka Jerikho .

translation.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good : her candle goeth not out by night .
translation.kha: Ka tip ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei kiba ka thaw , bad ka trei haduh ynda miet bha .

translation.en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place : I thought to promote thee unto great honour  ; but , lo , the  Lord  hath kept thee back from honour .
translation.kha: Khie leit noh mynta sha la ïing ! Nga la kular ban ai bainong ïa me , hynrei U  Trai  u la khang ïa me ban ïoh ïa kata ka bainong .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that David his father did .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid , u la leh ïa kaei kaba sngewbha ha U  Trai .

translation.en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least , why take ye thought for the rest ?
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban leh wat ïa kum kane kaei kaei kaba rit , balei ban khuslai shaphang kiwei pat kiei kiei ?

translation.en: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up into the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nonglamktien bad pule ïa ka . Nangta u leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Behold , I will bring them from the north country , and gather them from the coasts of the earth , and with them the blind and the lame , the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together : a great company shall return thither .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ki na shaphang shatei bad ngan lumlang ïa ki na kiba kut ka pyrthei . Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kin wan lang bad ki , ki kynthei ba la armet bad kito ki ban sa kha . Kin sa long pat ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

translation.en: And when they had told David , saying , Uriah went not down unto his house , David said unto Uriah , Camest thou not from thy journey ? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house ?
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohsngew ba u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing , u la kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang shu wan phai hadien ka jingleit kaba jlan ; balei phi khlem leit sha ïing ?

translation.en: And thou shalt take the garments , and put upon Aaron the coat , and the robe of the ephod , and the ephod , and the breastplate , and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod :
translation.kha: Nangta pynriam ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh — ka sopti-poh , ka barandi kaba hapoh ka ephod , ka ephod , ka jingdeng shadem bad u panpoh .

translation.en: And Moses built an altar , and called the name of it Jehovah–nissi :
translation.kha: U Moses u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u ai kyrteng ïa ka  U  Trai  u long ka Lama jong nga .

translation.en: And , behold , certain of the scribes said within themselves , This man blasphemeth .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Une u briew u krenbeiñ Blei !

translation.en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things , and to enter into his glory ?
translation.kha: Hato kam long kaba donkam ïa U Messaïah ban shahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei baroh bad nangta ban rung sha ka burom jong u ?

translation.en: Likewise also the cup after supper , saying ,  This cup is the new testament in my blood , which is shed for you .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , u la ai ha ki ïa ka khuri hadien ka jingbam miet , da kaba ong ,  Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang bathymmai jong U Blei ïa kaba la pynskhem da ka snam jong nga , ïa kaba la pynmih noh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake ? Verily , verily , I say unto thee , The cock shall not crow , till thou hast denied me thrice .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato me long ba la kloi shisha ban ïap na ka bynta jong nga ? Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih men len ïa nga lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba kular ïa kiei kiei kiba kim ju lah ban ai satia ki long kum ki lyoh bad ka lyer ki bym ai slap .

translation.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire , and earnestly looked upon him , and said , This man was also with him .
translation.kha: Haba kawei na ki shakri kynthei ka la ïohi ïa u ba u shong hangta harud ding , ka la khmih shlip sha u bad ka la ong ,  Une u briew ruh u la don bad U Jisu !

translation.en: But when divers were hardened , and believed not , but spake evil of that way before the multitude , he departed from them , and separated the disciples , disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na ki , ki long kiba mynthi bad kim ngeit , bad ha khmat ka kynhun baroh kawei ki la kren ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang ka Lynti jong U Trai . Kumta u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la ïalam bad u ïa kiba ngeit bad man la ka sngi u la pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut ha ka kamra hikai u Tyrannus .

translation.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image , or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above , or that is in the earth beneath , or that is in the water under the earth :
translation.kha: Wat thaw durblei na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shajrong , ne ha ka khyndew sha tbian , ne ha ka um hapoh ka khyndew .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the  Lord  , I have sinned  ; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me : now therefore , if it displease thee , I will get me back again .
translation.kha: U Balaam u phai ktien ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym tip ba me ïeng hapdeng lynti ban khang ïa nga ; hynrei mynta , lada kam dei ïa nga ban leit , ngan leit phai noh sha la ïing .

translation.en: I am fine .
translation.kha: Nga Shait .

translation.en: What you had been told ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi hap ban leh ba ki ong ?

translation.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them , and the new wine shall fail in her .
translation.kha: Hynrei shen phin ym ïoh ïa u kew bad ka umphniang Olib kat ban dap biang bad yn ym don waiñ shuh .

translation.en: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed , saying , That it was needful to circumcise them , and to command them to keep the law of Moses .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki parabangeit kiba long na ka kynhun jong ki Pharisi ki la ïeng bad ki la ong ,  Ïa ki Jentil dei ban otsher bad bthah ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong u Moses .

translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto the women , Fear not ye : for I know that ye seek Jesus , which was crucified .
translation.kha: U angel u la kren ha ki kynthei .  Phim dei ban sheptieng ,  u la ong .  Nga tip phi ïawad ïa U Jisu , uba la shah sahnarphna .

translation.en: Pharaoh shall see them , and shall be comforted over all his multitude , even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ka jingïohi ïa baroh kine kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma kan long ka jingtngen ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: And hired counsellors against them , to frustrate their purpose , all the days of Cyrus king of Persia , even until the reign of Darius king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ki la pynbam pisa ruh ïa ki rangbah synshar ka sorkar Persia ban trei pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la ïai leh ïa kane baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Syros haduh ka jingsynshar u Darius .

translation.en: And they burnt the city with fire , and all that was therein : only the silver , and the gold , and the vessels of brass and of iron , they put into the treasury of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah bad ki thang khoit ïa ka , lem bad baroh kiba don ha ka , lait noh kita kiei kiei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nar , ïa kaba ki la shim bad buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew U  Trai .

translation.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together , and encamped in Gilead . And the children of Israel assembled themselves together , and encamped in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Nangta ka kynhun shipai jong ki Ammon ka la pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad sher dara ha Gilead . Ki paid Israel ki la ïalumlang bad sher dara ha Mispah kaba ha Gilead .

translation.en: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest , even to the mountains  ; and the rivers shall be full of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynmih ïa ka snam jong me haduh ba kan da lyngkien halor ki lumbah bad kan pyndap ïa ki wahduid .

translation.en: And Pharaoh–neco put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath , that he might not reign in Jerusalem  ; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver , and a talent of gold .
translation.kha: Ka jingsynshar jong u ka la kut haba u Neko u syiem Ijipt u kem koidi ïa u ha Riblah , ha ri ki Hamath , bad pynlong ïa ka Judah ban siew lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa bad laiphew saw kilo ka ksiar kum ka bai nguh syiem .

translation.en: I know that there is no good in them , but for a man to rejoice , and to do good in his life .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh ba baroh kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban kmen bad leh ïa kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah katba ngi dang im .

translation.en: Elam the fifth , Jehohanan the sixth , Elioenai the seventh .
translation.kha: U don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba la jer ter ter kat kum ka rta : u Sekharaïah , u Jediael , u Sebadaïah , u Jathniel , u Elam , u Jehohanan bad u Eliehoenai .

translation.en: But if ye do not forgive , neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses .
translation.kha: Lada phim map ïa kiwei , U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ym map ïa ki jingbakla kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: And Jesus , perceiving the thought of their heart , took a child , and set him by him ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la shim ïa u khynnah , u la pynïeng hajan jong u bad u la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host , and said unto them , Have her forth of the ranges : and whoso followeth her , let him be slain with the sword . For the priest said , Slay her not in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap hapoh ka jaka jong ka Templ , kumta u khot ïa ki rangbah shipai bad u ong ,  Ïalam ïa ka shabar napdeng ki laiñ jong ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uno uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .

translation.en: Are not my days few ? cease then , and let me alone , that I may take comfort a little ,
translation.kha: Hato ka jingim jong nga ka la jan kut ? Ieh ïa nga marwei ! Shah ba ngan lehkmen ïa ka por kaba dang sah ,

translation.en: But then we saw the need to produce a new translation that would better help people to learn the “accurate knowledge of truth ,” which is God’s will for everyone .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ïohi ba la donkam ban pynmih ïa ka jingpynkyllaktien bathymmai ban ïarap ïa ki briew ban ïoh “jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” Kane ka dei ka mon jong U Blei na ka bynta iwei pa iwei .

translation.en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , which killest the prophets , and stonest them that are sent unto thee  ; how often would I have gathered thy children together , as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings , and ye would not !
translation.kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , pha lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah sha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ki briew jong pha , kumba ka syiar ka kdup ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei phan ym shah ïa nga !

translation.en: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence , and the violent take it by force .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u haduh kane ka sngi hi , ka Hima ki bneng ka la shah ïa ka jingleh jubor , bad ki nongleh jubor ki pyrshang ban kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that while he executed the priest s office before God in the order of his course ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Sekharaïah u dang pyndep ïa ka kam kum u lyngdoh ha ka Templ , da kaba shim ïa la ka bynta ha ka jingshakri ba man ka sngi .

translation.en: For thou hast said in thine heart , I will ascend into heaven , I will exalt my throne above the stars of God : I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation , in the sides of the north :
translation.kha: Me la kut jingmut ban kiew shaduh bneng bad ban buh ïa ka khet jong me halor ki khlur kiba hajrong tam . Me la pyrkhat ba men shong kum u syiem halor uta u lumbah ha ka phang bashatei ha kaba ki blei ki ïalumlang .

translation.en: The hearing ear , and the seeing eye , the  Lord  hath made even both of them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa ngi ki khmat ban peit da ki bad ïa ki shkor ban sngap da ki .

translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan .

translation.en: And when it was day , certain of the Jews banded together , and bound themselves under a curse , saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud katto katne ngut ki Jiw ki la ïakynduh lang bad ki la pynlong ka jingsylla . Ki la shim smai ba kin ym bam lane dih ei ei tad ynda ki la lah pynïap ïa u Paul .

translation.en: And David sent and enquired after the woman . And one said , Is not this Bath–sheba , the daughter of Eliam , the wife of Uriah the Hittite ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban lap ka dei mano , bad u la tip ba ka dei ka Bathsheba , ka khun jong u Eliam bad ka tnga jong u Uriah u nong Hit .

translation.en: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house , for all the service thereof , and for all that shall be done therein .
translation.kha: Nga buh ïa ki ban leh ïa ka kam bapoh ïa kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest  ; it crieth out against me : therefore have I hated it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga ki la phai pyrshah ïa nga ; kum u sing hapoh ka khlaw ki la kyrhuh ïa nga , bad kumta nga isih ïa ki .

translation.en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias , saying , The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la long uta u briew ïa uba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la kren shaphang jong u haba u la ong ,  U don uwei uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , To pynkhreh ka lynti ïa U Trai ; to pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta jong u ban ïaid !

translation.en: Now there was found in it a poor wise man , and he by his wisdom delivered the city  ; yet no man remembered that same poor man .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba duk uba sah hangta , hynrei uba sian katta katta ba u jin da lah ban pyllait im ïa ka shnongrit . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the  Lord  , as in the days of old , and as in former years .
translation.kha: Nangta ki jingainguh ïa kiba ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki wallam sha U  Trai  kin long kiba pynsngewbha ïa u , kumba ki ju long ha ki por kiba la leit .

translation.en: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you ? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom .
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno napdeng jong phi uba stad bad shemphang ? U dei ban pynshisha ïa ka da ka jingim babha , da ki kam babha jong u kiba u la leh ha ka jingsngewrit bad jingstad .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab , and found the princes of Judah , and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah , that ministered to Ahaziah , he slew them .
translation.kha: Katba u Jehu u dang pyntreikam ïa ka rai jong U Blei halor ka longïing syiem , u la ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun kaba don ki nongïalam jong ka Judia bad ki pyrsa jong u Ahasaïah kiba la synran ïa u Ahasaïah ha ka jingleit jngoh jong u . U Jehu u la pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee , saying , This is the way , walk ye in it , when ye turn to the right hand , and when ye turn to the left .
translation.kha: Lada phi sakma noh na ka lynti sha kamon ne sha kadiang , phin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u hadien jong phi kaba ong ,  Kane ka dei ka lynti . Bud ïa ka .

translation.en: We are confounded , because we have heard reproach : shame hath covered our faces : for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the  Lord s  house .
translation.kha: Phi ong , ‘ La pynjahburom ïa ngi bad la pynlehrain ïa ngi ; ngi sngew ba ngim lah leh ei ei shuh namar ki nongwei ki la shimti noh ïa ki jaka bakhuid ha ka Templ .’

translation.en: And after that many days were fulfilled , the Jews took counsel to kill him :
translation.kha: Hadien bun sngi , ki Jiw ki la ïashem lang bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynïap ïa u Saul , hynrei la ïathuh ha u shaphang ka jingthmu jong ki .

translation.en: For it is written , As I live , saith the Lord , every knee shall bow to me , and every tongue shall confess to God .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei ba-im , ong U Trai , baroh kin dem khohsiew ha khmat jong nga , bad baroh kin phla ba nga long U Blei .

translation.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales , and they believed them not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki apostol ki la pyrkhat ba kaei kaba kita ki kynthei ki la ong ka long ka bym don jingmut , bad kim shym la ngeit ïa ki .

translation.en: And they began to accuse him , saying , We found this fellow perverting the nation , and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar , saying that he himself is Christ a King .
translation.kha: Ngi la kem ïa une u briew uba ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong ngi , da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym siew khajna sha u Patsha bad u kam ba ma u hi u long U Messaïah , u syiem .

translation.en: And Mephibosheth had a young son , whose name was Micha . And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth .
translation.kha: U Mephibosheth u don uwei u khun samla uba kyrteng u Mika . Baroh ki dkhot ka longïing jong u Siba ki kylla long ki shakri jong u Mephibosheth .

translation.en: A wild ass used to the wilderness , that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure  ; in her occasion who can turn her away ? all they that seek her will not weary themselves  ; in her month they shall find her .
translation.kha: ka da mareh stet sha ka ri shyiap . Haba ka don ha ka jingkwah shongkha , mano ba lah ban bat synshar ïa ka ? Ym don uno uno u shynrang uba kwah ïa ka uba dei ban pynjynjar ïa lade ; ka ïai don borabor ha ka aïom shongkha .

translation.en: The Babylonians , and all the Chaldeans , Pekod , and Shoa , and Koa , and all the Assyrians with them : all of them desirable young men , captains and rulers , great lords and renowned , all of them riding upon horses .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ki nong Babilonia bad ki nong Khaldi baroh , ki rangbah na Pekod , Shoa , bad Koa , bad ïa ki nong Assyria baroh . Ngan lumlang ïa kito ki rangsamla ba-bhabriew bad ki rangbah shipai , baroh kito ki rangbah pynïaidkam bapaw bad ki rangbah shipai ba-halor .

translation.en: Then shall the  Lord  go forth , and fight against those nations , as when he fought in the day of battle .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  un mih shabar bad un ïaleh pyrshah ïa kito ki hima , kumba u la ïaleh ha ki por ba la dep .

translation.en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime  ; but the children of Esau succeeded them , when they had destroyed them from before them , and dwelt in their stead  ; as Israel did unto the land of his possession , which the  Lord  gave unto them .
translation.kha: Ki Hor ki la ju shong ha Edom , hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong u Iso ki beh ïa ki , ki pynjot ïa ka ri jong ki , bad ki buhai shnong ïa lade hangta , kumjuh kumba ki Israel kham hadien ki beh ïa ki nongshun jong ki na kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki . )

translation.en: Therefore , O thou son of man , speak unto the house of Israel  ; Thus ye speak , saying , If our transgressions and our sins be upon us , and we pine away in them , how should we then live ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , ïai-ong ha ki Israel , ïa kaei kaba ki ong : ‘ Ïa ngi la pynkit khia da ki pop bad ki jingryngkang jong ngi kiba ngi la leh . Ngi la ringswai . Kumno te ngi lah ban im ?’

translation.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword , and shall be led away captive into all nations : and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles , until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut kin shah pynïap da ka waitlam , bad kiwei pat kin shah rah kum ki koidi sha ki ri baroh ; bad ki bymngeit blei kin ïuh ïa ka Jerusalem tad ynda ka por jong ki ka la kut .

translation.en: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and serve him , those will I let remain still in their own land , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall till it , and dwell therein .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad shakri ïa u , te ngan shah ïa ka ba kan shong ha la ka ri , ban rep ïa ka bad shong hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Now the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah , while he was shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,
translation.kha: Katba ïa nga la dang set byndi ha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga

translation.en: Then took they him , and led him , and brought him into the high priest s house . And Peter followed afar off .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa U Jisu bad ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh ; bad u Petros u la bud na pajih .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , saying , Hear ye the words of this covenant , and do them .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad sha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem . Pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga hangta bad ïathuh ïa ki briew ban shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang bad ban kohnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the  Lord  , at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth .
translation.kha: Ki lum ki um noh kum ka bthing ha khmat U  Trai  , ha khmat U  Trai  jong ka khyndew baroh .

translation.en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial , of those that went with David , and said , Because they went not with us , we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered , save to every man his wife and his children , that they may lead them away , and depart .
translation.kha: Hynrei don napdeng kita kiba la leit ryngkat bad u Dabid , ki bymman bad ki riewkai , kiba ong ,  Kine kim shym la leit ryngkat bad ngi , bad kumta ngim dei ban ai bynta ei ei ïa ki na ka jinglute . Ki lah ban shim tang ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun ki kti , bad ai kin leit noh .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation  ; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u lehrain ïa nga bad ïa ka jinghikai jong nga ha kane ka sngi jong ka jingbymriewblei bad ka jingbymman , te U Khun U Briew un lehrain ïa u haba un wan ha ka burom jong U Kpa jong u ryngkat bad ki angel bakhuid .

translation.en: And again he denied with an oath , I do not know the man .
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Petros u la len ïa kata bad u la jubab ,  Nga smai ba ngam ithuh ïa uta u briew !

translation.en: Ask ye now , and see whether a man doth travail with child ? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins , as a woman in travail , and all faces are turned into paleness ?
translation.kha: Mynta to sangeh bad pyrkhat ! Hato u briew u lah ban kha khun ? Te balei keiñ ba nga ïohi ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ba u buh ïa la ka kti ha la ka kpoh kum ka kynthei ha ka jingsuh kha ? Balei uwei pa uwei baroh u blad rong ?

translation.en: Greatly desiring to see thee , being mindful of thy tears , that I may be filled with joy ;
translation.kha: Da thrang ba kwah eh ban ïohi ïa me , nga kynmaw ïa ki ummat jong me , khnang ba yn ïoh pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing , as unto a faithful Creator .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kito kiba shahshitom namar ba ka long ka mon U Blei ïa ki , ki dei da la ki kam babha ban shaniah tylli ïa lade ha U Nongthaw jong ki , uba ïai bat ïa la ka jingkular .

translation.en: And when Herod saw Jesus , he was exceeding glad : for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him  ; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him .
translation.kha: U Herod u la sngewbha shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , namar u la lah ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad u la da kwah eh ban ïohi ïa u la slem bah . U la kyrmen ban ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u leh katto katne ki kambah .

translation.en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering , and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings .
translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop , bad ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem kum ka jingainguh pynïasuk .

translation.en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea , from the bay that looketh southward :
translation.kha: Kane ka pud bashaphang shathie ka sdang na ka tduh kaba shathie jong ka Duriaw Baïap ,

translation.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance : but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki kmen , ki phuh samrkhie , hynrei haba ki sngewsih , ki pyn-i jingsngewdiaw .

translation.en: And desired favour against him , that he would send for him to Jerusalem , laying wait in the way to kill him .
translation.kha: Ki la kyrpad ïa u Phestos ban leh ei ei na ka bynta jong ki da kaba wallam ïa u Paul sha Jerusalem , naba ki la lah pynlong ka jingïasylla ban pynïap ïa u ha lynti .

translation.en: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits  ; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled , and fell there  ; and they that remained fled to the mountain .
translation.kha: Ka them ka la dap da ki thliew bsiang ; bad haba ki syiem jong ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah ki la pyrshang ban phet ïap na ka thma , ki la hap ha kita ki thliew ; hynrei ki lai ngut kiwei pat ki syiem ki la phet ïap sha ki lumbah .

translation.en: For he saith , I have heard thee in a time accepted , and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee : behold , now is the accepted time ; behold , now is the day of salvation .
translation.kha: Ha sngap aïu U Blei u ong :  Haba ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pyn-i ïa ka jingshem sngewbha ha phi , nga la ïohsngew ïa phi ; haba ka sngi ka la poi ïa nga ban pynim ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi .  To shahshkor ! Kane ka dei ka kynta ban pdiang ïa ka jingshem sngewbha U Blei ; Mynta , ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingpynim !

translation.en: And some fell on stony ground , where it had not much earth  ; and immediately it sprang up , because it had no depth of earth :
translation.kha: Katto katne na u , u la hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw , ha ka jaka ba duna khyndew . Tang katto katne por ki symbai ki la shylluit , namar ka khyndew kam da jylliew .

translation.en: And the disciples went , and did as Jesus commanded them ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki synran ki la leit bad ki la leh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la bthah ïa ki :

translation.en: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways .
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynshuwa u la shah ïa ki briew baroh ban ïaid ha ka mon jong ki .

translation.en: And again , I will put my trust in him . And again , Behold I and the children which God hath given me .
translation.kha: U ong ruh ,  Ngan buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U Blei .  Bad u ong ruh ,  Hangne nga don bad ki khun ïa kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga .

translation.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings for the rain  ; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries .
translation.kha: U wanrah ïa ki lyoh  erïong na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; u pynlong leilieh ïa ki  erïong , bad u wanrah shabar ïa ka lyer na la ka jaka buh .

translation.en: For they covered the face of the whole earth , so that the land was darkened  ; and they did eat every herb of the land , and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left : and there remained not any green thing in the trees , or in the herbs of the field , through all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki la tap ïa ka khyndew baroh kat haduh ba ka ïong ngaiñ da ki puit suda . Ki la bam ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u phria u dang pynsah , kynthup ïa ki soh baroh ha ki dieng . Ym shym sah shuh kano kano kaba jyrngam ha u jingthung ne ha u dieng ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

translation.en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth–shean and her towns , and Ibleam and her towns , and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns , and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns , even three countries .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka ri Issakhar bad Asher , ki Manasseh ki ïohkynti ïa ka Beth Shan bad ka Ibleam , lem bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki , kumjuh ruh ïa ka Dor ( kata kaba harud duriaw ) , ka Endor , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell : and great was the fall of it .
translation.kha: U slap u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing , bad ka la khyllem . Bad katno ka jingkhyllem bashyrkhei ka la long !

translation.en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering , and his meat offering , ( they shall be unto you without blemish ) and their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa kine bad ïa ka jingainguh waiñ nalor ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingainguh bam kaba man ka sngi .

translation.en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked , he saith , Behold the Lamb of God !
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Ïoannis u dang ïeng biang hangta bad ar ngut na ki synran jong u , mynba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u dang ïaid nangta .  Ha khmih U Khunlangbrot U Blei !  u la ong .

translation.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up , and they shall be changed : but thou art the same , and thy years shall not fail .
translation.kha: Men khylliap noh ïa ki kum ka sopti-lor , bad yn bujli ïa ki kum ïa ki jaiñ , hynrei me long borabor ujuh , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym kut shuh .

translation.en: Seek the  Lord  , and his strength : seek his face evermore .
translation.kha: To leit sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap ; bad to mane ïa u borabor .

translation.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants , and did as the  Lord  had said unto him : and so it was , because he feared his father s household , and the men of the city , that he could not do it by day , that he did it by night .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u shim shiphew ngut na ki shakri jong u bad u leh kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa u . U la sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa ka longïing bad ïa ki briew ha ka nongrit ban leh ïa ka ha ka por mynsngi , kumta u leh ïa ka ha ka por mynmiet .

translation.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and saddled his ass , and went with the princes of Moab .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u teh jin ïa la ka kada , bad u leit bad kita ki nongïalam jong ki Moab .

translation.en: Let no man seek his own , but every man another s wealth .
translation.kha: Kam dei ïa uwei ruh na phi ban khmih ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi , hynrei ïa ki jingmyntoi jong kiwei de .

translation.en: And Judas the brother of James , and Judas Iscariot , which also was the traitor .
translation.kha: U Judas u khun jong u Jakob bad u Judas Iskariot uba la kylla long u nongshetkylla .

translation.en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force : but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon , and a flame from the midst of Sihon , and shall devour the corner of Moab , and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones .
translation.kha: Ki nongphetwir bymdonbor shuh ki pyrshang ban wad jingïada ha Heshbon , ka nongbah kaba u syiem Sihon shisien u la synshar , hynrei ka don ha ki thylliej ding . Ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki jaka kiba ha khmat bad ïa ki lumbah bajrong jong ki nong Moab kiba sngewtynnat ïa ka thma .

translation.en: Wherein I suffer trouble , as an evil doer , even unto bonds ; but the word of God is not bound .
translation.kha: Namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , nga shahshitom bad nga shah teh kynjri ruh kum u riewrunar .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath also a controversy with Judah , and will punish Jacob according to his ways  ; according to his doings will he recompense him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingmudui ban wanlam pyrshah ïa ki paid Judah ; un pynshitom ruh ïa ka Israel na ka bynta ka rukom leh ki briew jong ka . Un ainong ïa ki na ka bynta kaei ba ki la leh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Ask now the priests concerning the law , saying ,
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Kylli ïa ki lyngdoh ban ai ka rai halor kane ka jingkylli :

translation.en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths , and sat under the booths : for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so . And there was very great gladness .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jinglongmraw , ki la shna ïa ki jakarieh bad shong hapoh jong ki . Kane ka la long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba la leh naduh ki sngi u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad baroh ki la kmen haduh katta katta .

translation.en: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba khathynriew snem , bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering , that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains , Go in , and slay them  ; let none come forth . And they smote them with the edge of the sword  ; and the guard and the captains cast them out , and went to the city of the house of Baal .
translation.kha: Tang mar shu dep ai ïa ki jingkñia , u Jehu u ong ha kita ki nongap bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie rung bad pynïap ïa ki baroh , wat shah ïano ïano ban lait im !  Ki la leit rung shapoh bad ki waitlam , ki la pynïap ïa ki baroh , bad ki la paring shabar ïa ki met . Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka kyntang kaba shapoh jong ka templ ,

translation.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth , about six hundred thousand on foot that were men , beside children .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki mihnoh bad ki ïaid da ka kjat na Rameses haduh Sukkoth . Ki ïadon baroh kumba hynriew lakh ngut ki rangbah , nalor ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

translation.en: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests : and we shall reign on the earth .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki , ka hima ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei jong ngi , bad kin synshar ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God , and lettest such words go out of thy mouth ?
translation.kha: Me leh bitar ïa U Blei bad me kyntait ïa u .

translation.en: And she said unto him , Give me a blessing : for thou hast given me a south land  ; give me also springs of water . And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga kwah katto katne ki pukri um . Ka jaka ba phi la ai ïa nga ka don ha ka ri ryngkhiang .  Kumta u Kaleb u ai ha ka ïa ki umpohliew kiba haneng bad kiba harum .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto the people , It is the  Lord  that advanced Moses and Aaron , and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong shuh shuh ,  U dei U  Trai  keiñ uba la thung ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt .

translation.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children : he rewardeth him , and he shall know it .
translation.kha: Phi ong ba U Blei u pynshitom ïa u khun namar ki pop jong u kpa . Em ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ki nongpop hi ; ai ba un pyn-i ba u leh ïa ka , namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: And they were exceeding sorrowful , and began every one of them to say unto him , Lord , is it I ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la sngewdiaw shikatdei eh , bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien uwei pat ,  Da shisha , A Trai , mem mut ba dei ma nga ?

translation.en: For the Son of God , Jesus Christ , who was preached among you by us , even by me and Silvanus and Timothy , was not yea and nay , but in him was yea .
translation.kha: Naba U Jisu Khrist , u Khun U Blei , ïa uba la ïalap hapdeng jong phi da u Silas , u Timothi bad da nga hi , um long uta uba  Ho-oid  bad  Em .  Hynrei , u long ma u kaba  Ho-oid  jong U Blei ; naba dei ma u , uba long kaba  Ho-oid  ïa ki jingkular U Blei baroh .

translation.en: And there shall be no more curse : but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it  ; and his servants shall serve him :
translation.kha: Yn ym don kano kano kaba hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ïa kaba yn shem hapoh ka nongbah . Ka khet ka jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot kan don hapoh ka nongbah , bad ki shakri jong u kin mane ïa u .

translation.en: And for the wood offering , at times appointed , and for the firstfruits . Remember me , O my God , for good .
translation.kha: nga pynkhreh ïa ki diengthang na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang ban wallam ha ki por ba la buh , bad na ka bynta ki briew ban wallam ki jingainguh da u kew banyngkong bad ki soh kiba ih nyngkong . To kynmaw ïa kane baroh , A Blei , bad to kyrkhu ïa nga .

translation.en: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not , but saith unto him ,  Go home to thy friends , and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee , and hath had compassion on thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shah ïa u . Pynban , u la ong ïa u ,  Khie leit phai pat sha ïing sha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me bad ïathuh ïa ki haduh katno U Trai u la leh na ka bynta jong me bad kumno u la lehsbun ïa me .

translation.en: And Joshua made peace with them , and made a league with them , to let them live : and the princes of the congregation sware unto them .
translation.kha: U Joshua u pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki briew jong ka Gibeon bad u la shah ïa ki ba kin im . Ki nongïalam jong ka kynhun ki Israel ki ai ka jingkular skhem ba kin bat ïa kata ka jingïateh lok .

translation.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away  ; yea , they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Kynsan ki nong Sabia ki wan tur bad tuh ïa ki baroh . Ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei na ki shakri jong phi lait sa tang ïa nga . Tang ma nga uba la lait phet ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the  Lord  our God , and also with him that is not here with us this day :
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka bad ngi baroh kiba ïeng hangne ha khmat jong u mynta ka sngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi ki ban dang kha .

translation.en: To make their land desolate , and a perpetual hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished , and wag his head .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa kane ka ri ka bynta ka jingtriem , ban ñiewbeiñ junom . Baroh kiba la ïaid lyngba kin kyndit ha kaei kaba ki ïohi ; kin kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jinglyngngoh .

translation.en: Now therefore give me this mountain , whereof the  Lord  spake in that day  ; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there , and that the cities were great and fenced : if so be the  Lord  will be with me , then I shall be able to drive them out , as the  Lord  said .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ai ha nga ïa ka ri lum ba U  Trai  u la kular ïa nga ha kata ka sngi mynba ki briew jong nga lem bad nga , ngi la wanrah ïa kata ka khubor . Ngi la ïathuh ïa phi ha kato ka por ba ka jait ki ramhah kiba la khot ki Anakim ki la don hangta ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong da ki kut bakhraw . Lehse U  Trai  hi un don ryngkat bad nga , bad ngan beh krad ïa ki , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .

translation.en: And the king called the Gibeonites , and said unto them  ; ( now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel , but of the remnant of the Amorites  ; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them : and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah . )
translation.kha: ( Ki paid Gibeon kim dei ki Israel ; ki dei ka kynhun barit ki Amor ïa kaba ki Israel ki la kular ban ïada , hynrei u Saul u la pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ki namar ka jingshitrhem na ka bynta ki paid Israel bad Judah . )

translation.en: Wherein ye greatly rejoice , though now for a season , if need be , ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations :
translation.kha: To ïakmen shaphang kane , wat la ka lah ban long kaba donkam ïa phi mynta ban sngewsih shipor namar kiba bun jait ki jingtynjuh kiba phi shahshitom .

translation.en: And his servitor said , What , should I set this before an hundred men ? He said again , Give the people , that they may eat : for thus saith the  Lord  , They shall eat , and shall leave thereof .
translation.kha: hynrei u jubab ,  Hato phi pyrkhat kane kan biang na ka bynta ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ?  U Elisha u jubab ,  Ai ha ki ban bam , namar U  Trai  u ong ba kin bam bad yn don kaba sah tam .

translation.en: And the old man said , Peace be with thee  ; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me  ; only lodge not in the street .
translation.kha: U tymmen u ong ,  Nga pdiang sngewbha ha ïing jong nga ! Ngan pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi ; phim dei ban sahmiet hangne ha madan shnong .

translation.en: So Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard sent , and Nebushasban , Rab–saris , and Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , and all the king of Babylon s princes  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Nebusaradan , ryngkat bad ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan u Nebushasban bad u Nergal Sareser bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wallam sha nga na ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman : these are the families of Simeon .
translation.kha: U Simeon u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul u khun jong ka kynthei nong Kanaan ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki .

translation.en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes , and your officers , that I may speak these words in their ears , and call heaven and earth to record against them .
translation.kha: Lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh na ki jait jong phi bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi , ba ngan ïathuh ha ki ïa kine kiei kiei ; ngan khot ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ba kin long ki sakhi jong nga pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa na Tishbe ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Ahab jong ka Samaria .

translation.en: Go , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah , concerning the words of the book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is poured out upon us , because our fathers have not kept the word of the  Lord  , to do after all that is written in this book .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba dang sah ha Israel bad Judah . Wad bniah shaphang ki jinghikai na kane ka kitab . U  Trai  u bitar ïa ngi namar ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien U  Trai  bad kim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba kane ka kitab ka ong ban leh .

translation.en: For he saith to the snow , Be thou on the earth  ; likewise to the small rain , and to the great rain of his strength .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ka ïor ban hap halor ka khyndew , bad u phah ïa u slap uba theh kum u  lap praw .

translation.en: And thou saidst , I will surely do thee good , and make thy seed as the sand of the sea , which cannot be numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba me la kular ban pynbiang ba kiei kiei kin ïaid beit bad nga bad ban ai ha nga kham bun ki khun ki ksiew , kiba bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw .

translation.en: For this they willingly are ignorant of , that by the word of God the heavens were of old , and the earth standing out of the water and in the water :
translation.kha: Ki da thmu khnang ban leh klet ïa ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum la slem bah , bad ïa ki bneng bad ka khyndew la pynlong .

translation.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine , wholly a right seed : how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me ?
translation.kha: Nga la thung ïa me kum ïa u dieng sohwaiñ ba la jied na u symbai uba bha tam . Hynrei ha khmih me la kylla long uei ! Me la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba pyut bad u bymdondor ei ei .

translation.en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them , to suffice them ? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them , to suffice them ?
translation.kha: Hato don blang don masi katta katta ban pynïap kat haduh ban da pynbiang ïa ki ? Hato ki dohkha baroh ha ka duriaw kin dap na ka bynta jong ki ?

translation.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving , and declare his works with rejoicing .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa u da ki jingkñia , bad da ki jingrwai jong ka jingkmen ki dei ban ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And Solomon s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country , and all the wisdom of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Solomon u kham stad ban ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Mihngi lane ïa ki riewstad jong ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And I John saw these things , and heard them . And when I had heard and seen , I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things .
translation.kha: Ma nga , u Ïoannis , nga la ïohsngew bad la ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh . Bad haba nga la dep ïohsngew bad ïohi ïa ki , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u angel uba la pyn-i ha nga ïa kine kiei kiei , bad nga la jan mane ïa u .

translation.en: Delilah therefore took new ropes , and bound him therewith , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber . And he brake them from off his arms like a thread .
