translation.kha: Kumta ka Delilah ka shim ki tyllai kiba thymmai bad ka khum ïa u . Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Ki rangbah ki ap ha kawei pat ka kamra . Hynrei u bthat ïa kita ki tyllai na ki ksang ti jong u kum ïa u  saihon .

translation.en: And Adoni–bezek said , Threescore and ten kings , having their thumbs and their great toes cut off , gathered their meat under my table : as I have done , so God hath requited me . And they brought him to Jerusalem , and there he died .
translation.kha: U Adonibesek u ong ,  Hynñiewphew ngut ki syiem ba la shah ot ki  tikmie bad ki  jatkmie ki hap ban tam jingbam na khrum miej jong nga . U Blei u la leh mynta ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ki .  La ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem , ha kaba u la ïap .

translation.en: And say unto it , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O mount Seir , I am against thee , and I will stretch out mine hand against thee , and I will make thee most desolate .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kaei ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong :  Nga long u nongshun jong me , ko ki lumbah ka Edom ! Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jaka kynjah .

translation.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron  ; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver , which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth , four hundred shekels of silver , current money with the merchant .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la mynjur bad u la thew ïa kata ka dor kaba u Ephron u la ong ha ka jingïohsngew lang kita ki briew — sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa kat kum ka jingthew ba la pyndonkam da ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and went out against Israel into the wilderness : and he came to Jahaz , and fought against Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shah ïa ki Israel ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong u . U la lum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u bad u la leit sha Jahas ha ka ri khlaw bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time , and the feast of unleavened bread seven days .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi baroh ki paid Israel kiba don hangta ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat .

translation.en: The forest was covered with snow and the evenings were quiet as animals slept through the cold winter nights .
translation.kha: Ka khlaw la sop da u ior , bad ki janmiet ki kynjah katba ki mrad ki iohthiah ha ki miet tlang ba khriat .

translation.en: And there came a voice from heaven , saying , Thou art my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
translation.kha: Bad ka sur ka la wan na bneng ,  Me long U Khun ba-ieit jong nga hi . Nga sngewbha ïa me .

translation.en: But after I am risen again , I will go before you into Galilee .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba la pynmihpat ïa nga , ngan leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: Prepare ye war against her  ; arise , and let us go up at noon . Woe unto us ! for the day goeth away , for the shadows of the evening are stretched out .
translation.kha: Kin ïa-ong ,  Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem ! To khreh ! Ngin tur ïaleh ha ka por shiteng sngi !  Hynrei nangta kin ïa-ong ,  Ka la slem palat , ka sngi ka la jan kut artat , bad ki syrngiew janmiet ki la sdang jrong .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto her ,  Let the children first be filled : for it is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it unto the dogs .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ai ba ngin bsa nyngkong shuwa ïa ki khun . Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad ban bret ïa ka ha ki ksew .

translation.en: As for God , his way is perfect  ; the word of the  Lord  is tried : he is a buckler to all them that trust in him .
translation.kha: Une U Blei — ki kam jong u ki long kiba janai ; ki ktien jong u kiba lah ban shaniah ! U long kum ka stieh ïa baroh kiba wad jingïada jong u .

translation.en: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire . This is the second death .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa ka jingïap bad ïa ka Hades la bret ha ka pung ka ding . ( Kane ka pung ka ding ka long ka jingïap kaba ar . )

translation.en: While the word was in the king s mouth , there fell a voice from heaven , saying , O king Nebuchadnezzar , to thee it is spoken  ; The kingdom is departed from thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ki kyntien kin mih shabar na ka shyntur jong u , ka sur ka la kren na bneng ,  Ko syiem Nebukhadnessar , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ! Ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong me la shim noh mynta na me .

translation.en: After it a voice roareth : he thundereth with the voice of his excellency  ; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa ka jingkyrhuh ka sur jong u la ïohsngew ka jingriew sngewtynnat jong u pyrthat , bad ha ki por baroh ka leilieh ka thaba .

translation.en: And Dilean , and Mizpeh , and Joktheel ,
translation.kha: ka Dilean , ka Mispah , ka Joktheel ,

translation.en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon , which have been done in you , they had a great while ago repented , sitting in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha , ko Khorasin ! A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah ba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad ha Sidon , ki briew kiba hangta kin jin da la shong naduh mynshuwa , kin kup ka jaiñ khain bad synreit dpei halor lade , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !

translation.en: For circumcision verily profiteth , if thou keep the law : but if thou be a breaker of the law , thy circumcision is made uncircumcision .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , ka jingotsher jong phi ka don ka dor ; hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , kan jin da la bha ba phim shym la shah otsher .

translation.en: Behold , I will watch over them for evil , and not for good : and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine , until there be an end of them .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih ïa kane ba phin ym manbha , hynrei phin shah pynjot . Baroh na phi phin ïap , ha ka thma ne na ka jingpang , haduh ba yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban sah .

translation.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way  ; they found no city to dwell in .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki la sakma ha ka ri shyiap bym don lynti bad kim shym la shem ïa ka lynti jong ki sha ka nongbah ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: So Moses the servant of the  Lord  died there in the land of Moab , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ïap hangta ha ri Moab , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .

translation.en: And when Abigail saw David , she hasted , and lighted off the ass , and fell before David on her face , and bowed herself to the ground ,
translation.kha: Haba ka Abigail ka ïohi ïa u Dabid , ka la hiar kloi kloi bad ka dem khrup ha khyndew

translation.en: But Absalom fled . And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Absalom u la phet krad . Ha kata ka por u shipai ha ka por ap phira u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah babun kiba wan hiar na u lum , ha ka lynti na Horonaim . U la leit sha u syiem bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi .

translation.en: As coals are to burning coals , and wood to fire  ; so is a contentious man to kindle strife .
translation.kha: U rnga u pynrhem ïa ka ding , ka diengïap ka pynmeh ïa ka , u nongthaw jingkulmar u pynshit ïa ki jingïamai .

translation.en: As soon then as they were come to land , they saw a fire of coals there , and fish laid thereon , and bread .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïa jam sha ryngkew , ki la ïohi ïa u rnga ding hangta bad ïa ka dohkha ba la buh halor jong ka , bad katto katne u kpu .

translation.en: Ibhar also , and Elishua , and Nepheg , and Japhia ,
translation.kha: U Ibhar , u Elishua , u Nepheg , u Japhia ,

translation.en: We lie down in our shame , and our confusion covereth us : for we have sinned against the  Lord  our God , we and our fathers , from our youth even unto this day , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban shah ha ka jinglehrain bad ai ba ka jingjahburom kan tap ïa ngi . Ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ngi la ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; ngim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother , that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa kiba sah na ki kynhun jong u hapoh ka hukum jong u Abishai , u para jong u , uba la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Ammon .

translation.en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together  ; for the king s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement : but she shall not retain the power of the arm  ; neither shall he stand , nor his arm : but she shall be given up , and they that brought her , and he that begat her , and he that strengthened her in these times .
translation.kha: Hadien bun tylli ki snem u syiem ka Ijipt un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Syria bad un ai shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u . Hynrei ka jingïateh lok kan ym neh ; bad ïa ka , ïa u tnga jong ka , ïa i khun jong ka bad ïa ki shakri kiba la ïaleit bad ka yn pynïap baroh .

translation.en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards :
translation.kha: Thaw ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel .
translation.kha: U Moses u bteng ïa la ka jingkren ha ki paid Israel ,

translation.en: And when Joab was come out from David , he sent messengers after Abner , which brought him again from the well of Sirah : but David knew it not .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la mihnoh na u Dabid , u Joab u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit beh ïa u Abner , bad ki la wallam ïa u na ka Pukri Sirah ; hynrei u Dabid um tip ei ei shaphang kata .

translation.en: That hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , hath not defiled his neighbour s wife ,
translation.kha: Um shym mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki duwan ba la mana . Um shym khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ,

translation.en: Fear ye not me ? saith the  Lord  : will ye not tremble at my presence , which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree , that it cannot pass it : and though the waves thereof toss themselves , yet can they not prevail  ; though they roar , yet can they not pass over it ?
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  ; balei phim sheptieng ïa nga ? Balei phim khynñiuh ha khmat jong nga ? Nga la buh ïa u shyiap kum u pud jong ka duriaw , u pud uba neh ba kam lah ban jam palat . Ka duriaw ka lah ban kynting , hynrei kam lah ban leit palat ïa u ; ki jingat phyllung ki lah ban kyrhuh , hynrei kim lah ban ksam lyngba .

translation.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and they have caused him to ride upon the king s mule :
translation.kha: U la phah khot ïa u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ïa ki nongïada syiem ban synran ïa u .

translation.en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again , and called Jesus , and said unto him , Art thou the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la rung pat sha ka ïing bad u la khot ïa U Jisu .  Hato me long u syiem jong ki Jiw ?  u la kylli ïa u .

translation.en: Or ever the silver cord be loosed , or the golden bowl be broken , or the pitcher be broken at the fountain , or the wheel broken at the cistern .
translation.kha: U kynjri rupa un dkut , bad ka sharak ksiar kan hap bad kan pait ; u tyllai ha ka pukri um un dkut ; bad ïa u khra um yn pynpait .

translation.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud , and bring forth boughs like a plant .
translation.kha: da ka um un khie lung kum u jingthung ba dang lung .

translation.en: The  Lord  thundered from heaven , and the most High uttered his voice .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kyrhuh na suiñbneng , bad ïa ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh la ïohsngew .

translation.en: And he said , Go . And he sent her away for two months : and she went with her companions , and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ka ban leit bad u phah noh ar bnai ïa ka . Ma ka bad la ki paralok ki leit kiew sha ki lum bad ki ïam sngewsih namar ba kan sa ïap kum kaba khlem shongkurim bad khlem khun khlem kti .

translation.en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said , These are they whom the  Lord  hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa ki ban leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Therefore will I howl for Moab , and I will cry out for all Moab  ; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir–heres .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïam na ka bynta uwei pa uwei ha Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew jong ka Kir Heres .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye be come into the land which I give unto you , and shall reap the harvest thereof , then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest :
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel ,  Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi , bad haba phi ot ïa u kew , leit rah ïa ka song kaba nyngkong sha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people , that they had not done sacrifice unto them .
translation.kha: Wat da kine ki kyntien , ki apostol da kaba jwat ki la lah ban khang ïa u paidbah na kaba ai jingkñia ha ki .

translation.en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh u la wai shi lakh ngut ki shipai na Israel ha ka dor kaba lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa .

translation.en: What will ye do in the solemn day , and in the day of the feast of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Bad haba ka por kan poi na ka bynta ki Jingkhawai Niam ba la jied na ka bynta ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , kin ïaleh kumno hangta ?

translation.en: The princes of Zoan are become fools , the princes of Memphis are deceived  ; they have also seduced Egypt , even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Soan bad jong ka Memphis ki dei ki bieit . La khmih lynti ïa ki ban ïalam ïa ka ri , hynrei ki la ïalam bakla ïa ka .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh : and the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat u Pharaoh , hynrei U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u , bad um shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Yet a little while am I with you , and then I go unto him that sent me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ngan don bad phi tang shipor , bad nangta ngan sa leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Knowing this first , that there shall come in the last days scoffers , walking after their own lusts ,
translation.kha: Nyngkong eh , phi dei ban sngewthuh ba ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh yn don ki briew kaba ïa ka jingim jong ki la tyllep da ki jingkwah brai jong ki hi .

translation.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father , save he which is of God , he hath seen the Father .
translation.kha: Kane kam mut ba uno uno u la ïohi ïa U Kpa ; uta uba na U Blei u long tang ma u uba la ïohi ïa U Kpa .

translation.en: And I said , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest .
translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . Bad U Trai u la jubab , ‘ Nga long U Jisu , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ .

translation.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven , from thence will the  Lord  thy God gather thee , and from thence will he fetch thee :
translation.kha: Wat la phi la sakma kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei ruh , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un lumlang bad wan ïalam pat ïa phi ,

translation.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear : for whosoever hath , to him shall be given  ; and whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have .
translation.kha: Da phikir , te , kumno phi pynshahshkor ; namar ha uno uno uba don yn ai kham bun shuh , hynrei ha uno uno u bym don , un shah shim noh na u wat ïa kata kaba rit tam kaba u pyrkhat ba u don .

translation.en: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah , and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka Judah , u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba sngewbha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .

translation.en: When I looked for good , then evil came unto me : and when I waited for light , there came darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la kyrmen ban ïoh jingkmen bad jingshai , hynrei ka jingeh bad ka jingdum pynban ki wan .

translation.en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head , and thrust his sword in his fellow s side  ; so they fell down together : wherefore that place was called Helkath–hazzurim , which is in Gibeon .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew u kynrup na ka khlieh ïa uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad u pynngam ïa la ka waitlam ha ka krung jong u nongïaleh pyrshah , ba kumta baroh arphew saw ngut ki la kyllon ïap lang . Bad kumta , ïa kata ka jaka ha Gibeon la khot  Ka Lyngkha jong ki Waitlam .

translation.en: When the wicked rise , men hide themselves : but when they perish , the righteous increase .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin buhrieh ïa lade haba ki briew kiba sniew ki wan ha ka bor . Hynrei ynda ki hap na ka bor , kiba hok kin synshar biang .

translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons , and washed them with water .
translation.kha: U Moses u wallam ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sha khmat bad u bthah ïa ki ban sum da ka um .

translation.en: And we utterly destroyed them , as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon , utterly destroying the men , women , and children , of every city .
translation.kha: Ngi la pynjot ïa ki shnong baroh bad ngi la pynïap lut ruh ïa ki shynrang , ki kynthei , bad ki khynnah , kumba ngi la leh ha ki shnong jong u Sihon u Syiem Heshbon .

translation.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , unto the border of the children of Ammon  ;
translation.kha: Ka kner shaduh ka khappud jong ka Ammon bad kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh kiba la synshar da u Sihon u syiem ka Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon .

translation.en: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the  Lord  unto battle , to the plains of Jericho .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  kumba sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba la khreh ïa ka thma ki la jam sha shiliang sha ka pyntha kaba hajan ka Jerikho .

translation.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before ?
translation.kha: Shu tharai , te , ba phi dei ban ïohi ïa U Khun U briew ba u leit kiew pat sha ka jaka ha kaba u la don mynshuwa .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Elijah , Go down with him : be not afraid of him . And he arose , and went down with him unto the king .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah ,  Khie leit hiar lem bad u , bad wat sheptieng .  Kumta u Elijah u la leit bad u rangbah pynïaidkam sha u syiem ,

translation.en: As he came forth of his mother s womb , naked shall he return to go as he came , and shall take nothing of his labour , which he may carry away in his hand .
translation.kha: Ngi ieh ïa kane ka pyrthei kumba ngi la wan rung sha ka — da kaba thylli . Nalor ka kam jong ngi baroh ym don kano kano kaba ngi lah ban rah bad ngi .

translation.en: Then the elders of the congregation said , How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïalam jong ka jingïalumlang ki ong ,  Ym don kynthei shuh hapdeng ka jait Benjamin . Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga na ka bynta ki rangbah ba dang sah ?

translation.en: And the king was much moved , and went up to the chamber over the gate , and wept : and as he went , thus he said , O my son Absalom , my son , my son Absalom ! would God I had died for thee , O Absalom , my son , my son !
translation.kha: Te u syiem u la shah tyllep da ka sngewsih . U leit kiew sha ka kamra kaba halor kata ka khyrdop , bad u la ïam . Katba u dang leit , u la kyang ,  A , ko khun jong nga ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! Ko Absalom , u khun jong nga ! Lada ngan da la ïap ha ka jaka jong phi , ko khun jong nga ! Ko Absalom , ko khun jong nga !

translation.en: And he put them all out , and took her by the hand , and called , saying ,  Maid , arise .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la khot ,  Khie joit , ko khun jong nga !

translation.en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun , saying , Every man to his city , and every man to his own country .
translation.kha: Haba la jan sep sngi , la wan ka hukum ha ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ,  Uwei pa uwei u briew un leit phai noh sha ka la ri bad ka nongbah !

translation.en: And the tale of the bricks , which they did make heretofore , ye shall lay upon them  ; ye shall not diminish ought thereof : for they be idle  ; therefore they cry , saying , Let us go and sacrifice to our God .
translation.kha: Hynrei khmih ba kin shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba mynshuwa ; tang uwei ruh ym dei ban duna . Kim da bunkam eh , bad dei namar kata ba ki ïai kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ai ki jingkñia sha U Blei jong ki !

translation.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs , being seen of them forty days , and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God :
translation.kha: Ha ki sawphew sngi hadien ka jingïap jong u , u la mihpaw bunsien ha ki ha ki rukom kiba la pynshisha khlem jingartatien ba u im . Ki la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïakren bad ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you , I am not ashamed ; but as we spake all things to you in truth , even so our boasting , which I made before Titus , is found a truth .
translation.kha: Nga la kob sarong shaphang jong phi ha u , bad phim shym pynduh jingkyrmen ïa nga . Ngi la kren borabor ïa ka jingshisha ha phi , bad ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingkob sarong kaba ngi la ong ha u Titos la ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One , and ye know all things .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi la lah don ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la theh ha phi da U Khrist , bad kumta phi baroh phi tip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: So likewise ye , when ye shall see all these things , know that it is near , even at the doors .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , phin tip ba ka por ka la jan ban sdang artat .

translation.en: And the children of Israel set forward , and pitched in Oboth .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la mihnoh bad ki la sher dara ha Oboth .

translation.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Abimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Shavsha was scribe  ;
translation.kha: u Sadok u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;

translation.en: Come , and let us return unto the  Lord  : for he hath torn , and he will heal us  ; he hath smitten , and he will bind us up .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ong ,  Ale ngin ïaleit phai sha U  Trai  ! U la pynmynsaw ïa ngi , hynrei da shisha un pynkhiah ïa ngi ; kumta un pynkhiah ïa ngi ; u la pynmong ïa ngi , hynrei un sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ngi , hato un ym leh kumta ?

translation.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes  ; but the  Lord  weigheth the spirits .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pyrkhat ba baroh kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei dei U  Trai  uba bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .

translation.en: As for my people , children are their oppressors , and women rule over them . O my people , they which lead thee cause thee to err , and destroy the way of thy paths .
translation.kha: Ki nongai pisa kylliang ki banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki nongai ram jong ki , ki thok ïa ki . Ko paidlang jong nga , ki nongïalam jong phi ki ïalam bakla ïa phi , khnang ba phin ym tip kano ka lynti ban phai pat .

translation.en: For if they do these things in a green tree , what shall be done in the dry ?
translation.kha: Naba lada ïa kiba kum kine kiei kiei la leh haba u dieng u dang jyrngam , kaei ka ban jia haba u la tyrkhong ?

translation.en: And I charged Baruch before them , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong ki baroh nga la ong ha u Barukh ,

translation.en: See now that I , even I , am he , and there is no god with me : I kill , and I make alive  ; I wound , and I heal : neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga , bad tang ma nga hi , nga long U Blei ; ym don uwei pat u blei uba shisha . Nga pynïap bad nga ai jingim , nga pynmong bad nga pynkoit , bad ym don uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kaei ba nga leh .

translation.en: I Paul have written it with mine own hand , I will repay it : albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides .
translation.kha: Hangne , ngan thoh ïa kane da ka kti jong nga hi :  Ma nga , u Paul , ngan siew pat ïa me  ( Ha ka jingshisha , ngam dei ban pynkynmaw ïa me , ba me shahram ïa lade hi ha nga . )

translation.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ngeit bad la kyrkhu ïa u ; kumta ruh ïa baroh kiba ngeit la kyrkhu kumba la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: Concerning the divisions of the porters : Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore , of the sons of Asaph .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingai kam ïa ki Lebi kiba shakri kum ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ . Na ka kur jong u Korah la don u Meshelemaïah u khun jong u Kore , na ka longïing jong u Asaph .

translation.en: When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart : and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang jong u Ïoannis , u la mih nangta da ka lieng bad u la leit sha ka jaka bakynjah marwei hi . Ki briew ki la tip shaphang kata , kumta ki la iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki la ïabud ïa u na ryngkew .

translation.en: And be it indeed that I have erred , mine error remaineth with myself .
translation.kha: Wat la nga la leh bymdei , kumno kata ka pynmong ïa phi ?

translation.en: Hearken  ; Behold , there went out a sower to sow :
translation.kha: Ha sngap ! Shisien la don u briew uba la mih ban bet kew .

translation.en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and lament over thee , saying , What city is like Tyre , like the destroyed in the midst of the sea ?
translation.kha: Ki phawar ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha : ‘ Badno yn ïanujor ïa ka Tyros , ka Tyros kaba la jah jar mynta shapoh duriaw ?

translation.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish , disobedient , deceived , serving divers lusts and pleasures , living in malice and envy , hateful , and hating one another .
translation.kha: Naba ngi ruh ngi la long shisien kiba bieit , ki bymkohnguh bad kiba leh bakla . Ngi la long ki mraw ha ki jingkwah brai bad ki jingsngewbha babun jait . Ngi la pynlut ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingsniew bad jingpihuiñ ; kiwei ki la isih ïa ngi bad ngi la isih ïa ki .

translation.en: And he put upon him the coat , and girded him with the girdle , and clothed him with the robe , and put the ephod upon him , and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod , and bound it unto him therewith .
translation.kha: U pynphong ïa ka sopti bad pynkup ïa ka barandi ha u Aaron , bad u pynteh ïa u panpoh ha ka syngkai jong u . U pynphong ïa ka ephod ha u , bad u pynskhem ïa ka da kaba teh ïa ki jingteh ba la thain itynnat ha ka syngkai jong u .

translation.en: As for me , I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee : neither have I desired the woeful day  ; thou knowest : that which came out of my lips was right before thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , ngam ju kyrpad ïa me ban wallam ka jingpynjot halor jong ki ; ngam shym la kwah ïa ka por jingjynjar na ka bynta jong ki . A  Trai  , me tip ïa kane ; me tip ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: God shall enlarge Japheth , and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem  ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
translation.kha: To U Blei un pynkhraw ïa u Japheth , Ai ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin shong kin sah bad ki briew jong u Shem ! U Kanaan un long u mraw jong u Japheth .

translation.en: Take thee again another roll , and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll , which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ban shim da kawei pat ka kot kli bad ban thoh ha ka ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha kata kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: Therefore my people shall know my name : therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak : behold , it is I .
translation.kha: Ha ki por ki ban wan phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei bad ba nga la kren ha phi .

translation.en: The words of a wise man s mouth are gracious  ; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba stad u kren ka wanrah ha u ïa ka burom , hynrei ïa u bieit la pynjot da ki ktien jong u hi .

translation.en: And to them which were in Hebron , and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka sha ki jaka baroh ha kiba ma u bad ki briew jong ki la ju ïaid .

translation.en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah . Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  did choose out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u khun jong u Solomon u la don sawphew wei snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la jied na ka ri Israel baroh kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah ka nong Ammon .

translation.en: And the sixth , Ithream , by Eglah David s wife . These were born to David in Hebron .
translation.kha: u Ithream , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Eglah . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang baroh la kha ha Hebron .

translation.en: And they went out , they and all their hosts with them , much people , even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude , with horses and chariots very many .
translation.kha: Kita ki la ïawan lem bad ki shipai jong ki baroh — ka kynhun shipai kaba bun briew kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki don ruh shibun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom .

translation.en: And Samson said unto her , If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried , then shall I be weak , and be as another man .
translation.kha: U Samson u jubab ,  Lada ki khum ïa nga da ki hynñiew tylli ki  saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , ngan duh bor , bad ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .

translation.en: And the watchman saw another man running : and the watchman called unto the porter , and said , Behold another man running alone . And the king said , He also bringeth tidings .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u nongap phira u ïohi sa uwei pat u briew uba mareh marwei , bad u pyrta sha tbian sha u nongap khyrdop ,  Ha peit ! Don sa uwei u briew uba mareh !  U syiem u jubab ,  Uta ruh u wanrah khubor babha .

translation.en: And I said after she had done all these things , Turn thou unto me . But she returned not . And her treacherous sister Judah saw it .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba hadien ba ka la leh ïa kane baroh , da kaba thikna kan sa wan phai pat sha nga . Hynrei kam shym wan phai , bad ka Judah ka para bymïaineh jong ka , ka la ïohi ïa kata baroh .

translation.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat , an Ephrathite of Zeredah , Solomon s servant , whose mother s name was Zeruah , a widow woman , even he lifted up his hand against the king .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Solomon u dei uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u , u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba na Seredah kaba ha Ephraim . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka riewkynthei kaba kyrteng ka Seruah .

translation.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance , both for him that is born among the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ka long ïa baroh kiba leh pop khlem da mut khnang , la ki dei ki traishnong Israel ne ki nongwei bashong basah bad ki .

translation.en: But I will come to you shortly , if the Lord will , and will know , not the speech of them which are puffed up , but the power .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada U Trai u mon , ngan sa wan shen sha phi , bad nangta ngan sa shem da lade hi ïa ka bor kaba kine ki briew kiba sarong ki don , bad ym tang ïa kaei kaba ki ong .

translation.en: They on the rock are they , which , when they hear , receive the word with joy  ; and these have no root , which for a while believe , and in time of temptation fall away .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba hap halor ka jaka maw ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor bad kiba pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen . Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki ; ki ngeit tang shipor hynrei haba ka por jingtynjuh ka wan poi , ki hap noh .

translation.en: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be earthquakes in divers places , and there shall be famines and troubles : these are the beginnings of sorrows .
translation.kha: Ki ri kin ïaleh para ma ki ; ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat . Ki jumai kin khynñiuh ha kylleng , bad kin don ki  nemsniew . Kine kiei kiei ki long kum ki jingpang suh kha banyngkong .

translation.en: And not only this ; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one , even by our father Isaac ;
translation.kha: Bad kam dei tang katne . Naba ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang ka Rebekka ki la don ujuh u kpa , u Isaak , u kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord  , in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe , in the higher court , at the entry of the new gate of the  Lord s  house , in the ears of all the people .
translation.kha: Nangta , katba baroh ki briew ki dang ïasngap , u Barukh u la pule na ka kot kli ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah ong . U la leh ïa kane ha ka Templ , na ka kamra jong u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar . Ka kamra jong u ka don ha ka phyllaw kaba haneng hajan ka jaka ban rung sha ka Khyrdop Bathymmai jong ka Templ .

translation.en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock , there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns : but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen , and for the treading of lesser cattle .
translation.kha: Baroh ki lumrit ha kaba shisien la thung ïa ki mar rep kin jyllei shikatdei da ki shiah ba yn ym don mano mano ba leit hangta . Kan long ka jaka ha kaba ki masi bad ki langbrot ki bam phlang .

translation.en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision , that the law of Moses should not be broken  ; are ye angry at me , because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Lada ïa u khynnah la otsher ha ka sngi Sabbaton ba yn ym pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum u Moses , balei phi bitar ïa nga namar ba nga pynkhiah ïa u briew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him , Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin : and let her stand before the king , and let her cherish him , and let her lie in thy bosom , that my lord the king may get heat .
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah synshar jong u ki ong ha u ,  Syiem Kynrad , shah ngin wad ka samla kynthei ban sah bad phi bad ban sumar ïa phi . Kan thiah ha syndah jong phi ba kan pynsyaid ïa phi .

translation.en: In that day , he which shall be upon the housetop , and his stuff in the house , let him not come down to take it away : and he that is in the field , let him likewise not return back .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi u briew uba don halor ka tnum jong ka ïing jong u , um dei ban leit hiar shapoh ka ïing ban shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u ; ha kajuh ka rukom u briew uba don shabar ha ka lyngkha um dei ban leit phai pat sha ïing .

translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayers : these shall receive greater damnation .
translation.kha: Ki shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad knieh noh na ki , ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta pat ki duwai jlan ha khmat ki briew . Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba khraw !

translation.en: Behold , God is great , and we know him not , neither can the number of his years be searched out .
translation.kha: Ngim lah ban tip lut ïa ka jingkhraw jong u lane ñiew ïa jingbun ki snem jong u .

translation.en: And Chephar–ammoni , and Ophni , and Geba  ; twelve cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Shepharammoni , ka Ophni , bad ka Geba : khat-ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath appeared of old unto me , saying , Yea , I have loved thee with an everlasting love : therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , nga la ieit ïa phi borabor , kumta nga ïai pyn-i ïa phi ïa ka jingieit baneh jong nga .

translation.en: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship , more than those things which were spoken by Paul .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u rangbah shipai u la kham kohnguh ïa kaei kaba u kapten bad ïa u trai lieng , bad ym ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .

translation.en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance .
translation.kha: Ha ka por jong u , ka rupa ha Jerusalem ka kynrei kum u maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jyllei kum u dieng Sykomore    ha trai ki lum Judah .

translation.en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin , which pertained to Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and twelve of the servants of David .
translation.kha: Kumta khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , ki mihkhmat ïa u Ishbosheth , bad ïa ka jait Benjamin , ki ïakhun ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah jong u Dabid .

translation.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass , and in iron , and in purple , and crimson , and blue , and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem , whom David my father did provide .
translation.kha: Mynta to phah sha nga u briew uba tbit ban ohdur , ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , bad ka nar , bad ha kaba thain ïa ka jaiñ kaba jngum , kaba sawbthuh , bad kaba rong saw . Un trei bad ki nongshna jingshna jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem kiba u Dabid u kpa jong nga u la jied .

translation.en: And he said unto her , Up , and let us be going . But none answered . Then the man took her up upon an ass , and the man rose up , and gat him unto his place .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Khie joit . Ngin ïaleit noh .  Hynrei kam shym phai ktien satia . Kumta u kyntiew ïa ka met jong ka halor ka kada bad u sdang ïa ka jingleit sha la shnong .

translation.en: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up , and encamped against Jabesh–gilead : and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash , Make a covenant with us , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: Kumba shi bnai hadien kata , u Nahash u syiem Ammon u ïalam ïa la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka shnong Jabesh kaba ha ri Gilead bad u kerkut ïa ka . Ki rangbah jong ka Jabesh ki ong ha u Nahash ,  Ïateh jutang bad ngi , bad ngin pdiang ïa phi kum u nongsynshar jong ngi .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate , and an howling from the second , and a great crashing from the hills .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha ka Khyrdop Dohkha ha Jerusalem . Phin ïohsngew ka jingud ha ka bynta bathymmai jong ka nongbah bad ka jingsawa bajam jong ka jingkhyllem ha ki lumrit .

translation.en: Thou shalt not take thee a wife , neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place .
translation.kha: Wat shongkurim lane don khun ha ka jaka kaba kum kane .

translation.en: How weak is thine heart , saith the Lord  God  , seeing thou doest all these things , the work of an imperious whorish woman  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Pha la leh ïa kane baroh kum ka nuti ka bym don jinglehrain .

translation.en: It was Mary Magdalene , and Joanna , and Mary the mother of James , and other women that were with them , which told these things unto the apostles .
translation.kha: Kita ki kynthei ki la long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Ïoanna , bad ka Mari ka kmie jong u Jakob ; ma ki lem bad kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba bad ki , ki la ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki apostol .

translation.en: So then faith cometh by hearing , and hearing by the word of God .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingngeit ka wan lyngba kaba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ka khubor ka wan lyngba kaba ïalap ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: And ye shall go out at the breaches , every cow at that which is before her  ; and ye shall cast them into the palace , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Phin sa shah ring sha ka jaka bapei ha ka kynroh ba hajan tam , bad yn sa bret ïa phi shabar .

translation.en: Or , Who shall descend into the deep ? ( that is , to bring up Christ again from the dead . )
translation.kha: Lymne ba phin kylli , Uei u ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei shapoh ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap ) .

translation.en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , The Son can do nothing of himself , but what he seeth the Father do : for what things soever he doeth , these also doeth the Son likewise .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Khun um lah ban leh ei ei na lade ; u leh tang ïa kaei kaba u ïohi ba U Kpa jong u , u leh . Ïa kaei kaba U Kpa u leh , U Khun ruh u leh .

translation.en: And Eltolad , and Bethul , and Hormah ,
translation.kha: ka Eltolad , ka Bethul , ka Hormah ,

translation.en: A feast is made for laughter , and wine maketh merry : but money answereth all things .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam khawai ka pynkmen ïa phi bad ka waiñ ka pyndap jingkmen ïa phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh ïa kano kano na kine khlem ka pisa .

translation.en: They that make them are like unto them  ; so is every one that trusteth in them .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito baroh kiba thaw ïa ki bad kiba shaniah ha ki kin long kum ki bleithaw kiba ki la thaw .

translation.en: Many people think that Jehovah’s Witnesses is the name of a new religion .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki tharai ba ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ka dei ka kyrteng jong ka niam bathymmai .

translation.en: ( Psalm 1 :1-3 ) Stick close to the congregation .
translation.kha: ( Salm 1 :1-3 ) Ia snohlang bad ka balang .

translation.en: ( Matthew 24 :14 ) What a joy it would be if you were able to help someone else to become a servant of Jehovah and gain eternal life !—1 Thessalonians 2 :19 , 20 .
translation.kha: ( Mathaios 24 :14 ) Katno phin kmen lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei ban long ki shakri jong U Jehobah bad ban ioh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Thessaloni 2 :19 , 20 .

translation.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop , and dip it in the water , and sprinkle it upon the tent , and upon all the vessels , and upon the persons that were there , and upon him that touched a bone , or one slain , or one dead , or a grave :
translation.kha: Ha ka bynta kaba nyngkong u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un shim ïa u tnat Hissop , un wieh ïa u ha kata ka um , bad un synreit ha kata ka ïingjaiñ , ha ki jingbuh jingsat baroh , bad ha ki briew kiba don hangta . Ha ka bynta kaba ar , uta uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa kata ka um ha kita kiba la ktah ïa ka shyieng briew , lane ïa ka metïap , lane ïa ka jingtep .

translation.en: And Abimelech said , What is this thou hast done unto us ? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife , and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us .
translation.kha: Kaei keiñ kane kaba me la leh ha ngi ?  u Abimelekh u ong .  Uwei na ki briew jong nga un jin da la kum ïathiah bad ka tnga jong me , bad men jin da la kit pop namar ki jingleh jong ngi .

translation.en: And he said , Throw her down . So they threw her down : and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall , and on the horses : and he trode her under foot .
translation.kha: bad u Jehu u la ong ïa ki ,  Bret ïa ka shapoh !  Ki la bret ïa ka shapoh bad ka snam jong ka , ka pashait ha ka kynroh bad ha ki kulai . U Jehu u ñiah ïa ki kulai ïa ka kali ïapom halor ka met jong ka ,

translation.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son , whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh s house : and Genubath was in Pharaoh s household among the sons of Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ka kha ha u ïa u khun , u Genubath , ïa uba la pynsan pynrangbah da ka syiem ha ïingsyiem , ha kaba u shong u sah lem bad ki khun shynrang u syiem .

translation.en: And Samuel said , What hast thou done ? And Saul said , Because I saw that the people were scattered from me , and that thou camest not within the days appointed , and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash  ;
translation.kha: hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Phi la leh aïu kumne ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad phim pat shym wan poi haba phi la ong ba phin wan ; nalor kata , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ha Mikhmash ,

translation.en: He died on a pole , or a stake .
translation.kha: U la ïap halor u dieng .

translation.en: Then the devil leaveth him , and , behold , angels came and ministered unto him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la iehnoh ïa U Jisu ; bad ki angel ki la ïawan bad ki la ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: And I charged your judges at that time , saying , Hear the causes between your brethren , and judge righteously between every man and his brother , and the stranger that is with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba thung , nga la hikai ïa ki , ‘ Sngap bha ïa ki kam ïakajia kiba mih hapdeng ki briew jong phi . Bishar hok ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam , la ka long tang hapdeng ki briew jong phi , ne ka ïadei ruh bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: Very good , thank you .
translation.kha: Bha bha , khublei .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat feared , and set himself to seek the  Lord  , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la sheptieng bad duwai ha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïalam . Hadien kata u ai hukum ban pynlong ka jingshah jingit ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots , saying , Fight neither with small nor great , save only with the king of Israel .
translation.kha: U syiem Syria u la lah hukum ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki rangbah kali ïapom jong u ban ym tur ïaleh ïano ïano lait tang ïa u syiem Israel .

translation.en: If any man s work shall be burned , he shall suffer loss : but he himself shall be saved ; yet so as by fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ïa ka jingtrei jong uno uno la thang duh noh , uta un duh ïa ka , hynrei ma u hi un ïohlait im , kumba u la lait im lyngba ka ding .

translation.en: Declare his glory among the heathen , his wonders among all people .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u sha ki hima , ïa ki kam radbah jong u sha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons , and said unto them , Be fruitful , and multiply , and replenish the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Noah bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad u ong ha ki ,  To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And they said , We will call the damsel , and enquire at her mouth .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  To ngin khot ïa ka bad tip aïu ka don ban ong .

translation.en: How is the city of praise not left , the city of my joy !
translation.kha: Ka nongbah bapawnam kaba ju dap tang da ka jingsngewbha kan shah iehnoh ïingjah .

translation.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me  ; so that my feet did not slip .
translation.kha: Me la da ïa nga na kaba shah kem , bad ngam pat ju kyllon .

translation.en: Then it shall be , that , when ye eat of the bread of the land , ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam kaba mih hangta , khyndiat na ka dei ban buh sharud kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .

translation.en: And they shall be coupled together beneath , and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring : thus shall it be for them both  ; they shall be for the two corners .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha ki dong dei ban pynïasoh lang naduh trai , baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . Dei ban thaw ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong baroh ar tylli ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: Then the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Jephthah , and he passed over Gilead , and Manasseh , and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead , and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Te U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u wan ha u Jephthah . U ïaid lyngba ïa ka Gilead bad ka Manasseh bad u wan phai sha Mispah ha Gilead , bad nangta u leit sha Ammon .

translation.en: Behold , he withholdeth the waters , and they dry up : also he sendeth them out , and they overturn the earth .
translation.kha: Ka jingrang ryngkhiang ka wan haba U Blei u pynsangeh ïa u slap ; ki jingshlei um ki wan haba u pyllait war ïa ka um .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord  , for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut !

translation.en: But let every man prove his own work , and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone , and not in another .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban bishar ïa la ka jong ka jingleh . Lada ka long kaba bha , te u lah ban sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba ma u da lade u la leh , khlem da ïanujor ïa ka bad kaei kaba kiwei ki la leh .

translation.en: And they shall answer , Because they forsook the  Lord  their God , who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt , and have taken hold upon other gods , and have worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath the  Lord  brought upon them all this evil .
translation.kha: Te ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , bad ki la snoh ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa ki . Namarkata , U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’

translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye nations , and declare it in the isles afar off , and say , He that scattered Israel will gather him , and keep him , as a shepherd doth his flock .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki jaitbynriew , to shahshkor ïa nga , bad to pynbna ïa ki ktien jong nga shaduh ki rud duriaw kiba jngai . Nga la pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga , hynrei ngan lumlang ïa ki bad ïada ïa ki kumba u nongaplangbrot u ïada ïa la ka kynhun langbrot .

translation.en: He is not here , but is risen : remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee ,
translation.kha: Um don hangne ; la pynmihpat ïa u . Kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u la ong ha phi mynba u dang don ha Galilaïa :

translation.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish , and of an honeycomb .
translation.kha: Ki la ai ha u shi lyngkhot ka dohkha ba la shet ,

translation.en: By pureness , by knowledge , by longsuffering , by kindness , by the Holy Ghost , by love unfeigned ,
translation.kha: Da ka jinglong sngur jong ngi , ka jingtip , jingïaishah , bad jingsbun ngi la pyn-i ïa lade ba ngi long ki shakri U Blei — da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , da ka jingieit bashisha jong ngi , da ka khubor jong ka jingshisha jong ngi , bad da ka bor U Blei .

translation.en: In thy filthiness is lewdness : because I have purged thee , and thou wast not purged , thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more , till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ki jingleh awria jong pha ki la pyntngit ïa pha . Wat la nga la pyrshang ban pynkhuid ïa pha , pha ïaisah ha ka jingtngit . Phan ym long khuid pat haduh ba phan da mad lut ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga .

translation.en: And when he went forth to land , there met him out of the city a certain man , which had devils long time , and ware no clothes , neither abode in any house , but in the tombs .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hiar harud duriaw , la wan ïashem ïa u da u briew na ka shnong uba shongksuid . La slem bah une u briew u la leit khlem phong jaiñ bad um mon ban shong ha ïing , hynrei u la pynlut ïa la ka por ha ki krem jingtep .

translation.en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba la pynpaw ïa ka jingsbun bad ka jingieit U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi , u la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: Now , brethren , if I come unto you speaking with tongues , what shall I profit you , except I shall speak to you either by revelation , or by knowledge , or by prophesying , or by doctrine ?
translation.kha: Kumta haba nga wan ha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ka myntoi aïu ïa phi lada nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher ? Tang khyndiat ruh em , lymda nga wanrah katto katne ka jingpynpaw na U Blei ne katto katne ka jingtip ne katto katne ka khubor kaba pyrsad mynsiem , ne katto katne ka jinghikai .

translation.en: And when Felix heard these things , having more perfect knowledge of that way , he deferred them , and said , When Lysias the chief captain shall come down , I will know the uttermost of your matter .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pheliks , uba la ïoh jingtip bha shaphang ka Lynti , u la pynsangeh shuwa ïa ka jingbishar .  Haba u Lusias , u rangbah ai hukum u poi ,  u la ong ha ki ,  ngan sa rai ïa ka kam jong phi .

translation.en: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga leh ha ka rukom ba kham pher ïa kiba lait im jong kane ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And the officers shall speak unto the people , saying , What man is there that hath built a new house , and hath not dedicated it ? let him go and return to his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man dedicate it .
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah synshar kin kren ha uta u paidïapom , bad kin ong , ‘ Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep shna ïing thymmai , hynrei u bym pat pynkyntang ïa ka ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat u pynkyntang ïa ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: For kings , and for all that are in authority ; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty .
translation.kha: Na bynta ki Syiem , na bynta baroh ki ba don ha bor shynshar , ba ngi lah ban im ka jingim kaba jar jar bad kaba suk ha ka jingtiengburom baroh sha U Blei bad da ka jinglong jingim kaba dei .

translation.en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wanlam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: So he called every one of his lord s debtors unto him , and said unto the first , How much owest thou unto my lord ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la khot shapoh ïa ki briew baroh kiba shahram ha u kynrad jong u . U la ong ïa uba nyngkong , ‘ Sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ïa u kynrad jong nga ?’

translation.en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes , and made him look up : and he was restored , and saw every man clearly .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la buh biang ïa la ki kti ha ki khmat jong uta u briew . Ha kane ka por uta u briew u la peit shaiñ , ka jingïohi jong u ka la wan phai pat , bad u la ïohi shai ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Behold , is it not of the  Lord  of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire , and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity ?
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba phi la jop ki la pynshohthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei bymmyntoi , bad baroh kaba ki la tei la bam duh ha ka ding . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la leh ïa kane .

translation.en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem , according to thine estimation , for the money of five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , which is twenty gerahs .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khunlung dei ban thied pat ynda ki la dap shi bnai ha ka jingbuhdor bym kylla kaba long san tylli ki sbai rupa , kat kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom .

translation.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: bad kin bret ïa ki shapoh ka lawar ding baklang , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .

translation.en: And Gaal spake again and said , See there come people down by the middle of the land , and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim .
translation.kha: U Gaal u ong biang ,  Ha khmih ! La don ki briew ki wan hiar napdeng u lum , bad kawei ka kynhun ka wan na ka lynti na u dieng Sning jong ki nongkhan !

translation.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I do not this for your sakes , O house of Israel , but for mine holy name s sake , which ye have profaned among the heathen , whither ye went .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to ai ha ki Israel ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga don na ka bynta jong ki : Kaei kaba ngan leh kam long na ka bynta jong phi ki Israel , hynrei na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , ïa kaba phi la pynjahburom ha kawei pa kawei ka ri kat sha kaba phi leit .

translation.en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold , which fill their masters  houses with violence and deceit .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba mane kum ki nongmane bleithaw bad kiba tuh bad pynïap khnang ban pyndap ïa ka ïing u kynrad jong ki da ka jinglute .

translation.en: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression , and it cast down the truth to the ground  ; and it practised , and prospered .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la leh pop hangta ha ka jaka ban ai ki jingkñia kiba dei man la ka sngi , bad ïa ka niam bashisha la bret sha khyndew . Ka reng ka la jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ka la leh .

translation.en: Where did you sleep ?
translation.kha: Haei phi thiah ?

translation.en: And Beth–nimrah , and Beth–haran , fenced cities : and folds for sheep .
translation.kha: Beth Nimrah , bad Beth Haran .

translation.en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in man .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha u briew .

translation.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi la ïathuh ha u Laban ba u Jakob u la phet noh .

translation.en: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved , to fill up their sins alway : for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrshang wat ban pynsangeh ïa ngi na kaba ïalap ha ki Jentil ïa ka khubor ka ban wallam ka jingpynim ha ki . Ha kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ïa baroh ki pop kiba ki la ju ïai leh . Bad mynta ka jingbitar jong U Blei ha kaba kut ka la wan hiar halor jong ki!

translation.en: Beat your plowshares into swords , and your pruninghooks into spears : let the weak say , I am strong .
translation.kha: Shoh tyrnem ïa kiba nep jong ki lyngkor jong phi ban pynlong waitlam bad ïa ki wait ngor tnat dieng ban pynlong sum . Wat kiba tlot ki dei ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: To all that be in Rome , beloved of God , called to be saints : Grace to you and peace from God our Father , and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga thoh sha phi baroh kiba ha Rom kiba U Blei u ieit bad ba u la khot ban long ki briew jong u hi : To U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,

translation.en: He hath filled me with bitterness , he hath made me drunken with wormwood .
translation.kha: Ka jingshah shitom bakthang ka long baroh kaba u la ai ïa nga kum ka jingbam bad jingdih .

translation.en: To redeem them that were under the law , that we might receive the adoption of sons .
translation.kha: U la wan kum u Khun na ka briew bad u la im hapoh ka Hukum ki Jiw , ban siewspah ïa kito kiba hapoh ka Hukum , ba ngi lah ban long ki khun U Blei .

translation.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills : they shall be on the head of Joseph , and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren .
translation.kha: Ki jingkyrkhu da u kew bad ki syntiew ki jingkyrkhu kiba don ha ki lumbah na mynhyndai bad kiei kiei kiba sngewtynnat na ki lumrit baneh junom . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin hiar halor ka khlieh u Joseph , Ha ka shyllangmat jong uta keiñ ïa uba la pynkyrpang na la ki hynmen .

translation.en: Yet count him not as an enemy , but admonish him as a brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat ñiew ïa u kum u nongshun ; pynban , to maham ïa u kum u para .

translation.en: And they shall say to you , See here  ; or , see there : go not after them , nor follow them .
translation.kha: Kin don kito ki ban ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangtai !’ lane ‘ Ha khmih hangne !’ Hynrei wat mih shabar ban wad ïa ka .

translation.en: What is the Almighty , that we should serve him ? and what profit should we have , if we pray unto him ?
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat bymdonkam ban shakri ïa U Blei lane ban don kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban duwai ha u .

translation.en: Knowing this first , that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation .
translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , namarkata , to kynmaw ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai da lade ïa ka jingïathuhlypa ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

translation.en: A drop of sweat ran down his temple .
translation.kha: Shi drop ka syep ka jaw na moimoi jong u .

translation.en: I am resolved what to do , that , when I am put out of the stewardship , they may receive me into their houses .
translation.kha: Mynta nga tip kaei ba ngan leh ! Te haba ka kam jong nga ka duh noh , ngan don ki paralok ki ban pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong ki .’

translation.en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn , and reapeth the ears with his arm  ; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan long kum ka lyngkha ha kaba ïa u riewhadem la ot bad la kheit , kan kynjah kum ka lyngkha ha ka Them Rephaim haba la pynsah lyngkhuit ïa ka .

translation.en: They ravished the women in Zion , and the maids in the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ïa ki tnga jong ngi la batbor ha u lum Seïon hi ; ha man ki nongrit ka Judia ïa ki khun kynthei jong ngi la pynbor ban pyndem .

translation.en: And she answered him , Nay , my brother , do not force me  ; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel : do not thou this folly .
translation.kha: Em ,  ka ong .  Wat pynbor ïa nga ban leh kum kane ka kam pohjait ! Kaba da sngewjli !

translation.en: After two days will he revive us : in the third day he will raise us up , and we shall live in his sight .
translation.kha: Ha ki ar ne lai sngi un pynim ïa ngi , bad ngin ïoh im ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year , in the first month , in the first day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,

translation.en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness : they walked not in my statutes , and they despised my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them  ; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted : then I said , I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness , to consume them .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat ha ka ri shyiap ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , kiba wallam jingim ïa uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki . Ki la pyntngit khoit ïa ka Sabbaton . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha ka ri shyiap bad ban pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Because he hath despised the word of the  Lord  , and hath broken his commandment , that soul shall utterly be cut off  ; his iniquity shall be upon him .
translation.kha: namar ki la kyntait ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong bad ba ki la pynkheiñ khnang ïa kawei na ki hukum jong u . Kin kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki hi .

translation.en: And the water ran round about the altar  ; and he filled the trench also with water .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la tuid sawdong ïa ka duwan bad la pyndap ïa ka kharai .

translation.en: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver : and he shall purify the sons of Levi , and purge them as gold and silver , that they may offer unto the  Lord  an offering in righteousness .
translation.kha: Un wan ban bishar kum uwei uba phrang bad pynkhuid ïa ka rupa . Kumba u nongtrei nar u phrang ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , kumta u nonglamktien jong U  Trai  un pynkhuid ïa ki lyngdoh , khnang ba kin wallam sha U  Trai  da ki jingainguh kiba dei .

translation.en: But I see another law in my members , warring against the law of my mind , and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ïohi ïa ka hukum kaba pher kaba trei hapoh ka met jong nga — ka hukum kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum kaba ka jingmut jong nga ka mynjur . Ka pynlong ïa nga u koidi ïa ka hukum jong ka pop kaba trei ha ka met jong nga .

translation.en: Then will I go unto the altar of God , unto God my exceeding joy : yea , upon the harp will I praise thee , O God my God .
translation.kha: Te ngan leit sha ka duwan jong me , A Blei ; me long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong nga . Ngan tem ïa ka duitara jong nga bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , A Blei , U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour : and strong men retain riches .
translation.kha: Ka briew kaba sbun ka long kaba la ñiewkor , hynrei ka briew khlem ka jinglong babha ka long ka jingjahburom . Ki briew kiba jaipdeh kin ym don pisa satia , hynrei ki briew kiba minot thop kin riewspah .

translation.en: If thou hast run with the footmen , and they have wearied thee , then how canst thou contend with horses ? and if in the land of peace , wherein thou trustedst , they wearied thee , then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Jeremaïah , lada me la thait ban ïamareh pyrshah ïa ki rangbah , kumno me lah ban ïamareh pyrshah ïa ki kulai ? Lada mem lah wat ban ïeng ha ka jaka bym don jingkah , kumno men leh ha ka khlaw harud jong ka Jordan ?

translation.en: And she said unto her servants , Go on before me  ; behold , I come after you . But she told not her husband Nabal .
translation.kha: Nangta ka ong ha ki shakri ,  Khie nang ïaid sha khmat bad ngan sa bud nadien jong phi .  Hynrei kam shym ïathuh ei ei ha la u tnga .

translation.en: And Jesus answered him ,  The first of all the commandments is , Hear , O Israel  ; The Lord our God is one Lord :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaba kongsan eh ka dei kane , ‘ Shahshkor , ko Israel ! U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u , U Trai .

translation.en: And when he had opened the fourth seal , I heard the voice of the fourth beast say , Come and see .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba saw ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba saw uba ong ,  To wan !

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the Lord  God  , that I will send a famine in the land , not a famine of bread , nor a thirst for water , but of hearing the words of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Ki briew kin thngan , hynrei ym ïa u kpu ; kin sliang , hynrei ym ïa ka um . Kin thngan bad kin sliang ïa ka khubor na U  Trai . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: They cried unto them , Depart ye  ; it is unclean  ; depart , depart , touch not : when they fled away and wandered , they said among the heathen , They shall no more sojourn there .
translation.kha: Khie leit noh !  ki briew ki pyrta .  Phi la long kiba tngit ! Wat ktah ïa nga !  Kumta ki la sakma na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , khlem don mano mano ba pdiang sngewbha .

translation.en: For to be carnally minded is death ; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace .
translation.kha: Kaba shah synshar ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh , ka ïalam sha ka jingïap ; kaba shah synshar ha U Mynsiem , ka ïalam sha ka jingim bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves , and are become judges of evil thoughts ?
translation.kha: te phi long ba la rem da kaba pynïapher hapdeng jong phi hi bad phi bishar ha ka nongrim jong ki jingthmu basniew .

translation.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? nay , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush : therefore shall they fall among them that fall : in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , hato phim lehrain namar ba phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli ? Em , phim shym lehrain satia ; phim shym tip hi ruh kumno ban sawkyr-ang ! Bad kumta phin kyllon kumba kiwei pat ki la kyllon ; haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , kata kan long ka jingkut jong phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me ,  Arise , Peter  ; slay and eat .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit , ko Petros , to pynïap bad to bam !’

translation.en: Wherefore I also , after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus , and love unto all the saints ,
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw , naduh ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Trai Jisu bad ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh ,

translation.en: When he therefore was come up again , and had broken bread , and eaten , and talked a long while , even till break of day , so he departed .
translation.kha: Nangta u la leit pat shajrong , u la kdiah kpu , bad u la bam . Hadien ba u la ïakren slem bad ki haduh ban da mih ka sngi , u Paul u leit noh .

translation.en: Then went he down , and dipped himself seven times in Jordan , according to the saying of the man of God : and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child , and he was clean .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u leit hiar sha ka Jordan , u pynngam ïa lade hynñiew sien ha ka , kumba u Elisha u la bthah , bad u la ïohkhiah phar . Ka doh jong u ka la wandur bad khiah krat , kum ka jong u khunlung .

translation.en: For there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; neither hid , that shall not be known .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la tap yn plied , bad ïa kano kano kaba rieh yn pynpaw .

translation.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled  ; they are all of them snared in holes , and they are hid in prison houses : they are for a prey , and none delivereth  ; for a spoil , and none saith , Restore .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki briew jong u la shah lute ; ki la shah set ha ki krem byndi bad shah buhrieh ha ki ïingbyndi . Ki la shah lute bad shah pynjot . Khlem uno uno uba wan ban pyllait im ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish  ; and Joshua smote him and his people , until he had left him none remaining .
translation.kha: U Horam u syiem ka Geser u la wan ban ïarap ïa ka Lakhish , hynrei u Joshua u jop ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad um shym la pyllait im wat ïa uwei ruh na ki .

translation.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit , and the Spirit against the flesh : and these are contrary the one to the other : so that ye cannot do the things that ye would .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew jong ngi ka kwah ka long marpyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah , bad kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah ka long marpyrshah ïa kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew jong ngi ka kwah . Kine ar ki ïalong nongshun , bad kane ka mut ba phim lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia  ;
translation.kha: Haba la kurup ïa ka Ashdod , U  Trai  u la ong ,  U Isaïah u shakri jong nga u la ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad da ka kjat suda haduh lai snem . Kane ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ijipt bad ïa ka Sudan .

translation.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth , he began to cry out , and say , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba dei U Jisu uba na Nasareth , u la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! U Khun U Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !

translation.en: Without natural affection , trucebreakers , false accusers , incontinent , fierce , despisers of those that are good ,
translation.kha: kin long ki bym lehsbun , ki bym ïamap , kiba kren sniew , kiba thala , bad kiba runar ; kin isih ïa kaba bha ,

translation.en: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting .
translation.kha: U Klaudius Lusias , sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor Badonburom : Khublei .

translation.en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kawei pat ka pharshi :  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u la bet ïa u symbai babha hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations , beginning at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad ha ka kyrteng jong u ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Jingkylla-kaba-mut bad ka jingmap ïa ki pop dei ban ïalap sha ki jaitbynriew baroh , da kaba sdang na Jerusalem .

translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without , and made a crown of gold to it round about .
translation.kha: U suit ïa ka da ka ksiar kaba nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .

translation.en: O  Lord  , thou knowest : remember me , and visit me , and revenge me of my persecutors  ; take me not away in thy longsuffering : know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  , me sngewthuh . To kynmaw ïa nga bad ïarap ïa nga . Shah ngan ïoh pynhiarkput halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga . Wat ym da ïaishah katta katta ïa ki kat ba kin jop ha kaba pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba ka dei na ka bynta jong me ba la ibeiñ ïa nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass a long time after that the  Lord  had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about , that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age .
translation.kha: Kham slem hadien kane , U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingïada na ki nongshun sawdong jong ki . Ha kata ka por u Joshua u la tymmen bha ,

translation.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us , which was contrary to us , and took it out of the way , nailing it to his cross ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh ; u la pyndam noh ïa ka jingbuh jingthoh ka bymsngewtynnat ïa ki ram jong ngi lem bad ki kyndon jong ka kiba teh bad weng noh syndon ïa ka da kaba sah preg ïa ka ha ka diengphna .

translation.en: The seven good kine are seven years  ; and the seven good ears are seven years : the dream is one .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki snem , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met ruh ki long ruh ki hynñiew tylli ki snem ; ki don kajuh ka jingmut .

translation.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come , whereof we speak .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la buh ïa ki angel kum ki nongsynshar halor ka pyrthei kaba thymmai ka ban sa wan — ka pyrthei ïa kaba ngi ïakren .

translation.en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you  ; even as the green herb have I given you all things .
translation.kha: Mynta phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumjuh ruh ïa ki jingthung bajyrngam ; nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi ban long jingbam .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Remove the diadem , and take off the crown : this shall not be the same : exalt him that is low , and abase him that is high .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . To law noh ïa la ka pansngiat bad ka jaiñspong jong me . Yn ym don kaei kaei ruh ka ban sah kumjuh . Kyntiew ïa kiba duk sha ka bor ! Pynhiar ïa kito kiba synshar !

translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O house of Israel : bless the  Lord  , O house of Aaron :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki paid Israel ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei !

translation.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , Come hither , and hear the words of the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Ale hangne bad sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ban ong .

translation.en: Then shalt thou prosper , if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the  Lord  charged Moses with concerning Israel : be strong , and of good courage  ; dread not , nor be dismayed .
translation.kha: Lada me kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses na ka bynta ki Israel , me lah ban jop . Kut jingmut bad long skhem , bad wat shah ïa kano kano ban pyntieng ïa me .

translation.en: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture , but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures ? and to have drunk of the deep waters , but ye must foul the residue with your feet ?
