translation.kha: Don na phi ki bym hun ban ïoh bam ïa u phlang uba shngiam tam ; phi da kyrdem wat ïa kaei kaba phim bam ! Phi dih ïa ka um kaba sngur bad phi da pynjngut ïa kata kaba phim dih !

translation.en: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God , and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: lem bad ka ding baklang , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba kyntait ïa U Blei bad ki bymkohnguh ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the  Lord  , of all the best thereof , even the hallowed part thereof out of it .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka na kaba bha tam kaba phi la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: For all of my father s house were but dead men before my lord the king : yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table . What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba na ka longïing jong i pa jong nga ki dei hok ban shah pynïap ha phi ko Syiem Kynrad , hynrei phi ai ha nga ka hok ban bam ha ka miej bam jong phi . Ngam don hok ban pan shuh shuh ïa ki jinglehbha na u Syiem Kynrad .

translation.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God , and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka kupar jong u briew uba pynkhih ïa la ki ksang ti sha U Blei bad uba beiñ pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers , as the heat in a dry place  ; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud : the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low .
translation.kha: kum ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri baryngkhiang . Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me la pynsngap jar ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ; Me la pynsngap jar ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki riewrunar , kum u lyoh uba pynpyngngad ha ka sngi bashit .

translation.en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Isaak ban kular ïa u Jakob bad u Iso da ki jingkyrkhu ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: Behold , thou art called a Jew , and restest in the law , and makest thy boast of God ,
translation.kha: Kumno shaphang jong phi ? Phi khot ïa lade u Jiw ; phi shaniah ha ka Hukum bad sngewsarong shaphang U Blei ;

translation.en: Behold , ye fast for strife and debate , and to smite with the fist of wickedness : ye shall not fast as ye do this day , to make your voice to be heard on high .
translation.kha: Ka jingshah jingit jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban lehbor , bad phi ïakajia bad ïashoh . Phi pyrkhat ba kane ka rukom jingshah jingit kan pynlong ïa nga ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong phi ?

translation.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness , and I make sackcloth their covering .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban pyndum ïa ka suiñbneng , ban ïohi kumba ka ïambriew namar kiba ïap .

translation.en: The king of Debir , one  ; the king of Geder , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Debir , ka Geder ,

translation.en: For Mahlah , Tirzah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Noah , the daughters of Zelophehad , were married unto their father s brothers  sons :
translation.kha: Kumta ka Mahlah , Tirsah , Hoglah , Milkah , bad Noah , ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , bad ki la ïashongkurim bad la ki bakha .

translation.en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the  Lord  , and the praises of the  Lord  , according to all that the  Lord  hath bestowed on us , and the great goodness toward the house of Israel , which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies , and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses .
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka jingieit baïaineh jong U  Trai  ; ngan ïaroh ïa u ïa baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta jong ngi . U la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa ki paid Israel namar ka jingisynei bad ka jingieit baneh jong u .

translation.en: When the morning was come , all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , baroh ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynlong ki jingthmu jong ki pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: She standeth in the top of high places , by the way in the places of the paths .
translation.kha: Hajrong ki lum harud lynti bad ha ka jaka ïashem ki lad , ka ïeng .

translation.en: Return , I pray you , let it not be iniquity  ; yea , return again , my righteousness is in it .
translation.kha: Phi la leit jngai palat . Sangeh na kaba long bymhok . Wat pynrem ïa nga . Ngam shym bakla .

translation.en: And Moses cried unto the  Lord  , saying , Heal her now , O God , I beseech thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kyang ha U  Trai  ,  A Blei , to pynkhiah ïa ka !

translation.en: Incline your ear , and come unto me : hear , and your soul shall live  ; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you , even the sure mercies of David .
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta , ko ki briew jong nga , bad to wan sha nga ; to wan sha nga , bad phin ïoh jingim ! Ngan pynlong ka jutang baneh bad phi bad ngan ai ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba nga la kular ha u Dabid .

translation.en: Thus did all the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel ki la kohnguh bad leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: And shall not God avenge his own elect , which cry day and night unto him , though he bear long with them ?
translation.kha: Mynta , hato U Blei un ym bishar ha ka liang jong ki briew jong u kiba kyang sha u mynsngi bad mynmiet ban ïoh jingïarap ? Hato un long uba suki ban ïarap ïa ki ?

translation.en: And he hath given it to be furbished , that it may be handled : this sword is sharpened , and it is furbished , to give it into the hand of the slayer .
translation.kha: Ïa ka waitlam la nang pynphyrnai , ba kan long kaba la pynkhreh ban pyndonkam . La pynnep bad pynphyrnai , ban buh ha ki kti u nongpynïap .

translation.en: ( For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel , until he had cut off every male in Edom : )
translation.kha: Slem bah ha shuwa jong kane , mynba u Dabid u pynjot ïa ka Edom , u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , u la leit shata ban tep ïa kiba la ïap .

translation.en: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith . Grace be with thee . Amen .
translation.kha: Don kiba kam ba ki don ïa ka , bad kaba mih ka long ba ki jah noh na ka lynti jong ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei jong U Blei to kan long bad phi baroh .

translation.en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men , and the  Lord  delivered a very great host into their hand , because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers . So they executed judgment against Joash .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Syria ka long kaba rit , hynrei U  Trai  u la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Judia kaba kham heh namar ki paidbah ki la iehnoh ïa u , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom la pynshitom ïa u syiem Joash .

translation.en: The size of the universe tells us of his power .
translation.kha: Ka jingïar jong ka haw haw ka ïathuh shaphang ka bor jong u .

translation.en: In the body of his flesh through death , to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , da ka jingïap jong U Khun jong u ha kane ka doh , U Blei u la pynlong ïa phi ki paralok jong u , khnang ban pynïeng ïa phi , kiba khuid , kiba sngur , bad kiba khlem jingduna ha khmat jong u .

translation.en: For the promise , that he should be the heir of the world , was not to Abraham , or to his seed , through the law , but through the righteousness of faith .
translation.kha: Mynba U Blei u la kular ïa u Abraham bad kiba hiarpateng na u ba ka pyrthei kan long ka jong u , u la leh kumta , ym namar ba U Abraham u la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , hynrei namar u la ngeit bad la ñiew ïa u , uba hok da U Blei .

translation.en: And he struck it into the pan , or kettle , or caldron , or pot  ; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself . So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither .
translation.kha: u ju dung ïa uta u proh hapoh u khiew shet , bad kat kaba ngat ha uta u proh ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh . Ki ju leh kumta ïa ki Israel baroh kiba wan sha Shiloh ban ai jingkñia .

translation.en: And he went in unto Hagar , and she conceived : and when she saw that she had conceived , her mistress was despised in her eyes .
translation.kha: U Abram u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Hagar , bad ka la punkhun . Haba ka tip ba ka la punkhun , ka la sngewsarong bad ka la ibeiñ ïa ka Sarai .

translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of your words , when ye spake unto me  ; and the  Lord  said unto me , I have heard the voice of the words of this people , which they have spoken unto thee : they have well said all that they have spoken .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u ong ha nga , ‘ Nga la ïohsngew kine ki briew ki ong aïu ; ki la kren ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: Therefore go thou , and read in the roll , which thou hast written from my mouth , the words of the  Lord  in the ears of the people in the  Lord s  house upon the fasting day : and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa me ban rung hangta ha kawei pat ka sien ba ki briew kin ïashahjingit . Men pule jam na ka kot kli , khnang ba kin ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba U  Trai  u la lah ong ha nga bad ba nga la dep phah thoh ha me . Leh ïa kane ha ka jaka ba baroh ki lah ban ïohsngew ïa me , kynthup ïa ki paid Judah kiba la wan rung shapoh na ki shnong jong ki .

translation.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the  Lord  : moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah .
translation.kha: U sngewsarong ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  bad pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah ha Judah .

translation.en: And Philip said , If thou believest with all thine heart , thou mayest . And he answered and said , I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God .
translation.kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Lah ban pynbaptis ïa me lada me ngeit da ka dohnud baroh .   Nga ngeit ,  u la jubab ;  nga ngeit ba U Jisu Khrist u long U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Or else let these same here say , if they have found any evil doing in me , while I stood before the council ,
translation.kha: Lane shah ïa kine kiba don hangne ban ïathuh kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shem ba nga shah pynrem haba nga la ïeng ha khmat ka Dorbar —

translation.en: So the prophet departed , and waited for the king by the way , and disguised himself with ashes upon his face .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u sop spaiñ ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñ , ban buhrieh ïa ka durkhmat , bad u leit bad ïeng harud lynti , ban ap ïa u syiem Israel ban ïaid nangta .

translation.en: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem , and besieged it .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai ba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , The fire of God is fallen from heaven , and hath burned up the sheep , and the servants , and consumed them  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  U Pyrthat u la tied ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki nongaplangbrot bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: Seek the  Lord  , and ye shall live  ; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph , and devour it , and there be none to quench it in Beth–el .
translation.kha: Phet sha U  Trai  , bad phin ïoh im . Lada phim leit , un bam duh kum ka ding ha ki paid Israel . Ka ding kan thang duh ïa ki briew ka Bethel , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynlip ïa ka .

translation.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants , every drove by themselves  ; and said unto his servants , Pass over before me , and put a space betwixt drove and drove .
translation.kha: U la pynbynta ïa ki ha la ka jong ka jong ka kynhun , bad u buh uwei u shakri jong u ba un khmih ïa kawei kawei ka kynhun . U la ong ha ki ,  Khie nang ïaid sha khmat jong nga , bad pynjngai khyndiat hapdeng kawei ka kynhun bad kawei pat .

translation.en: This is a faithful saying , and these things I will that thou affirm constantly , that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works . These things are good and profitable unto men .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha . Nga kwah ba men ïai ban kyrpang ïa kine kiei kiei , khnang ba kito kiba ngeit ha U Blei kin kitkhia ha kaba ai ïa ka por jong ki ban leh ïa ki kam babha , kiba long ki babha bad kiba myntoi ïa baroh .

translation.en: For this is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many for the remission of sins .
translation.kha: kane ka long ka snam jong nga , kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang jong U Blei , ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la theh noh na ka bynta kiba bun ïa ka ban map ïa ki pop .

translation.en: And Jacob said , Swear to me this day  ; and he sware unto him : and he sold his birthright unto Jacob .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nyngkong to smai ba phin ai noh ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi .  U Iso u smai bad u ai noh ïa la ki hok ha u Jakob .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  because of the Midianites ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki la kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap pyrshah ïa ki Midian ,

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths , and choose the things that please me , and take hold of my covenant  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ong kum ha uta u briew ,  Lada me pyndonburom ïa nga da kaba rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabbaton bad lada me leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga bad sumar khuid ïa ka jutang jong nga ,

translation.en: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture , wherewith thou coverest thyself .
translation.kha: Suh ïa ki rynjup ksai ha ki saw tylli ki dong jong ki jaiñkup jong phi .

translation.en: And when they found him not , they turned back again to Jerusalem , seeking him .
translation.kha: Ki shym la shem ïa u , kumta ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem ban wad ïa u .

translation.en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez , and encamped against Thebez , and took it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u leit sha Thebes , u kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , bad u kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: This twenty years have I been with thee  ; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young , and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten .
translation.kha: Nga la don bad phi mynta la arphew snem ; ki langbrot bad ki blang jong phi kim shym la sangeh ban kha khun , bad ngam pat ju bam doh ïa uno uno na ki langbrot shynrang na ki kynhun jingri jong phi .

translation.en: And so it was , that , while they were there , the days were accomplished that she should be delivered .
translation.kha: Ka la punkhun , bad katba ki dang don ha Bethlehem , ka por ka la dei ïa ka ba kan kha khun .

translation.en: Buy the truth , and sell it not  ; also wisdom , and instruction , and understanding .
translation.kha: Ka jingshisha , ka jingstad , ka jingtip bad ka jingshemphang — kine ki long kiba kordor ba phin siew , hynrei kiba shongdor rem ïa phi ban die .

translation.en: Then said I to the angel that talked with me , Whither do these bear the ephah ?
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Shaei ki rah ïa ka ?

translation.en: But if ye will not hearken unto us , to be circumcised  ; then will we take our daughter , and we will be gone .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim pdiang ïa kaba ngi ong , bad phim shah otsher , ngin shim noh ïa ka bad ngin leit noh .

translation.en: And he gave unto Moses , when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai , two tables of testimony , tables of stone , written with the finger of God .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la dep kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai , u ai ha u ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba U Blei da lade hi u la thoh ïa ki hukum .

translation.en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall .
translation.kha: Mynta la pynjot ïa pha ha ka duriaw ; pha la ngam sha ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah . Ki mar jong pha bad baroh kiba la trei na ka bynta jong pha ki la jah noh ryngkat bad pha ha ka duriaw .’

translation.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem , and their rulers , because they knew him not , nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day , they have fulfilled them in condemning him .
translation.kha: Naba ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad ki nongsynshar jong ki kim tip ba u long U Nongpynim , lymne ba ki la shemphang ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ïa kiba la pule man ka sngi Sabbaton . Pynban ki la pynlong ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ban urlong shisha da kaba pynrem ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: But , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country , and from all countries whither I had driven them  ; and they shall dwell in their own land .
translation.kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri kaba shatei bad na kiwei pat ki ri baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Te kin sa ïoh shong ha la ka jong ka ri .

translation.en: Also Amaziah said unto Amos , O thou seer , go , flee thee away into the land of Judah , and there eat bread , and prophesy there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u ong ha u Amos ,  Kata ka la biang , ko nongïathuhlypa , khie leit noh sha Judah bad leh ïa ka kam ïalap jong me hangta , bad sa ïathuhlypa de hangta . Ai ba kin siew ïa me na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Then called Esther for Hatach , one of the king s chamberlains , whom he had appointed to attend upon her , and gave him a commandment to Mordecai , to know what it was , and why it was .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khot ïa u Hathakh , uwei na ki ïunukh ba la thung da u syiem , bad ong ïa u ban leit sha u Mordekai bad ban shem ïa kaei kaba la jia bad ban kylli balei ka long kumta .

translation.en: To wit , that God was in Christ , reconciling the world unto himself , not imputing their trespasses unto them ; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation .
translation.kha: Ka khubor jong ngi ka long ba U Blei u la pynlong paralok ïa u bynriew baroh lyngba U Khrist . U Blei um shym la buh jingkheiñ ïa ki pop jong ki , bad u la ai ha ngi ka khubor kaba ïathuh kumno u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong u .

translation.en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests , and an holy nation . These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: ka jaitbynriew ba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad phin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And Jiphtah , and Ashnah , and Nezib ,
translation.kha: ka Iphtah , ka Ashnah , ka Nesib ,

translation.en: He then lying on Jesus  breast saith unto him , Lord , who is it ?
translation.kha: Kumta uta u synran u la tur kham sha jan U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , u dei uno ?

translation.en: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob , and David my servant , so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : for I will cause their captivity to return , and have mercy on them .
translation.kha: Bad kumba , shisha , nga la leh ïa kane , kumta ngan pynneh ïa la ka jutang bad ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob bad u shakri jong nga u Dabid . Ngan jied ïa uwei na ki nonghiarpateng u Dabid ban synshar halor ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Ngan isynei ïa ki briew jong nga bad pynlong ïa ki ban roi kyrhai pat .

translation.en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid .
translation.kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Bilhah ïa ka Rakhel ka khun jong u kum ka shakri jong ka . )

translation.en: For the  Lord s  portion is his people  ; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob u la jied na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: And God was displeased with this thing  ; therefore he smote Israel .
translation.kha: La pynsngewsih ïa U Blei da kaei kaba la dep leh , kumta u la pynshitom ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And he went up from thence unto Beth–el : and as he was going up by the way , there came forth little children out of the city , and mocked him , and said unto him , Go up , thou bald head  ; go up , thou bald head .
translation.kha: U Elisha u mihnoh na Jerikho ban leit sha Bethel , bad ha lynti katto katne ngut ki khynnah shynrang ki wan mih na ka shnong bad ki leh biria ïa u ,  Khie phet noh nangne , ko syllen !  ki la pyrta .

translation.en: And Nathan said to David , Thou art the man . Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I anointed thee king over Israel , and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul  ;
translation.kha: Phi long uta u briew ,  u Nathan u ong ha u Dabid .  Bad kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u ong : ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem Israel bad pyllait im ïa me na u Saul .

translation.en: One post shall run to meet another , and one messenger to meet another , to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end ,
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uwei hadien uwei u mareh ban ïathuh ha u syiem ka Babilonia ba ïa ka nongbah jong u la pynpra na baroh ki liang .

translation.en: And they left all the commandments of the  Lord  their God , and made them molten images , even two calves , and made a grove , and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served Baal .
translation.kha: Ki pynkheiñ ïa baroh ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong ki bad ki thaw ar tylli ki khun masi da ka nar ban mane ; ki thaw ruh ïa ka durblei jong ka blei Asherah , ki mane ïa ki khlur , bad ki shakri ïa u blei Baal .

translation.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her : and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness , which put bracelets upon their hands , and beautiful crowns upon their heads .
translation.kha: Lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur jingsawa jong ki paidbah ba leh sngewbha , ka kynhun ki rangbah ba la wanrah na ka ri shyiap . Ki pyndeng ïa ki khadu ha ki kti ki kynthei bad ki pansngiat ba-itynnat ha ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife : but every fool will be meddling .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bieit u lah ban sdang ïa ki jingïania ; kaba donburom ka long ban kiar na kine .

translation.en: The grave  ; and the barren womb  ; the earth that is not filled with water  ; and the fire that saith not , It is enough .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka kynthei kaba khlem khun , ka khyndew rkhiang kaba donkam slap , bad ka ding kaba meh bym lah ban tem .

translation.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed , as Gozan , and Haran , and Rezeph , and the children of Eden which were in Telassar ?
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki Gosan , Haran bad Reseph , bad ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka Betheden kiba shong ha Telassar , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki blei jong ki uba pyllait im ïa ki .

translation.en: Then she went in , and fell at his feet , and bowed herself to the ground , and took up her son , and went out .
translation.kha: Ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u Elisha , lem bad ka khmat kaba kynduh ha ka khyndew , nangta ka la shim ïa la u khun bad ka mihnoh .

translation.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost .
translation.kha: Ngan sah hangne ha Ephesos haduh ka sngi Pentekost .

translation.en: For even Christ pleased not himself ; but , as it is written , The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me .
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist um shym la pynsngewbha ïa lade . Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa kiba la thew ha phi ki la hap halor jong nga .

translation.en: And when he was departed thence , he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him : and he saluted him , and said to him , Is thine heart right , as my heart is with thy heart ? And Jehonadab answered , It is . If it be , give me thine hand . And he gave him his hand  ; and he took him up to him into the chariot .
translation.kha: U Jehu u bteng biang ïa ka jingleit , bad ha lynti la ïakynduh ïa u da u Jonadab u khun jong ka Rekhab . U Jehu u la khublei ïa u bad u la ong ,  Ma phi bad ma nga , ngi ïa-pyrkhat kumjuh , hato phin kyrshan ïa nga ?   Ho-oid ,  u Jonadab u jubab . U Jehu u ong ,  Ai ka kti ngin ïakhublei .  Ki ïabat kti bad u Jehu u ïarap ïa u ban kiew ha ka kali ïapom ,

translation.en: And , behold , I send the promise of my Father upon you : but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem , until ye be endued with power from on high .
translation.kha: Bad nga hi ngan phah halor jong phi ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular . Hynrei phi dei ban ap ha ka nongbah tad ynda ka bor ba najrong ka wan hiar halor jong phi .

translation.en: And he said unto Moses , I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee , and thy wife , and her two sons with her .
translation.kha: U la phah ktien sha u Moses ba ki la ïawan ,

translation.en: What is the role of the congregation elders ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka kamram jong ki rangbah balang ?

translation.en: Even the prophet Jeremiah said , Amen : the  Lord  do so : the  Lord  perform thy words which thou hast prophesied , to bring again the vessels of the  Lord s  house , and all that is carried away captive , from Babylon into this place .
translation.kha: Kaba phylla ! Nga kyrmen U  Trai  un leh ïa kane ! Nga da kyrmen shisha un pynlong ïa ka jingïathuhlypa jong phi ban urlong shisha bad un wallam pat na Babilonia ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba la shah ïalam noh kum ki koidi .

translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host  ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder  ;
translation.kha: U Joab , u khun ka Seruïah , u long u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u long uba khmih sumar ïa ki dulir ;

translation.en: And they brought every man his present , vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and raiment , harness , and spices , horses , and mules , a rate year by year .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki u wanrah ki jingai sngewbha ïa u Solomon — ki tiar kiba da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki barandi , ki tiar thma , ki musla , ki kulai , bad ki khashor . Kane ka ïai bteng na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And in mercy shall the throne be established : and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David , judging , and seeking judgment , and hasting righteousness .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid un long syiem , bad un synshar ïa ki briew da ka jingïaineh bad ka jingieit . Un long uba kloi ban leh ïa kaba dei , bad un khmih ba yn leh ïa ka jingbishar hok . )

translation.en: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about , and chased them , and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la kerkut ïa ki nongshun , bad khlem sangeh ki beh ïa ki nadien haduh ka jaka kaba sha mihngi na Gibeah , ki da pynïap ïa ki katba ki nang ïaid .

translation.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters : he was laid in iron :
translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la khum da ki kynjri , bad ïa u nar la pyndait sawdong ka ryndang jong u ,

translation.en: Let them curse it that curse the day , who are ready to raise up their mourning .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki nongkren byrtong ban tim ïa kata ka sngi , Kito kiba tip kumno ban bat ïa u Lebiathan .

translation.en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart , and the year of my redeemed is come .
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut ba ka por ban pynim ïa ki briew jong nga ka la wan ; ka la dei ka por ban pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: Conaniah also , and Shemaiah and Nethaneel , his brethren , and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad , chief of the Levites , gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle , and five hundred oxen .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ki Lebi — u Konanaïah , u Shemaïah bad u para jong u , u Nethanel , u Hashabaïah , u Jeiel , bad u Josabad — ki ai sngewbha san hajar tylli ki langbrot bad ki khunblang bad sanspah tylli ki masi kyrtong na ka bynta ki Lebi ban ai kum ki jingkñia .

translation.en: Does anybody hear me ?
translation.kha: Don ba iohsngew ianga ?

translation.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away , and the abomination that maketh desolate set up , there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ki sangeh , kata , naduh ka por jong ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli , shihajar arspah khyndaiphew tylli ki sngi kin ïaid .

translation.en: At that day ye shall ask in my name : and I say not unto you , that I will pray the Father for you :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan poi , phin pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ngam ong ba ngan pan na u na ka bynta jong phi , naba U Kpa da lade hi u ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off , but not for himself : and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary  ; and the end thereof shall be with a flood , and unto the end of the war desolations are determined .
translation.kha: Bad ha kaba kut jong kata ka por ïa u nongïalam ba la jied jong U Blei yn pynïap khlem bishar hok . Ïa ka nongbah bad ïa ka Templ yn pynjot da ka kynhun shipai kaba hiarthma jong u nongsynshar badonbor . Kaba kut kan wan kum ka jingshlei um , ka da wallam ïa ka thma bad ïa ka jingpynjot kaba U Blei u la lah pynkhreh .

translation.en: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth ; but if her husband be dead , she is at liberty to be married to whom she will ; only in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ka briew kaba la shongkurim kam long kaba laitluid katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u ïap noh , te ka long kaba laitluid ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u briew uba ka mon , hynrei tang lada u long uba ngeit .

translation.en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth , and been wanton  ; ye have nourished your hearts , as in a day of slaughter .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka pyrthei ka la long kaba dap da ka jingpahuh bad jingsngewbha . Phi la pynsngaid ïa lade na ka bynta ka sngi ka jingshohdoh .

translation.en: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven , clothed with a cloud : and a rainbow was upon his head , and his face was as it were the sun , and his feet as pillars of fire :
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi sa uwei pat u angel bakhrawbor ba u wan hiar na bneng . La sop ïa u ha u lyoh bad la don u simpyllieng sawdong ka khlieh jong u ; ka durkhmat jong u ka long kum ka sngi , bad ki kjat jong u kum ki rishot ding .

translation.en: And when the dew that lay was gone up , behold , upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing , as small as the hoar frost on the ground .
translation.kha: Ynda kata ka umjer ka la rkhiang , la don kaei re kaei kaba stang bad ni phup phup , kum u thah halor ka khyndew .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah :

translation.en: And all the men of Israel , when they saw the man , fled from him , and were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa u Goliath , ki her krad na u da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Gaza , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they carried away captive the whole captivity , to deliver them up to Edom :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Gasa ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh bad die noh ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ki briew ka Edom .

translation.en: And he took the calf which they had made , and burnt it in the fire , and ground it to powder , and strawed it upon the water , and made the children of Israel drink of it .
translation.kha: U shim ïa uta u khun masi uba ki la thaw , u pynum ïa u ha ka ding , bad u tylliat pynlwet jin ïa u , bad u la khleh ïa kata ha ka um . Nangta u la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban dih ïa ka .

translation.en: And he came and took her by the hand , and lifted her up  ; and immediately the fever left her , and she ministered unto them .
translation.kha: U la leit sha ka , u la shim ïa ka na ka kti , bad u la khyllie ïa ka . Ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa ki .

translation.en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt , and took Pharaoh s daughter , and brought her into the city of David , until he had made an end of building his own house , and the house of the  Lord  , and the wall of Jerusalem round about .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la pynlong ka jingmynjur ban ïatreilang bad u syiem Ijipt da kaba shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u . U la wan ïalam ïa ka ban shong ha ka Nongbah U Dabid haduh ba un da dep tei ïa la ka ïingsyiem , ka Templ , bad ka kynroh sawdong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Whom shall he teach knowledge ? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine ? them that are weaned from the milk , and drawn from the breasts .
translation.kha: Ki mudui shaphang jong nga . Ki ong ,  U mut aïu utai u briew ba u wan hikai ? Uei uba donkam ïa ka khubor jong u ? Ka long kaba bha tang na ka bynta ki khunlung ba dang shu iehnoh buiñ !

translation.en: And Lot said unto them , Oh , not so , my Lord :
translation.kha: Hynrei u Lot u jubab ,  Em , sngewbha wat pynbor ba ngin leh kumta .

translation.en: Come up , ye horses  ; and rage , ye chariots  ; and let the mighty men come forth  ; the Ethiopians and the Libyans , that handle the shield  ; and the Ludim , that handle and bend the bow .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki kulai ban leit bad ïa ki kali ïapom ban tyllun ! To phah noh ïa ki shipai : ki rangbah na Sudan bad Lydia , kiba rah ïa ki stieh bad ki nongsiatkhnam batbit na Lydia .’

translation.en: For it came to pass , that , when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel , they turned back again from pursuing him .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki kali ïapom ki ïohi ba um dei u syiem Israel , kumta ki sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u .

translation.en: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , ye , and your fathers , your kings , and your princes , and the people of the land , did not the  Lord  remember them , and came it not into his mind ?
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki jingkñia kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ki syiem jong phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , bad ki briew jong ka ri ki ai ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem — hato phi pyrkhat ba U  Trai  um tip shaphang jong ki lane ba u la klet ïa ki ?

translation.en: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynjahburom ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted , and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted , and every one that had some white in it , and all the brown among the sheep , and gave them into the hand of his sons .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka sngi u Laban u shim noh ïa ki blang shynrang baroh kiba thohshuid bad kiba thohbroin , bad ïa ki blang kynthei baroh kiba thohbria bad kiba thohbroin , ne kiba thohlieh ; u shim noh ruh ïa ki khunlangbrot baïong baroh .

translation.en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up , behold , two men stood by them in white apparel  ;
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïaï khmied la ki khmat sha sahit bneng mynba u dang kiew , kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah kiba riam lieh ki la ïeng hajan jong ki bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap , and go thou after them : have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee ? and when thou art athirst , go unto the vessels , and drink of that which the young men have drawn .
translation.kha: khmih ïa ki ban ïohi hangno ki ot bad don lang bad ki . Nga la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong nga ba kin ym leh bymdei ïa phi . Bad man ba phi sliang , leit ban dih na ki khra um ba ki la pyndap .

translation.en: And Jacob came to Shalem , a city of Shechem , which is in the land of Canaan , when he came from Paddan–aram  ; and pitched his tent before the city .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingwanphai na Mesopotamia , u Jakob u la poi suk poi saiñ ha ka nongbah Shekhem ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u sher ïa la ka dara ha ka madan kaba hajan kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: And Jesus stood before the governor : and the governor asked him , saying , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou sayest .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïeng ha khmat u lyngskor ka hima Rom , uba la kylli jingkylli ïa u .  Hato me long u Syiem ki Jiw ?  u la kylli .  Me ong kumta ,  la jubab U Jisu .

translation.en: I love the  Lord  , because he hath heard my voice and my supplications .
translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa U  Trai  , namar u sngew ïa nga , u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .

translation.en: And again , when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world , he saith , And let all the angels of God worship him .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Blei u la dei ban phah ïa U Khun ba la kha nyngkong sha ka pyrthei , u la ong ,  Baroh ki angel U Blei ki dei ban mane ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day , that the  Lord  did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And all the king s servants , that were in the king s gate , bowed , and reverenced Haman : for the king had so commanded concerning him . But Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence .
translation.kha: U syiem u la hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ha ka jingtreikam ban pynpaw ïa ka jingburom ïa u Haman da kaba dem khohsiew bad nguh ïa u . Baroh ki la leh kumta , lait noh tang u Mordekai , uba la kyntait ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs , and of the same body , and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel :
translation.kha: Ka jingmaïan ka long kata kaba da ka lynti ka gospel , ki Jentil ki ïoh bynta lem bad ki Jiw ïa ki jingkyrkhu U Blei ; ki long ki dkhot jong kajuh ka met bad ki ïoh bynta ïa ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong lyngba U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as she continued praying before the  Lord  , that Eli marked her mouth .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la ïai duwai slem ha U  Trai  bad u Eli u nang khmih ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong ka .

translation.en: But they set their abominations in the house , which is called by my name , to defile it .
translation.kha: Ki buh wat ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong ki ha ka Templ ba la tei na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days , and full of trouble .
translation.kha: La kha ïa ngi baroh ki briew kiba tlot bad bymdonbor . Baroh ka ïalam sha kajuh ka jingim balyngkot , bajynjar .

translation.en: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall , there cried a woman unto him , saying , Help , my lord , O king .
translation.kha: Katba u syiem Israel u dang ïaid najan ka kynroh shnong , kawei ka kynthei ka pyrta jam ,  Syiem Kynrad , ïarap lem ïa nga !

translation.en: And they stirred up the people , and the elders , and the scribes , and came upon him , and caught him , and brought him to the council ,
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah , ïa ki tymmen ki san , bad ïa ki nonghikai ka hukum . Ki la kem ïa u Stephan bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha khmat ka Dorbar .

translation.en: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee  ; for they will not hearken unto me : for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ruh na ki paid Israel kiba mon ban shahshkor , naba kim shahshkor wat ïa nga ruh ; baroh na ki , ki long kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang .

translation.en: And if a man smite his servant , or his maid , with a rod , and he die under his hand  ; he shall be surely punished .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shoh da u dieng ïa la u mraw , la u shynrang ne ka kynthei , bad uta u mraw u ïap ha shen , uta u kynrad u dei ban shah pynshitom .

translation.en: Blessed are they that mourn : for they shall be comforted .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba sngewsih ; U Blei un pyntngen ïa ki !

translation.en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Kynmaw ban rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton , kumba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps , and will rend the caul of their heart , and there will I devour them like a lion : the wild beast shall tear them .
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum ka dngiem kaba la duh ïa la ki khun , bad ngan tar arliang ïa phi . Kum u sing ngan bam ïa phi hangta hi , bad ngan tar ïa phi lyngkhot lyngkhai kum u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: And the same day , when the even was come , he saith unto them ,  Let us pass over unto the other side .
translation.kha: Ha ka janmiet jong kata kajuh ka sngi , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  To ngin ïaleit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: Then they came to Zerubbabel , and to the chief of the fathers , and said unto them , Let us build with you : for we seek your God , as ye do  ; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur , which brought us up hither .
translation.kha: Kumta ki leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Serubbabel bad ïa ki rangbah kur bad ki ong ,  To ngin ïasnohkti lang bad phi ha ka jingtei ïa ka Templ . Ngi mane ïa ujuh U Blei uba phi mane , bad ngi ju ai ki jingkñia ha u naduh ka por u Esarhaddon , u patsha ka Assyria , uba phah ïa ngi ban shong ban sah hangne .

translation.en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph , saying , Thy father did command before he died , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah khubor sha u Joseph da kaba ong ,  Shuwa ba i pa in ïap , i la bthah ïa ngi ban kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka jingleh kam sniew jong ngi ïa phi .

translation.en: Behold , I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves : be ye therefore wise as serpents , and harmless as doves .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! nga phah noh ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun ki suri . Phi dei ban phikir kum ki bseiñ bad kiba jemnud kum ki paro .

translation.en: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron . And it came to pass , as the ark of God came to Ekron , that the Ekronites cried out , saying , They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us , to slay us and our people .
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha Ekron kawei pat ka nongbah jong ki Philistia , hynrei haba ka poi hangta , ki briew ki la lynñiar jam ,  Ki la wallam shane ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei ki Israel , khnang ban pynïap ïa ngi baroh !

translation.en: Concerning Edom , thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Is wisdom no more in Teman ? is counsel perished from the prudent ? is their wisdom vanished ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong shaphang ka Edom :  Hato ki briew ka Edom ki la duh noh ïa la ka jingbishar babha ? Hato ki nongaibuit jong ki kim lah shuh ban ïathuh ïa ki kaei ba ki dei ban leh ? Hato ka jingstad jong ki baroh ka la jah noh ?

translation.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the  Lord  will take away thy master from thy head to day ? And he answered , Yea , I know it  ; hold ye your peace .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don hangta ki la leit sha u Elisha bad ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato phi tip ba U  Trai  un sa shim noh na phi ïa u kynrad jong phi ha kane ka sngi ?   Ho-oid , nga tip ,  u Elisha u jubab ;  Hynrei to ngin ym ïakren shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when I , even I Daniel , had seen the vision , and sought for the meaning , then , behold , there stood before me as the appearance of a man .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrshang ban sngewthuh aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba kynsan uwei u la wan ïeng ha khmat jong nga .

translation.en: And Elkanah her husband said unto her , Do what seemeth thee good  ; tarry until thou have weaned him  ; only the  Lord  establish his word . So the woman abode , and gave her son suck until she weaned him .
translation.kha: U Elkanah u la ong ha ka ,  Leh katba phi sngewbit ; sah ha ïing haduh ba phin da pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u . Bad to U  Trai  un pynurlong ïa ka jingkular jong phi .  Kumta ka Hannah ka shong ha ïing bad ka sumar ïa la u khun bad ïai bsa ïai pjiah ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , that they said , Surely it is the king of Israel . And they turned aside to fight against him : and Jehoshaphat cried out .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki ïohi ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat , baroh ki tharai ba u dei u syiem Israel , bad ki phai ban tur ïaleh ïa u ; hynrei haba u lynñiar ,

translation.en: Why dost thou strive against him ? for he giveth not account of any of his matters .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi kynnoh ïa U Blei ba um ju jubab ïa ki jingkhñium u briew ?

translation.en: For in mine holy mountain , in the mountain of the height of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , there shall all the house of Israel , all of them in the land , serve me : there will I accept them , and there will I require your offerings , and the firstfruits of your oblations , with all your holy things .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri , halor u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , u lumbah bajrong jong ka Israel , ma phi ki Israel baroh phin mane ïa nga . Ngan sngewbha eh bad phi bad ngan khmih lynti ïa phi ban wallam ha nga ïa ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa ki jingainguh bakynsai tam jong phi , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha bakhuid jong phi .

translation.en: When he hath made plain the face thereof , doth he not cast abroad the fitches , and scatter the cummin , and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place ?
translation.kha: Shisien ba u la pynkhreh ïa ka khyndew , u bet ïa ki symbai jong ki jingthung kum ïa u dil bad u kumin . U bet ha ki laiñ ïa u kew bad u barli , bad sawdong ha ki rud jong ka , u bet da kiwei pat ki symbai .

translation.en: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy , they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius , a centurion of Augustus  band .
translation.kha: Ynda la ïakut ba ngi dei ban leit da ka lieng sha Italy , ki la aiti ïa u Paul bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki koidi ha u Julius , u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka pyrton shipai ka Hima Rom kaba la khot  Ka Pyrton shipai jong u Patsha .

translation.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks , and their staff declareth unto them : for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err , and they have gone a whoring from under their God .
translation.kha: Ki pan ïa ki jingpynpaw na u lyngkhot dieng ! u diengduh u batai ïa ki kaei ba ki kwah ban tip ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Kum ka briew kaba la kylla nuti , ki la aiti ïa lade ha kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And when they heard these sayings , they were full of wrath , and cried out , saying , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien , ki la bitar shla bad ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !

translation.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration , and seethe his flesh in the holy place .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka doh jong uta u langbrot ba la pyndonkam ha ka por ba pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad phon ïa ka ha kata ka jaka kaba kyntang .

translation.en: And he sent , and beheaded John in the prison .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah khrai khlieh ïa u Ïoannis ha byndi .

translation.en: But if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not , it is a burning boil  ; and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka sah kumjuh bad kam shym pur , ka long tang ka sohkhliang kaba sah dak na u tohjaw , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: It was me who killed Kennedy .
translation.kha: Dei manga ba pyniap ia u Kennedy .

translation.en: For whosoever shall do the will of God , the same is my brother , and my sister , and mother .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , u long u para jong nga , ka para jong nga , ka kmie jong nga .

translation.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables .  A certain man planted a vineyard , and set an hedge about it , and digged a place for the winefat , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country .
translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la kren ha ki ha ki pharshi :  Shisien la don u briew uba don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la thaw ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew ban khñiot sohwaiñ , bad u la thaw ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha ki nongshimwai bad u la mih na ïing ban leit jingleit .

translation.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten , the cankerworm , and the caterpiller , and the palmerworm , my great army which I sent among you .
translation.kha: Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa kaei kaba phi la duh noh ha ki snem mynba ki kynhun jong ki puit ki la bam ïa ki jingthung phi . Dei ma nga uba la phah ïa kane ka kynhun pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice , and kept my charge , my commandments , my statutes , and my laws .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , namar ba u Abraham u la kohnguh ïa nga , bad u la sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand : the faces of elders were not honoured .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongïalam jong ngi la shim noh bad phasi ; ïa ki tymmen shynrang jong ngi ym shym la ñiewburom .

translation.en: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle , and bade that he should be examined by scourging  ; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom u la hukum ïa la ki rangbah ban ïalam ïa u Paul shapoh ka kut shipai , bad u la ong ïa ki ban sympat ïa u khnang ban lap balei ba ki Jiw ki kyang kumne pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: He hath taken a bag of money with him , and will come home at the day appointed .
translation.kha: U la rah shi pla ka tyngka bad u bad un ym wan phai kumba ar taïew ei ei .

translation.en: Hath not my hand made all these things ?
translation.kha: Hato ym dei ma nga hi uba la thaw ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ?’

translation.en: If I sin , then thou markest me , and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity .
translation.kha: me ïai jngoh ban ïohi lada nga leh pop , khnang ba men kyntait ban map ïa nga .

translation.en: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day .
translation.kha: kynmaw ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask you one thing  ; and answer me :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Mynta shah ïa nga ban kylli kawei ka jingkylli ïa phi .

translation.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth .
translation.kha: Naba kan wan halor ki briew baroh ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For verily I say unto you , Till heaven and earth pass , one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law , till all be fulfilled .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba katba ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ki dang sah , ym don iwei i dak iba rit tam lymne i bynta iba rit tam na ka Hukum ïa iba yn pyndam noh — ym haduh kaba kut jong kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Take therefore no thought for the morrow : for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself . Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta wat khuslai ïa kaba lashai ; kan don bun ki jingkhuslai ki jong ka hi . Ym donkam ban kynton halor ki jingjynjar ba kawei pa kawei ka sngi ka wallam .

translation.en: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven , saying , Alleluia  ; Salvation , and glory , and honour , and power , unto the Lord our God :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ki paidbah babun ha bneng , da kaba ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Ka Jingpynim , ka burom , bad ka bor ki long ki jong U Blei jong ngi !

translation.en: Behold , the third time I am ready to come to you ; and I will not be burdensome to you : for I seek not yours , but you : for the children ought not to lay up for the parents , but the parents for the children .
translation.kha: Kane mynta ka long ka sien kaba lai ba nga la khreh ban wan jngoh ïa phi — bad ngan ym pynlong kino kino ki jingdawa na phi . Dei ïa phi ba nga kwah , ym ïa ka pisa jong phi . La kumno kumno , ki khun kim da dei ban pynbiang na ka bynta la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei ki kmie ki kpa keiñ ki dei ban pynbiang na ka bynta la ki khun .

translation.en: They answered and said unto him , If he were not a malefactor , we would not have delivered him up unto thee .
translation.kha: Ka jubab jong ki ka la long ,  Ngin ym da la wallam ïa u sha phi lada um shym la leh ïa ka kam runar .

translation.en: And while they went to buy , the bridegroom came  ; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage : and the door was shut .
translation.kha: Kumta ki theisotti kiba bieit ki la ïaleit ban thied khyndiat ka umphniang ; bad katba ki dang leit , la wan poi u nongleitkurim . Ki san ngut kiba la pynkhreh ki la ïaleit shapoh lem bad u sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , bad ïa ka jingkhang la khang .

translation.en: Precious in the sight of the  Lord  is the death of his saints .
translation.kha: Katno kaba pangnud ka long ïa U  Trai haba iwei na ki briew jong u i ïap !

translation.en: And I will send the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , among them , till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers .
translation.kha: Ngan wanlam ïa ka thma , ïa ka  nemsniew , bad ïa ka jingïapthngan halor jong ki haduh ba yn ym don shuh wat uwei ruh na ki u ban lait ha kata ka ri ba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh , This is the finger of God : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , and he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Te kita ki nongleh myntor ki ong ha u Pharaoh ,  U Blei u la leh ïa kane .  Hynrei u Pharaoh u dang mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things , he said unto him , Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Haba uwei na ki rangbah kiba ïashong bam u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha U Jisu ,  A katno kiba kmen long kito kiba shong ha ka jingkhawai ha ka Hima U Blei !

translation.en: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts  ; even one thing befalleth them : as the one dieth , so dieth the other  ; yea , they have all one breath  ; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast : for all is vanity .
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , kajuh ka kupar ka ap ïa ki briew bad ïa ki mrad kumjuh . Uwei u ïap kum uwei pat . Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw . U briew um long uba kham bha ban ïa ka mrad , namar ka jingim kam don jingmut ïa ki baroh ar .

translation.en: A sower went out to sow his seed : and as he sowed , some fell by the way side  ; and it was trodden down , and the fowls of the air devoured it .
translation.kha: Shisien la don u briew uba la leit ban bet symbai . Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai , katto katne na u , ki la hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , ha kaba ki la shah ïuh , bad ki sim ki la bam lut .

translation.en: It is not for kings , O Lemuel , it is not for kings to drink wine  ; nor for princes strong drink :
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko Lemuel . Ki syiem kim dei ban dih waiñ , lane kim dei ban thrang kyiad ;

translation.en: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi te , un hap ban ai jingkheiñ shaphang ïa lade ha U Blei .

translation.en: Which was the son of Simeon , which was the son of Juda , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Jonan , which was the son of Eliakim ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Simeon , u khun jong u Judah , u khun jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jonam , u khun jong u Eliakim ,

translation.en: If any man take a wife , and go in unto her , and hate her ,
translation.kha: Lada jia ba u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad hadien um mon shuh ïa ka ,

translation.en: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day , every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , phim dei shuh ban leh kumba phi la ju leh . Haduh mynta , phi ïamane Blei katba phi sngewdei ,

translation.en: So the  Lord  scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth : and they left off to build the city .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la pynsaphred ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ki la sangeh noh ha kaba tei ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for his word was with power .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai , namar u la kren da ka bor .

translation.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up ? and when he visiteth , what shall I answer him ?
translation.kha: Lada ngam leh kumta , kumno te ngan wan ha khmat U Blei ? Kaei nga lah ban ong haba U Blei u wan ban bishar ïa nga ?

translation.en: And Samuel said , Gather all Israel to Mizpah , and I will pray for you unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u phah khot ïa ki Israel baroh ban ïashem lang ha Mispah , da kaba ong ,  Ngan duwai hangta ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year , in the twelfth month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khat-ar jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: I considered all the living which walk under the sun , with the second child that shall stand up in his stead .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat shaphang ki briew baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka pyrthei , bad nga la sngewthuh ba hangno re hangno hapdeng jong ki don u samla u ban shimti ïa ka jaka jong u syiem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Judah , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have despised the law of the  Lord  , and have not kept his commandments , and their lies caused them to err , after the which their fathers have walked :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki jinghikai jong nga bad kim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ki la shah ïalam bakla da kijuh ki blei thala ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shakri .

translation.en: And Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second : but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons  ; therefore they were in one reckoning , according to their father s house .
translation.kha: U Shimei u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jahath , u Sina , u Jeush , bad u Beraïah , kat kum ka rta jong ki . U Jeush bad u Beraïah kim shym don bun ngut ki khun ki ksiew ; kumta la ñiew ïa ki kum kawei ka kur .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down upon mount Sinai , on the top of the mount : and the  Lord  called Moses up to the top of the mount  ; and Moses went up .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan hiar halor u Lum Sinai , bad u la khot ïa u Moses sha kliar jong u lum .

translation.en: Therefore the men of Jabesh said , To morrow we will come out unto you , and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you .
translation.kha: bad ki ong ha u Nahash ,  La shai ka sngi ngin sa aiti ïa lade ha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ngi katba phi sngewbit .

translation.en: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal , namely , Gideon , according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel .
translation.kha: Kim shym sngewnguh ïa ka longïing jong u Gideon na ka bynta kaba bha baroh kaba u la leh ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And he shall put off his garments , and put on other garments , and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place .
translation.kha: Nangta un leit pli ïa la ki jaiñ bad un rah ïa uta u dpei shabar ka jaka shong dara , sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid .

translation.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot , Turn thine hand , and carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .
translation.kha: Pynban ka jia ryngkhat hangta ba uwei u shipai Syria u siat da u khnam uba leit dei ïa u syiem Ahab napdeng ki jingpyndait ka jingkieng atiar jong u .  Nga la mynsaw !  u lynñiar ha u nongñiah kali ïapom jong u .  Phai bad kynran noh na ka thma !

translation.en: That by two immutable things , in which it was impossible for God to lie , we might have a strong consolation , who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us :
translation.kha: Te , don kine ar tylli kiei kiei ki bym lah ban kylla bad ïa kiba U Blei um lah ban lamler . Kumta ïa ngi kiba la shem ka jingshngain ha u la nang pynshlur shuh shuh ban batskhem ïa kata ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba la buh ha khmat jong ngi .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  In what place soever ye enter into an house , there abide till ye depart from that place .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ,  Hangno hangno ba la khot sngewbha ïa phi , sah ha kajuh ka ïing haduh ba phin da mih na kata ka jaka .

translation.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds : but when it is grown , it is the greatest among herbs , and becometh a tree , so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof .
translation.kha: U long u symbai uba rit tam na ki symbai baroh , hynrei haba u la san , u long u jingthung uba heh tam na baroh ki jingthung . U kylla long u dieng , ba kumta ki sim ki wan bad thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven , the same is my brother , and sister , and mother .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa u ban leh u long u para jong nga , ka para jong nga , bad ka kmie jong nga .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? That the Gentiles , which followed not after righteousness , have attained to righteousness , even the righteousness which is of faith .
translation.kha: Te kumta ngi ong ba ki Jentil , ki bym shym la pyrshang ban ïasuk bad U Blei , la pynïasuk bad u lyngba ka jingngeit ;

translation.en: Then the king arose very early in the morning , and went in haste unto the den of lions .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u syiem u la khie bad u la pynkloi sha ka thliew .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto me , Go and get thee a linen girdle , and put it upon thy loins , and put it not in water .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied ïa lade katto katne tylli ki patlun linen balyngkot bad ban phong ïa ki ; hynrei u la bthah ïa nga ban ym phong ïa ki hapoh ka um .

translation.en: There is a generation , whose teeth are as swords , and their jaw teeth as knives , to devour the poor from off the earth , and the needy from among men .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba shim kabu-runar ïa kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh ; kata ka long ka rukom ba ki kyrshan ïa la ka jingim .

translation.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully , and shall take away all thy labour , and shall leave thee naked and bare : and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered , both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Bad namar ba ki isih ïa pha , kin shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la trei na ka bynta kita bad kin ieh lyngkhuit bad thad ïa pha kum ka nuti . Ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha ki la wanrah ïa kane ha pha .

translation.en: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee for ever , when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Da shahshkor ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa phi , ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha junom , namar ba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness , and he is waited for of the sword .
translation.kha: Um don jingkyrmen ban lait na ka jingdum , namar hangno re hangno ka waitlam ka ap ban pynïap ïa u ,

translation.en: Behold , I and the children whom the  Lord  hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the  Lord  of hosts , which dwelleth in mount Zion .
translation.kha: Nga don hangne bad ki khun kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jong u ka long halor u Lum Seïon , u la phah ïa ngi kum ki khubor ba-im sha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in  ; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki dei ban lum ar shah ban ïa kaba ki ju lum man ka sngi bad pynkhreh ïa ka .

translation.en: After that they have borne their shame , and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me , when they dwelt safely in their land , and none made them afraid .
translation.kha: Haba sa shisien pat kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ka ri jong ki hi , ha kaba ym don shuh ba byrngem ïa ki , kin sa klet noh kumno ba ki shah pynjahburom naba ki la shetkylla ïa nga .

translation.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city , and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha Jerusalem , ka Nongbah Bakhuid , bad u la buh ïa U ha ka kliar kaba jrong tam jong ka Templ ,

translation.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee , then thou shalt be clear from this my oath : only bring not my son thither again .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka samla kam mon ban wan ryngkat bad me , men laitluid na kane ka jingkular . Hynrei da lei lei ruh wat leit ïalam noh ïa u khun jong nga shata .

translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not any more eat thereof , until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ha phi , ngan ym bam shuh na ka tad ynda la ai ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: For before these days rose up Theudas , boasting himself to be somebody  ; to whom a number of men , about four hundred , joined themselves : who was slain  ; and all , as many as obeyed him , were scattered , and brought to nought .
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw ba u Theudas u la mih katto katne por mynshuwa , u da kam ba u long uta uba khraw , bad kumba sawspah ngut ki briew ki la ïasoh bad u . Hynrei la pynïap ïa u , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma , bad ka kynhun jong u ka la kut noh .

translation.en: And the woman had a fat calf in the house  ; and she hasted , and killed it , and took flour , and kneaded it , and did bake unleavened bread thereof :
translation.kha: Kloi lan kata ka briew ka pynïap uwei u khun masi uba ka la ri pynsngaid . Nangta ka shim khyndiat u  purew , ka khleh ïa u , bad ka shet u kpu uba khlem thiat .

translation.en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land .
translation.kha: Haba la die ïa kano kano ka khyndew , ïa ka hok jong u trai khyndew ban thied pat ïa ka dei ban ithuh .

translation.en: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream , there is but one decree for you : for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me , till the time be changed : therefore tell me the dream , and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: ban ai ha phi baroh ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom lada phim ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew . Phi la ïamynjur para ma phi ban ïathuh ïa nga ki jinglamler namar ba phi kyrmen ba ha ka por babiang kiei kiei kin kylla . Ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad nangta ngan tip ba phi lah ruh ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: For their rock is not as our Rock , even our enemies themselves being judges .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki , ki tip ba ki blei jong ki , ki tlot , kim long kiba donbor kum U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: He appointed the moon for seasons : the sun knoweth his going down .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa u bnai ban pynlong jingkheiñ bnai ; ka sngi ka tip ïa ka por ban sep .

translation.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land , the chief of all their strength .
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang kiba nyngkong jong baroh ki longïing jong ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart : I know that this is with thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga tip ba baroh kata ka por me ïai thmu ha kaba rieh ban pynmynsaw ïa nga ,

translation.en: And onyx stones , and stones to be set for the ephod , and for the breastplate .
translation.kha: ki mawkordor Karnelian bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day , to the right hand , or to the left , to go after other gods to serve them .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim bit ban kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki ha kano kano ka rukom , lane mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: Now , my son , the  Lord  be with thee  ; and prosper thou , and build the house of the  Lord  thy God , as he hath said of thee .
translation.kha: U Dabid u bteng ,  Mynta , ko khun jong nga , ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me , bad ai ba un bat ïa ka kular jong u ban pynlah ïa me ban pyndep ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And as they departed from Jericho , a great multitude followed him .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki dang mihnoh na Jerikho , u paidbah babun u la bud .

translation.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave , that thou wouldest keep me secret , until thy wrath be past , that thou wouldest appoint me a set time , and remember me !
translation.kha: A ba men da buhrieh ïa nga ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; to ai ba yn buhrieh ïa nga tad haduh ban da jah ka jingbitar jong me , bad sa buh ïa ka por ba men kynmaw ïa nga .

translation.en: But woe to them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha kita ki sngi na ka bynta ki kynthei kiba armet bad ki kmie kiba don ki khun rit !

translation.en: And when he was come unto us , he took Paul s girdle , and bound his own hands and feet , and said , Thus saith the Holy Ghost , So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle , and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U la wan sha ngi , u la shim ïa u panpoh jong u Paul , u la teh ïa la ki kti bad ki kjat da uta , bad u la ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong : Ïa u trai jong une u panpoh yn teh ha kane ka rukom da ki Jiw ha Jerusalem , bad kin sa aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil .

translation.en: And profited in the Jews  religion above many my equals in mine own nation , being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers .
translation.kha: Nga la long uba ha khmat tam ïa kiba bun ki para Jiw kiba ïaryngkat rta bad nga ha kaba bud pyrkhing ïa ka niam Jiw , bad nga la kham pynleit jingmut shibun ha ki rukom pateng jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

translation.en: Yea , and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right ?
translation.kha: Balei phim bishar na ka bynta ïa lade hi ïa kaei kaba dei ban leh ?

translation.en: He also that had received two talents came and said , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me two talents : behold , I have gained two other talents beside them .
translation.kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga ar hajar tylli ki sbai . Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa ar hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’

translation.en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Absalom .

translation.en: O  Lord  , thou art my God  ; I will exalt thee , I will praise thy name  ; for thou hast done wonderful things  ; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei jong nga ; ngan pyndonburom ïa me bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Me la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla ; me la long uba ïaineh ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong me kiba me la thmu naduh mynbarim .

translation.en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood , which they had made for the purpose  ; and beside him stood Mattithiah , and Shema , and Anaiah , and Urijah , and Hilkiah , and Maaseiah , on his right hand  ; and on his left hand , Pedaiah , and Mishael , and Malchijah , and Hashum , and Hashbadana , Zechariah , and Meshullam .
translation.kha: U Esra u ïeng ha ka jaka ba kham kynjang ba la shna da ka dieng ïa kaba la shna khnang na ka bynta kata ka por . Kine ki briew ki ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong u : U Mattithaïah , u Shema , u Anaïah , u Uriah , u Hilkaïah , bad u Maaseïah ; bad kine pat ki ïeng ha ka liang kadiang jong u : u Pedaïah , u Mishael , u Malkhijah , u Hashum , u Hashbaddanah , u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam .

translation.en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ , not only to believe on him , but also to suffer for his sake ;
translation.kha: Naba ïa phi la ai ka lad ban shakri ïa U Khrist , ym tang ban ngeit ha u , hynrei ban shahshitom ruh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: Comfort ye , comfort ye my people , saith your God .
translation.kha: Pyntngen ïa ki briew jong nga ,  ong U Blei jong ngi .  Pyntngen ïa ki !

translation.en: So David fled , and escaped , and came to Samuel to Ramah , and told him all that Saul had done to him . And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth .
translation.kha: U Dabid u phet ïap bad u leit sha u Samuel ha Ramah bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kata baroh kaba u Saul u la leh ïa u . Nangta ma u bad u Samuel ki leit sha Naïoth bad ki sah hangta .

translation.en: And the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses of the kings of Judah , shall be defiled as the place of Topheth , because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven , and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods .
translation.kha: Ki ïing jong ka Jerusalem bad ki ïing jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad shisha baroh ki ïing ha kiba halor ki tnum jong ki la thang ïa ki jingiwbih sha ki khlur bad ha kaba ïa ka waiñ la theh kum ka jingainguh sha kiwei pat ki blei — ma ki baroh kin long ki bymkhuid kum ka Topheth .

translation.en: But they held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la lah ong ha ki ; kim shym la ong shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the  Lord  : but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki lynti jong ki briew kiba sniew ; hynrei u ieit ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Consider your ways .
translation.kha: Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ha phi ?

translation.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done .
translation.kha: U shakri u ïathuh lut ha u Isaak ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh .

translation.en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the  Lord  , and the day of vengeance of our God  ; to comfort all that mourn  ;
translation.kha: U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ba ka por ka wan haba U  Trai  un pynim ïa ki briew jong u bad jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki . U la phah ïa nga ban pyntngen ïa baroh kiba sngewsih ,

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga kular ba borabor yn don u nonghiarpateng na u Dabid ban long u syiem ki Israel

translation.en: If he rise again , and walk abroad upon his staff , then shall he that smote him be quit : only he shall pay for the loss of his time , and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed .
translation.kha: lada uta uba shah shoh u hap thiah pang , hynrei hadien u lah ban khie pat bad ban ïaid shabar da kaba kyrshan ha u diengduh , uta uba shoh ïa u , u dei ban buria ïa ka por kaba u la duh bad ban sumar na ka bynta jong u haduh ba un da jem bha .

translation.en: Whosoever transgresseth , and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ , hath not God . He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ , he hath both the Father and the Son .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bymïaineh ha ka jinghikai U Khrist , hynrei uba ïaid palat ïa ka , um don ïa U Blei . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha ka jinghikai , u don ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .

translation.en: And his disciples said unto him , Thou seest the multitude thronging thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la jubab ,  Me ïohi kumno ki briew ki ïa-thngian ïa me ; balei ba me kylli uei uba la ktah ïa me ?

translation.en: One law and one manner shall be for you , and for the stranger that sojourneth with you .
translation.kha: Kijuh ki aiñ bad kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ki long ïa phi bad ïa ki .

translation.en: And it shall be , that thou shalt drink of the brook  ; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there .
translation.kha: Ka wahduid kan pynbiang um ïa me ban dih , bad nga la hukum ïa ki tyngab ban wanrah jingbam ïa me hangta .

translation.en: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , which is blessed for evermore , knoweth that I lie not .
translation.kha: U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Trai Jisu — long ba la kyrkhu ïa ka kyrteng jong u junom ! — u tip ba ngam shym lamler .
