translation.en: The land shall not be sold for ever : for the land is mine  ; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban die duh ïa ka khyndew , namar phim long trai ïa ka ; ka long ka jong U Blei , bad phi long kum ki nongwei ïa kiba la shah ban pyndonkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah , and said , Who are ye ? And they answered , We are the brethren of Ahaziah  ; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen .
translation.kha: u ïakynduh katto katne ngut ki kur ki jait jong u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi dei kiei ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi dei ki kur ki jait jong u Ahasaïah . Ngi ïaleit sha Jesreel ban lehburom ïa ki khun jong ka syiem Jesebel bad ïa kiba ha ka longïing syiem .

translation.en: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth , and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem  ; and they are wasted and desolate , as at this day .
translation.kha: Te nga pynmih noh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga bad ka jingbitar shla ha ki shnong jong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem , bad nga thang ïa ki da ka ding . La iehnoh ïa ki ha ki jingjot bad ki la long ka jingïohi ba-itriem , kumba ki long mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes , and keep my judgments , and do them  ; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai  , khnang ba phin ïoh shongshngain ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: They have dealt treacherously against the  Lord  : for they have begotten strange children : now shall a month devour them with their portions .
translation.kha: Ki la long ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki khun jong ki kim long ki jong u . Kumta mynta , ma ki bad ki jaka jong ki kin sa shah pynjot noh shen .

translation.en: My beloved is mine , and I am his : he feedeth among the lilies .
translation.kha: Haduh katno phi long uba bhabriew , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; katno phi pynkmen ïa nga ! U phlang bajyrngam un long ka jingthiah jong ngi ,

translation.en: And I will put a division between my people and thy people : to morrow shall this sign be .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïapher hapdeng ki briew jong nga bad ki briew jong me . Kane ka kambah kan jia lashai .’

translation.en: But Amnon had a friend , whose name was Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother : and Jonadab was a very subtil man .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Amnon u don uwei u paralok uba shalak bha , uba kyrteng u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid .

translation.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay , whose foundation is in the dust , which are crushed before the moth ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat un shaniah ïa u jingthaw uba da ka dewbyrtha , uba da ka dewmet ba lah ban khñiot kum ïa u khñiang ?

translation.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves , and make you a graven image , the similitude of any figure , the likeness of male or female ,
translation.kha: Te , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi , sumar ba phin ym leh pop da kaba thaw na ka bynta ïa lade kano kano ka durblei — la ka long ka dur u briew lane ka briew ,

translation.en: And the son said unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and in thy sight , and am no more worthy to be called thy son .
translation.kha: ‘ Ko pa ,’ u khun jong u , u la ong , ‘ nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phi . Ngam long shuh uba dei ba yn khot u khun jong phi .’

translation.en: Then it shall be , when he maketh his sons to inherit that which he hath , that he may not make the son of the beloved firstborn before the son of the hated , which is indeed the firstborn :
translation.kha: ha ka sngi ba uta u briew u rai ban sam ïa ka spah ka phew jong u ha la ki khun , um dei ban leh shiliang ïa u khun jong kata ka tnga ba u kham ieit da kaba ai noh ha u ïa ka bynta u khun nyngkong jong u .

translation.en: I have planted , Apollos watered ; but God gave the increase .
translation.kha: Nga la bet , u Apollos u ai um , hynrei dei U Blei uba pynsan .

translation.en: And he set three days  journey betwixt himself and Jacob : and Jacob fed the rest of Laban s flocks .
translation.kha: U phah peit ïa ki ha ki khun jong u , bad nangta u la leit noh na u Jakob lem bad kata ka kynhun langbrot ha ka jingjngai kumba lai sngi lynti . U Jakob u ai bam ai dih ïa ki kynhun jingri kiba dang sah jong u Laban .

translation.en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites , and built a city , and called the name thereof Luz : which is the name thereof unto this day .
translation.kha: Kham hadien u la leit sha ri ki Hit , u la tei hangta kawei ka nongbah , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Lus , kaba dang dei hi ka kyrteng jong ka .

translation.en: I will therefore that men pray every where , lifting up holy hands , without wrath and doubting .
translation.kha: Ha man la ka jingshakri ha ka balang , nga kwah ba ki rangbah kin duwai , ki briew kiba la pynkyntang sha U Blei bad kiba lah ban rah ïa la ki kti ha ka jingduwai khlem jingbitar lane ka jingïakajia .

translation.en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon s house  ; and he was laid down . And she took flour , and kneaded it , and made cakes in his sight , and did bake the cakes .
translation.kha: Ka la leit shata bad ka lap ba u don ha jingthiah . Ka shim shilynglun u kpu im , ka la pynkhreh ïa u , bad ka shna katto katne tylli ki kpu hangta ha kaba u lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Nangta ka la shet ïa ki kpu

translation.en: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me  ; as also the king s words that he had spoken unto me . And they said , Let us rise up and build . So they strengthened their hands for this good work .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ong ïa ki kumno U Blei u la long ryngkat bad nga bad ïarap ïa nga , bad kaei kaba u patsha u la ong ha nga . Ki la phai ktien ,  To ngin ïasdang tei pat !  Bad kumta ki la ïakhreh ban sdang ïa ka kam .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Shebna ,  Haba kata ka jia , ngan phah khot ïa u shakri jong nga u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah .

translation.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf : in the morning he shall devour the prey , and at night he shall divide the spoil .
translation.kha: U Benjamin u long kum u suri uba jlawnguid , Mynstep bad janmiet u pynïap bad u bam .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth  ; shew forth from day to day his salvation .
translation.kha: Rwai ha U  Trai  , baroh ka pyrthei ! Pynbna man ka sngi ïa ka khubor babha ba u la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ , we are of all men most miserable .
translation.kha: Lada ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Khrist ka long tang ha kane ka jingim hi , te ngi dei ban ïoh kham bun ka jinglehisynei ban ïano ïano ruh ha ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: Let me pass through thy land : I will go along by the high way , I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left .
translation.kha: ‘ Shah ngin ïaid lynti na ka ri jong phi . Ngin shu ïaid beit beit na lynti bah bad ngin ym kynriah nangta .

translation.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first : but when Jesus was glorified , then remembered they that these things were written of him , and that they had done these things unto him .
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u kim shym la sngewthuh ïa kane ha kata ka por ; hynrei ynda haba la pyndonburom ïa U Jisu , ki la kynmaw ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la ong ïa kane shaphang jong u bad ki la leh ïa kane na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death , and brake their bands in sunder .
translation.kha: U wallam ïa ki na ka jingshaïong bad ka jingdum jong ki bad bthat lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki kynjri jong ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel , saying , This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations .
translation.kha: Ong ruh ha ki paid Israel , ‘ Kane ka dei ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang ïa kaba dei ban pyndonkam ha kaba shakri ïa nga ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .

translation.en: And the heathen shall know that I the  Lord  do sanctify Israel , when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore .
translation.kha: Haba nga pynïeng ïa ka Templ jong nga hangta ba kan don hapdeng jong ki junom , te ki jaitbynriew kin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la jied ïa ki Israel ba kin long ki briew ki jong nga hi .

translation.en: And none considereth in his heart , neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say , I have burned part of it in the fire  ; yea , also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof  ; I have roasted flesh , and eaten it : and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination ? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree ?
translation.kha: U nongshna ïa ki bleithaw um don ka jingpuson ne ka jingshemphang ban ong ,  Khyndiat na ka dieng nga thang duh . Nga shet khyndiat u kpu halor ki rnga bad nga syang doh bad nga la bam ïa ka . Bad kaba sah na ka dieng nga shna bleithaw . Hangne nga don ban nguh dem ïa u dieng tylli !

translation.en: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation , and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad hangta ha khmat jong kata ka pyrda u buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang . U kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka jingainguh bam halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: And the watchman told , saying , He came even unto them , and cometh not again : and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi  ; for he driveth furiously .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u nongap phira u leit ïathuh ba u nonglamktien u la poi sha ka kynhun hynrei u khlem wan phai . Bad u ong shuh shuh ,  U nongïalam jong ka kynhun u ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u kum uba lamwir , i kumba u dei u Jehu !

translation.en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth  ; and I have set thee so : thou wast upon the holy mountain of God  ; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire .
translation.kha: Nga buh ïa u angel ba-itriem hangta ban ap phira ïa me . Me la shong ha u lumbah bakhuid jong nga bad me la ïaid hapdeng ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .

translation.en: If he hath wronged thee , or oweth thee ought , put that on mine account  ;
translation.kha: Lada u la leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa me lane u dang don ka ram ban siew ïa me , shim ïa kata na nga .

translation.en: As he saith also in another place , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha kawei pat ka jaka ,  Men long u lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh jong u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom , which shall never be destroyed : and the kingdom shall not be left to other people , but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms , and it shall stand for ever .
translation.kha: Ha ka por jong kito ki nongsynshar U Blei ka bneng un seng ka hima ka ban ym kut junom . Yn ym lah ban jop ïa ka , hynrei kan pynjot thiaw ïa baroh kito ki hima , bad nangta kan neh junom .

translation.en: My brethren , be not many masters , knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ym dei shibun na phi ban long ki nonghikai . Kumba phi tip , ma ngi ki nonghikai ngin sa shah bishar kham pyrkhing ban ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Prepare the table , watch in the watchtower , eat , drink : arise , ye princes , and anoint the shield .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw la dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai ; ïa ki jaiñ rben la siang na ka bynta kiba shah khot sngewbha ba kin shong . Ki da ïabam bad ïadih . Kynsan la sawa ka hukum :  Ko rangbah shipai ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !

translation.en: But it shall come to pass , if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day  ; that all these curses shall come upon thee , and overtake thee :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad phim sumar hok ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ baroh ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , kine ki jingtim baroh kin sa ngat ha phi .

translation.en: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet , whether he eat little or much : but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep .
translation.kha: Ki nongtrei ki lah ne kim lah ban don kat ban biang ban bam , hynrei la kumno kumno ki ïoh ka jingïohthiah kaba bang . Pynban , kiba riewspah , ki don bun haduh katta katta ha kaba kim ïohthiah namar ka jingkhuslai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall  ; and the pride of her power shall come down : from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Naduh Migdol ha ka phang shatei haduh Aswan ha ka phang shathie , baroh ki nongkyrshan ïa ka Ijipt kin shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka kynhun shipai basarong jong ka Ijipt yn pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong : but I will suddenly make him run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ki khlaw barben artet ïa ka Jordan haduh ki jaka phlang bajyrngam , ngan wan bad ban pynlong ïa ki nong Edom ban phet krad kyndit na ka ri jong ki . Nangta u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Uno uba lah ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban ïakob bad nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?

translation.en: And Achish said , Whither have ye made a road to day ? And David said , Against the south of Judah , and against the south of the Jerahmeelites , and against the south of the Kenites .
translation.kha: Nangta u wan phai pat sha u Akhish , uba ju kylli ïa u ,  Phi la leit lute shano ha kane ka kynti ?  bad u Dabid ruh u ju ïathuh ïa u ba u la leit sha ka ri Judah kaba shathie , lane sha ka ri ki Jerahmeel , lane sha ka ri bashong ki Ken .

translation.en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved , that goeth down sweetly , causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ieit tang ïa kawei , bad ka long kaba i-ieit kum ka lyngdkhur . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong ka kmie , ka khun ba-ieit eh jong ka kmie . Baroh ki kynthei ki khmih ïa ka bad ki ïaroh ïa ka ; ki mahadei bad ki tnga kliar ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka .

translation.en: Peter said unto him , Though I should die with thee , yet will I not deny thee . Likewise also said all the disciples .
translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Da lei lei ngan ym ong ïa kata , wat lada nga dei ban ïap lem bad me !  Bad baroh kiwei pat ki synran ki la ïa-ong ïa kajuh .

translation.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs , even glory to the righteous . But I said , My leanness , my leanness , woe unto me ! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously  ; yea , the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously .
translation.kha: Na ki bynta bajngai tam ka pyrthei ngin ïohsngew ïa ki jingrwai jingïaroh ïa ki Israel , ka jaitbynriew bahok . Hynrei ym don jingkyrmen na ka bynta jong nga ! Nga shu duh lehnoh-ei ! Ki nongshetkylla ki ïai shetkylla , bad ka kam shyrkhei jong ki ka nang sniew nang sniew .

translation.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor , his throne shall be established for ever .
translation.kha: Lada u syiem u ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , un synshar slem .

translation.en: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom , and to see the business that is done upon the earth : ( for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes : )
translation.kha: Man ba nga pyrshang ban long stad bad ban tip kaei kaba jia ha ka pyrthei , nga la sngewthuh ba phi lah ban peitmat , miet la bad sngi

translation.en: And he prepared great provision for them : and when they had eaten and drunk , he sent them away , and they went to their master . So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Israel u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw na ka bynta jong ki ; bad ynda ki la bam la dih , u phah ba kin leit noh sha u syiem ka Syria . Naduh kata ka por ki Syria ki la sangeh ban wan lute ïa ka ri Israel .

translation.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary , and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation , and for the altar , and he shall make an atonement for the priests , and for all the people of the congregation .
translation.kha: bad un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , ïa ka duwan , ïa ki lyngdoh , bad ïa u paidbah baroh .

translation.en: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured , even thy merchants , from thy youth : they shall wander every one to his quarter  ; none shall save thee .
translation.kha: Kata ka long baroh kaba kin leh ïa pha — kito ki nongbatai kupar kiba pha la twad jingmut baroh shi jingim jong pha . Baroh na ki kin ieh ïa pha bad kin leit ha la ki lynti , bad yn ym don uba sah u ban pyllait im ïa pha .

translation.en: And it grieved me sore : therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad nga bret baroh shabar ïa ki tiar ki tar u Tobiah .

translation.en: And I will bring the land into desolation : and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri jong phi haduh ba ki nongshun jong phi kiba ïohknieh ïa ka kin da lyngngoh ngaiñ ïa ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: There the prisoners rest together  ; they hear not the voice of the oppressor .
translation.kha: Wat ki koidi ki ïoh jingsuk , ba ki la laitluid na ki jingshah hylla bad jingshah hukum tyngeh .

translation.en: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel : and when they joined battle , Israel was smitten before the Philistines : and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki tur ïaleh pyrshah bad hadien ka jingïaleh kaba jur ki jop ïa ki Israel bad ki pynïap ha ka madan thma kumba saw hajar ngut ki rangïapom .

translation.en: For I am with thee , and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee : for I have much people in this city .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa me , naba kiba bun ha kane ka nongbah ki long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: ( For they will come out after us ) till we have drawn them from the city  ; for they will say , They flee before us , as at the first : therefore we will flee before them .
translation.kha: Kin wan beh ïa ngi haduh ba ngin da ïalam ïa ki kham sha jngai na ka nongbah . Kin pyrkhat ba ngi la phet ïap na ki , kumba ngi leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle , and though thou set thy nest among the stars , thence will I bring thee down , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat la pha pynlong ïa la ka ïing shajrong kat ka skum pukni , khnang ba yn i kumba ka don hapdeng ki khlur , pynban ngan pynhiar ïa pha sha tbian .

translation.en: And he defiled Topheth , which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom , that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah ruh u la ñiewsang ïa ka Topheth , ka jaka mane thala ha Them Hinnom , khnang ba yn ym don uwei ruh u ban kñia ïa la u khun ne ka khun kum ka jingainguh thang ïa u blei Molekh .

translation.en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron , and spake , saying , Behold , we are thy bone and thy flesh .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki jait Israel ki la leit sha u Dabid ha Hebron bad ki ong ha u ,  Ngi dei ki para doh para snam jong phi .

translation.en: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel , and reigned ten years in Samaria .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Menahem u khun jong u Gadi u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar shiphew snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And see , if it goeth up by the way of his own coast to Beth–shemesh , then he hath done us this great evil : but if not , then we shall know that it is not his hand that smote us  ; it was a chance that happened to us .
translation.kha: Nangta peit kumno ka ïaid ; lada ka leit sha la ka ri Beth Shemesh , ka mut ba dei U Blei ki Israel uba la pynngat ha ngi ïa kane ka jingjynjar kaba sngewshyrkhei . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ngin sa tip ba ym dei ma u uba la phah ïa ka khlam ; ka dei kaba shu wan jia ryngkhat .

translation.en: And great multitudes came unto him , having with them those that were lame , blind , dumb , maimed , and many others , and cast them down at Jesus  feet  ; and he healed them :
translation.kha: Ki paidbah babun ki la wan sha u , ki da wallam bad ki ïa kiba dkoh , kiba matlah , kiba khrew , ki bymnang kren , bad kiwei pat ki briew kiba pang , ïa kiba ki la buh ha ki kjat jong U Jisu ; bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate , and the habitation forsaken , and left like a wilderness : there shall the calf feed , and there shall he lie down , and consume the branches thereof .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ba la kerkut ka don ha ka jingjot . La iehnoh kynjah ïa ka kum ka ri khlaw kynjah bym don ei ei . Ka la long ka jaka bam phlang jong ki masi , ha kaba ki lah ban shongthait bad bam phlang .

translation.en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even  ; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom : and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them  ; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground  ;
translation.kha: Haba kita ki ar ngut ki angel ki la poi ha Sodom ha ka por janmiet , u Lot u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka nongbah . Haba u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u ïeng joit ban leit ïashem ïa ki .

translation.en: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel , whom the Egyptians keep in bondage  ; and I have remembered my covenant .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki Israel , ïa kiba ki nong Ijipt ki la teh mraw , bad nga la kynmaw ïa la ka jutang .

translation.en: But if he thus say , I have no delight in thee  ; behold , here am I , let him do to me as seemeth good unto him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngewbha ïa nga — te , ai un leh ïa nga katba u ibit .

translation.en: And they that fed the swine fled , and told it in the city , and in the country . And they went out to see what it was that was done .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïa-ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor ha ka shnong bad ha ki jaka rep . Ki briew ki la wan ban khmih ïa kaei kaba la jia

translation.en: And Jehu went , and Jehonadab the son of Rechab , into the house of Baal , and said unto the worshippers of Baal , Search , and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the  Lord  , but the worshippers of Baal only .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Jehu da lade u leit rung shapoh ka templ ryngkat bad u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab , bad u ong ha kita ki briew hangta ,  Pynthikna ba tang ki nongmane ïa u Baal ki don bad ym don uno uno u nongmane ïa U  Trai  uba la wan shapoh .

translation.en: And delivered just Lot , vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked :
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa u Lot , u briew uba bha , uba la pisa jingmut da ka jinglong bajakhlia jong ki briew bymkheiñ ïa ka aiñ .

translation.en: And they that were sent went their way , and found even as he had said unto them .
translation.kha: Ki la nang leit ha la ka lynti bad ki la shem ïa kaei kaei baroh thik kumba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ïa ki .

translation.en: Wherefore he saith , Awake thou that sleepest , and arise from the dead , and Christ shall give thee light .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba la ong ,  To khie joit , me uba ïohthiah , bad to mih na kiba ïap , bad U Khrist un tyngshaiñ halor jong me .

translation.en: And Alammelech , and Amad , and Mishal  ; and reacheth to Carmel westward , and to Shihor–libnath  ;
translation.kha: ka Allam Melekh , ka Amad , bad ka Mishal . Ha ka phang sepngi ka kynjoh ïa ka Karmel bad Shihor Libnath .

translation.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead , and quickeneth them  ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will .
translation.kha: Kumba U Kpa u pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom U Khun u ai jingim ïa kito kiba u mon .

translation.en: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city , and that the smoke of the city ascended , then they turned again , and slew the men of Ai .
translation.kha: Haba u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki ïohi ba kita kiwei pat ki la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah bad ba ka la pluh , ki phai kylla bad ki sdang pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong ka Ai .

translation.en: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance ? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ s , let him of himself think this again , that , as he is Christ s , even so are we Christ s .
translation.kha: Phi khmih ïa kiei kiei kiba paw shabar . Hato don mano mano hangto uba dawa ne kaba dawa ïa lade ba phi dei jong U Khrist ? La kumno kumno , ai ba un pyrkhat biang shaphang ïa lade , namar ngi long ki jong U Khrist , kumba long ma u hi .

translation.en: Now after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them , and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u syiem Dabid u tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia bad u jop ïa ki . U shim noh na ka jingpynïaid jong ki ïa ka nongbah Gath bad ki nongrit ba don sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway : but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief .
translation.kha: Kohnguh borabor ïa U  Trai  bad phin long kiba suk . Lada phi long kiba eh dohnud , phin hap ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: There is another that beareth witness of me  ; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true .
translation.kha: Hynrei don uwei pat uba phla na ka bynta jong nga , bad nga tip ba ïa kaei kaba u ong shaphang jong nga ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: The flesh also , in which , even in the skin thereof , was a boil , and is healed ,
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u briew u mih tohjaw bad u la jem ,

translation.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together : they are firm in themselves  ; they cannot be moved .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ka bynta kaba jem ha ka snieh jong u ; ka long kaba eh bad kaba jwat kum ka nar .

translation.en: This charge I commit unto thee , son Timothy , according to the prophecies which went before on thee , that thou by them mightest war a good warfare ;
translation.kha: Ko Timothi , u khun jong nga , nga pynkhamti ha me ïa kane ka hukum , kaba katba kum ki ktien jong ka jingïathuhlypa ba la kren shaphang jong me ha ka por kaba la leit .

translation.en: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man s hand under their wings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba uwei pa uwei na kita ki kherub u don kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh ki thapniang jong ki .

translation.en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish , and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish , and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and one log of oil .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , un wallam ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang bad kawei ka langbrot kynthei kaba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , lai kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad kumba shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors , and thy lovers shall go into captivity : surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongïalam jong phi yn rong noh da ka lyer , kiba ïateh lok bad phi kin shah ring kum ki mraw ka thma ; ïa ka nongbah jong phi yn pynjahburom bad shah pynlehrain namar ki kam bymman baroh kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u long u shakri uba sniew , un ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong nga un wan slem ,

translation.en: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month : and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him .
translation.kha: Ka la long ha ka por tlang bad u syiem u dang shong ha ka ïingsyiem tlang ha khmat ka ding .

translation.en: God understandeth the way thereof , and he knoweth the place thereof .
translation.kha: Tang U Blei u tip ïa ka lynti , u tip ïa ka jaka hangno la shem ïa ka jingstad .

translation.en: I know also , my God , that thou triest the heart , and hast pleasure in uprightness . As for me , in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things : and now have I seen with joy thy people , which are present here , to offer willingly unto thee .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba me tynjuh ïa ka dohnud jong uwei pa uwei bad me sngewbha bad ki briew kiba im hok . Ha ka hok bad ka jinglong sngur nga la ai da ka mon sngewbha ïa kane baroh sha me , bad nga la ïohi katno ki briew jong me kiba la ïalumlang hangne ki kmen ban wanrah ki jingainguh sha me .

translation.en: And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the street which is called Straight , and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul , of Tarsus : for , behold , he prayeth ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Khreh bad leit sha ‘ Ka Lynti Ba-beit ,’ bad ha ka ïing jong u Judas kylli ïa u briew na Tarsos uba kyrteng u Saul .

translation.en: And some of them that stood by , when they heard it , said , Behold , he calleth Elias .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  To sngap , u khot ïa u Elijah !

translation.en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget  ; neither shall ye fear other gods .
translation.kha: bad phim dei ban klet ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  thy God will send the hornet among them , until they that are left , and hide themselves from thee , be destroyed .
translation.kha: Nalor kane U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi un phah ruh ïa u kyieng hapdeng jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa kito kiba lait im bad kiba phet rieh .

translation.en: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret  ; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki ban duwai ha U Blei ka bneng na ka bynta ka jingisynei bad ban kyrpad ïa u ban batai ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap lem bad kiwei pat ki nongai jingmut ha Babilon .

translation.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not : for with such sacrifices God is well pleased .
translation.kha: Wat klet ban lehbha bad ïarap uwei ïa uwei pat , namar kine ki long ki jingkñia kiba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus , what advantageth it me , if the dead rise not ? let us eat and drink ; for to morrow we die .
translation.kha: Lada nga la ïaleh bad ki  mradkhlaw  hangne ha Ephesos ha ki jingthmu briew , hato ka myntoi aïu ïa nga ? Hynrei lada ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , te , kumba don ka jingong ,  To ngin ïabam ngin ïadih , naba lashai ngin sa ïap .

translation.en: Come , let us make our father drink wine , and we will lie with him , that we may preserve seed of our father .
translation.kha: Ale ngin ïapyndih buaid ïa i pa bad ngin ïathiah lang bad i , khnang ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti na i .

translation.en: And many nations shall come , and say , Come , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , and to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for the law shall go forth of Zion , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad ki briew jong ki , kin ong ,  ïa ngin ïaleit sha u lum jong U  Trai  , sha ka Templ jong U Blei ki Israel . Naba un hikai ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai U  Trai  ka wan na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha la ki briew .

translation.en: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing : for Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , took of the accursed thing : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jinghukum U  Trai  ïa ki Israel ban ym shim na Jerikho ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ban pynjot thiaw , ym shym la kohnguh . U briew uba kyrteng u Akhan um shym la kohnguh ïa kata ka hukum , bad kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel . ( U Akhan u dei u khun jong u Karmi bad u ksiew jong u Sabdi , bad uba na ka kur Serah , kaba long shi bynta na ka jait Judah . )

translation.en: And David sent messengers , and took her  ; and she came in unto him , and he lay with her  ; for she was purified from her uncleanness : and she returned unto her house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la phah ki nonglamktien sha ka ; ki la wallam ïa ka sha u bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka . ( Ka dang shu lah pyndep ïa la ka jinglehniam pynkhuid kaba man u bnai . ) Nangta ka la leit phai sha ïing .

translation.en: While he spake these things unto them , behold , there came a certain ruler , and worshipped him , saying , My daughter is even now dead : but come and lay thy hand upon her , and she shall live .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , u rangbah synshar ki Jiw u la wan sha U , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ka khun jong nga ka dang shu ïap ; hynrei wan ban buh ïa ki kti jong me halor jong ka , bad kan im pat .

translation.en: And every little chamber was one reed long , and one reed broad  ; and between the little chambers were five cubits  ; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed .
translation.kha: Sha lyndet jong ka , ka don ka jaka ïaid ha kaba don lai tylli ki kamra ap phira ha baroh arliang . Kawei pa kawei ka kamra ap phira ka long kaba sawdong , lai mitar ha ki liang baroh bad ki kynroh hapdeng kita ki kamra ki rben ar mitar shiteng . Sha lyndet jong ki kamra ap phira ka don ka jaka ïaid kaba jrong lai mitar kaba poi sha ka kamra ban rung kaba phai marpyrshah ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And he took about five thousand men , and set them to lie in ambush between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of the city .
translation.kha: U shim kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah bad u buh ha kaba rieh ïa ki ha ka phang sepngi jong ka nongbah , hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel .

translation.en: Like a family , they live and work together , enjoy meals together , and study the Bible together in unity . —Psalm 133 :1 .
translation.kha: Kum Shiïing-shisem , ki im bad ki ïatreilang , ki ïa bam lang , bad pule lang ïa ka Baibl da ka jingïatylli . —Salm 133 :1 .

translation.en: Now then do it : for the  Lord  hath spoken of David , saying , By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines , and out of the hand of all their enemies .
translation.kha: Mynta , kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi . Kynmaw ba U  Trai  u la ong , ‘ Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Dabid u shakri jong nga ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel na ki Philistia bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun jong ki baroh .’

translation.en: Behold , the day of the  Lord  cometh , and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ha kaba U  Trai  un shong ha ka khet bishar ka la jan . Te ïa ka Jerusalem yn sa lute , bad ïa ka jinglute yn sa pynïabynta ha ka jingïohi jong phi .

translation.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men , then his wrath was kindled .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ba kita ki rangbah lai ngut kim shym lah ban ai jubab ïa u Job , u la bitar bad sdang ban kren .

translation.en: But he turned , and said unto Peter ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : thou art an offence unto me : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but those that be of men .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la ong ha u Petros ,  Khie noh na nga , ko Soitan ! Me long u maw jynthut ha ka lynti jong nga , namar kine ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei , hynrei na u briew .

translation.en: And he suffered no man to follow him , save Peter , and James , and John the brother of James .
translation.kha: Te um shym la shah ïano ïano ruh ban leit bad u , hynrei tang ïa u Petros bad u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis .

translation.en: And other fell on good ground , and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased  ; and brought forth , some thirty , and some sixty , and some an hundred .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ki symbai ki la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha , bad ki la shylluit , ki la san bad pynmih sohkew ; katto katne ki don laiphew tylli ki sohkew , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli bad kiwei pat shispah tylli .

translation.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts , saying , What manner of child shall this be ! And the hand of the Lord was with him .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la pyrkhat shaphang kata bad u la kylli ,  Aïu une u khunlung un long ?  Naba ka la long kaba shai ba ka bor jong U Trai ka la don halor jong u .

translation.en: Even if you cannot study for long periods , decide how much time you can set aside , and try not to let anything interfere .
translation.kha: Wat la phim lah ban pule kham slem , peit hi katno phi lah ban pule , bad wat ailad ïa kaei kaei ruh ban pynthut ïa ka jingpule jong phi .

translation.en: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month , and encamped in Gilgal , in the east border of Jericho .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la jam ïa ka Jordan ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba nyngkong bad ki la shong dara ha Gilgal , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerikho .

translation.en: And I looked , and there was none to help  ; and I wondered that there was none to uphold : therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me  ; and my fury , it upheld me .
translation.kha: Nga la lyngngoh haba nga khmih bad peit ba ym don uwei ruh u ban ïarap ïa nga . Hynrei ka jingbitar jong nga ka pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , bad nga ïoh ïa ka jingjop ïa lade hi .

translation.en: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain , according to the word of the  Lord  God of Israel , which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah , the son of Amittai , the prophet , which was of Gath–hepher .
translation.kha: U kurup pat ïa ka ri baroh kaba dei jong ki Israel , naduh ka Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei shaduh ka Duriaw Baïap ha ka phang shathie . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la kular lyngba u shakri jong u , u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Amittai , uba na Gath Hepher .

translation.en: He paweth in the valley , and rejoiceth in his strength : he goeth on to meet the armed men .
translation.kha: Ki thrang ban trud ïa ka khyndew ha ka jaka them ; ki mareh stet sha ka thma da la ka bor baroh .

translation.en: Remember , O  Lord  , the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem  ; who said , Rase it , rase it , even to the foundation thereof .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , kaei kaba ki Edom ki la leh ha ka sngi ba kurup ïa ka Jerusalem . To kynmaw kumno ki ïai-ong ,  To pynjot thiaw ïa ka !

translation.en: And he said , Whether they be come out for peace , take them alive  ; or whether they be come out for war , take them alive .
translation.kha: U hukum ,  Kem im ïa ki , kam pher la ki wan ban ïaleh ne pan ïasuk .

translation.en: And their houses shall be turned unto others , with their fields and wives together : for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ïing jong ki yn ai noh ha kiwei , bad kumta kan long ïa ki lyngkha jong ki bad ki tnga jong ki . Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ki briew jong kane ka ri .

translation.en: And Saul knew David s voice , and said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And David said , It is my voice , my lord , O king .
translation.kha: U Saul u sngewthuh ïa ka sur u Dabid , bad u kylli ,  Dabid , hato dei ma phi ko khun jong nga ?   Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ,  u Dabid u jubab .

translation.en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up , even from the dead  ; from whence also he received him in a figure .
translation.kha: U Abraham u da kheiñ ba U Blei u lah ban pynmihpat ïa u Isaak na ka jingïap — bad kum ban shu ong , u Abraham u la ïohpdiang pat ïa u Isaak na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And when I have broken the staff of your bread , ten women shall bake your bread in one oven , and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight : and ye shall eat , and not be satisfied .
translation.kha: Ngan ot noh ïa ka jingpynpoi jingbam jong phi , ba kumta shiphew ngut ki kynthei kin donkam tang kawei ka dpei ban shet ïa u kpu baroh uba ki don . Kin ïasam ïa uta u kpu da kaba shu thew , bad wat haba phi la bam lut ïa u ruh , phin dang thngan .

translation.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust , and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks .
translation.kha: Bret noh ïa ka ksiar jong phi , tep ïa ka ksiar babha tam jong phi ha ka phud jong ka wahduid ba la rngad .

translation.en: The Lord hath cast off his altar , he hath abhorred his sanctuary , he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces  ; they have made a noise in the house of the  Lord  , as in the day of a solemn feast .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingjot bakynjah mynta , ka Jerusalem ka kynmaw ïa la ka burom ba-itynnat kaba mynbarim . Haba ka hap ha ki nongshun , ym don mano mano ba wan ïarap ïa ka ; ki nongjop ïa ka ki la rkhie ha ka jingkyllon jong ka .

translation.en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon , throughout the houses of their fathers , by their families  ;
translation.kha: lem bad u Eliasaph u khun jong u Lael kum u rangbah kur .

translation.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth , in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth .
translation.kha: ( Ko Oholibah , pha kwah ban leh biang ïa ka jingjakhlia ïa kiba la pynrem ïa pha kum ka samla khynraw ha Ijipt , ha kaba ki rangbah ki ïalehkai bad ka shadem jong pha bad pha duh noh ïa la ka jinglong sotti . )

translation.en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire : this is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi , ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer . Ka kham bha shibun ban sngewhun bad kaei kaba phi don ban ïa kaba ïai kwah ïa kawei pat kaei kaei .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while they were slaying them , and I was left , that I fell upon my face , and cried , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Katba ka jingpynïap ka dang ïaid , nga la don hangta marwei . Nga dem khrup ha khyndew bad nga pyrta ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , hato me la bitar palat ïa ka Jerusalem ba men pynïap lut ïa baroh kiba dang sah ha Israel ?

translation.en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat , and let her fall off .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la ot noh ïa ki tyllai kiba bat ïa ka lieng rit bad ki la pyllait ïa ka .

translation.en: And Joab drew nigh , and the people that were with him , unto the battle against the Syrians : and they fled before him .
translation.kha: U Joab bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid shaphrang ban tur ïaleh , bad ki Syria ki phet krad .

translation.en: Therefore will I also deal in fury : mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice , yet will I not hear them .
translation.kha: Kin sa sngew ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga baroh ; ngan ym tyngkai ïa ki ne pyn-i ka jinglehisynei ei ei ïa ki . Kin kyang ha nga da ki jingduwai jam katba ki lah , hynrei ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .

translation.en: Therefore now ,  Lord  God of Israel , keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him , saying , There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel  ; so that thy children take heed to their way , that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga kyrpad ba men bat ruh ïa la ka kular kaba me la pynlong bad u kpa jong nga mynba me ïathuh ha u ba yn don borabor uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u , u ban synshar kum u syiem ki Israel , tang lada ki kohnguh ïa me kumba me la leh .

translation.en: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment : so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel .
translation.kha: U Absalom u leh kumne ïa uwei pa uwei u Israel uba wan sha u syiem ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar ; bad da kumta u ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon , nor any that come into Dagon s house , tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day .
translation.kha: ( Dei namar kata ba haduh mynta ruh ki lyngdoh u Dagon bad baroh kiba mane ïa u ha Ashdod ki ryngkang noh ïa kata ka jaka bad kim ju ïaid nalor jong ka . )

translation.en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling : likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
translation.kha: Ki shna ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ha rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na kita ki jingkah baroh ar tylli .

translation.en: And they came up into Judah , and brake into it , and carried away all the substance that was found in the king s house , and his sons also , and his wives  ; so that there was never a son left him , save Jehoahaz , the youngest of his sons .
translation.kha: Ki la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ki la lute ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad ki ïalam kum koidi ïa baroh ki tnga bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u syiem lait noh tang u Ahasaïah , u khun khatduh jong u .

translation.en: And when he came to the tower , he took them from their hand , and bestowed them in the house : and he let the men go , and they departed .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u lum ba u Elisha u shong , u Gehasi u la shim ïa ki ar tylli ki pla bad u la kit ïa ki shapoh ïing . Nangta u la phah noh ïa ki shakri jong u Naaman .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me  ; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha , uno uno uba pdiang ïa uno uno uba nga phah , u pdiang ïa nga ruh ; bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa nga , u pdiang ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand , but the goats on the left .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa ki briew kiba hok sha ka liang kamon jong u bad ïa kiwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .

translation.en: But by an equality , that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want , that their abundance also may be a supply for your want : that there may be equality :
translation.kha: Ngam pyrshang ban pynsting ïa kiwei da kaba buh ïa ka jingkit kaba khia halor jong phi ; hynrei namar ba phi don kyrhai ha kane ka por , kaba long kaba biang ba phi dei ban ïarap ïa kito kiba kyrduh . Te , haba phi kyrduh bad ma ki pat ki don kyrhai , kin ïarap ïa phi . Ha kane ka rukom yn ïoh ñiew mar ryngkat ïa phi bad ïa ki .

translation.en: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls , and with his axes he shall break down thy towers .
translation.kha: Kin tied ha ki kynroh jong pha da ki dieng pynpra kynroh bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha da ki nar rod .

translation.en: They shall not make baldness upon their head , neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard , nor make any cuttings in their flesh .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh um dei ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhkhlieh , lane khap ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh , lane pynmong ïa la ka met .

translation.en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , give me this water , that I thirst not , neither come hither to draw .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  kata ka briew ka la ong ,  to ai ha nga ïa kata ka um ! Te ngan ym sliang shuh , lymne ngan hap wan shane ban tong um .

translation.en: Then said the princes of the Philistines , What do these Hebrews here ? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines , Is not this David , the servant of Saul the king of Israel , which hath been with me these days , or these years , and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia haba ki ïohi ïa ki , ki kylli ,  Kine ki Hebru ki wan leh aïu hangne ?  U Akhish u jubab ,  Une u dei u Dabid , uba ju long u shakri jong u Saul , u syiem Israel . La kham slem mynta u la don ryngkat bad nga . Naduh ba u la wan phet sha nga , haduh kane ka sngi , ngam shym lap ba u la leh bakla ei ei .

translation.en: Hath oppressed the poor and needy , hath spoiled by violence , hath not restored the pledge , and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols , hath committed abomination ,
translation.kha: U shukor ïa kiba duk , u lute , u bat noh ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U leit sha ki jaka mane blei thala , da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli ,

translation.en: Then the priest shall look on him : and , behold , if the scall be spread in the skin , the priest shall not seek for yellow hair  ; he is unclean .
translation.kha: u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa u . Lada kata ka prum ka la pur shisha , um donkam ban da khmih sa ïa u shñiuh ba lam stem ; ka la paw shai hi ba u long u bymkhuid .

translation.en: Is it not yet a very little while , and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field , and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest ?
translation.kha: Kumba ka don ka jingong , kan ym slem ba ka khlaw barben kan sa long ka jaka rep , bad ka jaka rep kan sa long pat ka khlaw .

translation.en: Wash thyself therefore , and anoint thee , and put thy raiment upon thee , and get thee down to the floor : but make not thyself known unto the man , until he shall have done eating and drinking .
translation.kha: Te sum sleh ïa lade , sleh ki jingiwbih , bad phong ki jaiñ kiba bha tam . Nangta leit sha ka jaka ba u dung kew ; hynrei wat ai ba un tip ba phi don hangta tad haduh ba un da dep bam dep dih .

translation.en: Who can find a virtuous woman ? for her price is far above rubies .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba eh ban shem ïa ka tnga kaba lah ! ka dor jong ka , ka kham kor shibun ban ïa ki mawkordor .

translation.en: We'll go to any length to send our child to a good university .
translation.kha: Ngin leh katba lah ban phah ia i khun jongngi sha ka iuniversity ba bha .

translation.en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah ki la shetkylla la biang ïa nga , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: The same material is studied in every one of our more than 110 ,000 congregations earth wide .
translation.kha: Baroh ki balang kiba don palat 1 ,10 ,000 tylli ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki ïa pule ïa kajuh ka bynta .

translation.en: She is more precious than rubies : and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka kham kordor shibun ban ïa ki mawlynnai ; ym don kano kano ruh na ka jingkwah jong phi ba lah ban ïanujor bad ka .

translation.en: But brother goeth to law with brother , and that before the unbelievers .
translation.kha: Pynban , uwei u parabangeit u leit sha ka ïingbishar pyrshah ïa uwei pat bad u ailad ïa u bymngeit ban bishar ïa ka kam!

translation.en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah : and the men of war , mighty men of valour , were in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka Judah u tei ki kut bad ki nongbah , ha kiba la buh bun bah ki mar ki mata . Ha Jerusalem , u buh ki rangbah synshar kiba tbit bha , kat kum ki kur jong ki .

translation.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a certain man clothed in linen , whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz :
translation.kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei uba kup ki jaiñ linen bad u panpoh ksiar nylla .

translation.en: Because they ministered unto them before their idols , and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity  ; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them , saith the Lord  God  , and they shall bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki la leh ïa ka jingmane ïa ki bleithaw na ka bynta ki paid Israel bad ba ha kane ka rukom ki la ïalam ïa ki paidbah sha ka pop , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga smai kyntang ba dei ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And he said , Take the arrows . And he took them . And he said unto the king of Israel , Smite upon the ground . And he smote thrice , and stayed .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ban shim ïa ki khnam kiba dang sah bad pduh ïa ka khyndew da ki . U syiem u pduh ïa ka khyndew lai sien , bad nangta u sangeh .

translation.en: At the same time spake the  Lord  by Isaiah the son of Amoz , saying , Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins , and put off thy shoe from thy foot . And he did so , walking naked and barefoot .
translation.kha: Lai snem mynshuwa , U  Trai  u la ong ïa u Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ban loit noh ïa ki juti jong u bad ïa ka jaiñ khain kaba u phong . U la kohnguh bad u la ïaid lyngkhuit bad da ka kjat suda .

translation.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard , very costly , and anointed the feet of Jesus , and wiped his feet with her hair : and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment .
translation.kha: Te ka Mari ka la shim shiteng litar ka jingiwbih kaba remdor bha ïa kaba la shna na u nard bakynsai , ka la theh ïa ka ha ki kjat U Jisu , bad ka la ñiad ïa ki kjat jong u da u shñiuh khlieh jong ka . Ka jingsma basngewtynnat na ka jingiwbih ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he called the name of that place Beth–el : but the name of that city was called Luz at the first .
translation.kha: U khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Bethel . ( Ïa ka shnong kaba don hangta la tip shisien kum ka Lus . )

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the seventh month , that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama , of the seed royal , and the princes of the king , even ten men with him , came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah  ; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai uba hynñiew jong kata ka snem , u Ishmael , u khun jong u Nethanaïah bad u ksiew jong u Elishama , u dkhot ka longïing syiem bad uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba hakhlieh duh jong u syiem , u la leit sha Mispah lem bad shiphew ngut ki rangbah ban peit ïa u Gedalaïah .

translation.en: Take you wise men , and understanding , and known among your tribes , and I will make them rulers over you .
translation.kha: Jied na kawei kawei ka jait ïa ki briew kiba stad , kiba shemphang , bad kiba rangbah jingmut , bad ngan thung ïa ki kum ki nongbishar ki ban peit halor ïa phi .’

translation.en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death .
translation.kha: Namar ka hukum jong U Mynsiem kaba wallam ka jingim ïa ngi ha U Khrist Jisu , ka la pyllait ïa nga na ka hukum jong ka pop bad ka jingïap .

translation.en: And there was Mary Magdalene , and the other Mary , sitting over against the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka nong Magdala , bad kawei pat ka Mari , ki la shong hangta marpyrshah ïa ka jingtep .

translation.en: Now Jesus loved Martha , and her sister , and Lazarus .
translation.kha: U Jisu u ieit ïa ka Martha , ïa ka para jong ka , bad ïa u Lasaros .

translation.en: And it was told Joab , Behold , the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Joab ba u Syiem Dabid u jaw ummat bad u ïambriew na ka bynta u Absalom .

translation.en: Adam passed on sin to all his children .
translation.kha: Na u Adam ka la hiar pateng ka pop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u baroh .

translation.en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel , Give counsel among you what we shall do .
translation.kha: Nangta u Absalom u phai sha u Ahithophel bad u ong ,  Mynta ba ngi don hangne , kaei ka jingai jingmut jong phi ïa ngi ban leh ?

translation.en: I know it is so of a truth : but how should man be just with God ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la ïohsngew ïa kata baroh mynshuwa . Hynrei da kumno u briew u lah ban jop ïa ka kam jong u pyrshah ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying  ; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths , and fulfilled with your hand , saying , We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed , to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her : ye will surely accomplish your vows , and surely perform your vows .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki briew baroh , khamtam ïa ki kynthei , ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha ki paid Judah kiba sah ha Ijipt :  Ma phi bad ki tnga jong phi , phi la pynlong ki jingkular bakyntang ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng . Phi la kular ba phin ai ki jingkñia ha ka bad ban theh ka jingainguh waiñ ha ka , bad phi la bat ïa la ki jingkular . Ka long kaba bha keiñ ! To bat ïa la ki jingkular ! Pyndep ïa la ki jingsmai !

translation.en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
translation.kha: bad beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi , kumba u la kular .

translation.en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation , and offerings .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la don bun snem shabar na Jerusalem , nga la leit shata ban rah katto katne ka pisa sha ki briew jong nga bad ban ai ki jingkñia .

translation.en: Awake to righteousness , and sin not ; for some have not the knowledge of God : I speak this to your shame .
translation.kha: To kynditbynriew sha ka lynti jong ka jing hok bad nai leh pop . Nga pynbna ba phin lehrain ba don hapdeng jong phi ki bymtip ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And his disciples came , and took up the body , and buried it , and went and told Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïawan , ki la bah ïa ka met jong u , bad ki la tep ïa ka ; nangta ki la leit bad ïathuh ha U Jisu .

translation.en: Ye shall not offer unto the  Lord  that which is bruised , or crushed , or broken , or cut  ; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land .
translation.kha: Wat kñia sha U  Trai  ïa uno uno u jingri uba la shah shohdab ne shah puid . Ym dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold .
translation.kha: U Hiram u la phah sha u Solomon palat ïa ka saw hajar kilo ka ksiar .

translation.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron , and of the anointing of his sons , out of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , in the day when he presented them to minister unto the  Lord  in the priest s office  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka bynta jong ka jingbam ba la ainguh sha U  Trai  ïa kaba la ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun jong u ha kata ka sngi ba pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: Her husband is known in the gates , when he sitteth among the elders of the land .
translation.kha: U tnga jong ka u long uba la ithuh bha , bad u long uwei na ki nongshong shnong uba pawkhmat .

translation.en: He will come .
translation.kha: Yn sa wan ma u .

translation.en: And the evil spirit answered and said , Jesus I know , and Paul I know  ; but who are ye ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u mynsiem bymman u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ithuh ïa U Jisu , bad nga tip shaphang u Paul ; hynrei ma phi — phi dei kiei ?

translation.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein , for the fruit of their doings .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long kum ka ri shyiap namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong ha ka .

translation.en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment : and as many as touched were made perfectly whole .
translation.kha: Ki la kyrpad ïa u ba un shah ïa kito kiba pang la kumno kumno ban ïohktah ïa ka tduh jong ka jaiñkup jong u ; bad ïa baroh kito kiba la ktah ïa ka la pynkhiah .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise , O ye servants of the  Lord  , praise the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Phi ki shakri jong U  Trai  ; to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !

translation.en: Also , that the soul be without knowledge , it is not good  ; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth .
translation.kha: Ka jingshitrhem khlem ka jingtip kam long kaba bha ; ka jingbymïaishah kan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it .
translation.kha: Teh ïa kiwei pat ki tduh jong kita ki kynjri ha ki ar tylli ki shrong , bad ha kane ka rukom pynsnoh ïa ki sha khmat ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod .

translation.en: Be not righteous over much  ; neither make thyself over wise : why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
translation.kha: Kumta te wat long uba bha palat ne uba stad palat — balei yn pynïap ïa lade hi ?

translation.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment ? wilt thou condemn me , that thou mayest be righteous ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrshang ban pynshisha ba nga long u bymhok — ban buh ïa nga ha ka bymdei bad ïa lade ha kaba dei ?

translation.en: But ye have a custom , that I should release unto you one at the passover : will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kat kum ka rukom kaba phi don , nga ju pyllait ïa u koidi ha phi ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Phi kwah ïa nga ba ngan pyllait ha phi ïa u syiem ki Jiw ?

translation.en: Then said some of them of Jerusalem , Is not this he , whom they seek to kill ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  Hato um dei une u briew ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki ïawad ban pynïap ?

translation.en: And he said unto her , Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite , and said unto him , Give me thy vineyard for money  ; or else , if it please thee , I will give thee another vineyard for it : and he answered , I will not give thee my vineyard .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Namar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ïa nga . Nga la tyrwa ban thied ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong u , lane , lada u sngewdei , ban ai ïa u da kawei pat ha ka jaka jong ka , hynrei u ong ïa nga ba ngam lah ban ïoh ïa ka !

translation.en: Watch ye , stand fast in the faith , quit you like men , be strong .
translation.kha: To sharai , to ïeng skhem ha ka jingngeit , to long shlur , to long kiba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Can a maid forget her ornaments , or a bride her attire ? yet my people have forgotten me days without number .
translation.kha: Hato ka samla kan klet ïa ki jingdeng jong ka , lane ka nongleitkurim ïa ka jaiñ kyntiew kurim jong ka ? Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la klet ïa nga bun bun sngi ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew .

translation.en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas , Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord , and see how they do .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Paul u la ong ïa u Barnabas ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai pat bad leit jngoh ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi ha man la ka shnong ha kaba ngi la ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai , bad to ngin wad kumno ki ïalong .

translation.en: Ye are blessed of the  Lord  which made heaven and earth .
translation.kha: To phin long kiba la kyrkhu da U  Trai  , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Thou hast heard their reproach , O  Lord  , and all their imaginations against me  ;
translation.kha: Me la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki krenbeiñ ïa nga , A  Trai  ; me tip ïa baroh ki jingïasylla jong ki .

translation.en: But I say unto you , I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine , until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father s kingdom .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh ïa kane ka waiñ tad haduh ka sngi ba nga dih ïa ka waiñ thymmai bad phi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong nga .

translation.en: For your hands are defiled with blood , and your fingers with iniquity  ; your lips have spoken lies , your tongue hath muttered perverseness .
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la rem namar ka jinglamler , ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpynïap briew .

translation.en: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost .
translation.kha: Namar U Khun U Briew u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew kiba la jah noh .

translation.en: Hear ye , and give ear  ; be not proud : for the  Lord  hath spoken .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u la kren ! To pynrit bad shahshkor ïa u .

translation.en: But when the morning was now come , Jesus stood on the shore : but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus .
translation.kha: Katba nang mih ka sngi , U Jisu u la ïeng halor ryngkew , hynrei ki synran kim ithuh ba dei U Jisu .

translation.en: And David arose , and came to the place where Saul had pitched : and David beheld the place where Saul lay , and Abner the son of Ner , the captain of his host : and Saul lay in the trench , and the people pitched round about him .
translation.kha: U leit mar mar ban tip thik ïa ka jaka ha kaba u Saul bad u Abner , u khun jong u Ner , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul ki thiah . U Saul u thiah hapdeng ka jaka sher dara , bad sawdong jong u ki briew jong u ki shong dara .

translation.en: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name .
translation.kha: Te , uno uno um lah ban ong , ba la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong nga .

translation.en: They were confounded because they had hoped  ; they came thither , and were ashamed .
translation.kha: hynrei ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka ïap harud ki wahduid ba-tyrkhong .

translation.en: Because of the mountain of Zion , which is desolate , the foxes walk upon it .
translation.kha: namar u lum Seïon u long kynjah bad u la shah iehnoh , bad ki myrsiang khlaw ki shang kylleng lyngba ki jingpra jong u .

translation.en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully : for he shall come up , and shall become strong with a small people .
translation.kha: Da kaba pynlong ki jingïateh lok , un shukor ïa kiwei ki hima , bad un nang khlaiñ bad nang khlaiñ , wat la u synshar tang ïa ka hima kaba rit .

translation.en: These are they which were not defiled with women  ; for they are virgins . These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth . These were redeemed from among men , being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb .
translation.kha: Ki long ki rangbah kiba la ri khuid ïa lade khlem ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei ; ki long ki rangsotti . Ki bud ïa U Khunlangbrot kat shaba u leit . La siewspah ïa ki napdeng u khunbynriew bad ki long kiba nyngkong ïa kiba la ainguh ha U Blei bad ha u Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Kum u kpa jong u ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol : and their brethren said unto them , What say ye ?
translation.kha: Haba kita ki rangbah san ngut ki leit phai sha Sorah bad Eshtaol , ki para ri jong ki , ki kylli , kaei kaba ki la shem .

translation.en: And David said to Saul , Wherefore hearest thou men s words , saying , Behold , David seeketh thy hurt ?
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Balei phi sngap ïa ki briew kiba ong ba nga pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa phi ?

translation.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots .
translation.kha: Ki jingpyrta jong ki maji ba ngam jyllop ki sawa ha ka rud duriaw .

translation.en: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years  ; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria  ; and I will defend this city for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ba men im tam sa khatsan snem . Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ïa kane ka nongbah Jerusalem na u patsha ka Assyria . Ngan ïada ïa kane ka nongbah , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .

translation.en: Go , and say to Hezekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will add unto thy days fifteen years .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Isaïah ban leit pat sha u Hesekaïah ban ong ha u ,  Nga , U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kpa tymmen jong me u Dabid , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me bad ïohi ïa ki ummat jong me ; ngan shah pat ïa me ban im sa khatsan snem .

translation.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away : they shall take to themselves their curtains , and all their vessels , and their camels  ; and they shall cry unto them , Fear is on every side .
translation.kha: Knieh ïa ki ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingri jong ki , ïa ki pyrda jong ka ïingjaiñ bad baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . Shim ïa ki ut jong ki bad ong ïa ki briew , ‘ Ka jingma ka don baroh sawdong jong phi .’

translation.en: And judgment is come upon the plain country  ; upon Holon , and upon Jahzah , and upon Mephaath ,
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar ka la wan ha ki nongbah jong ki sharing lum : ha ka Holon , Jahsah , Mephath ,

translation.en: At some time in your life , you have likely asked , ‘ Why all the suffering ?’
translation.kha: Teng teng ha ka jingim jong phi , phi la ju kylli , ‘ Balei kein katne katne ki jingjynjar ?’

translation.en: And when they had found him , they said unto him , All men seek for thee .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la shem ïa u , ki la ong ,  Baroh ki ïawad ïa me .

translation.en: Which , when it was full , they drew to shore , and sat down , and gathered the good into vessels , but cast the bad away .
translation.kha: Haba ka jar ka la dap , ki la tan ïa ka sharud duriaw bad ki la ïashong ban pynbynta ïa ki dohkha : ïa kiba bha sha ki jingdiang jong ki , bad ïa ki bymmyntoi la bret noh .

translation.en: And when she had brought them unto him to eat , he took hold of her , and said unto her , Come lie with me , my sister .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang ai ïa ki ha u , u la bat trait ïa ka bad u ong ,  Ale thiah lang bad nga !

translation.en: And , behold , there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years , and was bowed together , and could in no wise lift up herself .
translation.kha: Kawei ka briew hangta ka la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlong ïa ka ban shitom haduh khatphra snem ; ka la kdor ryngkdung bad kam lah ban pynbeit shuh .

translation.en: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err , and to do worse than the heathen , whom the  Lord  had destroyed before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u ïalam ïa ki paid Judah ban leh ïa ki pop kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang .

translation.en: And when we were come to Jerusalem , the brethren received us gladly .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha Jerusalem , ki parabangeit ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Miriam the prophetess , the sister of Aaron , took a timbrel in her hand  ; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances .
translation.kha: Te ka Miriam ka nongïathuhlypa , ka para jong u Aaron , ka la shim ïa la ka kanjari , bad ki kynthei baroh ruh ki la ïabud nadien jong ka , ki da tem ïa ki kanjari , bad ki da ïashad ruh .

translation.en: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring , in goodly apparel , and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment  ;
translation.kha: Tharai u briew uba riewspah uba deng ïa ka sati ksiar bad uba riam da ki jaiñ kiba kynsai u wan rung sha ka jingïalang jong phi , bad u briew uba duk ha ki jaiñjot ruh u wan .

translation.en: Receive , I pray thee , the law from his mouth , and lay up his words in thine heart .
translation.kha: Pdiang ïa ki jinghikai ba u ai ; buh ïa ki ktien jong u ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: And the Philistines came up yet again , and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Philistia ki leit phai pat sha ka Them Rephaim bad ki knieh biang ïa ka .

translation.en: They shall lament for the teats , for the pleasant fields , for the fruitful vine .
translation.kha: To tied ïa la ki shadem ha ka jingsngewsih namar ki lyngkha baseisoh bad ki bri sohwaiñ ki la shah pynjot ,

translation.en: And his brightness was as the light  ; he had horns coming out of his hand : and there was the hiding of his power .
translation.kha: U wan bad ka jingthaba ka leilieh ; ka jingshai ka phalang na ka kti jong u , dei hangta ba ka bor jong u ka rieh .

translation.en: Let them alone : they be blind leaders of the blind . And if the blind lead the blind , both shall fall into the ditch .
translation.kha: Wat khuslai shaphang jong ki ! Ki long ki nongïalam bamatlah jong kiba matlah ; bad haba uwei u briew uba matlah u ïalam ïa uwei pat , baroh ar ngut ki hap sha ka kharai .

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , Concerning the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , even these are my feasts .
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki Jingkhawai Niam , haba ki paid Israel ki ïalumlang ban mane Blei .

translation.en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , ki briew jong ka hima bashatei ka Israel ki ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid .

translation.en: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah . And it came to pass in the month Chisleu , in the twentieth year , as I was in Shushan the palace ,
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa kaei kaba u Nehemaïah u khun jong u Hakalaïah u la pyndep . Ha u bnai Kisleb jong ka snem kaba arphew ba u Artakserksis u long u patsha ka Persia , ma nga , u Nehemaïah , nga don ha ka nongbah jong ka hima , ka Susa .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will not forsake his people for his great name s sake : because it hath pleased the  Lord  to make you his people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ka jingkular kaba kyntang bad un ym iehnoh ïa phi namar u la rai ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Peter said unto him , Lord , why cannot I follow thee now ? I will lay down my life for thy sake .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , balei ngam lah ban bud ïa me mynta ?  u Petros u la kylli .  Nga kloi ban ïap na ka bynta jong me !

translation.en: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin : but yield yourselves unto God , as those that are alive from the dead , and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God .
translation.kha: Lymne ba phi dei ban pyndem ïa kano kano ka bynta jong phi sha ka pop ha ka jingpyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingthmu bymman . Pynban , phi dei ban ai ïa lade sha U Blei , kum kito ïa kiba la wallam pat na ka jingïap sha ka jingim , bad ban pyndem ha u ïa la ka jingim baroh kawei , ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingthmu bahok .

translation.en: And every island fled away , and the mountains were not found .
translation.kha: Baroh ki dewlynnong ki la jah , baroh ki lumbah kim don shuh .

translation.en: Is my strength the strength of stones ? or is my flesh of brass ?
translation.kha: Hato la thaw ïa nga na u maw ? Hato ka met jong nga ka dei ka rnong ?

translation.en: And it was the third hour , and they crucified him .
translation.kha: Ka la long khyndai baje mynstep mynba ki la sahnarphna ïa u .

translation.en: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel , and there shall be none to bury her . And he opened the door , and fled .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Jesebel yn ym tep ; ïa ka met jong ka yn bam da ki ksew ha ka thain jong ka Jesreel .’   Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u nongïathuhlypa samla u la mihnoh na ka kamra bad u la phet ïap .

translation.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth  ; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee ?
translation.kha: bad kin hikai ïa phi kaei ka jingshisha ka long . Nangta haba la phah ïa phi ban shem ïa ka , phin wanrah ïa ka jubab kaba dei .

translation.en: For , behold , the darkness shall cover the earth , and gross darkness the people : but the  Lord  shall arise upon thee , and his glory shall be seen upon thee .
translation.kha: Ïa kiwei pat ki ri yn tap da ka jingdum , hynrei ha phi ka jingshai U  Trai  ka tyngshaiñ ; ka jingphyrnai ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan long bad phi .

translation.en: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver , which I had given thee , and madest to thyself images of men , and didst commit whoredom with them ,
translation.kha: Pha la shim ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad rupa jong pha kiba nga lah ai ha pha , ban thaw ki durblei shynrang , bad leh awria bad ki .

translation.en: If it please the king , let there go a royal commandment from him , and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes , that it be not altered , That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus  ; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she .
translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa u Syiem , pynmih ka jingpynbna syiem ba ka Bashti kan ym lah shuh ban wan ha khmat u syiem . Hukum ban thoh ïa kata ha ki aiñ jong ka Persia bad Media , khnang ba kata kan ym kylla shuh . Nangta ai ïa ka jaka jong ka kum ka mahadei sha kano kano ka kynthei kaba kham bha .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Is it not written in your law , I said , Ye are gods ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  La thoh ha ka hukum jong phi hi ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Phi long ki blei .’

translation.en: Can thine heart endure , or can thine hands be strong , in the days that I shall deal with thee ? I the  Lord  have spoken it , and will do it .
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin dang don ka jingshlur kaba sah lane phin dang donbor kat ban rah ïa la ka kti ynda nga la pyndep bad phi ? Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren , bad nga bat ïa la ka ktien .

translation.en: And the thing which he did displeased the  Lord  : wherefore he slew him also .
translation.kha: Kata kaba u leh ka la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u la pynïap noh ïa u ruh .

translation.en: But if a woman have long hair , it is a glory to her : for her hair is given her for a covering .
