translation.kha: Balei , ka jinglong tynrai hi ka hikai ïa phi ba u shñiuh uba jrong ha u briew u long ka jingjahburom , hynrei ha ka briew u long ka burom ba-itynnat . Ïa u shñiuh uba jrong la ai ha ka ban long kum ka jingtap ïa ka khlieh .

translation.en: Even as they delivered them unto us , which from the beginning were eyewitnesses , and ministers of the word  ;
translation.kha: Ki la thoh ïa kaei kaba la ïathuh ha ngi da kito kiba la ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh naduh kaba sdang bad kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: And he said unto me , O Daniel , a man greatly beloved , understand the words that I speak unto thee , and stand upright : for unto thee am I now sent . And when he had spoken this word unto me , I stood trembling .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Daniel , U Blei u ieit ïa me . Ïeng joit bad to shahshkor biang biang ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Ïa nga la phah sha me .  Haba u la lah ong ïa kane , nga la ïeng , nga dang khynñiuh hi .

translation.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together , and went over , and pitched in the valley of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Midian , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki ïalumlang baroh , ki jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan , bad ki sher dara ha ka Them Jesreel .

translation.en: As God liveth , who hath taken away my judgment  ; and the Almighty , who hath vexed my soul  ;
translation.kha: Nga smai da U Blei Ba-im Badonbor Baroh , Uba kyntait ïa ka hok ïa nga bad uba pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang —

translation.en: In the end of the sabbath , as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week , came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Hadien ka sngi Sabbaton katba ka step Sngi U Blei ka dang kynjat shai , ka Mari ka nong Magdala , bad kawei pat ka Mari ki la leit ban khmih ïa ka jingtep .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Make thee a fiery serpent , and set it upon a pole : and it shall come to pass , that every one that is bitten , when he looketh upon it , shall live .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ban shna u bseiñ rnong bad wah ïa u ha u dieng , kumta ba uno uno uba shah puh bseiñ u lah ban peit sha u bad un koit .

translation.en: And all that handle the oar , the mariners , and all the pilots of the sea , shall come down from their ships , they shall stand upon the land  ;
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka liengbah ka la shah iehnoh mynta , bad uwei pa uwei u maji u la poi sha ryngkew .

translation.en: Or if I send a pestilence into that land , and pour out my fury upon it in blood , to cut off from it man and beast :
translation.kha: Lada nga phah ïa ka khlam ha kata ka ri bad ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga shim noh bun ki mynsiem , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ,

translation.en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour s wife , neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour s house , his field , or his manservant , or his maidservant , his ox , or his ass , or any thing that is thy neighbour s .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; wat ikwah ïa ka ïing jong u , ïa ka jaka jong u , ïa ki mraw jong u , ïa ki masi jong u , ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ka jong u .’

translation.en: Now therefore put away , said he , the strange gods which are among you , and incline your heart unto the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Te kumta , iehnoh syndon ïa kito ki blei nongwei kiba phi don ,  u la dawa ,  bad kular skhem ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , when Solomon had built the two houses , the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house ,
translation.kha: Ka shim por arphew snem ïa u Solomon ban tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .

translation.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath : and behold every one that is proud , and abase him .
translation.kha: To khmih sha kito kiba sarong ; theh ïa ka jingbitar jong me bad pynpoh ïa ki .

translation.en: But the multitude of the city was divided : and part held with the Jews , and part with the apostles .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka nongbah ki la long arliang : Katto katne ngut ki la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , kiwei pat na ka bynta ki apostol .

translation.en: And the manna was as coriander seed , and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium .
translation.kha: ( Ka manna ka long kum ki symbai kiba rit bad kaba lam byrlieh stem ha ka rong .

translation.en: What can I do ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngan hap leh ?

translation.en: Depart ye , depart ye , go ye out from thence , touch no unclean thing  ; go ye out of the midst of her  ; be ye clean , that bear the vessels of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To pynthikna phi baroh kiba mih na Babilon , phi baroh kiba rah ïa ki tiar ka templ ! Wat ktah ïa kaba la mana ; ri khuid ïa lade bad mihnoh .

translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad , and because of thy bondwoman  ; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee , hearken unto her voice  ; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Wat khuslai na ka bynta uta u khynnah bad na ka bynta ka Hagar ka mraw jong me . Leh ïa kaei kaba ka Sarah ka ong ha me , namar na u Isaak men sa ïoh ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .

translation.en: And on the third day eleven bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ai khatwei tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And when it was told Saul , he sent other messengers , and they prophesied likewise . And Saul sent messengers again the third time , and they prophesied also .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , u phah kham bun shuh shuh ki nongrah-khubor , bad kita ruh ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa . U phah ki nongrah-khubor ha ka sien kaba lai , bad kajuh ka la jia ha ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Isaac was old , and his eyes were dim , so that he could not see , he called Esau his eldest son , and said unto him , My son : and he said unto him , Behold , here am I .
translation.kha: U Isaak mynta u la tymmen bad u la kylla matlah . U la phah khot ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Iso u bad u ong ïa u ,  Ko khun !   Oi ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And thou shalt bring in the table , and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it  ; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick , and light the lamps thereof .
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka miej bad buh ryntih ïa ki tiar jong ka ha ka . Wanrah ruh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad buh hangta ïa ki sharak jong u .

translation.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath , to observe the sabbath throughout their generations , for a perpetual covenant .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sumar ïa kane ka sngi kum ka dak jong ka jutang .

translation.en: And it shall be said in that day , Lo , this is our God  ; we have waited for him , and he will save us : this is the  Lord   ; we have waited for him , we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation .
translation.kha: Haba kane kan jia , baroh kin ong ,  U long U Blei jong ngi ! Ngi la buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ngi ha u , bad u la pyllait im ïa ngi . U long U  Trai  ! Ngi la buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u , bad mynta ngi kmen namar ba u la pynim ïa ngi .

translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab , and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth : and Moab shall die with tumult , with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet :
translation.kha: Ngan phah ka ding ha ka ri Moab bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Kerioth . Ki briew ka Moab kin ïap hapdeng ka jingkhynwin jong ka thma katba ki shipai ki dang khynwin bad ki turoi ki dang sawa .

translation.en: Then said Zebul unto him , Where is now thy mouth , wherewith thou saidst , Who is Abimelech , that we should serve him ? is not this the people that thou hast despised ? go out , I pray now , and fight with them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sebul u ong ha u ,  Shano kato ka jingkren kob jong me ? Dei ma me uba ong balei ngin shakri ïa une u Abimelekh . Kine ki dei ki briew kiba me la krenbeiñ . Khie mih mynta bad ïaleh ïa ki .

translation.en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines : and the Philistines went to their own place .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Saul u la sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , bad ki la leit phai noh sha la ka ri .

translation.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth ? or who hath disposed the whole world ?
translation.kha: Hato U Blei u ïoh ka bor na uwei pat ? Hato don uno uno uba buh ïa u ban peit halor ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: And the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their houses , and all the men that appertained unto Korah , and all their goods .
translation.kha: bad ka la nguid ïa ki bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , lem bad ïa ki nongbud jong u Korah baroh bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki .

translation.en: And they said , Is not this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? how is it then that he saith ,  I came down from heaven ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ,  Hato une u briew um dei U Jisu , u khun jong u Joseph ? Ngi ithuh ïa u kpa bad ïa ka kmie jong u . Kumno te , ba u ong mynta ba u la wan hiar na bneng ?

translation.en: And said unto them  ; Go ye also into the vineyard , and whatsoever is right I will give you . And they went their way .
translation.kha: kumta u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Phi ruh khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ , bad ngan siew ka bainong kaba biang .’ Kumta ki la leit .

translation.en: And the priest , whom he shall anoint , and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest s office in his father s stead , shall make the atonement , and shall put on the linen clothes , even the holy garments :
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa uba la pynkupbor bad pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ha ka jaka u kpa jong u , u dei ban pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . U dei ban da phong ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ,

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came mightily upon him , and he rent him as he would have rent a kid , and he had nothing in his hand : but he told not his father or his mother what he had done .
translation.kha: Mar kumta , ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynïoh bor ïa u Samson , bad u Samson u kad ïa uta u sing da la ki kti , kumba kad ïa i khunblang . Hynrei um shym ïathuh ha la u kpa ne ha ka kmie ïa kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hearkened to the voice of Israel , and delivered up the Canaanites  ; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities : and he called the name of the place Hormah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa ki bad u ïarap ïa ki ban jop ïa ki nong Kanaan . Kumta ki Israel ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong jong ki , bad ki la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Hormah .

translation.en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall , so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth .
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka la long ka daw ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew ha baroh kawei ka pyrthei , bad mynta ka Babilonia kan kyllon namar ka la long ka daw ïa ka jingïap jong kiba bun ki Israel . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son : but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father .
translation.kha: U samla uba kohnguh ïa ka aiñ u dei uba stad . Uta uba ïalong paralok bad ki bymlarkam ei ei u pynjahburom ïa la u kpa .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , that the mountain of the  Lord s  house shall be established in the top of the mountains , and shall be exalted above the hills  ; and all nations shall flow unto it .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba da jrong eh halor ki lumrit baroh . Kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kin tuid sha u ,

translation.en: And now we call the proud happy  ; yea , they that work wickedness are set up  ; yea , they that tempt God are even delivered .
translation.kha: Kumba ngi ïohi ïa ka , ki briew kiba sarong ki long kita kiba kmen . Ki briew kiba sniew ym tang ba ki roi kyrhai , hynrei ki tynjuh ïa ka jingïaishah U Blei da ki kam basniew jong ki bad ki lait na kata .’

translation.en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith , it saith to them who are under the law : that every mouth may be stopped , and all the world may become guilty before God .
translation.kha: Mynta ngi tip ba kiei kiei baroh ha ka Hukum ki dei ïa kito kiba im hapoh ka Hukum , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa baroh ki jingaidaw jong ki briew bad wallam ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .

translation.en: And again , departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon , he came unto the sea of Galilee , through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis .
translation.kha: U Jisu nangta u la mihnoh na ka thain jong ka Tyros bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Sidon sha ka duriaw Galilaïa , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka Dekapolis .

translation.en: Then said Mary unto the angel , How shall this be , seeing I know not a man ?
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la ong ha u angel ,  Nga long kaba dang sotti . Kumno , te , kane ka lah ban long ?

translation.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone , because it is too heavy for me .
translation.kha: Da lade hi ngam lah shuh ban kitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ; ka la khia than ïa nga !

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Ye are they which justify yourselves before men  ; but God knoweth your hearts : for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phi long kita kiba pynlong ïa lade ban ibiang ha ka jingkhmih jong kiwei ki briew , hynrei U Blei u tip ïa ka dohnud jong phi . Naba kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la ñiewkordor shikatdei eh da u briew , ki long ki bymdondor ei ei ruh em ha ka jingkhmih U Blei .

translation.en: But they said , We will drink no wine : for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us , saying , Ye shall drink no wine , neither ye , nor your sons for ever :
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la jubab ,  Ngim ju dih waiñ . U kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab u la ong ïa ngi ba ma ngi lymne ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi ngim dei ban dih ïa kano kano ka waiñ .

translation.en: And thou , even thyself , shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee  ; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not : for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger , which shall burn for ever .
translation.kha: Phin hap ban iehnoh ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan pynlong ïa phi ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong phi ha ka ri kaba phim tip ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kum ka ding , bad kan pluh junom .

translation.en: For we must needs die , and are as water spilt on the ground , which cannot be gathered up again  ; neither doth God respect any person : yet doth he devise means , that his banished be not expelled from him .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngin ïap ; ngi long kum ka um kaba hoit ha khyndew , ïa kaba ym lah shuh ban tong biang . Wat U Blei um ju wallam ïa kiba la ïap ban im pat , hynrei u syiem u lah la kumno kumno ban shem lynti ban wallam pat ïa u briew na ka jingphet wir .

translation.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself , but he that is called of God , as was Aaron .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ruh uba shim ha lade ïa ka burom ka jinglong rangbah lyngdoh . Ka dei tang lyngba ka jingkhot U Blei , ba u briew u lah ban long u rangbah lyngdoh — kumba u Aaron u la long .

translation.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place , and hangeth the earth upon nothing .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyiar ha ka sahit bneng bashatei bad u sdien ïa ka pyrthei ha ka haw haw ba-thylli .

translation.en: But if ye bite and devour one another , take heed that ye be not consumed one of another .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi leh kum ki mradkhlaw , phi pynmong bad pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat , te sumar bha , ïoh phin ïa-pynjot noh khoit iwei ïa iwei .

translation.en: And Saul , yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord , went unto the high priest ,
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Saul u la byrngem ban pynïap ïa ki nongbud jong U Trai .

translation.en: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good  ; beast for beast .
translation.kha: bad uno uno uba pynïap ïa u jingri jong uwei pat u briew , un buria ïa u , ka jingim namar ka jingim .

translation.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment  ; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver , and five changes of raiment .
translation.kha: U ai ruh ha uwei pa uwei na ki mar shi riam ki jaiñ , hynrei ïa u Benjamin pat u ai laispah tylli ki sbai rupa bad san riam ki jaiñ .

translation.en: And Jesus went out , and departed from the temple : and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mih bad u la leit noh na ka Templ mynba ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u ban pyn-i ïa ki jingtei jong ka .

translation.en: And there went out the king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrah , and the king of Admah , and the king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela ( the same is Zoar  ; ) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki syiem jong ka Sodom , ka Gomorrah , ka Admah , ka Seboiim , bad ka Bela ki la khreh ïa la ki shipai na ka bynta ka thma ha ka them Siddim bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  that created the heavens  ; God himself that formed the earth and made it  ; he hath established it , he created it not in vain , he formed it to be inhabited : I am the  Lord   ; and there is none else .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng — U long tang ma u hi U Blei ! U pynlong bad thaw ïa ka pyrthei — U thaw ïa ka kaba skhem bad kaba neh . Um shym la thaw ïa ka ban iehnoh suda , hynrei ka jaka ba ki briew kin shong kin sah . U long ma u , uba ong ,  Nga long U  Trai  , ym don uwei pat U Blei .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king of Ai saw it , that they hasted and rose up early , and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle , he and all his people , at a time appointed , before the plain  ; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem jong ka Ai u ïohi ïa ki rangbah jong u Joshua , u pynstet ban leit ïaleh . Ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih sha ka phang ka Them Jordan ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha kajuh ka jaka kum mynshuwa , khlem da tip ba un shah tur ïaleh na shadien .

translation.en: And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John , whose surname was Mark  ; where many were gathered together praying .
translation.kha: Da kaba tip ïa la ka jinglong jingman , u la leit sha ka ïing jong ka Mari , ka kmie jong u Ïoannis Markos , ha kaba bun ki briew ki la ïalumlang bad ba ki dang duwai .

translation.en: And was transfigured before them : and his face did shine as the sun , and his raiment was white as the light .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakhmih , ka jingkylla dur ka la wan ha U Jisu : Ka durkhmat jong u ka da tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la lieh phyrnai eh .

translation.en: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it , they returned to Ekron the same day .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki peit ïa ki ba ki leh ïa kane bad hangta ki leit phai pat sha Ekron ha kata hi ka sngi .

translation.en: And the Philistine said to David , Come to me , and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air , and to the beasts of the field .
translation.kha: Wan shane ,  u kob ïa u Dabid ,  bad ngan ai ïa ka met jong me ha ki sim bad ha ki mrad ba kin bam .

translation.en: See , for that the  Lord  hath given you the sabbath , therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days  ; abide ye every man in his place , let no man go out of his place on the seventh day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  nga la ai ha phi ïa ka sngi shongthait , bad dei namar kata ba ha ka sngi kaba hynriew nga ai jingbam ïa phi kat ban biang na ka bynta ar sngi . Baroh phin ïashong ha ka jaka ba phi don ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad phim dei ban mih na la ïing .

translation.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane yn bret kloi lan ha ka lawar ding baklang .

translation.en: They have made it desolate , and being desolate it mourneth unto me  ; the whole land is made desolate , because no man layeth it to heart .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkylla ri khlaw ïa ka ; ka la long thylli ha khmat jong nga . Ka ri baroh kawei ka la kylla long ka ri shyiap , bad ym don mano mano ba salia .

translation.en: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host : and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar .
translation.kha: U syiem u thung ïa u Benaïah kum u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka u Joab bad u buh ïa u Sadok u lyngdoh ha ka jaka u Abiathar .

translation.en: Better is little with the fear of the  Lord  than great treasure and trouble therewith .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban long kiba duk bad ba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ban ïa kaba long kiba riewspah bad shah jynjar .

translation.en: These are the things that ye shall do  ; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour  ; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates :
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba phi dei ban leh . Kren ïa ka jingshisha iwei ïa iwei pat . Ha ki ïingbishar ai ïa ki jingbishar hok kiba shisha — kaba wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: So built we the wall  ; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof : for the people had a mind to work .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi ïai tei ïa ka kynroh , bad shen ka la ïeng mar shiteng ka jingjrong , namar ki briew ki shitrhem ha ka jingtrei .

translation.en: How much is this ?
translation.kha: Katno kane ?

translation.en: And for fear of him the keepers did shake , and became as dead men .
translation.kha: Ki nongap phira ki la sheptieng katta katta haduh ba ki la kyiuh bad ki la long kum ki briew kiba la ïap .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  : that is my name : and my glory will I not give to another , neither my praise to graven images .
translation.kha: Nga hi marwei nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ym don kiwei pat ki blei kiba lah ban ïoh bynta na ka burom jong nga ; ngan ym shah ïa ki bleithaw ban ïoh bynta na ka jingïaroh jong nga .

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts shall defend them  ; and they shall devour , and subdue with sling stones  ; and they shall drink , and make a noise as through wine  ; and they shall be filled like bowls , and as the corners of the altar .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad kin pynjot ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Kin pyrta ha ka thma kum ki rangbah ba la buaid bad kin pynmih ïa ka snam jong ki nongshun jong ki ; kan tuid kum ka snam jong ka jingkñia ba la theh halor ka duwan na ka jingdiang .

translation.en: Then David took hold on his clothes , and rent them  ; and likewise all the men that were with him :
translation.kha: U Dabid u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ki briew jong u baroh ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh , The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years : few and evil have the days of the years of my life been , and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Ha ka jingim jong nga kaba ïaidwir nawei shawei nga la dap shispah laiphew snem . Kita ki snem ki long kiba khyndiat bad kiba eh , ym kum ki snem kiba jrong ba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynlut ha ka jingïaid wir .

translation.en: And ye shall serve the  Lord  your God , and he shall bless thy bread , and thy water  ; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Lada phi mane ïa nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , te ngan kyrkhu ïa phi da ka bam bad ka um , bad ngan weng noh ruh ïa ki jingpang jong phi baroh .

translation.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the  Lord  God of Israel , and sought him , he was found of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , ki phai sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ki la wad ïa u bad shem ïa u .

translation.en: And all things are of God , who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ , and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation ;
translation.kha: Ïa kane baroh la leh da U Blei , uba lyngba U Khrist u la pynkylla ïa ngi na ki nongshun sha ki paralok jong u bad u la aiti ha ngi ïa ka kamram ban pynlong ïa kiwei ruh ki paralok jong u .

translation.en: So he fled with all that he had  ; and he rose up , and passed over the river , and set his face toward the mount Gilead .
translation.kha: U la kit lut kat ïa kaba u don bad u phet noh kyrkieh . U la jam ïa ka wah Ïuphratis , bad u leit kiew sha ki phang ka ri lum Gilead .

translation.en: And the  Lord  magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel , and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ban tiengburom ïa u Solomon , bad u la pynlong ïa u uba kham donburom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u syiem uba la synshar ïa ka Israel .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Put every man his sword by his side , and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp , and slay every man his brother , and every man his companion , and every man his neighbour .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u hukum ïa uwei pa uwei na phi ban kieng ïa la ka waitlam , bad ïaid lyngba ïa ka jaka sher dara baroh na kane ka khyrdop sha kawei pat bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah uba long u hynmen u para jong u , ïa ki paralok jong u , bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u .

translation.en: Blessed are the pure in heart : for they shall see God .
translation.kha: Suk kiba khuid ha ka dohnud ; kin ïohi ïa U Blei !

translation.en: There shall no man be able to stand before you : for the  Lord  your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon , as he hath said unto you .
translation.kha: Shano shano shaba phi leit ha kata ka ri , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa ki briew ba kin sheptieng ïa phi , kumba u la kular , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynsangeh ïa phi .

translation.en: And they cried unto the children of Dan . And they turned their faces , and said unto Micah , What aileth thee , that thou comest with such a company ?
translation.kha: bad ki pyrta ïa ki . Ki rangbah na Dan ki kyrtiang dien bad ki kylli ïa u Mikah ,  Kaei kaba la jia ? Balei katne u paidbah ?

translation.en: For the vineyard of the  Lord  of hosts is the house of Israel , and the men of Judah his pleasant plant : and he looked for judgment , but behold oppression  ; for righteousness , but behold a cry .
translation.kha: Ka Israel ka dei ka bri sohwaiñ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ; ki briew ka Judah ki dei ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba u la thung . U la khmih lynti ba kin leh ïa kaei kaba bha , hynrei pynban ki la pynïap briew . U la khmih lynti ba kin leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei kiba shah lanot jong ki , ki kyang ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: They organize assemblies and conventions , coordinate the construction of new Kingdom Halls , and see that literature is shipped to the congregations to supply their needs .
translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa ki jingïaseng asembli bad convention , ki pynïaid ïa ki jingtei ïa ki Ïing Hima bathymmai , bad ki peit ba ki kot ki sla kin poi sha ki balang ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki .

translation.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time , Sit on my right hand , until I make thine enemies thy footstool ?
translation.kha: U Blei um ju ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u :  Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga haduh ba ngan da pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong me ba kin long kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .

translation.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered mortar , seeing vanity , and divining lies unto them , saying , Thus saith the Lord  God  , when the  Lord  hath not spoken .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la buhrieh ïa la ki pop kum kito kiba tap ïa ka kynroh da ka pushara lieh . Ki ïohi ïa ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki pynmih la ki jong jingïathuhlypa ba bakla . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar , hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngam shym la kren ha ki .

translation.en: Blind , or broken , or maimed , or having a wen , or scurvy , or scabbed , ye shall not offer these unto the  Lord  , nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat kñia sha U  Trai  da uno uno u jingri uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la mong ka met , uba don prum , uba don  ñiangdait , lane uba sarew prum . Wat kñia kum ïa uta u jingri ha ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam .

translation.en: And saw two ships standing by the lake : but the fishermen were gone out of them , and were washing their nets .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ar tylli ki lieng ba la tan sharud duriaw ; ki nongtong dohkha ki la ieh ïa ki bad ki la sait ïa ki jar .

translation.en: And when they had fulfilled the days , as they returned , the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem  ; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .
translation.kha: Haba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , ki la khreh ban leit phai noh sha ïing , hynrei u khynnah Jisu u la sah ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains :
translation.kha: Nangta kito kiba don ha Judia ki dei ban phet sha ki lum .

translation.en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath  ;
translation.kha: Ym dei tang bad phi ba U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad ki jingdawa baroh kiba don ha ka .

translation.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power ? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength ?
translation.kha: Katno phi la long ka jingïarap babha ïa nga — u briew uba duk , uba tlot kum ma nga !

translation.en: Behold , his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him : but the just shall live by his faith .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka dei ka khubor : ‘ Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im , hynrei kito kiba hok kin im namar ki long kiba ïaineh ha U Blei .’

translation.en: Then said he unto me , The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great , and the land is full of blood , and the city full of perverseness : for they say , The  Lord  hath forsaken the earth , and the  Lord  seeth not .
translation.kha: U Blei u la jubab ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki la rem na ki pop kiba shyrkhei . Ki la pynïap briew ha ka ri baroh kawei bad ki pyndap ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kam runar . Ki ong ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ngam ïohi ïa ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel , whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people , and officers over them  ; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation , that they may stand there with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah badonburom ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah , wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin ïeng hangta hajan jong me .

translation.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael , Abraham s son , whom Hagar the Egyptian , Sarah s handmaid , bare unto Abraham :
translation.kha: U Ishmael , ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt kaba long ka mraw jong ka Sarah , ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham ,

translation.en: O Zion , that bringest good tidings , get thee up into the high mountain  ; O Jerusalem , that bringest good tidings , lift up thy voice with strength  ; lift it up , be not afraid  ; say unto the cities of Judah , Behold your God !
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , leit kiew sha u lumbah bajrong bad to pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ! To kyang da ka sur bajam , ko Seïon ; to pynbna ka khubor babha ! To kren bad wat sheptieng . Ïathuh ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba U Blei jong ki u la wan !

translation.en: And when they began to sing and to praise , the  Lord  set ambushments against the children of Ammon , Moab , and mount Seir , which were come against Judah  ; and they were smitten .
translation.kha: Haba ki la sdang ban rwai , U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai ba wan tur ïaleh , ban ngat hapdeng ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel , I said unto Peter before them all , If thou , being a Jew , livest after the manner of Gentiles , and not as do the Jews , why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews ?
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba kim shym la ïaid ha ka lynti kaba beit jong ka jingshisha ka Gospel , nga la ong ïa u Petros ha khmat jong ki baroh ,  Me dei u Jiw , pynban , me la im kum u Jentil , ym kum u Jiw . Kumno te , me lah ban pynbor ïa ki Jentil ban im kum ki Jiw ?

translation.en: And Solomon said , If he will shew himself a worthy man , there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth : but if wickedness shall be found in him , he shall die .
translation.kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Lada u ai jingkyrshan , yn ym ktah wat ïa uwei na ki shñiuh ha ka khlieh jong u ; hynrei lada um long kumta , un ïap .

translation.en: As free , and not using your liberty for a cloak of maliciousness , but as the servants of God .
translation.kha: To im kum ki briew kiba laitluid ; hynrei wat pyndonkam ïa ka jinglaitluid ban buhrieh ïa kano kano kaba sniew , hynrei to im kum ki mraw jong U Blei .

translation.en: And the sons of Naphtali  ; Jahzeel , and Guni , and Jezer , and Shillem .
translation.kha: U Naphtali bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Jahsil , u Guni , u Jeser , bad u Shillem .

translation.en: And he looked , and behold a well in the field , and , lo , there were three flocks of sheep lying by it  ; for out of that well they watered the flocks : and a great stone was upon the well s mouth .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan u poi ha kawei ka pukri ha ki lyngkha bad lai kynhun ki langbrot kiba dem sawdong jong ka . La ju ai um ïa kita ki kynhun langbrot na kata ka pukri ha kaba don u mawkhang uba heh , ha khlieh jong ka .

translation.en: For the greatest benefit , it is good to do the same before attending a congregation meeting .
translation.kha: Ban kham ïoh jingmyntoi , ka long kaba donkam ban leh kumjuh shuwa ban wan sha ki jingïalang .

translation.en: My servant Moses is not so , who is faithful in all mine house .
translation.kha: Ka pher haba nga ïakren bad u shakri jong nga , u Moses . Nga la buh ïa u ban peit ïa baroh ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .

translation.en: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering , both of the new moons , and of all the set feasts of the  Lord  that were consecrated , and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad nalor kata , ki ai ki jingainguh thang tylli bad kito ki jingainguh ban ai ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai bad ha baroh kiwei ki jingïaseng ba ju long ha kaba la mane ïa U  Trai  , kumjuh ruh ki jingainguh ba ai sha U  Trai  da ka mon sngewbha .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by his holiness , that , lo , the days shall come upon you , that he will take you away with hooks , and your posterity with fishhooks .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u long uba khuid , u la kular ,  Ki sngi kin poi haba kin ring noh ïa phi da ki bnoh ; kawei pa kawei na phi kan long kum ka dohkha ba la bnoh .

translation.en: Then he is gracious unto him , and saith , Deliver him from going down to the pit : I have found a ransom .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsngewsynei u angel un ong ,  Pyllait noh ïa u ! Um dei ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Hangne ka don ka kuna ban pyllaitluid ïa u .

translation.en: The elder women as mothers ; the younger as sisters , with all purity .
translation.kha: To wat sneng ïa uba la kham rangbah , hynrei to kyrpad ha u kum la u kpa . To ñiew ïa kiba kham samla kum la ki para , ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham ïaw kum ki kmie , bad ïa ki kynthei kiba kham samla kum ki para , da ka jingsngur mynsiem baroh .

translation.en: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war , which were of the children of Dan , stood by the entering of the gate .
translation.kha: Katba ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai na Dan , ki la khreh ban ïaleh thma , ki dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop ,

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall bring you into the land of Israel , into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers .
translation.kha: Haba nga wallam pat ïa phi sha Israel , ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka Deborah bad u Barak u khun jong u Abinoam ki la rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai :

translation.en: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned sixteen years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Joash u Syiem ka Judah , u Jehoash u khun jong u Jehoahas u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: Art thou the Christ ? tell us . And he said unto them ,  If I tell you , ye will not believe :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la ong ,  hato me dei U Messaïah ?  U la jubab ,  Lada nga ïathuh ha phi , phin ym ngeit ïa nga ;

translation.en: That it may be well with thee , and thou mayest live long on the earth .
translation.kha: Khnang ba baroh kan long bha bad phi , bad ba phi lah ban im slem ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the sin offering of atonement , and the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering of it , and their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Ai ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop nalor u  langsohmoh ba la ai ha ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah , bad ïa ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingkñia ainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka .

translation.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way : but the folly of fools is deceit .
translation.kha: Balei ba u briew uba sian u stad ? Namar u tip ïa kaei ban leh . Balei ba u briew ba-mutlop u bieit ? Namar ba u shu pyrkhat ba u tip .

translation.en: And Eber lived four and thirty years , and begat Peleg :
translation.kha: Haba u Eber u la dap laiphew saw snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Peleg ;

translation.en: But into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you not , go your ways out into the streets of the same , and say ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha man ba phi leit shapoh ka shnong bad ba ym shym la pdiang ïa phi , khie leit sha ki lynti bah bad ong ,

translation.en: ( Ezekiel 18 :4 ) Nowhere does the Bible teach that man has an immortal soul that survives the death of the body .
translation.kha: ( Ezekiel 18 :4 ) Ym don hangno hangno ruh ba ka Baibl ka hikai ba ki briew ki don ka mynsiem kaba lait na ka jingiap jongka met .

translation.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David , saying , Let the  Lord  even require it at the hand of David s enemies .
translation.kha: ai ba kata ka jingkular markylliang jong ngi kan ym dkut noh . Lada pynkheiñ ïa ka , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: And though they go into captivity before their enemies , thence will I command the sword , and it shall slay them : and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil , and not for good .
translation.kha: Lada ki shah ringmraw ha ki nongshun jong ki , ngan hukum ïa ki ba kin pynïap . Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ki , ym ban ïarap ïa ki .

translation.en: Not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but as the servants of Christ , doing the will of God from the heart ;
translation.kha: Leh ïa kane ym tang haba ki khmih ïa phi , namar ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingmynjur jong ki ; hynrei , leh naduh ka dohnud baroh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , kum ki mraw U Khrist .

translation.en: For indeed he accepted the exhortation ; but being more forward , of his own accord he went unto you .
translation.kha: Ym dei tang ba u la pdiang sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ; u la thrang palat ban ïarap ïa kata da la ka mon sngewbha hi u la rai ban wan sha phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt surely give him , and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him : because that for this thing the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thy works , and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto .
translation.kha: Ai ha u da ka mon sngewbha bad khlem da khñium , te U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ki kam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium , who persuaded the people , and , having stoned Paul , drew him out of the city , supposing he had been dead .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Jiw ki la wan na Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia bad na Ikoniom ; ki la ïoh ïa u paidbah sha ka liang jong ki , ki la lynthem maw ïa u Paul bad ki la paring ïa u shabar shnong , da kaba pyrkhat ba u la ïap .

translation.en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Ahas u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Hesekaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time .
translation.kha: Pynban don kaei kaei kaba khang ïa kane ban jia mynta , bad phi tip ka dei kaei . Ha ka por kaba biang , te , Uta Uba Sniew un mihpaw .

translation.en: Being grieved that they taught the people , and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewbitar namar ba ki ar ngut ki apostol ki la hikai ïa ki briew ba U Jisu u lah mihpat na ka jingïap , kaba pynshisha ba kiba ïap kin mihpat .

translation.en: Not in the lust of concupiscence , even as the Gentiles which know not God :
translation.kha: ym ha ka jingkwah brai thala , kum kiba mane blei thala ki bymtip ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven : but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam dei ka jingthmu U  Trai  ban pynjot thiaw shi junom ïa ki Israel , kumta u pyllait im ïa ki lyngba u syiem Jeroboam uba ar .

translation.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground , and a trap for him in the way .
translation.kha: Ha ka khyndew ïa ka jingriam la buhrieh ; ïa ka jingriam la pynap ha ka lynti ïaid jong u .

translation.en: Now I praise you , brethren , that ye remember me in all things , and keep the ordinances , as I delivered them to you .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa phi namar ba phi kynmaw ïa nga borabor bad bud ïa ki jinghikai kiba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it lighter unto us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong : ‘ Ka  tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga !’

translation.en: And they did so , and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , and the king of Eglon .
translation.kha: Kumta la plie ïa ka krem bad la pynmih shabar ïa ki syiem ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron , ka Jarmuth , ka Lakhish , bad ka Eglon bad la leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua .

translation.en: For sin shall not have dominion over you : for ye are not under the law , but under grace .
translation.kha: Ka pop kam dei ban long ka kynrad jong phi ; namar phim im hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei .

translation.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death . And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Set thine house in order : for thou shalt die , and not live .
translation.kha: Kum ha kane ka por u Syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Amos u la leit ban jngoh ïa u bad u la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u ïathuh ïa phi ba phi dei ban buh beit ïa kiei kiei baroh namar phin ym koit shuh . Pynkhreh ban ïap .

translation.en: Surely God will not hear vanity , neither will the Almighty regard it .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban kyang jam ; U Blei Badonbor Baroh um shym ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa ki .

translation.en: And not for that nation only , but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , um shym la ong ïa kane na lade hi ; pynban , naba u la long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ïathuhlypa ba U Jisu u dei ban ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Jiw , bad ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei ba un pynwan lang ïa baroh ha kawei ka met ïa baroh ki briew jong U Blei kiba la pynsakma .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah  ; They shall not lament for him , saying , Ah my brother ! or , Ah sister ! they shall not lament for him , saying , Ah lord ! or , Ah his glory !
translation.kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u ong kumne shaphang u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah , u syiem ka Judah ,  Yn ym don ba ïambriew ha ka jingïap jong u lane ba ong , ‘ A katno kaba shyrkhei , ko paralok jong nga , A katno kaba shyrkhei !’ Yn ym don mano mano ba ïam sngewsih ïa u lane uba kyang , ‘ A ko Kynrad jong nga !’ ‘ A ko syiem jong nga !’

translation.en: Woe is me , my mother , that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth ! I have neither lent on usury , nor men have lent to me on usury  ; yet every one of them doth curse me .
translation.kha: A nga long u briew u bym don jingkmen ! Balei ba i mei jong nga i wallam ïa nga sha ka pyrthei ? Nga la dei ban ïakajia bad ïania bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri . Ngam shym la ai kylliang ïa kano kano ka pisa lane shim kylliang ïa kano kano ; pynban uwei pa uwei u tim ïa nga .

translation.en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak , If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the word of the  Lord  my God , to do less or more .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Balaam u jubab ,  Wat lada u Balak u ai lut ka ksiar ka rupa kaba don ha ïingsyiem jong u , da lei lei ngam lah khlem da kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong nga wat ïa iba rit tam .

translation.en: And others , tempting him , sought of him a sign from heaven .
translation.kha: Kiwei ki la kwah ban riam ïa U Jisu , kumta ki la ong ha u ban leh ka kambah ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa U .

translation.en: His parents answered them and said , We know that this is our son , and that he was born blind :
translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la jubab ,  Ngi tip ba u dei u khun jong ngi , bad ngi tip ba la kha matlah ïa u .

translation.en: If we receive the witness of men , the witness of God is greater : for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; hynrei ka jingphla U Blei ka long kaba kham khlaiñ , bad u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla shaphang U Khun jong u .

translation.en: Even every one that is called by my name : for I have created him for my glory , I have formed him  ; yea , I have made him .
translation.kha: Ki long ki briew jong nga hi , bad nga la thaw ïa ki ban wanrah burom ïa nga .

translation.en: He is the  Lord  our God : his judgments are in all the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei jong ngi ; ki hukum jong u ki long ïa ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner : and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah , that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joab bad u Abishai ki la mih ban buddien ïa u Abner , bad ha ka por sep sngi ki la wan poi ha u lum Ammah , uba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Giah ha ka lynti sha ka ri khlaw jong ka Gibeon .

translation.en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners , Go forth  ; to them that are in darkness , Shew yourselves . They shall feed in the ways , and their pastures shall be in all high places .
translation.kha: Ngan ong ha kiba shah set byndi , ‘ Leit ha kaba laitluid !’ bad ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingdum , ‘ Wan sha ka jingshai !’ Kin long kum ki langbrot kiba bam phlang halor ki lumrit ;

translation.en: And put my cup , the silver cup , in the sack s mouth of the youngest , and his corn money . And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken .
translation.kha: Thep ïa ka khuri rupa jong nga ha khlieh ka byrni jong u para khatduh , lem bad ïa ka bai kew jong u .  U la leh kumba la bthah ïa u .

translation.en: What is it therefore ? the multitude must needs come together : for they will hear that thou art come .
translation.kha: Khlem pep kin ïohsngew ba me la poi . Te , yn ïaleh kumno ?

translation.en: For verily I say unto you , That whosoever shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; and shall not doubt in his heart , but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass  ; he shall have whatsoever he saith .
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ha phi ba uno uno uba ong ha une u lum ban ïeng bad pynnoh ïa lade sha ka duriaw bad u bym don jingartatien ha ka dohnud jong u , hynrei ba u da ngeit ïa kaei kaba u ong kan long , yn leh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And I did so as I was commanded : I brought forth my stuff by day , as stuff for captivity , and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand  ; I brought it forth in the twilight , and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight .
translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leh . Ha kata ka sngi nga la teh ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad ha kata ka premmiet katba ka dang khreh dum nga la tih ka thliew ha ka kynroh da ki kti jong nga bad nga la mih shabar . Katba uwei uwei baroh u dang khmih , nga la tawah ïa ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong nga bad nga la mihnoh .

translation.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kjat-dien kamon jong u mrad yn ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang

translation.en: For the upright shall dwell in the land , and the perfect shall remain in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok — ki briew kiba ïaid beit — kin ïoh shongsah ha kane ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: That walk to go down into Egypt , and have not asked at my mouth  ; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh , and to trust in the shadow of Egypt !
translation.kha: Ki ïaleit sha Ijipt na ka bynta ka jingïarap khlem pan ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Ki kwah ba ka Ijipt kan ïada ïa ki , ba kumta ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u syiem ka Ijipt .

translation.en: Be thou instructed , O Jerusalem , lest my soul depart from thee  ; lest I make thee desolate , a land not inhabited .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , ai ba kine ki jingjynjar kin long ka jingmaham ïa phi , lymda kumta ngan iehnoh ïa phi ; ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah jong phi sha ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong basah .

translation.en: Give ear , O ye heavens , and I will speak  ; and hear , O earth , the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Ko ka bneng , shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong nga , bad ko ka pyrthei , sngap bha ïa kaei ba ngan kren .

translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto them , I go a fishing . They say unto him , We also go with thee . They went forth , and entered into a ship immediately  ; and that night they caught nothing .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la ong ha kita kiwei pat ,  Ngan leit tong dohkha noh .   Ngin wan lang bad me ,  ki la ong ha u . Kumta ki la ïamihnoh ha ka lieng , hynrei baroh shi miet kim shym la ngat ei ei ruh .

translation.en: A man s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth  ; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled .
translation.kha: Phin hap ban im lem bad ki soh kiba mih na baroh kaba phi kren .

translation.en: Therefore said they unto him , How were thine eyes opened ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka lah ban long ba mynta me lah ban imat pat ?  ki la kylli ïa u .

translation.en: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah , saying , There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïalumlang ha Mispah , ki la ai ka kular bakyntang sha U  Trai  :  Yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban shah ïa u Benjamin ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong ngi .

translation.en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingsuk hapdeng ki Israel bad Syria ha ki ar snem kiba bud .

translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :28 ) Yes , God’s purpose was for them to have children and eventually to spread their Paradise over all the earth .
translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :28 ) Hooid , ka jingthmu jong u Blei ka long ïa ki ban ïoh khun bad ban pynïar ïa ka paradais satlak ka pyrthei .

translation.en: For all have sinned , and come short of the glory of God ;
translation.kha: baroh ki la leh pop bad ki la jngai noh na ka jingpynim U Blei .

translation.en: For they know not to do right , saith the  Lord  , who store up violence and robbery in their palaces .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kine ki briew ki pyndap ïa la ki ïing paki dulan da kiei kiei kiba la shim da ki kam runar bad ki kam lehbor . Kim tip satia wat kumno ban lehhok .

translation.en: And Moses was fourscore years old , and Aaron fourscore and three years old , when they spake unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por mynba ki la kren ha u Pharaoh , u Moses u la don phraphew snem ka rta bad u Aaron u la don phraphew lai snem .

translation.en: But Paul cried with a loud voice , saying , Do thyself no harm : for we are all here .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la pyrta da ka ktien kaba jam ,  Wat pynmynsaw ïa lade . Ngi baroh ngi don hangne !

translation.en: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release .
translation.kha: Man kaba kut hynñiew snem , phi dei ban map ïa ka ram jong kito kiba kit ram na phi .

translation.en: Then the deputy , when he saw what was done , believed , being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord .
translation.kha: Haba uta u lyngskor u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , u la ngeit ; naba u la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Trai .

translation.en: He and his people with him , the terrible of the nations , shall be brought to destroy the land : and they shall draw their swords against Egypt , and fill the land with the slain .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai bymsalia jong u kin wan ban pynjulor ïa ka ri . Kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt da ki waitlam , bad ka ri kan dap da ki metïap .

translation.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue : and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi ong ka lah ban ri ïa ka jingim lane pynjot ïa ka ; te phi dei ban pdiang ïa ki soh kiba mih na ki ktien jong hi .

translation.en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath , from doing thy pleasure on my holy day  ; and call the sabbath a delight , the holy of the  Lord  , honourable  ; and shalt honour him , not doing thine own ways , nor finding thine own pleasure , nor speaking thine own words :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada phi ñiew ïa ka Sabbaton kum kaba kyntang bad phin ym beh tang ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi ha kata ka sngi ; lada phi ñiewkor ïa ka sngi kaba khuid jong nga bad lada phi burom ïa ka khlem da leit jingleit , treikam , lane shu bunktien bieit ha kata ka sngi ,

translation.en: For as ye in times past have not believed God , yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief :
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , phim shym kohnguh ïa U Blei mynshuwa ; hynrei mynta phi la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei U Blei namar ki Jiw ki la long ki bymkohnguh .

translation.en: They return , but not to the most High : they are like a deceitful bow : their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue : this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki ïai phai lyndet na nga sha u blei u bymdonbor ei ei ruh em . Ki long ki bym lah ban shaniah kum ka ryntieh kaba kynriang . Namar ki nongïalam jong ki , ki kren meng , kin ïap ha ka jingïap bashyrkhei , bad ki nong Ijipt kin sa ïa-rkhie .

translation.en: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa U Jisu ,

translation.en: And the Spirit bade me go with them , nothing doubting . Moreover these six brethren accompanied me , and we entered into the man s house :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ki khlem pynslem . Kine ki hynriew ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la synran ïa nga sha Kaisaria , bad baroh ngi la ïaleit sha ka ïing jong u Kornelios .

translation.en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month , on the fifteenth day of the month , like unto the feast that is in Judah , and he offered upon the altar . So did he in Beth–el , sacrificing unto the calves that he had made : and he placed in Beth–el the priests of the high places which he had made .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u seng ruh ïa ka jingkhawai niam ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , kum ka jingkhawai niam kaba ha Judah . Ha ka duwan kaba ha Bethel u la kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha kita ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la shna , bad u buh hangta ha Bethel ïa ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane kiba u la tei .

translation.en: ( Genesis 3 :21  ; 9 :3  ; Exodus 21 :28 ) But it is wrong to mistreat animals or to kill them just for sport or pleasure .—Proverbs 12 :10 .
translation.kha: ( Jenesis 3 :21 ; 9 :3 ; Eksodos 21 :28 ) Hynrei ka long ka bymdei ban leh beiñ ïa ki mrad lane pynïap ïa ki tang ban shu lehkai ne lehsngewbha .—Proberb 12 :10 .

translation.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him , Sir , didst not thou sow good seed in thy field ? from whence then hath it tares ?
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong uta u briew ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , u long u symbai uba bha uba phi la bet hapoh ka lyngkha jong phi ; nangno ki ñiut ki wan mih ?’

translation.en: And now , brethren , I commend you to God , and to the word of his grace , which is able to build you up , and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga aiti ïa phi ha ka jingsumar jong U Blei bad ha ka khubor jong ka jingaiei jong u , kaba lah ban tei ïa phi , bad ai ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba U Blei u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh .

translation.en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine  ; thy wives also and thy children , even the goodliest , are mine .
translation.kha: U syiem Benhadad u dawa ba men aiti noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me , ïa ki kynthei bad ïa kiba khlaiñ tam na ki khun jong me .

translation.en: And he said unto her , Give me , I pray thee , a little water to drink  ; for I am thirsty . And she opened a bottle of milk , and gave him drink , and covered him .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ka ,  Sngewbha ai umdih ïa nga ; nga sliang .  Ka plied ïa ka pla snieh dud bad ka ai dih ïa u , bad ka la pynrieh biang ïa u .

translation.en: And when all Jabesh–gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul ,
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong ka Jabesh ki ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ki Philistia ki la leh ïa u Saul ,

translation.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing , that he should not go after other gods : but he kept not that which the  Lord  commanded .
translation.kha: Wat haba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la paw ha u Solomon ar sien , bad u la hukum ïa u ban ym mane ïa ki blei nongwei , u Solomon um shym la kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , hynrei u la phai dien noh na U .

translation.en: And gladness is taken away , and joy out of the plentiful field  ; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing , neither shall there be shouting : the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses  ; I have made their vintage shouting to cease .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano bakmen mynta ha ki lyngkha baseisoh . Ym don mano mano ba pyrta jam lane rwai ha ki bri sohwaiñ . Ym don ba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ban shna waiñ ; ki jingpyrta jam jong ka jingkmen ki la kut .

translation.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth , and let the wicked be no more . Bless thou the  Lord  , O my soul . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki nongpop na ka pyrthei ; ai ba ki bymman kin duh shuh . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And his concubine that was in Shechem , she also bare him a son , whose name he called Abimelech .
translation.kha: U don ruh kawei ka tnga kliar ha Shekhem ; ka la kha uwei u khun na u bad u ai kyrteng ïa u , u Abimelekh .

translation.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem  ; and Jesus went before them : and they were amazed  ; and as they followed , they were afraid . And he took again the twelve , and began to tell them what things should happen unto him ,
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la don mynta ha ka jingïaid lynti ban leit kiew sha Jerusalem . U Jisu u la nang leit ha shuwa ki synran , kiba la dap da ka jingsngewtieng ; ki briew kiba la bud nadien ki la sheptieng . Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la shim ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran sharud bad u la kren ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ïa u .

translation.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king , which made a marriage for his son ,
translation.kha: Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Shisien la don u syiem uba la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai shongkurim na ka bynta u khun jong u .

translation.en: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the  Lord   ; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it , to the name of the  Lord  , to Jerusalem : neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka Jerusalem yn khot , ‘ Ka Khet ka jong U  Trai  ,’ bad baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang hangta ban mane ïa nga . Kin ym leh shuh ïa kaei ba ka dohnud ba-mutlop bad basniew jong ki ka ong .

translation.en: And Ornan turned back , and saw the angel  ; and his four sons with him hid themselves . Now Ornan was threshing wheat .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka jaka shoh kew u Araunah bad saw ngut ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang shoh kew , bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u angel , ki khun shynrang ki la mareh bad rieh .

translation.en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river  ; and her maidens walked along by the river s side  ; and when she saw the ark among the flags , she sent her maid to fetch it .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka la wan hiar sha ka wah ban sum , katba ki shakri kynthei jong ka pat ki nang ïa-ïaid kai harud wah . Kynsan ka la ïohi ïa kata ka shang hapdeng ki khah , bad ka phah ïa ka mraw ban leit shim ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , I will gather thee to thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace , neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place , and upon the inhabitants of the same . So they brought the king word again .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wanrah ha Jerusalem kan ym wan tad hadien ka jingïap jong me . Ngan ai ba men ïap ha ka jingsuk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah ryngkat bad kane ka khubor .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Jacob , Return unto the land of thy fathers , and to thy kindred  ; and I will be with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit phai pat sha ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me , bad sha la ki kur ki jait . Nga ngan long lem ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hangta ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid bad ïaroh ïa U Blei ,

translation.en: But the Lord said unto him ,  Go thy way : for he is a chosen vessel unto me , to bear my name before the Gentiles , and kings , and the children of Israel :
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Khie leit , namar ba nga la jied ïa u ban shakri ïa nga , ban pyntip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ki Jentil bad ha ki syiem bad ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre , the crowning city , whose merchants are princes , whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth ?
translation.kha: Uei uba la thmu ban wanrah ïa kane ha Tyros , kata ka nongbah u patsha , kiba ki khun syiem kiba khaïi pateng ki la long ki briew ïa kiba la ñiewburom eh ha ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: Casting all your care upon him  ; for he careth for you .
translation.kha: To buh ha u ïa ki jingkhuslai jong phi baroh , namar u sumar sukher ïa phi .

translation.en: And he walked in all the sins of his father , which he had done before him : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as the heart of David his father .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kijuh ki pop kum u kpa jong u bad um shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kumba ïaineh u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u .

translation.en: Ethiopia , and Libya , and Lydia , and all the mingled people , and Chub , and the men of the land that is in league , shall fall with them by the sword .
translation.kha: Kata ka thma kan pynïap ruh ïa ki shipai kiba la shu wai na Sudan , Lydia , Libya , Arabia , Kub , bad wat napdeng ki briew jong nga hi .

translation.en: And Samson said unto them , Though ye have done this , yet will I be avenged of you , and after that I will cease .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ïa ki ,  Te haduh katne pleng phi leh ! Nga smai ba ngan ym shongthait tad haduh ba ngan ïoh pynhiarkput ïa phi !

translation.en: Who is this that cometh up as a flood , whose waters are moved as the rivers ?
translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah kaba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka ?

translation.en: Two women shall be grinding together  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin ïatylliat lang ïa u kew : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.en: For I long to see you , that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift , to the end ye may be established ;
translation.kha: Naba nga kwah haduh katta katta ban ïohi ïa phi , khnang ban ïasam ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem bad phi bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: And ye returned and wept before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  would not hearken to your voice , nor give ear unto you .
translation.kha: Kumta phi la lynñiar ha U  Trai  ba un ïarap ïa phi , hynrei um shym sngap ne shahshkor ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh : and Moses cried unto the  Lord  because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki ïamihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u Moses u kyrpad eh ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kita ki jakoid kiba u la wallam ha u Pharaoh .

translation.en: And the man said unto Eli , I am he that came out of the army , and I fled to day out of the army . And he said , What is there done , my son ?
translation.kha: Uta u rangbah u ong ,  Nga la lait phet na ka thma ; bad nga la shu mareh shi lynter lynti haduh hangne mynta ka sngi .  U Eli u kylli ïa u ,  Ka la jia aïu , ko khun jong nga ?

translation.en: And the remnant took his servants , and entreated them spitefully , and slew them .
translation.kha: katba kiwei pat ki bat trait ïa ki shakri , ki shoh ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa ki .

translation.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , nor thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thine ox , nor thine ass , nor any of thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates  ; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou .
translation.kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta jong nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , lane ki khun jong phi , lane ki mraw jong phi , lane ki jingri jong phi , lane ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi . Ki mraw jong phi ki dei ban shongthait kumjuh .

translation.en: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more ; death hath no more dominion over him .
translation.kha: Namar ngi tip ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap bad un ym ïap shuh lano lano ruh — ka jingïap kan ym lah leh donbor shuh halor jong u .

translation.en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat , Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships . But Jehoshaphat would not .
translation.kha: Nangta u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel u tyrwa ban shah ïa ki maji jong u ba kin leit bad ki maji u Jehoshaphat , hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la kyntait ïa ka jingtyrwa .

translation.en: And this thing became a sin : for the people went to worship before the one , even unto Dan .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki briew ki la leh pop , naba ki leit mane ha Bethel bad ha Dan .

translation.en: Let us be glad and rejoice , and give honour to him : for the marriage of the Lamb is come , and his wife hath made herself ready .
translation.kha: To ngin ïarisa bad shadkmen ; to ngin ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ! Naba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingshongkurim jong U Khunlangbrot , bad ka nongleitkurim jong u ka la pynkhreh ïa lade na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest , they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God , which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim , and of all the remnant of Israel , and of all Judah and Benjamin  ; and they returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ka pisa kaba ki Lebi kiba long ki nongap phira ki la lum ha ka Templ la aiti ha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh . ( La lum ïa ka na ki briew ka Ephraim bad Manasseh bad kaba sah jong ka Hima bashatei , bad na ki paid Judah , Benjamin , bad Jerusalem . )

translation.en: The vision of Obadiah . Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning Edom  ; We have heard a rumour from the  Lord  , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen , Arise ye , and let us rise up against her in battle .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuhlypa jong u Obadaïah — kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong shaphang ka jaitbynriew Edom . U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ha ki jaitbynriew , bad ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong u :  To pynkhreh ! Ïa ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka Edom !

translation.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping , and began to wash his feet with tears , and did wipe them with the hairs of her head , and kissed his feet , and anointed them with the ointment .
translation.kha: bad ka la ïeng hadien jong U Jisu , hajan ki kjat jong u , ka da ïam bad ka da pynjhieh ïa ki kjat jong u da ki ummat jong ka . Nangta ka la ñiad pynrkhiang ïa ki kjat jong u da u shñiuh jong ka , ka la doh ïa ki , bad ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh ba-iwbih halor jong ki .

translation.en: Thousands of years of human history tell us that there has been more and more suffering .
translation.kha: Da ki hajar snem , ka Histori u bynriew ka iathuh ia ngi ba ka la don khambun shuhshuh ki jingjynjar .

translation.en: And when he would not be persuaded , we ceased , saying , The will of the Lord be done .
translation.kha: Ngim shym lah ban pynkohnguh ïa u , kumta ngi la sangeh noh bad ngi la ong ,  Ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon jong U Trai .

translation.en: No mention shall be made of coral , or of pearls : for the price of wisdom is above rubies .
translation.kha: Ka dor jong ka jingstad ka long palat ban ïa ki paila lane ki mawleiñ lane ki mawkordor .

translation.en: But the rest fled to Aphek , into the city  ; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left . And Ben–hadad fled , and came into the city , into an inner chamber .
translation.kha: Kiba lait im ki ïaphet ïap sha ka nongbah Aphek , ha kaba ki kynroh ka nongbah ki khyllem halor ki arphew hynñiew hajar ngut . U Benhadad ruh u lait phet shapoh ka nongbah bad u rieh ha ka kamra ba shadien jong ka ïing .

translation.en: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people : for they had not put him into prison .
translation.kha: Ïa nga ym pat shym la set ha ka byndi bad nga dang ïaid laitluid hapdeng ki briew .

translation.en: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father , and ye in me , and I in you .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin sa tip ba nga long ha U Kpa jong nga bad ba ma phi ha nga , kumba nga long ha phi .

translation.en: And they sent the coat of many colours , and they brought it to their father  ; and said , This have we found : know now whether it be thy son s coat or no .
translation.kha: Ki leit rah ïa kata ka sopti sha la u kpa , bad ki ong ,  Ngi lap ïa kane . Khmih la ka dei ne em ka sopti u khun jong phi .

translation.en: And fear came upon every soul : and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles .
translation.kha: Shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla la leh lyngba ki apostol , bad ïa uwei pa uwei baroh la pyndap da ka jingsheptieng ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , To day shalt thou be with me in paradise .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Nga kular ïa me ba ha kane ka sngi men don ha ka Paradais bad nga .

translation.en: By his neesings a light doth shine , and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka thaba haba u synriah , bad ki khmat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba mih .

translation.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life : but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien kiba sbun ki pynkhie im , hynrei ki kyntien kiba khor ki pynlwet ïa ka dohnud .

translation.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man , unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works ,
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u Dabid u la mut mynba u la kren shaphang ka jingsuk jong u briew ïa uba U Blei u pdiang kum uba hok , lait noh na kano kano kaba u briew u leh :

translation.en: The  Lord  said moreover unto me  ; Son of man , wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah ? yea , declare unto them their abominations  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , hato me la kloi ban bishar ïa ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ? Pynrem ïa ki namar kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .

translation.en: But if not , be it known unto thee , O king , that we will not serve thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada um leh , to u Syiem Kynrad un tip skhem ba ngin ym mane ïa u blei jong phi , bad ngin ym dem ngon sha ka durbriew ksiar kaba phi la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: But without thy mind would I do nothing  ; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity , but willingly .
translation.kha: Wat la katta , ngam kwah ban pynbor ïa me ban ïarap ïa nga ; pynban , ngan jin da la kwah ba men leh ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha jong me hi . Te ngan ym leh ïa kano kano lymda me mynjur .

translation.en: And the king s servants said unto him , Behold , Haman standeth in the court . And the king said , Let him come in .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki ong ,  U Haman u don hangne , u dang ap ban ïakynduh bad phi .   Phah ïa u shapoh ,  ong u syiem .

translation.en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north , and destroy Assyria  ; and will make Nineveh a desolation , and dry like a wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u ban pynjot ïa ka Assyria . Un pynlong ïa ka nongbah Ninebeh ka jingjot ba la shah iehnoh , ka ri shyiap bym don um .

translation.en: But I say unto you , That Elias is indeed come , and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed , as it is written of him .
translation.kha: Pynban , nga ong ïa phi , pynban , ba u Elijah u la lah wan bad ba ki briew ki la leh ïa u kumba ki mon , kat kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u .

translation.en: For this Melchisedec , king of Salem , priest of the most high God , who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings , and blessed him  ;
translation.kha: Une u Melkhisedek u la long u syiem jong ka Salem bad u lyngdoh jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Katba u Abraham u dang wan phai na ka thma ha kaba u la jop ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem , u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrkhu ïa u ,

translation.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt , for it was not leavened  ; because they were thrust out of Egypt , and could not tarry , neither had they prepared for themselves any victual .
translation.kha: Ki shet ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat na uta u kpu im ba ki wanrah na Ijipt , naba ki la shah beh kynsan na ka ri Ijipt ba kim ïoh por ban da khreh jingbam lane ban pynkhreh ïa u kpu im .

translation.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him , Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father s house ?
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel bad ka Leah ki jubab ïa u Jakob ,  Ym don ei ei shuh kaba ngin ïoh bynta na la i pa .

translation.en: But the bullock , and his hide , his flesh , and his dung , he burnt with fire without the camp  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U shim ïa kaba sah na u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , ïa ka doh bad ïa ki snier jong u , bad u thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And the woman arose , and did after the saying of the man of God : and she went with her household , and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years .
translation.kha: Ka la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u , bad ka la leit bad la ka longïing ban shong ban sah ha Philistia haduh hynñiew snem .

translation.en: Therefore he knoweth their works , and he overturneth them in the night , so that they are destroyed .
translation.kha: Namar ba u tip kaei kaba u leh ; u weng noh ïa ki bad u pynlwet ïa ki mynmiet .

translation.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine  ; he stretched out his hand with scorners .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi pyndonburom ïa u syiem , ki pynlong ïa u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ban dih buaid bad leh bieit da ka waiñ .
