translation.en: Now when they were going , behold , some of the watch came into the city , and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done .
translation.kha: Katba ki kynthei ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki shipai kiba ap phira ïa ka jingtep ki la leit phai pat sha ka nongbah bad ki la ïathuh ha ki rangbah lyngdoh ïa baroh kaba la lah jia .

translation.en: And the people cried unto Moses  ; and when Moses prayed unto the  Lord  , the fire was quenched .
translation.kha: Kita ki paidbah ki la kyang ha u Moses ban ïarap ; u la duwai ha U  Trai  , bad ka ding ka la lip noh .

translation.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this , To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction , and to keep himself unspotted from the world .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba U Blei uba U Kpa u ñiew ba ka long kaba sngur bad ka jinglong riewblei bashisha ka long kane : Ban leit khmih ïa ki khunswet bad ïa ki riewkynthei ha ka jingshitom jong ki bad ban ri noh ïa lade kiba khlem thohbria na ka jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it : and the men were grieved , and they were very wroth , because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob s daughter  ; which thing ought not to be done .
translation.kha: Haba ki ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la kyndit bad bitar shla ba u Shekhem u la leh ïa kaba kum kane bad ba u la ibeiñ ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel da kaba batbor ïa ka khun jong u Jakob .

translation.en: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea : and a great multitude from Galilee followed him , and from Judaea ,
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la leit noh sha ka duriaw Galilaïa , bad u paidbah babun u la bud ïa u . Ki la wan na Galilaïa , na Judia ,

translation.en: His mother saith unto the servants , Whatsoever he saith unto you , do it .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u Jisu te ka la ong ïa ki shakri ,  To leh kat kaba u ong ïa phi .

translation.en: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners , they said unto his disciples , How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba long ki Pharisi , ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïabam bad kine ki briew ba la shah kyntait lem bad ki nonglum khajna , kumta ki la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei ba u ïabam lang bad kum kine ki briew ?

translation.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good  ; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil : for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u wallam ïa kaba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha kiba ha ka dohnud jong u ; u briew uba sniew u wallam ïa kaba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew . Naba ka shyntur ka kren ïa kaei kaba dap ha ka dohnud .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahasaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: The Zidonians also , and the Amalekites , and the Maonites , did oppress you  ; and ye cried to me , and I delivered you out of their hand .
translation.kha: Ki Sidon , ki Amalek , bad ki Maon ki la banbeiñ ïa phi ha ki por ba la leit ; bad phi la kyang jam sha nga . Hato ngam shym la pyllait im ïa phi na ki ?

translation.en: And they built the high places of Baal , which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom , to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech  ; which I commanded them not , neither came it into my mind , that they should do this abomination , to cause Judah to sin .
translation.kha: Ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal ha ka Them Hinnom , ban kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki ha u blei Molekh . Ngam shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane , bad kam ju rung wat ha ka jingmut jong nga ba kin leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei bad pynlong ïa ki paid Judah ban leh pop .

translation.en: Good understanding giveth favour : but the way of transgressors is hard .
translation.kha: Ka jingshemphang ka pynïoh ïa ka jingñiewburom , hynrei kito ki bym lah ban shaniah ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them  ; none shall slumber nor sleep  ; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed , nor the latchet of their shoes be broken :
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano na ki , kiba la sdang thait , bad ym don mano mano na ki , kiba jynthut . Kim ju samthiah lane thiah . Ym don u  saipan ba la lait , ym don u ksai juti uba la dkut .

translation.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the  Lord  , because the glory of the  Lord  had filled the  Lord s  house .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka Templ ka la dap da ka jingshai batyngshaiñ , ki lyngdoh kim shym lah ban rung shapoh .

translation.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall , and , behold , it be not in sight deeper than the skin , and that there is no black hair in it  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days :
translation.kha: Lada , haba u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa u , u shem ba kata ka prum kam shym long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , hynrei ym pat shym don shñiuh ïong hangta , yn pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow ? or will he harrow the valleys after thee ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban teh ïa u da u tyllai bad pynlur ïa u ? lane pynlong ïa u ban ring lyngkor ha ki lyngkha jong me ?

translation.en: If we have sown unto you spiritual things , is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things ?
translation.kha: Ngi la bet ïa u symbai ba kynja mynsiem hapdeng jong phi . Hato ka long palat eh lada ngi shim ïa ki jingmyntoi na phi ?

translation.en: But these are written , that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ , the Son of God  ; and that believing ye might have life through his name .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kine la thoh khnang ba phin ïoh ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , bad da kaba ngeit ha u phin ïoh ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: The land also shall be left of them , and shall enjoy her sabbaths , while she lieth desolate without them : and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity : because , even because they despised my judgments , and because their soul abhorred my statutes .
translation.kha: Nyngkong , la kumno kumno , ka ri ka dei ban lait na ki briew jong ka , ba kumta kan ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingshongthait kaba pura , bad ki dei ban shah pynshitom ha ban da biang namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden : for , behold , from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed .
translation.kha: naba u la kynmaw ïa nga , ka shakri barit jong u ! Naduh mynta ki briew baroh kin khot ïa nga , kaba kmen ,

translation.en: For ye may all prophesy one by one , that all may learn , and all may be comforted .
translation.kha: Phi baroh phi lah ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , uwei hadien uwei , khnang ba uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh jinghikai bad jingpynshlur .

translation.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki langbrot ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan lem bad ki jingainguh bam ba ai sha U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: To him which smote great kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba donbor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Bel boweth down , Nebo stoopeth , their idols were upon the beasts , and upon the cattle : your carriages were heavy loaden  ; they are a burden to the weary beast .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ki blei ka Babilon ! Ïa u Bel bad ïa u Nebo shisien la mane ïa ki , hynrei mynta la pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada , ka jingbankhia ïa ki met ki mrad ba la thait .

translation.en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
translation.kha: A katno uba kmen long u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha ïing !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In an acceptable time have I heard thee , and in a day of salvation have I helped thee : and I will preserve thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , to establish the earth , to cause to inherit the desolate heritages  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha la ki briew ,  Haba ka por ban pyllait im ïa phi ka la poi , ngan pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewbha jong nga ïa phi bad ban sngap ïa ki jingkhot kyrpad jingïarap . Ngan ri bad ïada ïa phi bad lyngba jong phi ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki briew baroh . Ngan shah ba phi shongduh sa shisien ha la ka ri kaba mynta ka la shu sah shrah .

translation.en: And the Chaldeans burned the king s house , and the houses of the people , with fire , and brake down the walls of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ki nong Babilonia ki la thang duh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad ïa ki ïing jong ki briew bad pynpra ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Now therefore take , I pray thee , thy weapons , thy quiver and thy bow , and go out to the field , and take me some venison  ;
translation.kha: To shim ïa la ka ryntieh bad ki khnam , khie leit sha rudnong bad pynïap kawei ka mrad na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Shout against her round about : she hath given her hand : her foundations are fallen , her walls are thrown down : for it is the vengeance of the  Lord  : take vengeance upon her  ; as she hath done , do unto her .
translation.kha: Pynjam ïa ka jingkyang thma baroh sawdong ka nongbah ! Mynta ka Babilon ka la wan pyndem . Ki kynroh jong ka ki la pei lyngba bad la pyntwa . Nga siew kylliang ïa ki nong Babilonia . Te to siew kylliang ïa ki , bad leh ïa ki kumba ki la leh ïa kiwei .

translation.en: And I have set there a place for the ark , wherein is the covenant of the  Lord  , which he made with our fathers , when he brought them out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Nga la pynkhreh ruh ka jaka ha ka Templ ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap jong ka jutang ha kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die  ; and he charged Solomon his son , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la jan ïap , u la khot ïa u Solomon , u khun jong u bad u la ai ha u ïa ki jingbthah bakhatduh :

translation.en: And the  Lord  put a word in Balaam s mouth , and said , Return unto Balak , and thus thou shalt speak .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Balaam kumno ban kren bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Balak , ban ai ha u ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: For before these days there was no hire for man , nor any hire for beast  ; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction : for I set all men every one against his neighbour .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa kata ka por ym don mano mano ba lah bor ban wai la ïa ki mrad lymne ki briew , ban ym don mano mano ba lait na ki nongshun jong u . Nga la pynphai ïa ki briew pyrshah iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar , and slew the calf of the sin offering , which was for himself .
translation.kha: U Aaron u leit sha ka duwan bad u pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong u hi .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  of hosts came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah .

translation.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds  ; I will be like the most High .
translation.kha: Me la ong ba men kiew ïa ki kliar jong ki lyoh bad ban long kum U Badonbor Tam .

translation.en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , namar jong phi , ïa ka Seïon yn lur kum ïa ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan long kum ka kynton ñiut , bad u lum ka Templ un long kum ka khlaw .

translation.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
translation.kha: Ha Ijipt u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , na ka Asenath ka khun jong u Potiphera , u lyngdoh ha ka Heliopolis .

translation.en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city , when they heard these things .
translation.kha: Da kine ki ktien ki la pynkhihwin ïa u paidbah bad ïa ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me : It is good for a man not to touch a woman .
translation.kha: Mynta , to ngin ïa-peit ïa ki bynta kiba phi la thoh . Ka bha ïa u briew ba un ym shongkurim .

translation.en: Then the spirit took me up , and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing , saying , Blessed be the glory of the  Lord  from his place .
translation.kha: Te U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah joit ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew na shadien jong nga ïa ka jingsawa jam jong ka sur kaba ong ,  To ïaroh ïa ka burom U  Trai  ha bneng shajrong !

translation.en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering , according to the manner : and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un kñia ïa kaba ar kum ka jingainguh thang , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .

translation.en: But he denied before them all , saying , I know not what thou sayest .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata ha khmat jong ki baroh .  Ngam tip ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab ,

translation.en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods : and the people did eat , and bowed down to their gods .
translation.kha: Kine ki kynthei ki la khot sngewbha ïa ki sha ki jingkhawai jingkñia ha kaba la mane ïa u blei ki Moab . Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ki jingbam bad mane ïa u blei Baal jong ki Peor .

translation.en: He stretched out his hand over the sea , he shook the kingdoms : the  Lord  hath given a commandment against the merchant city , to destroy the strong holds thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw bad u la jop ïa ki hima . U la hukum ban pynjot ïa ki jaka pdeng jong ki jingkhaïi pateng ka Phoenisia .

translation.en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary , and the young men shall utterly fall :
translation.kha: Wat kito kiba dang samla ki sngewtlot ; ki rangsamla ki lah ban kyllon ha ka jingthait .

translation.en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come , by a greater and more perfect tabernacle , not made with hands , that is to say , not of this building  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la lah wan lypa kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong kiei kiei kiba bha kiba la don lypa hangne . Ka Ïingjaiñ ha kaba u shakri ka long kaba kham khraw bad kaba kham janai ; kam dei ka ïingjaiñ kaba la shna da u briew , kata ka long , kam dei ka bynta jong kane ka pyrthei ïa kaba la thaw .

translation.en: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God  ; and to them were given seven trumpets .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba ïeng ha khmat U Blei , bad la ai ha ki , hynñiew tylli ki turoi .

translation.en: Here is the patience of the saints : here are they that keep the commandments of God , and the faith of Jesus .
translation.kha: Kane ka khot ïa ka jingïaishah ha ka liang ki briew jong U Blei , kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei bad kiba ïaineh ha U Jisu .

translation.en: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon , by the way . But David abode in the wilderness , and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad u sher dara harud lynti ha u Lum Hakhilah . U Dabid u dang don ha kata ka ri khlaw , bad haba u tip ba u Saul u la wan wad ïa u ,

translation.en: And when the people saw what Paul had done , they lifted up their voices , saying in the speech of Lycaonia , The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba u Paul u la leh , ki la sdang ban pyrta jam ha ka ktien Lykaonia jong ki ,  Ki blei ki la wan long kum ki briew bad ki la wan hiar sha ngi !

translation.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving , then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil , and unleavened wafers anointed with oil , and cakes mingled with oil , of fine flour , fried .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u wallam ïa kane ka jingainguh kum ka jingai sngewnguh sha U Blei , u dei ruh ban wanrah , ryngkat bad uta u mrad ïa uba yn kñia , ïa ka jingainguh ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat : ki kpu kiba rben ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib lane kiba stang ba la kyllan da ka umphniang Olib lane da u  purew ba la shet khleh bad ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: Having eyes full of adultery , and that cannot cease from sin  ; beguiling unstable souls : an heart they have exercised with covetous practices  ; cursed children :
translation.kha: Kim kwah ban peit ïa kaei kaei hynrei ïa ki kynthei ba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli ; ka jingkwah brai jong ki ïa ka pop kam ju hun . Ki ïalam ïa ki briew kiba tlot sha ka jingriam . Ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba la shah hikai ban long kiba lalot . Ki don hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei !

translation.en: For , behold , the day cometh , that shall burn as an oven  ; and all the proud , yea , and all that do wickedly , shall be stubble : and the day that cometh shall burn them up , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that it shall leave them neither root nor branch .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ka sngi ka la nang wan ha kaba ïa kiba sarong baroh bad ïa ki briew kiba sniew yn thang kum u phlangïap . Ha kata ka sngi kin shah thang lut , bad yn ym don kaba sah na ki .

translation.en: But ye shall receive power , after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you : and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem , and in all Judaea , and in Samaria , and unto the uttermost part of the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u wan ha phi , yn pyndap ïa phi da ka bor , bad phin long ki sakhi jong nga ha Jerusalem , ha baroh ka Judia bad Samaria , bad shaduh kiba kut jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest , and unto Joshua the son of Nun , and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki longïing na ka jait Lebi ki leit sha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , sha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad sha ki khlieh jong ki longïing na ki jait Israel baroh .

translation.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva , a Jew , and chief of the priests , which did so .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ngut ki shynrang kiba shi para , kiba long ki khun jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Skeba , ki la leh ïa kane .

translation.en: Then answered I them , and said unto them , The God of heaven , he will prosper us  ; therefore we his servants will arise and build : but ye have no portion , nor right , nor memorial , in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nga jubab ,  U Blei jong ka Bneng un ai jingjop ïa ngi . Ngi long ki shakri jong u , bad ngin sdang ïa ka jingtei . Hynrei phim don hok ïa kano kano ka jingdon ha Jerusalem , bad phim ïadon bynta ha ki riti ki dustur jong ka .

translation.en: Honour thy father and mother ; ( which is the first commandment with promise ; )
translation.kha: To burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,  kaba long ka hukum kaba nyngkong kaba don ka jingkular ha ka :

translation.en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary , having charge at the gates of the house , and ministering to the house : they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people , and they shall stand before them to minister unto them .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban shakri ïa nga ha ka Templ da kaba khmih ïa ki khyrdop bad ban trei ïa ka kam jong ka Templ . Ki lah ban pynïap ïa ki mrad kiba ki briew ki ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia , bad kin don ha ka kam ban shakri ïa ki briew .

translation.en: I counsel thee to keep the king s commandment , and that in regard of the oath of God .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba u syiem u ong , bad wat pynlong kano kano ka jingkular ha U Blei khlem da pyrkhat bha .

translation.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept , and all the works of the house of Ahab , and ye walk in their counsels  ; that I should make thee a desolation , and the inhabitants thereof an hissing : therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people .
translation.kha: Kane kan jia namar ba phi la bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u syiem Omri bad jong u khun jong u , u syiem Ahab . Phi la ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom pynïaidkam jong ki , bad kumta ngan wallam ïa ka jingjot ha phi , bad baroh kin kyntait ïa phi . Ki briew ha kylleng kin ñiewbeiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt , and rested in all the coasts of Egypt : very grievous were they  ; before them there were no such locusts as they , neither after them shall be such .
translation.kha: Kita ki puit ki wan kynhun kynhun bad ki dem ha ka ri baroh kawei . Kat kata ka jingbun ki puit ym pat ju ïohi mynno mynno lane yn ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh .

translation.en: And he asked Pharaoh s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord s house , saying , Wherefore look ye so sadly to day ?
translation.kha: Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ikhuslai palat mynta ka sngi ?

translation.en: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart , saying , The seventh year , the year of release , is at hand  ; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother , and thou givest him nought  ; and he cry unto the  Lord  against thee , and it be sin unto thee .
translation.kha: Wat kyntait ban ai kylliang ei ei ïa u , tang namar ba ka snem map ram ka la jan poi . Wat shah ba kum kata ka jingmut bymman kan rung ha phi . Lada phi kyntait ban ai kylliang , un sa kyang ha U  Trai  pyrshah ïa phi , te kan long pop ha phi .

translation.en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace .
translation.kha: Ka long kumjuh mynta : Don khyndiat ngut kiba dang sah na kito kiba U Blei u la jied namar ka jingaiei jong u .

translation.en: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face , that thy shame may appear .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi un sloit ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad un pynpaw ïa pha ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things , and needest not that any man should ask thee : by this we believe that thou camest forth from God .
translation.kha: Ngi tip mynta ba me tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ; mem da donkam ba uno uno un kylli jingkylli ïa me . Kane ka pynlong ïa ngi ban ngeit ba me la wan na U Blei .

translation.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof , and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it ,
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba la tap ïa ka duriaw da ki lyoh bad uba la sop ïa ka da ka jingdum .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , pardon my sin , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga kyrpad ïa phi , map ïa ka pop jong nga , bad leit phai bad nga , ba kumta ngan lah ban mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And because he saw it pleased the Jews , he proceeded further to take Peter also . ( Then were the days of unleavened bread . )
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ba kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki Jiw , u la thew ruh ban kem sa ïa u Petros . ( Kane ka la jia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ) .

translation.en: I will declare the decree : the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou art my Son  ; this day have I begotten thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynbna ,  ong u syiem ,  ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la pynbna . U ong ha nga : ‘ Me long u khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long u kpa jong me .

translation.en: And they shall be as mighty men , which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle : and they shall fight , because the  Lord  is with them , and the riders on horses shall be confounded .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah kin jop kum ki shipai kiba kyrdem ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ktieh jong ki lynti bah . Kin ïaleh namar U  Trai  u don bad ki , bad kin jop wat ïa ka kynhun shipai shong kulai jong u nongshun .

translation.en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken  ; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram .
translation.kha: U Balak u leh kumba la bthah , te ma u bad u Balaam ki la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants , shipmen that had knowledge of the sea , with the servants of Solomon .
translation.kha: U Syiem Hiram u la phah katto katne ngut ki maji kiba tbit bha na ka kynhun lieng jong u ban ïatreilang bad ki maji jong u Solomon .

translation.en: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah , and pursued the Philistines , and smote them , until they came under Beth–car .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki mih na Mispah bad ki beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , bad ki pynïap ïa ki lynter lynti haduh Bethkar .

translation.en: Laying wait for him , and seeking to catch something out of his mouth , that they might accuse him .
translation.kha: da kaba pyrshang ban buh ki jingriam ïa u bad ban kem daw ïa u lada u kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bakla .

translation.en: And with every living creature that is with you , of the fowl , of the cattle , and of every beast of the earth with you  ; from all that go out of the ark , to every beast of the earth .
translation.kha: bad baroh ki jingthaw ba-im — ki sim , bad ki mrad baroh — kat kiba la wan mih lang bad phi na kata ka lieng .

translation.en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor , that looketh toward Jeshimon .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalam ïa u Balaam sha khlieh u Lum Peor uba phai shaphang ri shyiap .

translation.en: And thou , Pashur , and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity : and thou shalt come to Babylon , and there thou shalt die , and shalt be buried there , thou , and all thy friends , to whom thou hast prophesied lies .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko Pashhur , ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me baroh yn kem ruh bad rah sha Babilonia . Hangta men ïap bad yn tep , lem bad ki paralok jong me baroh ïa kiba me la lah ïathuh bun ki jinglamler .’

translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
translation.kha: Ale wan rung , phi ki briew kiba duna ka bor sngewthuh !  Bad ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,

translation.en: For this people s heart is waxed gross , and their ears are dull of hearing , and their eyes they have closed  ; lest at any time they should see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and should understand with their heart , and should be converted , and I should heal them .
translation.kha: namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki la bthi , bad ki la set ïa ki shkor jong ki bad ki la khapbrip la ki khmat . Lymda kumta , ki khmat jong ki , kin jin da la ïohi , ki shkor jong ki kin jin da la ïohsngew ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki kin jin da la shemphang , bad kin jin da la wan phai pat sha nga ,’ ong U Blei , ‘ bad ngan pynkhiah ïa ki .’

translation.en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families : and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph .
translation.kha: Ka jaka kaba dei jong ki longïing jong ka jait Benjamin ka long kaba nyngkong eh ïa kaba la ai . Ka jaka jong ki ka don hapdeng ki jait Judah bad Joseph .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed what ye hear : with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you : and unto you that hear shall more be given .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew ! Da kijuh ki aiñ kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei , U Blei un sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — hynrei wat da kaba kham eh .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ahab u jubab ,  Haba phi kren ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno sien ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?

translation.en: The God of Abraham , and the God of Nahor , the God of their father , judge betwixt us . And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac .
translation.kha: U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Nahor un bishar hapdeng jong ngi .  Kumta , ha ka kyrteng U Blei ïa uba u Isaak u kpa jong u , u la mane , u Jakob u la smai da kaba sngew kyntang ban bat ïa kane ka kular .

translation.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years  ; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew tylli ki masi raikhoh kiba wan mih hadien bad ki hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba raikhoh , bad kiba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , ki long hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew .

translation.en: Thou therefore , son of man , prophesy , and smite thine hands together , and let the sword be doubled the third time , the sword of the slain : it is the sword of the great men that are slain , which entereth into their privy chambers .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Thab ïa la ki kti , bad ka waitlam kan mait bad ïai mait . Ka dei ka waitlam kaba pynïap , ka waitlam ba pynshyrkhei bad ba mait .

translation.en: None that go unto her return again , neither take they hold of the paths of life .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka uba lah ban wan phai . Un ym lah shuh ban wan phai pat sha ka lynti ka jingim .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah , and against Benjamin , and against the house of Ephraim  ; so that Israel was sore distressed .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki da jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban ïaleh ïa ki jait Judah , Benjamin , bad Ephraim . Ki Israel ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .

translation.en: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness : none of them shall remain , nor of their multitude , nor of any of theirs : neither shall there be wailing for them .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jubor ka nang pynroi ïa ka jingbymman . Yn ym don kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong ki , ki ban neh , la ka long ka spah , ka burom , ne ka nam jong ki .

translation.en: If ye love me , keep my commandments .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa nga , phin sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga .

translation.en: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee , and findeth Philip , and saith unto him ,  Follow me .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu u la kut jingmut ban leit noh sha Galilaïa . U la shem ïa u Philip bad u la ong ha u ,  To wan bad nga !

translation.en: Send one of you , and let him fetch your brother , and ye shall be kept in prison , that your words may be proved , whether there be any truth in you : or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies .
translation.kha: Uwei na phi un leit bad un wan ïalam ïa u . Ïa kiba sah na phi pat yn buh hapoh ka jingap phira tad haduh ba yn da lah ban pynshisha ïa kaei kaba phi ong . Lym kumta , katba u syiem u im , phi dei ki nongsyntiat .

translation.en: For when ye were the servants of sin , ye were free from righteousness .
translation.kha: Mynba phi la long ki mraw jong ka pop , phi la lait noh na ka hok .

translation.en: And thou sayest , How doth God know ? can he judge through the dark cloud ?
translation.kha: Bad pynban phi kylli ,  Aïu U Blei u tip ? la buhrieh ïa u ha ki lyoh — kumno u lah ban bishar ïa ngi ?

translation.en: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon , come down from thy glory , and sit in thirst  ; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee , and he shall destroy thy strong holds .
translation.kha: Phi kiba shong ha Dibon , to hiar noh na ka jaka badonburom jong phi bad shong ha khyndew ha u pui pui ; u nongpynjot ka Moab u don hangne bad u la ieh ïa ki kut jong ka ha ki jingjot .

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Don ne em hangta sa uwei u nongïathuhlypa ha uba ngi lah ban ïasyllok bad U  Trai  ?

translation.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed  ; as Gozan , and Haran , and Rezeph , and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar ?
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ka Gosan , Haran , bad Reseph , bad pynïap ïa ki briew ka Betheden kiba sah ha Telassar , bad ym don na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban pyllait im ïa ki .

translation.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise  ; but a foolish man spendeth it up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki shong ha ka spah bad ka jingim pahuh hynrei ki briew kiba bieit ki pynlut noh ïa ka pisa tang shu ïoh ïa ka .

translation.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Bring him down unto me , that I may set mine eyes upon him .
translation.kha: Nangta phi ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u shane , khnang ba phin ïoh peit ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , the hand of the  Lord  is upon thy cattle which is in the field , upon the horses , upon the asses , upon the camels , upon the oxen , and upon the sheep : there shall be a very grievous murrain .
translation.kha: ngan pynshitom ïa me da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang kaba shyrkhei ha ki jingri jong me baroh — ha ki kulai , ki kada , ki ut , ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang jong me .

translation.en: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding .
translation.kha: La don hangta hajan , ka kynhun jong ki sniang kiba bun , kiba ïabam jingbam ha ka sharing lum .

translation.en: Then Baruch answered them , He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth , and I wrote them with ink in the book .
translation.kha: U Barukh u la jubab ,  U Jeremaïah u la ong ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ha nga , bad nga la thoh ïa ka da ka sia ha kane ka kot kli .

translation.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant .
translation.kha: Uba khraw tam hapdeng jong phi u dei ban long u shakri jong phi .

translation.en: A good name is better than precious ointment  ; and the day of death than the day of one s birth .
translation.kha: Ka nam kaba bha ka kham kor ban ïa ka jingiwbih baremdor , bad ka sngi kaba phi ïap ka kham bha ban ïa ka sngi ha kaba la kha ïa phi .

translation.en: And there went out another horse that was red : and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth , and that they should kill one another : and there was given unto him a great sword .
translation.kha: Sa uwei pat u kulai u la wan mih , uba saw ka rong . Ha u nongshong kulai la ai ïa ka bor ban wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka pyrthei , ba ki briew kin ïa-pynïap para ma ki hi . La ai ha u ïa ka waitlam kaba heh .

translation.en: And we sailed thence , and came the next day over against Chios  ; and the next day we arrived at Samos , and tarried at Trogyllium  ; and the next day we came to Miletus .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng nangta bad ngi la poi ha Khios ha ka sngi kaba bud . Hadien shi sngi ngi la wan poi ha Samos , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Miletos .

translation.en: For as the lightning cometh out of the east , and shineth even unto the west  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
translation.kha: Naba U Khun U Briew un wan kum ka leilieh kaba thaba na shiliang sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , na mihngi sha sepngi .

translation.en: And if it bear fruit , well : and if not , then after that thou shalt cut it down .
translation.kha: Te lada u dieng u pynmih soh Dumbur ha ka snem kaba bud , katta kan kham bha ; lymda kumta , te phi lah ban phah khet noh ïa u .’

translation.en: And Micah consecrated the Levite  ; and the young man became his priest , and was in the house of Micah .
translation.kha: U Mikah u thung ïa u kum u lyngdoh jong u , bad u sah ha ïing u Mikah .

translation.en: Above it stood the seraphims : each one had six wings  ; with twain he covered his face , and with twain he covered his feet , and with twain he did fly .
translation.kha: Sawdong jong u ki seraph ki ïeng , uwei uwei na ki u don hynriew tylli ki thapniang . Uwei uwei u seraph u tap ïa la ka durkhmat da ki ar tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa la ka met da ki ar tylli , bad la pyndonkam ïa ki ar tylli kiwei pat ban her .

translation.en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them , they cast them into prison , charging the jailor to keep them safely :
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingsympat kaba jur , la set phatok ïa ki , bad la ai hukum ïa u nongpeit phatok ban khang skhem ïa ki .

translation.en: And the angel that talked with me came again , and waked me , as a man that is wakened out of his sleep ,
translation.kha: U angel uba la lah kren ha nga u la wan biang bad u la kyrsiew ïa nga la kumba nga dang thiah .

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  fell upon me , and said unto me , Speak  ; Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thus have ye said , O house of Israel : for I know the things that come into your mind , every one of them .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha ki briew ïa kane ka khubor :  Ko ki paid Israel , nga tip ïa kaei kaba phi ong bad ïa kaei kaba phi thmu .

translation.en: And said unto him , Thus saith Jephthah , Israel took not away the land of Moab , nor the land of the children of Ammon :
translation.kha: lem bad kane ka jubab ,  Kam long kaba shisha ba ki Israel ki la knieh ïa ka ri ki Moab ne ïa ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed  ; I saw , and behold a tree in the midst of the earth , and the height thereof was great .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang ïohthiah , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ïa u dieng bakhraw ha ka pdeng jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth , while the evil days come not , nor the years draw nigh , when thou shalt say , I have no pleasure in them  ;
translation.kha: Kumta to kynmaw ïa la U Nongthaw katba phi dang samla ha shuwa ka jingwan kito ki sngi bad ki snem ba-dum ha kaba phin ong ,  ngam sngewtynnat ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: And now , behold , the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir , whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade , when they came out of the land of Egypt , but they turned from them , and destroyed them not  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ki briew jong ka Ammon , ka Moab bad ka Edom ki la tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Mynba ki kpa tymmen ki mihnoh na Ijipt , mem shym la shah ïa ki ban rung ha kito ki ri , kumta ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la hap ban ïaid sawdong jong ki bad mem shym la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban lait na ka jingïap ? Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka umpohliew ka jingim .

translation.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way , he shall fall himself into his own pit : but the upright shall have good things in possession .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh buit bymman ïa u briew uba hok ban leh ïa kaba sniew , phin hap ha la ka jong ka liewlep . Uba lui lui un ïohnong shibun .

translation.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth , and thou shalt spread abroad to the west , and to the east , and to the north , and to the south : and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Kin man bun kum ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew . Kin pynïar ïa la u pud u sam ha ki liang baroh ; bad da me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And he said likewise to him , Be thou also over five cities .
translation.kha: Ïa une u la ong , ‘ Men long u nongkhmih ïa ki san tylli ki nongbah .’

translation.en: And some of them said , Could not this man , which opened the eyes of the blind , have caused that even this man should not have died ?
translation.kha: Hynrei don na ki kiba la ong ,  U la pynpeit ïa ki khmat uba matlah , ym dei ? Hato un ym lah ban ïa u Lasaros bat ym ïap ?

translation.en: After this I looked , and , behold , a door was opened in heaven : and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me  ; which said , Come up hither , and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por , nga don kawei pat ka jingïohipaw bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingkhang ba plie ha bneng . Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba sawa kum ka turoi kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren ha nga kumba mynshuwa , kaba ong ,  Wan kiew shane shalor , bad ngan pyn-i ïa me kaei kaba dei ban jia hadien kane .

translation.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah , Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king .
translation.kha: Nga sheptieng , kam dei kumta ,  u Jonathan u jubab .  U Syiem Kynrad , u Dabid u la pynlong syiem ïa u Solomon .

translation.en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches .
translation.kha: Hangno ba ka don ka jingtip , ïa ki kamra la pyndap pynbiang da ki jingbuh jingsat kiba kordor bad kiba itynnat .

translation.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt , and led you forty years through the wilderness , to possess the land of the Amorite .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ïalam ruh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , nga la ïalam ïa phi sawphew snem lyngba ka ri shyiap bad nga la ai ïa phi ïa ka ri ki Amor ba phin ïohkynti .

translation.en: All these of the sons of Obed–edom : they and their sons and their brethren , able men for strength for the service , were threescore and two of Obed–edom .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u Obed Edom ka pynmih hynriewphew ar ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit bha na ka bynta kane ka kam .

translation.en: And , behold , there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him .
translation.kha: Nangta ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Moses bad u Elijah ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .

translation.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead , and purifieth not himself , defileth the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel : because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him , he shall be unclean  ; his uncleanness is yet upon him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki sah hi ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ki . Kita ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ jong U  Trai  , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem , when they had fulfilled their ministry , and took with them John , whose surname was Mark .
translation.kha: U Barnabas bad u Saul ki la lah pyndep ïa la ka kam bad ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lem bad ki .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Fill the waterpots with water .  And they filled them up to the brim .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki shakri ,  Pyndap ïa kine ki khra da ka um .

translation.en: But the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots , and forty thousand footmen , and killed Shophach the captain of the host .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka sdang , bad ki Israel ki pynher krad ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria sha la ka jaka . U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynïap hynñiew hajar ngut ki nongñiah kali ïapom jong ki Syria bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . Ki pynïap ruh ïa u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum ki Syria .

translation.en: Servants have ruled over us : there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la synshar da ki rangbah kiba long kum ki mraw hi , bad ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka bor jong ki .

translation.en: Withal praying also for us , that God would open unto us a door of utterance , to speak the mystery of Christ , for which I am also in bonds :
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong ngi , ba kumta U Blei un ai ha ngi ka kabu babha ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u shaphang ka jingmaïan U Khrist . Namar kata keiñ balei ba nga don mynta ha byndi .

translation.en: And thine eye shall not pity  ; but life shall go for life , eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot .
translation.kha: Ha kum kita ki mokotduma , wat ju leh-isynei ; ka jingpynshitom kan long ka jingim namar ka jingim , ka khmat namar ka khmat , ka bniat namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , bad ka kjat namar ka kjat .

translation.en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the  Lord  , and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem bad u Jehoïada ki ai ïa kata ka pisa ha kito kiba dei peit ïa ka kam shna pynbha ïa ka Templ , bad ki wai ïa ki misteri maw , ki misteri dieng , ki nongtrei nar , ban shna pynbha .

translation.en: It is sown a natural body ; it is raised a spiritual body . There is a natural body , and there is a spiritual body .
translation.kha: Haba la tep , ka long kaba kynja doh ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long ka met kaba kynja mynsiem . Ka don shisha ka met ba kynja doh , kumta ruh ka dei ban don ka met ba kynja mynsiem .

translation.en: As also the high priest doth bear me witness , and all the estate of the elders : from whom also I received letters unto the brethren , and went to Damascus , to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem , for to be punished .
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar hi baroh kawei ki lah ban pynshisha ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha . Nga la ïohpdiang na ki ïa ki shithi kiba la thoh sha ki para Jiw kiba ha Damaskos , kumta nga la leit shata ban kem ïa kine ki briew bad wan ïalam pat ïa ki , kiba la khum ha ki kynjri sha Jerusalem ba yn pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: Till another king arose , which knew not Joseph .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u syiem u bym shym ithuh ïa u Joseph u la sdang ban synshar ha Ijipt .

translation.en: And one of his servants answered and said , Let some take , I pray thee , five of the horses that remain , which are left in the city , ( behold , they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it : behold , I say , they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed : ) and let us send and see .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u , u ong ,  Ki briew ha kane ka nongbah ki long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , la kum kito kiba la ïap . Kumta , to ngin ïaphah katto katne ngut ki rangbah bad san tylli ki kulai kiba dang sah khnang ba ngin tip ka la jia aïu .

translation.en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard .
translation.kha: Naba ngim lah ban sangeh ban kren ïa kaei kaba ma ngi hi ngi la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

translation.en: And Edom said unto him , Thou shalt not pass by me , lest I come out against thee with the sword .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ong ,  Ngim shah ïa phi ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong ngi ! Lada phi pyrshang , ngin mih bad tur ïaleh ïa phi .

translation.en: And the waters covered their enemies : there was not one of them left .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka um ka la pynngam jyllop ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait .

translation.en: As thou hast given him power over all flesh , that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him .
translation.kha: Naba me la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor u bynriew baroh , khnang ba u lah ban ai ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha kito baroh ïa kiba me la ai ha u .

translation.en: And Og the king of Bashan : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: bad ïa u Og , u syiem ka Bashan ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth–el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel , saying , Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel : the land is not able to bear all his words .
translation.kha: Amasaïah , u lyngdoh ka Bethel , u la phah ka khubor sha u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel :  U Amos u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi hapdeng ki briew . Ki jingkren jong u kin pynjot ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , u Moses u wanlam ïa uta u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Sing , O barren , thou that didst not bear  ; break forth into singing , and cry aloud , thou that didst not travail with child : for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , pha la long kum ka briew ka bym don khun , hynrei mynta pha lah ban rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Mynta phan sa ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka briew kaba u tnga jong ka um ju iehnoh ïa ka !

translation.en: Lo , their good is not in their hand : the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
translation.kha: Ki ong ba ki ïoh jingjop da ka bor jong ki hi , hynrei ïa ka rukom jingpyrkhat jong ki , ngam lah ban pdiang .

translation.en: And I will give them an heart to know me , that I am the  Lord  : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God : for they shall return unto me with their whole heart .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingangnud ban tip ba nga long U  Trai . Te ki kin long ki briew jong nga , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki , namar kin phai pat sha nga da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang long kawei ka jaitbynriew , wat leh ïa kano kano ka ban ïarap ïa kine ki jaitbynriew ne pynmyntoi ïa ki .

translation.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips : but the just shall come out of trouble .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki shah riam ha ki ktien jong ki hi , hynrei ki briew kiba beit ki pyllait ïa lade na ka jynjar .

translation.en: And when they had stripped him , they took his head , and his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to carry tidings unto their idols , and to the people .
translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Saul , ki law noh ïa ki jingkieng atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban leit ïathuh ïa ka khubor babha sha ki bleithaw jong ki bad sha ki briew jong ki .

translation.en: Now also when I am old and grayheaded , O God , forsake me not  ; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation , and thy power to every one that is to come .
translation.kha: Mynta ba nga la tymmen ruh bad ba u shñiuh jong nga u la lieh , wat iehnoh ïa nga , A Blei ! to long bad nga katba nga pynbna ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong me ha ki pateng baroh ki ban sa wan .

translation.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother s womb , nor hid sorrow from mine eyes .
translation.kha: To tim ïa kata ka miet ba ka shah ba yn kha ïa nga , da kaba pynshah ïa nga ha ki jingjynjar bad ki jingsngewsih .

translation.en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array , army against army .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia bad jong ki Israel ki ïa-ïeng riang marpyrshah ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: All his transgressions that he hath committed , they shall not be mentioned unto him : in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live .
translation.kha: Ïa ki pop jong u baroh yn map , bad un im , namar u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement : and thou shalt cleanse the altar , when thou hast made an atonement for it , and thou shalt anoint it , to sanctify it .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi me dei ban kñia uwei u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia , khnang ba yn map ïa ka pop . Kane kan pynkhuid ruh ïa kata ka duwan . Nangta kyllan ïa ka da ka umphniang Olib ban pynkyntang ïa ka .

translation.en: And he is before all things , and by him all things consist .
translation.kha: Bad U don shuwa ïa kiei kiei baroh , ha u kiei kiei baroh ki ïoh ïa la ka jaka kaba dei .

translation.en: And saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned unto you , and ye have not lamented .
translation.kha: ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingrwai shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym la shad ! Ngi la rwai ïa ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym la ïam !’

translation.en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth , but that which is good to the use of edifying , that it may minister grace unto the hearers .
translation.kha: Wat kren ïa ki ktien pynmong , hynrei , tang ki ktien kiba long ka jingïarap , kita keiñ kiba tei bad kiba ïadei tang ïa kata kaba donkam , khnang ba kaei kaba phi kren kan long kaba bha ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa phi .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka khubor .

translation.en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask .
translation.kha: U Herod u la sngewbha eh haduh ba u la kular ïa ka ,  Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha ïa kano kano kaba pha pan !

translation.en: But woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck , in those days ! for there shall be great distress in the land , and wrath upon this people .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don khunlung ! Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bashyrkhei kan wan halor kane ka ri , bad ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei kan hap ha kane ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: If others be partakers of this power over you , are not we rather ? Nevertheless we have not used this power ; but suffer all things , lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ .
translation.kha: Lada kiwei pat ki don hok ban khmih lynti ïa kane na phi , hato ngi ngim don ïa ka hok kaba kham khraw ? Hynrei ngim shym la pyndonkam ïa kane ka hok . Pynban , ngi la ïaishah ïa kiei kiei baroh khnang ban ym buh jingpynwit ha ka lynti jong ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .

translation.en: And Jesus went out , and his disciples , into the towns of Caesarea Philippi : and by the way he asked his disciples , saying unto them ,  Whom do men say that I am ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la leit noh sha ki nongrit kiba hajan ka Kaisaria Philippi . Katba u dang ïaid ha lynti u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , ki briew ki ong ba nga dei uei ?

translation.en: This city shall not be your caldron , neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof  ; but I will judge you in the border of Israel :
translation.kha: Kane ka nongbah kan ym ïada ïa phi ha ka rukom ba u khiew u da ïa ka doh hapoh jong u . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi hangno hangno ba phi don ha ka ri Israel .

translation.en: And he called the name of the place Massah , and Meribah , because of the chiding of the children of Israel , and because they tempted the  Lord  , saying , Is the  Lord  among us , or not ?
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Massah bad ka Meribah , namar ba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium bad tynjuh ïa U  Trai  haba ki ïakylli ,  Hato U  Trai  u don ne em bad ngi ?

translation.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews , and in Jerusalem  ; whom they slew and hanged on a tree :
translation.kha: Ngi long ki sakhi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh ha ka ri Israel bad ha Jerusalem . Nangta ki la pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .

translation.en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities , and want of bread in all your places : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba la wallam ïa ka jingïapthngan ha ki nongbah jong phi baroh , pynban phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon , ha ka  tikmie kamon , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .

translation.en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven , and the fatness of the earth , and plenty of corn and wine :
translation.kha: To U Blei un ai ha me ïa ka umjer na bneng , bad un pynseisoh ïa ki lyngkha jong me ! To un ai ha me kyrhai u kew bad ka waiñ !

translation.en: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads , when they stood , and had let down their wings .
translation.kha: hynrei ka don hi ka jingsawa najrong ka tnum kaba halor ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: As for the likeness of their faces , they four had the face of a man , and the face of a lion , on the right side : and they four had the face of an ox on the left side  ; they four also had the face of an eagle .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im u don saw tylli ki durkhmat baïapher : ka durbriew ha khmat , sha ka mon ka durkhmat sing , sha kadiang ka durkhmat masi dab , bad shadien ka durkhmat pukni .

translation.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet , saying , The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
translation.kha: Kumba la thoh ha ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :  Don uwei uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : ‘ To pynkhreh ka lynti bah na ka bynta U Trai ; to pynlong ka lynti ba-beit na ka bynta jong u ba un ïaid !

translation.en: But Ahaz said , I will not ask , neither will I tempt the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Ahas u jubab ,  Ngan ym pan ïa ka dak . Nga kyntait ban tynjuh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful , and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long uba ïaineh ha kito kiba ïaineh ha me ; bad uba bha nadong shadong ha kito kiba janai .

translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head , and restore thee unto thy place : and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh s cup into his hand , after the former manner when thou wast his butler .
translation.kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi , un map ïa phi , bad un buh biang ïa phi ha kajuh ka kyrdan . Phin sa ai ha u ïa ka khuri jong u kumba phi ju leh mynshuwa mynba phi long u nongrah khuri rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And he fell to the earth , and heard a voice saying unto him ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
translation.kha: U la hap sha madan bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha u ,  Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?

translation.en: Glory to God in the highest , and on earth peace , good will toward men .
translation.kha: Ka burom ïa U Blei ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam , bad ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ha kito kiba u sngewbha !

translation.en: And he said , Bring me a new cruse , and put salt therein . And they brought it to him .
translation.kha: Buh khyndiat ka mluh ha ka pliang thymmai , bad wanrah ïa ka ha nga ,  u la hukum . Ki la wanrah ïa ka ha u ,

translation.en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week : and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease , and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate , even until the consummation , and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate .
translation.kha: Uta u nongsynshar un don ka jingïateh kular kaba skhem bad kiba bun ki briew haduh hynñiew snem , bad haba shiteng na kane ka por ka la leit , un pynkut ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli yn buh ha ka jaka bajrong tam jong ka Templ bad kan sah hangta tad haduh ba uta uba buh ïa ka hangta u ïashem ïa kaba kut kaba U Blei u la lah pynkhreh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: The sons of Benjamin  ; Bela , and Becher , and Jediael , three .
translation.kha: U Benjamin u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : U Bela , u Bekher , bad u Jediael .

translation.en: Remember the word unto thy servant , upon which thou hast caused me to hope .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka jingkular jong me ïa nga , u shakri jong me , ka la ai jingkyrmen ïa nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka jingtap halor ka Synduk Ka Jutang .

translation.en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and his brethren the priests , and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and his brethren , and builded the altar of the God of Israel , to offer burnt offerings thereon , as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God .
translation.kha: bad u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak , ki para lyngdoh jong u , bad u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u , ki la ïatei biang ïa ka duwan jong U Blei ki Israel , khnang ba ki lah ban thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses , u briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba u ong ban ai ha u Isaïah :  Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingshah shitom ; ngi la shah pynshitom bad don ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi long kum ka briew kaba la khreh ban kha khun , hynrei ka tlot palat ban kha .

translation.en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod , and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon , and I will turn mine hand against Ekron : and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan weng noh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki nongbah ka Ashdod bad ka Ashkelon . Ngan pynshitom ïa ka nongbah Ekron , bad ïa baroh ki Philistia kiba dang sah kin ïap .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days , or to do evil ? to save life , or to kill ?  But they held their peace .
translation.kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa ki briew ,  Kaei kaba ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Ban ïarap lane ban pynsniew ? Ban pynim ïa ka jingim u briew lane ban pynjot ïa ka ?  Hynrei kim shym la ong ei ei .

translation.en: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you ?
translation.kha: Kumno ? Hato nga la shim kabu ïa phi lyngba uno uno na ki nonglamktien kiba nga la phah ?

translation.en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the  Lord  , and in the audience of our God , keep and seek for all the commandments of the  Lord  your God : that ye may possess this good land , and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko paidbah jong nga , ha khmat U Blei jong ngi bad ha khmat kane ka jingïalang ki Israel baroh , ki paidlang jong U  Trai  , nga kyntu ïa phi ba phin kohnguh da kaba phikir bha ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi , ba kumta phi lah ban ïai bat kynti ïa kane ka ri kaba bha bad kumta ba phin lah ban ai pateng ïa ka junom ha ki pateng ki ban wan .

translation.en: And put fire therein , and put incense in them before the  Lord  to morrow : and it shall be that the man whom the  Lord  doth choose , he shall be holy : ye take too much upon you , ye sons of Levi .
translation.kha: Lashai mynstep , ma phi bad ki nongbud jong phi phin shim ïa ki khiew buh ding , phin buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad leit rah ïa ki sha ka duwan . Ngin sa peit hangta ïa uno na ngi U  Trai  u la jied . Dei ma phi hi ki Lebi kiba la leh shaba palat !

translation.en: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings , and to kindle meat offerings , and to do sacrifice continually .
translation.kha: bad ba borabor yn don ki lyngdoh na ka jait Lebi ban shakri ïa nga bad ban ai ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam bad ki jingkñia .

translation.en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead , some mocked : and others said , We will hear thee again of this matter .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul u kren shaphang ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap , katto katne na ki , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u , hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  Ngi kwah ban ïohsngew ba men kren biang ïa kane .

translation.en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood : neither shall ye use enchantment , nor observe times .
translation.kha: Wat bam ïa kano kano ka doh ba dang don snam ha ka . Wat leh ïa kano kano ka kam byrtong .

translation.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee : but say in a word , and my servant shall be healed .
translation.kha: lymne ba nga ñiew ïa lade uba bit ban wan sha me da lade . Shu ai tang ka hukum , bad u shakri jong nga un ïohkhiah .

translation.en: Wherefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt separate three cities for thee .
translation.kha: Namar kata nga hukum ïa phi ban buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong jakarieh .

translation.en: And like unto him was there no king before him , that turned to the  Lord  with all his heart , and with all his soul , and with all his might , according to all the law of Moses  ; neither after him arose there any like him .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don syiem uba kum ma u mynshuwa , uba shakri ïa U  Trai  da ka dohnud , ka jingmut , bad da ka bor jong u baroh , da kaba kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum u Moses ; lymne don u syiem uba kum ma u naduh kata .

translation.en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice , Who is worthy to open the book , and to loose the seals thereof ?
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba khlaiñ , uba pynbna ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Mano uba dei hok ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait bad ban plied ïa ka kot kli ?

translation.en: I will sing unto the  Lord  as long as I live : I will sing praise to my God while I have my being .
translation.kha: Ngan rwai ha U  Trai  baroh shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; katba nga dang im ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: For wisdom is a defence , and money is a defence : but the excellency of knowledge is , that wisdom giveth life to them that have it .
translation.kha: bad kan ai ha phi ka jingshngain kumba lah ka pisa . Ka jingstad ka ri pynim ïa phi — kane ka dei ka kabu jong ka jingtip .

translation.en: And the way of peace have they not known :
translation.kha: Kim shym la tip ïa ka lynti jong ka jingsuk ,

translation.en: Is not this the carpenter s son ? is not his mother called Mary ? and his brethren , James , and Joses , and Simon , and Judas ?
translation.kha: Um dei une u khun jong u misteri ? Hato ka Mari kam dei ka kmie jong u , bad hato u Jakob , u Josis , u Simon bad u Judah kim dei ki para shynrang jong u ?

translation.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked , and bringeth the wheel over them .
translation.kha: U syiem uba stad un shem uno uba leh ïa ka bymdei , bad un pynshitom ïa u khlem isynei .

translation.en: And hath gone and served other gods , and worshipped them , either the sun , or moon , or any of the host of heaven , which I have not commanded  ;
translation.kha: da kaba mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , lane ïa ka sngi , lane ïa u bnai , lane ïa ki khlur , kaba long pyrshah ïa ka hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Beware of him , and obey his voice , provoke him not  ; for he will not pardon your transgressions : for my name is in him .
translation.kha: Shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa u . Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa u , naba nga la phah ïa u , bad un ym map ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah kaba kum kata .

translation.en: And Isaac departed thence , and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar , and dwelt there .
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u mihnoh nangta bad u sher dara ha ka Them Gerar , ha kaba u la shong la sah katto katne por .

translation.en: Jude , the servant of Jesus Christ , and brother of James , to them that are sanctified by God the Father , and preserved in Jesus Christ , and called :
translation.kha: Na u Judah , u shakri jong u Jisu Khrist , bad u para jong u Jakob — Sha kito kiba la khot da U Blei , kiba im hapoh ka jingieit jong U Blei U Kpa bad ha ka jingsumar U Jisu Khrist :

translation.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you .
translation.kha: hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , kan kham donkam shibun eh ba ngan dang im .

translation.en: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised , that soul shall be cut off from his people  ; he hath broken my covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u shynrang u bym shym la otsher yn nym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew jong nga , namar ba um shym la bat ïa ka jutang bad nga .

translation.en: I have heard a rumour from the  Lord  , and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen , saying , Gather ye together , and come against her , and rise up to the battle .
translation.kha: Nga ong ,  Ko Edom , nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U  Trai . U la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ïalumlang ïa ki shipai bad ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa pha .

translation.en: And they rose up early on the morrow , and offered burnt offerings , and brought peace offerings  ; and the people sat down to eat and to drink , and rose up to play .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la wallam katto katne ki mrad ba yn thang kum ki jingkñia bad ïa kiwei pat ban ïabam kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ki briew ki la ïashong ban ïakhawai , kaba la kylla long ka jingïaleh shongshit ha ka ïadih ïabam bad ïaleh awria .

translation.en: So Michal let David down through a window : and he went , and fled , and escaped .
translation.kha: Ka pynhiar ïa u na ka jingkhangïit , bad u phet ïap bad u lait im .

translation.en: ( For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man . For oftentimes it had caught him : and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters  ; and he brake the bands , and was driven of the devil into the wilderness . )
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane namar U Jisu u la lah hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman ban mihnoh na u . Bunsien u la lympat ïa u , wat haba la set khop ïa u , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u la teh da ki kynjri , u ju pyndkut ïa ki kynjri bad shah ïalam ha u ksuid sha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: His eyes shall be red with wine , and his teeth white with milk .
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong u ki saw triej na kaba dih waiñ , Bad ki bniat jong u ki lieh shaid na kaba dih dud .

translation.en: Then the earth shook and trembled  ; the foundations of heaven moved and shook , because he was wroth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad khynñiuh ; ki nongrim jong ka suiñbneng ki khih bad ki kyiuh , namar ba U Blei u la bitar !

translation.en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire : thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them , nor take it unto thee , lest thou be snared therein : for it is an abomination to the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki . Wat ikwah ïa ka rupa lane ïa ka ksiar kaba don ha ki , bad wat shim ïa ka sha lade ïoh phi ïap , namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ka jingmane bleithaw .

translation.en: And rose up , and thrust him out of the city , and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built , that they might cast him down headlong .
translation.kha: Ki la ïeng joit , ki la tan ïa U Jisu shabar jong ka shnong , bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha kliar jong u lum ha kaba la tei ïa ka shnong jong ki . Ki la mut ban bret ïa u na ka riat ,

translation.en: And he overthrew those cities , and all the plain , and all the inhabitants of the cities , and that which grew upon the ground .
translation.kha: bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa kata ka them baroh kawei lem bad ïa ki briew baroh hangta , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba mih ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence , then was Haman full of wrath .
translation.kha: U Haman u la bitar haba u la sngewthuh ba u Mordekai un ym dem khohsiew ïa u ,

translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God , in whom thou trustest , deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Haba u Patsha u ïohsngew ïa kane , u phah ka shithi sha u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah ban ong ïa u ,  U Blei ïa uba me shaniah u la ong ha me ba un ym hap ha ki kti jong nga , hynrei wat ai ba kata kan shukor ïa me .

translation.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy ; having their conscience seared with a hot iron ;
translation.kha: Kiba kum kita ki jinghikai ki wan na ki riewarsap bashukor , kiba la ïap ki jingïatiplem , kumba la thang da u narsaw .

translation.en: Their young ones are in good liking , they grow up with corn  ; they go forth , and return not unto them .
translation.kha: Ha khlaw ki khun rit jong ki , ki san ha ka jingkhlaiñ ; ki leit noh bad kim wan phai shuh .

translation.en: And whether it be cow or ewe , ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day .
translation.kha: Wat kñia ha kajuh ka sngi ïa ka masi bad u khun jong ka , ïa ka langbrot bad u khun jong ka , lane ïa ka blang bad u khun jong ka .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto God , O that Ishmael might live before thee !
translation.kha: U ong ha U Blei ,  Balei ym ai ïa u Ishmael ba un long u nongïoh pateng jong nga ?

translation.en: While it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts , as in the provocation .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la long haba ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes , they were filled with envy , and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul , contradicting and blaspheming .
translation.kha: Haba ki Jiw ki la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , ki la dap da ka jingpihuiñ ; ki la ïania ïa kaei kaba u Paul u la kren bad ki la krenbeiñ ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore said his parents , He is of age  ; ask him .
translation.kha: Dei na kata balei ba ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la ong ,  U la biang ka rta ; to kylli ïa u !

translation.en: So I spake unto you  ; and ye would not hear , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  , and went presumptuously up into the hill .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kren , hynrei phim patiaw satia ; phi la ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa u , bad da ka mynsiem kaba sngewmeng phi la leit kiew sha kata ka ri lum .

translation.en: Seeing his days are determined , the number of his months are with thee , thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass  ;
translation.kha: Ka jingjrong ka rta ka jingim jong ngi la rai lypa — Ka jingkheiñ ki bnai ba ngin im . Lah dep buh ïa u pud , bad ym lah ban pynkylla .

translation.en: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains , and the chains had been plucked asunder by him , and the fetters broken in pieces : neither could any man tame him .
translation.kha: bunsien ïa ki kjat bad ki kti jong u la teh da ki kynjri , hynrei man ka por u bthat ïa ki kynjri bad pynpait ïa ki nar ha ki kjat jong u . U khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ym don uba lah ban pyndem ïa u .

translation.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves , Who is this that forgiveth sins also ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kiba ïashong bam ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki ,  Uei une , uba map wat ïa ki pop ?

translation.en: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated , so that no man went through thee , I will make thee an eternal excellency , a joy of many generations .
translation.kha: Yn ym iehnoh beiñ bad isih shuh ïa pha , ka nongbah kaba la shah iehnoh beiñ bad kynjah . Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba khraw bad kaba itynnat , ka jaka jong ka jingkmen junom la junom .

translation.en: Behold , the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth : much more the wicked and the sinner .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïoh bainong hangne ha pyrthei , te phi lah ban thikna ba ki bymman bad ki briew kiba pop kin shah pynshitom .

translation.en: Men s hearts failing them for fear , and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth : for the powers of heaven shall be shaken .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïapler na ka jingsheptieng katba ki dang ap ïa kaei kaba wan halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei , naba ïa ki bor ha ka haw haw yn beh noh na ki lynti jong ki .

translation.en: Israel hath sinned , and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them : for they have even taken of the accursed thing , and have also stolen , and dissembled also , and they have put it even among their own stuff .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh pop ! Ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingkular bad nga kaba nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat . Ki la shim katto katne kiei kiei kiba dei ban pynjot . Ki la tuh ïa ki , ki la len shaphang kata , bad buh lang ïa ki bad la ki jong ki tiar ki tar .

translation.en: But now ye also put off all these ; anger , wrath , malice , blasphemy , filthy communication out of your mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta phi dei ban kiar noh na kine kiei kiei baroh : Ka jingbitar , ka jingkwah jakhlia , bad ki jingsngew kiba dap da ka jingisih . Ki jingkrenbeiñ lane ki jingkrensih kim dei da lei lei ban mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong phi .

translation.en: And the inhabitant shall not say , I am sick : the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity .
translation.kha: Yn ym don uba shong ba sah ha ka ri jong ngi , u ban dang ud pang , bad ïa ki pop baroh yn map .

translation.en: When Jesus heard that , he said ,  This sickness is not unto death , but for the glory of God , that the Son of God might be glorified thereby .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la ong ,  Kaba kut jong kane ka jingpang kan ym dei ka jingïap jong u Lasaros ; kane ka la jia khnang ban wallam ka burom ïa U Blei , bad kan long ka lad ha kaba U Khun U Blei un ïohpdiang ïa ka burom .

translation.en: Think upon me , my God , for good , according to all that I have done for this people .
