translation.kha: Nga duwai ha me , A Blei , to kynmaw ban kyrkhu na ka bynta kaei kaei baroh ba nga la leh na ka bynta kane ka jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And Joab sent messengers to David , and said , I have fought against Rabbah , and have taken the city of waters .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid ban ïathuh :  Nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka Rabbah bad nga la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka pynbiang umdih jong ka .

translation.en: Curse ye Meroz , said the angel of the  Lord  , curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof  ; because they came not to the help of the  Lord  , to the help of the  Lord  against the mighty .
translation.kha: Buh ka jingtim halor ka Meros ,  ong u angel jong U  Trai  ,  Ka jingtim , ka jingtim halor kito kiba sah hangta . Kim shym la wan ïarap ïa U  Trai  , Kim shym wan kum ki shipai ban ïaleh pyrshah na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: For neither at any time used we flattering words , as ye know , nor a cloak of covetousness ; God is witness :
translation.kha: Phi tip bha ba ngim shym la wan ha phi da ki jingkren jali ja-um , lymne ba ngi la pyndonkam ïa ki kyntien ban da  rap-jot ïa ka jinglalot — U Blei u long u sakhi ïa ngi !

translation.en: And Elijah answered and said unto them , If I be a man of God , let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And the fire of God came down from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
translation.kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangbah jong me !  Hangta hi ka ding jong U Blei ka la wan hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And David put his hand in his bag , and took thence a stone , and slang it , and smote the Philistine in his forehead , that the stone sunk into his forehead  ; and he fell upon his face to the earth .
translation.kha: U bsuh ïa la ka kti hapoh ka pla kieng jong u bad u sei ïa uwei u maw , bad u kawang ïa u Goliath . Uta u maw u dei phak na ka shyllangmat jong u bad u pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u , bad u Goliath u kyllon khram da pyllup ha khyndew .

translation.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u syiem bad u Haman ki leit ban bam bad ka Esther ha ka sien kaba ar .

translation.en: Come , let us take our fill of love until the morning : let us solace ourselves with loves .
translation.kha: Ale keiñ , ngin ïaleh ieit baroh shi miet . Ngin ïalehkmen katba ngi dang ïakdup .

translation.en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God : Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno phin lah ban ithuh la u long U Mynsiem jong U Blei : Uno uno uba pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew , u don U Mynsiem uba wan na U Blei .

translation.en: And forgettest the  Lord  thy maker , that hath stretched forth the heavens , and laid the foundations of the earth  ; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor , as if he were ready to destroy ? and where is the fury of the oppressor ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la klet ïa U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi , uba pynïar ïa ki bneng bad uba pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ? Balei phi im ha ka jingïai-sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla jong kito kiba banbeiñ ïa phi , jong kito kiba long ba la kloi ban pynjot ïa phi ? Ka jingbitar shla jong ki kam lah shuh da lei lei ban ktah ïa phi .

translation.en: And Lamech took unto him two wives : the name of the one was Adah , and the name of the other Zillah .
translation.kha: U Lamekh u don ar ngut ki tnga , ka Adah , bad ka Sillah .

translation.en: For I have not spoken of myself  ; but the Father which sent me , he gave me a commandment , what I should say , and what I should speak .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ngam shym la kren ha ka bor jong nga hi ; hynrei U Kpa uba la phah ïa nga u la hukum ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga dei ban ong bad kren .

translation.en: Take my yoke upon you , and learn of me  ; for I am meek and lowly in heart : and ye shall find rest unto your souls .
translation.kha: To shim ïa ka lyngkor jong nga bad buh ïa ka halor jong phi , bad to hikai na nga , namar nga long uba jemnud bad uba sngewrit ha ka mynsiem ; bad phin shem ka jingjahthait .

translation.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity : but the  Lord  was my stay .
translation.kha: Haba nga don ha ka jynjar , ki la tur ïaleh ïa nga , hynrei U  Trai  u la ïada ïa nga .

translation.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes , and saw , and , behold , there stood before the river a ram which had two horns : and the two horns were high  ; but one was higher than the other , and the higher came up last .
translation.kha: bad hangta harud jong ka wah nga la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la don ar tylli ki reng bajrong , kawei na ki kaba kham jrong bad kham thymmai bad ïa kawei pat .

translation.en: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth–gilead  ; and the Syrians wounded Joram .
translation.kha: U Syiem Ahasaïah u ïasnohkti lang bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ban ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth kaba ha Gilead , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .

translation.en: But if ye turn away , and forsake my statutes and my commandments , which I have set before you , and shall go and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ma me bad ki briew jong me kin ym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , bad phi mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,

translation.en: And the elders of that city shall take that man and chastise him  ;
translation.kha: Te kita ki nongïalam shnong kin shim ïa uta u tnga bad kin sympat ïa u .

translation.en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Behold , this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the  Lord   ; and such things have befallen me : and if I had eaten the sin offering to day , should it have been accepted in the sight of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Te u Aaron u jubab ,  Lada nga la bam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop mynta ka sngi , hato U  Trai  un sngewbha ? Ki paidbah ki la wallam ïa la ki jingkñia namar ka pop sha U  Trai  mynta ka sngi , bad ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang jong ki , pynban kum kine kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei ki dang wan jia ha nga .

translation.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land : but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u pyrkhat khia ïa ka jingbishar hok , ka ri kan long kaba khlaiñ , hynrei haba u pyrkhat khia tang ïa ka pisa , un pynjot ïa ka ri jong u .

translation.en: Look unto Abraham your father , and unto Sarah that bare you : for I called him alone , and blessed him , and increased him .
translation.kha: Puson halor u kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , bad ka Sarah , na kiba phi hiarpateng . Mynba nga la khot ïa u Abraham , u la long uba khlem khun , hynrei nga la kyrkhu ïa u bad nga la ai ki khun ïa u ; Nga la pynroi ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord .
translation.kha: bad ban pynbna ba ka por ka la poi haba U Trai un pynim ïa ki briew jong u .

translation.en: God reveals precious truths that fill us with joy and hope .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha bakordor kaba ai jingkmen bad jingkyrmen ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Boaz said unto her , At mealtime come thou hither , and eat of the bread , and dip thy morsel in the vinegar . And she sat beside the reapers : and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat , and was sufficed , and left .
translation.kha: Ha ka por bam , u Boas u ong ïa ka Ruth ,  Wan bad shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad wieh ïa u ha kane ka sos   .  Kumta ka la shong lang bad ki nongtrei , bad u Boas u ai ïa ka katto katne u kew sdieh . Ka la bam haduh ban da sngewhun , bad ka dang don katto katne ka jingbam kaba sah tam .

translation.en: For our light affliction , which is but for a moment , worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory ;
translation.kha: Bad kane ka jingshahshitom kaba khyndiat bad kaba tang shipor kaba ngi shah kan wallam ha ngi ïa ka burom bakhraw bad ba bymjukut , kaba kham khraw palat ban ïa kata ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet .
translation.kha: U Sephanaïah u pule ïa ka shithi ha nga ,

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou canst believe , all things are possible to him that believeth .
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  lada ma me hi me lah . Kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ïa u briew uba don ka jingngeit .

translation.en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him : he is an unwise son  ; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki don ka lad ban im , hynrei ka long kaba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka — kum u khunlung uba la dei ban kha , u bym treh ban mih na ka kpoh .

translation.en: Thou shalt not wrest judgment  ; thou shalt not respect persons , neither take a gift : for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise , and pervert the words of the righteous .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban leh bymhok lane leh shiliang khmat ha ki jingbishar jong ki ; kim dei ruh ban bamsap , namar ka jingbamsap ka pynmatlah wat ïa kito kiba stad bad kiba hok , bad ki pynlong ïa ki ban rai bakla .

translation.en: But were mingled among the heathen , and learned their works .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïashongkha khleh bad ki bad bud ïa ki rukom leh blei thala jong ki .

translation.en: Then were the king s scribes called at that time in the third month , that is , the month Sivan , on the three and twentieth day thereof  ; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews , and to the lieutenants , and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia , an hundred twenty and seven provinces , unto every province according to the writing thereof , and unto every people after their language , and to the Jews according to their writing , and according to their language .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ha ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba lai , u bnai Siban . U Mordekai u khot ïa ki sekretari jong u syiem bad u pule ba kin thoh ïa ki shithi sha ki Jiw bad ïa ki lat , ki nongsynshar , bad ki rangbah synshar jong baroh ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki probins    naduh India haduh Sudan . Ïa ki shithi la thoh sha baroh ki probins ha ki ktien bad ki rukom thoh jong ki .

translation.en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth : but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki long kum ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ; ki bymman ki long kum ka sharak ka ban lip noh .

translation.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom , that they are double to that which is ! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth .
translation.kha: Un ïathuh ïa me ba don ki jingmaïan ka jingstad ; ki don kiei kiei kiba palat ïa ka jingshemphang u bynriew . U Blei u pynshitom kham duna ïa me ban ïa kaba me dei hok .

translation.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir , with the precious onyx , or the sapphire .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar babha tam bad ki mawkordor , kim lah ban ïaryngkat bad ka dor jong ka .

translation.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan .
translation.kha: Naba don na ki riewkynthei kiba la lah phai noh ban bud ïa u Soitan .

translation.en: Go thy way , eat thy bread with joy , and drink thy wine with a merry heart  ; for God now accepteth thy works .
translation.kha: To leh — bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi bad long uba kmen ; dih ïa ka waiñ jong phi bad to long kiba dap da ka jingkmen . Ka long kaba biang bad U Blei .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Korah , Be thou and all thy company before the  Lord  , thou , and they , and Aaron , to morrow :
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Korah ,  Lashai ka sngi , ma me bad ki nongbud jong me baroh arspah sanphew ngut phi dei ban wan sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ; u Aaron ruh un don lang hangta .

translation.en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots , even white bright spots  ;
translation.kha: Haba u briew ne ka briew ki don ki dak thohlieh ha ka sniehdoh jong ki , u lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa uta u briew .

translation.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines  land many days .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la shong slem hangta ha Philistia .

translation.en: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month .
translation.kha: Bad u Hananaïah u la ïap ha u bnai bahynñiew jong kata kajuh ka snem .

translation.en: And they went out of the prison , and entered into the house of Lydia : and when they had seen the brethren , they comforted them , and departed .
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la mihnoh na ka byndi bad ki la leit sha ka ïing jong ka Lydia . Hangta ki la ïakynduh ïa ki parabangeit , ki la kren ki kyntien pynshlur ïa ki , bad ki la leit noh .

translation.en: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade , yn pynrit ; bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa lade , yn pynkhraw .

translation.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one : for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren ,
translation.kha: U pynkhuid ïa ki briew na ki pop jong ki , bad ma u lem bad kita baroh ïa kiba la pynkhuid ki don ujuh U Kpa . Namarkata , U Jisu um sngewlehrain ban khot ïa ki , ki para jong u .

translation.en: Gibeon , and Ramah , and Beeroth ,
translation.kha: La don ruh ka Gibeon , ka Ramah , ka Beeroth ,

translation.en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and smoking flax shall he not quench , till he send forth judgment unto victory .
translation.kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la kdor lane pynlip ïa u  sai sharak ba dang mehding . Un ïaineh tad haduh ba un pynlong ïa ka jinglehhok ban jop ,

translation.en: And he said , Thou hast asked a hard thing : nevertheless , if thou see me when I am taken from thee , it shall be so unto thee  ; but if not , it shall not be so .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka jingkyrpad kaba jwat ban ai ,  u Elijah u phai ktien .  Hynrei men ïohpdiang ïa ka lada me ïohi ïa nga haba dang shim noh ïa nga na me ; lada mem ïohi ïa nga , men ym ïohpdiang ïa ka .

translation.en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy : for I have espoused you to one husband , that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong phi , kumba U Blei u sngew ; phi long kum ka theisotti basngur ïa kaba nga la kular ha ka jingshongkurim bad tang ïa uwei u briew , U Khrist hi .

translation.en: So they went near , and carried them in their coats out of the camp  ; as Moses had said .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïawan , ki bat na ki jaiñkup jong ki metïap bad ki ïarah noh ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara , kumba u Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam . And Jeroboam arose , and fled into Egypt , unto Shishak king of Egypt , and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Solomon u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Jeroboam ; hynrei u phet ïap sha u Shishak u syiem ka Ijipt bad u la sah hangta haduh ka jingïap u Solomon .

translation.en: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased , he sinned yet more , and hardened his heart , he and his servants .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la leh pop biang . Ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïailong kiba mutlop kum mynshuwa ,

translation.en: and the current issues of The Watchtower and Awake !
translation.kha: bad ïa ki makasin bathymmai jong ka Kut Ap Phira bad To Sharai !

translation.en: And Peter , fastening his eyes upon him with John , said , Look on us .
translation.kha: Ki la khmih shlip ha u , bad u Petros u la ong ,  Peit sha ngi !

translation.en: And the servant said , Lord , it is done as thou hast commanded , and yet there is room .
translation.kha: Shen shen u shakri u la ong , ‘ La pyndep ïa ka hukum jong me , ko kynrad , hynrei dang don jaka na ka bynta kiba bun .’

translation.en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria , and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt , and the Egyptian into Assyria , and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , kan don ka surok bah hapdeng ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria . Ki briew jong kito ki ar tylli ki ri kin ïaleit ïawan hapdeng jong ki , bad ki ar tylli ki ri kin ïamane lang .

translation.en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law , shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision ?
translation.kha: Lada u Jentil , u bym shym la otsher , u kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka Hukum , hato U Blei un ym ñiew ïa u kumba u la dep otsher ?

translation.en: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok , which approach unto me , to minister unto me , saith the Lord  God  , a young bullock for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Kito ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jait Lebi kiba hiarpateng na u Sadok ki long tang ma ki , ki ban wan ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ban shakri ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga hukum ïa kane . Men ai ïa ki u masi lyngraw ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop .

translation.en: Then said he ,  Unto what is the kingdom of God like ? and whereunto shall I resemble it ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka long kum kaei ? Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka ?

translation.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought , and stripped the naked of their clothing .
translation.kha: Ban pynlong ïa u para jong phi ban siew pat ïa ka pisa kaba u dei ban siew , phi shim noh ïa ki jaiñ ki nep jong u bad ieh ïa u khlem don ei ei shuh ban phong .

translation.en: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity , and the water of affliction , yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more , but thine eyes shall see thy teachers :
translation.kha: U Trai un pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid lyngba ki por ba-eh , hynrei ma u hi un don hangta ban hikai ïa phi , bad phin ym donkam ban wad shuh ïa u .

translation.en: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit : for the Spirit searcheth all things , yea , the deep things of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei , dei ha ngi ba U Blei u la pynpaw ïa kaba u la buhrieh , da U Mynsiem jong u . U Mynsiem u ïit ïa kiei kiei baroh , wat ïa ki jingjylliew ba la buhrieh jong ki jingthmu U Blei .

translation.en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law ; but desire to have you circumcised , that they may glory in your flesh .
translation.kha: Wat kita kiba pdiang ïa ka jingotsher kim shym kohnguh ïa ka Hukum ; ki kwah ïa phi ban otsher khnang ba ki lah ban kob ba phi la pynkohnguh ha kane ka jinglehniam ha ka doh .

translation.en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse , the army and the power  ; they shall lie down together , they shall not rise : they are extinct , they are quenched as tow .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhlaiñ sha ka jingpynjot , ka kynhun shipai , ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai . Ki kyllon ha madan , kim lah khie shuh , ki lip kum ka thylliej ding ka sharak !

translation.en: The officers answered , Never man spake like this man .
translation.kha: Ki nongap phira ki la jubab ,  Ym pat ju don uno uno u ban kren kum une u briew !

translation.en: Now these are the generations of Terah : Terah begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran  ; and Haran begat Lot .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Terah , uba long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran . U Haran u dei u kpa jong u Lot ,

translation.en: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols  ; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars .
translation.kha: Ngan phriang ïa ki metïap jong ki briew ka Israel ; bad ngan pynphriang ïa ki shyieng jong ki baroh sawdong ki duwan .

translation.en: Who raised up the righteous man from the east , called him to his foot , gave the nations before him , and made him rule over kings ? he gave them as the dust to his sword , and as driven stubble to his bow .
translation.kha: Uei uta uba wanrah ïa u nongjop na sha mihngi , bad pynlong ïa u ban leh risa kat shaba u leit ? Mano ba ai jingjop ïa u halor ki syiem bad ki jaitbynriew ? Ka waitlam jong u ka mait ïa ki la kumba ki long ka pui pui , ki khnam jong u ki pynsaphred ïa ki kum u phlangïap ha khmat ka lyer .

translation.en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech , which he did unto his father , in slaying his seventy brethren :
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka long ba U Blei u siew kylliang ïa u Abimelekh namar ka kam sniew kaba u la leh pyrshah ïa la u kpa ha kaba pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And , behold , the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying , This shall not be thine heir  ; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir .
translation.kha: Nangta u ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren biang ha u ,  Une u Eliesar uba long u mraw un ym ïohpateng ïa ka spah ka phew jong me ; u khun jong me hi un long u nongïoh pateng jong me .

translation.en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as thou hast heard , and live ?
translation.kha: Don mo ki briew kiba dang im hadien ba ki la ïohsngew ïa u blei uba kren ha ki na ka ding , kumba phi , phi la ïohsngew ?

translation.en: And Leah said , God hath endued me with a good dowry  ; now will my husband dwell with me , because I have born him six sons : and she called his name Zebulun .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka ong ,  U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingai kaba kordor . Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa pdiang ïa nga , namar nga la kha ïa u hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Sebulun .

translation.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers : for thy testimonies are my meditation .  I understand more than the ancients , because I keep thy precepts .  I have refrained my feet from every evil way , that I might keep thy word .  I have not departed from thy judgments : for thou hast taught me .  How sweet are thy words unto my taste ! yea , sweeter than honey to my mouth !    Through thy precepts I get understanding : therefore I hate every false way .  Thy word is a lamp unto my feet , and a light unto my path .    I have sworn , and I will perform it , that I will keep thy righteous judgments .  I am afflicted very much : quicken me , O  Lord  , according unto thy word .  Accept , I beseech thee , the freewill offerings of my mouth , O  Lord  , and teach me thy judgments .  My soul is continually in my hand : yet do I not forget thy law .  The wicked have laid a snare for me : yet I erred not from thy precepts .  Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever : for they are the rejoicing of my heart .  I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway , even unto the end .    I hate vain thoughts : but thy law do I love .  Thou art my hiding place and my shield : I hope in thy word .  Depart from me , ye evildoers : for I will keep the commandments of my God .  Uphold me according unto thy word , that I may live : and let me not be ashamed of my hope .  Hold thou me up , and I shall be safe : and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually .  Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes : for their deceit is falsehood .  Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross : therefore I love thy testimonies .    My flesh trembleth for fear of thee  ; and I am afraid of thy judgments .  I have done judgment and justice : leave me not to mine oppressors .  Be surety for thy servant for good : let not the proud oppress me .  Mine eyes fail for thy salvation , and for the word of thy righteousness .  Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy , and teach me thy statutes .  I am thy servant  ; give me understanding , that I may know thy testimonies .  It is time for thee ,  Lord  , to work : for they have made void thy law .  Therefore I love thy commandments above gold  ; yea , above fine gold .  Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right  ; and I hate every false way .  Thy testimonies are wonderful : therefore doth my soul keep them .  The entrance of thy words giveth light  ; it giveth understanding unto the simple .  I opened my mouth , and panted : for I longed for thy commandments .  Look thou upon me , and be merciful unto me , as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name .    Order my steps in thy word : and let not any iniquity have dominion over me .  Deliver me from the oppression of man : so will I keep thy precepts .  Make thy face to shine upon thy servant  ; and teach me thy statutes .  Rivers of waters run down mine eyes , because they keep not thy law .  Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , and upright are thy judgments .  Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful .      My zeal hath consumed me , because mine enemies have forgotten thy words .    Thy word is very pure : therefore thy servant loveth it .    I am small and despised : yet do not I forget thy precepts .  Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness , and thy law is the truth .  Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me : yet thy commandments are my delights .    The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting : give me understanding , and I shall live .  I cried with my whole heart  ; hear me , O  Lord  : I will keep thy statutes .  I cried unto thee  ; save me , and I shall keep thy testimonies .    I prevented the dawning of the morning , and cried : I hoped in thy word .  Mine eyes prevent the night watches , that I might meditate in thy word .  Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness : O  Lord  , quicken me according to thy judgment .  They draw nigh that follow after mischief : they are far from thy law .  Thou art near , O  Lord   ; and all thy commandments are truth .  Concerning thy testimonies , I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever .  Consider mine affliction , and deliver me : for I do not forget thy law .  Plead my cause , and deliver me : quicken me according to thy word .  Salvation is far from the wicked : for they seek not thy statutes .  Great are thy tender mercies , O  Lord  : quicken me according to thy judgments .    Many are my persecutors and mine enemies  ; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies .  I beheld the transgressors , and was grieved  ; because they kept not thy word .  Consider how I love thy precepts : quicken me , O  Lord  , according to thy lovingkindness .  Thy word is true from the beginning : and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever .    Princes have persecuted me without a cause : but my heart standeth in awe of thy word .  I rejoice at thy word , as one that findeth great spoil .  I hate and abhor lying : but thy law do I love .  Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments .  Great peace have they which love thy law : and nothing shall offend them .    Lord  , I have hoped for thy salvation , and done thy commandments .  My soul hath kept thy testimonies  ; and I love them exceedingly .  I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies : for all my ways are before thee .  Let my cry come near before thee , O  Lord  : give me understanding according to thy word .  Let my supplication come before thee : deliver me according to thy word .  My lips shall utter praise , when thou hast taught me thy statutes .  My tongue shall speak of thy word : for all thy commandments are righteousness .  Let thine hand help me  ; for I have chosen thy precepts .  I have longed for thy salvation , O  Lord   ; and thy law is my delight .  Let my soul live , and it shall praise thee  ; and let thy judgments help me .  I have gone astray like a lost sheep  ; seek thy servant  ; for I do not forget thy commandments .
translation.kha: Nga shemphang kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai jong nga baroh , namar nga puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .  Nga don ka jingstad kaba kham khraw ban ïa ki riewtymmen , namar nga kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .  Nga kiar na ka jingleh sniew baroh , namar nga kwah ban kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .  Ngam shym la leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar ma me hi me long u nonghikai jong nga .  A katno kaba thiang ka long ka jingmad ïa ki jingbthah jong me — ki kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap !  Nga ïoh ka jingstad na ki aiñ jong me , bad kumta nga isih ïa ka jingleh basniew baroh .  Ka ktien jong me ka long ka sharak ban ïalam ïa nga bad ka jingshai ïa ka lynti ïaid jong nga .  Ngan bat ïa ka jingkular kyntang jong nga , ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah bahok jong me .  Ki jingshitom jong nga , A  Trai  , ki long shisha kiba shyrkhei ; to ri pynim ïa nga , kumba me la kular .  To pdiang ïa ka jingduwai ainguh jong nga , A  Trai  , bad to hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .  Nga long borabor uba la kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ; ngam shym la klet ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Ki riewbymman ki pynap ka jingriam ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym la long u bymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .  Ki hukum jong me ki long ka jingïohkynti jong nga bymjukut , ki long ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud jong nga .  Nga la kut jingmut ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me haduh ka sngi ba nga ïap .  Nga isih ïa kito ki bym shaniah tylli ha me , hynrei nga ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Me long u nongkyrshan bad u nongïada jong nga ; nga buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha ka jingkular jong me .  Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew kiba pop . Ngan kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei jong nga .  To pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , kumba me la kular , bad ngan ïoh im ; wat shah ba ngan noh mynsiem ha ka jingkyrmen jong nga .  To bat ïa nga , bad ngan long shngain , bad ngan ïai pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me .  Me kyntait ïa uwei pa uwei u bymkohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me ; ki buit shukor jong ki , ki long ki bymmyntoi .  Me ñiew ïa ki bymman baroh kum ka synrum , bad kumta nga ieit ïa ki jingbthah jong me .  Namar jong me nga sheptieng ; la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingtieng namar ki jingbishar jong me .  Nga la leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha ; A wat iehnoh ïa nga ha ki nongshun jong nga !  To kular ba men ïarap ïa u shakri jong me ; A wat shah ba ki briew kiba sngewmeng kin banbeiñ ïa nga !  Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha kaba ap ïa ka jingïarap bapynim jong me , ïa ka jingpyllait kaba me la kular .  To leh ïa nga kat kum ka jingieit baneh jong me , bad hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .  Nga long u shakri jong me ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban tip ïa ki jinghikai jong me .  A  Trai  , ka la dei ka por ba men leh ei ei , namar ki briew kim kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me palat ban ïa ka ksiar , palat ban ïa ka ksiar nylla .  Bad kumta nga bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me baroh ; nga isih ïa ki lynti bymdei baroh .  Ki jinghikai jong me ki long kiba phylla ; nga kohnguh ïa ki da ka dohnud jong nga baroh .  Ka jingbatai jong ki jinghikai jong me ka ai jingshai bad ka wallam jingstad ïa ki bymtip ei ei .  Ha ka jingangnud jong nga ïa ki hukum jong me nga thrang da ka shyntur kaba ang .  To phai sha nga bad to isynei ïa nga , kumba me leh halor kito baroh kiba ieit ïa me .  Kumba me la kular , to sumar ïa nga na kaba kyllon ; wat shah ïa nga ban jop da kaba sniew .  To pyllait im ïa nga na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa nga , khnang ba ngan lah ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .  To kyrkhu ïa nga da ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad to hikai ïa nga ïa ki aiñ jong me .  Ki ummat jong nga ki tuid kum ka wah , namar ki briew kim kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Me long uba hok , A  Trai  , bad ki aiñ jong me ki long kiba hok .  Ki jingpynbeit ryntih kiba me la ai ki long nadong shadong kiba beit bad kiba dei .  Ka jingbitar jong nga ka pluh hapoh jong nga kum ka ding , namar ki nongshun jong nga kim ñiewkor ïa ki hukum jong me .  A katno kaba thikna ka jingkular jong me ! A katno nga ieit ïa ka !  Nga long u bym long ei ei bad uba la shah kyntait , hynrei ngam leh klet ïa ki jinghikai jong me .  Ka hok jong me kan neh junom , bad ka aiñ jong me ka long borabor kaba shisha .  La pyndap ïa nga da ka jingjynjar bad ka jingkhuslai , hynrei ki hukum jong me ki wanrah jingkmen ïa nga .  Ki jingbthah jong nga ki long borabor kiba hok , to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , bad ngan ïoh im .  Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga khot kyrpad ïa me ; to jubab ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me !  Nga khot kyrpad ïa me , to pynim ïa nga , bad ngan sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me .  Ha shuwa ban mih ka sngi nga khot kyrpad ïa me ban ïoh jingïarap ; nga buh ka kyrmen jong nga ha ka jingkular jong me .  Baroh shi miet nga shong peitmat , ban puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .  Namar ka jingieit jong me ka long kaba neh , to sngew ïa nga , A  Trai  ; A to pyn-i ka jingisynei jong me , bad to ri pynim ïa nga !  Ki nongbehbeiñ barunar jong nga ki la wan kham hajan , ki briew ki bym ju sumar ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Hynrei me don hajan jong nga , A  Trai  , bad ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba neh skhem .  La slem bah nga la tip ïa ki jingbthah jong me ; me la thaw ïa ki ban neh junom .  To khmih ïa ka jingshitom jong nga , bad to pyllait im ïa nga , naba ngam shym leh klet ïa ka aiñ jong me .  To ïasaid ma me ïa ka hok jong nga , bad to pyllait ïa nga , to pynim ïa nga , kumba me la kular .  Ïa ki bymman yn ym pyllait im , namar kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .  Hynrei ka jingisynei jong me , A  Trai  , ka long kaba khraw , A to pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei jong me bad to pynim ïa nga !  Nga don shibun ki nongshun bad ki nongbanbeiñ , hynrei ngam shym bakla ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .  Haba nga khmih ïa kito ki nongshetkylla , la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingijli , namar kim sumar ïa ki hukum jong me .  To khmih haduh katno nga ieit ïa ki jingbthah jong me , A  Trai . Ka jingieit jong me kam ju kylla , kumta to pynim ïa nga !  Ka tynrai jong ka aiñ jong me ka dei ka jingshisha , bad baroh ki jingbishar bahok jong me ki long bymjukut .  Ki briew kiba donbor ki tur ïaleh ïa nga khlem nongrim , hynrei nga ñiewkor ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Haduh katno nga kmen namar ki jingkular jong me — kumba kmen uno uno uba shem ka jingkynshew babun .  Nga isih bad ijli ïa ki jinglamler baroh ; hynrei nga ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me .  Hynñiew sien shi sngi nga ainguh ïa me namar ki jingbishar bahok jong me .  Kito kiba ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me ki don ka jingshngain bajanai , bad ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynkyllon ïa ki .  Nga ap ïa me ban pynim ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad nga leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .  Nga kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me , nga ieit ïa ki da la ka dohnud baroh .  Nga kohnguh ïa ki hukum bad ïa ki jingbthah jong me ; me ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga leh .  Ai ba ka jingkhot kyrpad jong nga ban ïoh jingïarap kan poi sha me , A  Trai  ! To ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , kumba me la kular .  To shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga ; bad to pynim ïa nga kat kum ka jingkular jong me !  Ngan ïai ïaroh ïa me , namar me hikai ïa nga ïa ki aiñ jong me .  Ngan rwai shaphang ka aiñ jong me , namar ki hukum jong me ki long kiba hok .  To long borabor uba la kloi ban ïarap ïa nga , namar nga bud ïa ki hukum jong me .  A katno nga thrang ïa ka jingïarap bapynim jong me , A  Trai  ! Nga shem jingkmen ha ka aiñ jong me .  To ai ha nga ka jingim , khnang ba ngan lah ban ïaroh ïa me ; ai ba ki jingbthah jong me kin ïarap ïa nga .  Nga ïaid sakma kum ka langbrot kaba la jah noh , kumta to wan bad wad ïa nga , u shakri jong me , namar ngam shym leh klet ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Then Abraham fell upon his face , and laughed , and said in his heart , Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old ? and shall Sarah , that is ninety years old , bear ?
translation.kha: U Abraham u dem ngon ha khyndew , hynrei u la sdang ban rkhie haba u pyrkhat ,  Hato u briew u lah mo ban ïoh khun haba u la don shispah snem ka rta ? Hato ka Sarah ka lah mo ban ïoh khun haba ka la don khyndaiphew snem ka rta ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , that after the year was expired , at the time that kings go out to battle , Joab led forth the power of the army , and wasted the country of the children of Ammon , and came and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried at Jerusalem . And Joab smote Rabbah , and destroyed it .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem kaba ki syiem ki ju leit ïaleh thma , u Joab u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai bad hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ki Ammon ; u syiem Dabid , pat u sah ha Jerusalem . Ki kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah , ki tur ïaleh , bad pynjot ïa ka .

translation.en: As for the beauty of his ornament , he set it in majesty : but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein : therefore have I set it far from them .
translation.kha: Shisien ki la ju sngewsarong ïa la ki mawlynnai ba-itynnat , hynrei ki la pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna ïa ki bleithaw kiba ijli . Dei na kata ka daw balei ba U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka spah jong ki ban kynriah noh ïa ki .

translation.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty , that thou art righteous ? or is it gain to him , that thou makest thy ways perfect ?
translation.kha: Hato ka jingleh jong phi kaba dei , ka pynmyntoi ïa U Blei , lane ka jingbha jong phi ka ïarap ïa u ?

translation.en: The other disciples therefore said unto him , We have seen the Lord . But he said unto them , Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails , and put my finger into the print of the nails , and thrust my hand into his side , I will not believe .
translation.kha: Kumta kiwei pat ki synran ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  Ngi la ïohi ïa U Trai !  U Thomas u la ong ha ki ,  Lymda nga ïohi ïa ki dien preg ha ki kti jong u bad ïoh buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong nga ha kito ki dien preg bad ïa ka kti jong nga ha ka krung jong u , ngan ym ngeit .

translation.en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots , even nine hundred chariots of iron , and all the people that were with him , from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon .
translation.kha: u la khot ïa ki khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar bad ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad u la phah ïa ki na Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil sha ka wah Kishon .

translation.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit . Grace be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: U Trai un long lem bad ka mynsiem jong phi . Ka jingaiei jong U Blei kan long bad phi baroh . Amen .

translation.en: We are all one man s sons  ; we are true men , thy servants are no spies .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi ïalong shi para . Kynrad , ngim dei ki nongsyntiat , ngi dei ki briew ba shida .

translation.en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem , the children of Judah could not drive them out : but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh noh ïa ki Jebus kiba shong ha Jerusalem . Ki Jebus ki dang shong dang sah hangta lem bad ki paid Judah .

translation.en: Be ye therefore perfect , even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban long kiba janai — kumba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u long uba janai !

translation.en: So David went , he and the six hundred men that were with him , and came to the brook Besor , where those that were left behind stayed .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u hynriewspah ngut ki mihnoh , bad ynda ki poi ha ka wahduid Besor , don na ki kiba sah noh hangta .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Jehu , Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes , and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart , thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Jehu ,  Me la leh ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la kwah ïa me ban leh . Kumta nga kular ha me ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me , haduh kaba saw pateng bynriew , kin long ki syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: Then I will give you rain in due season , and the land shall yield her increase , and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit .
translation.kha: ngan phah ha phi ïa u slap ha ka aïom kaba biang , khnang ba ka khyndew kan pynmih kyrhai ki jingthung jingtep bad ki dieng kin seisoh .

translation.en: And with him they crucify two thieves  ; the one on his right hand , and the other on his left .
translation.kha: Ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki dakaid lem bad U Jisu , ïa uwei sha kamon bad ïa uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .

translation.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge : but the heart of the foolish doeth not so .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingtip la pynphriang da ki briew kiba stad , ym da kiba bieit .

translation.en: And he returned unto him , and , lo , he stood by his burnt sacrifice , he , and all the princes of Moab .
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la shem ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki Moab .

translation.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people : for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel , because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah .
translation.kha: U Aaron un ym ïohrung ha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki Israel ; un sa ïap noh , namar baroh ar ngut phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum jong nga ha Meribah .

translation.en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him , Hearken not unto him , nor consent .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki la jubab ,  Wat shahshkor ïa u ; wat pyndem .

translation.en: And not as it was by one that sinned , so is the gift : for the judgment was by one to condemnation , but the free gift is of many offences unto justification .
translation.kha: Bad ka don ka jingïapher hapdeng ka jingai sngewbha U Blei bad ka pop jong uwei u briew . Hadien jong kata kawei ka pop , la wan ka jingbishar ïa  Kiba pop ;  hynrei hadien ki pop kiba bun bah , ka wan ka jingai sngewbha kaba ngim don hok , ka jong  Uba khlem pop !

translation.en: Do you love me ?
translation.kha: Phi Ieid ia nga ?

translation.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour : but the way of the wicked seduceth them .
translation.kha: U briew uba hok u long ka jingkdew lynti ïa la u paralok , hynrei ka lynti jong u bymman ka ïalam bakla ïa ki .

translation.en: All things come alike to all : there is one event to the righteous , and to the wicked  ; to the good and to the clean , and to the unclean  ; to him that sacrificeth , and to him that sacrificeth not : as is the good , so is the sinner  ; and he that sweareth , as he that feareth an oath .
translation.kha: Kam don kano kano ka jingpher . Kajuh ka kupar ka wan ha uba hok bad ha uba bymman , ha uba bha bad ha uba sniew , ha kito kiba riewblei bad ha kito ki bymriewblei , ha kito kiba ai ki jingkñia bad ha kito ki bym ai . U briew babha um da ïapher eh na u nongpop ; uta uba smai um ïapher eh na uta u bym smai .

translation.en: Casting down imaginations , and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God , and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ ;
translation.kha: Ngi pynïap nia ïa ki jingïatainia ba-thala ; ngi pynduh ïa ka jingpynwit basngewmeng baroh ba la pynïeng pyrshah ïa kata ka jingtip U Blei ; ngi shim ïa ka jingpyrkhat baroh bad pynkohnguh ïa ka ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And when the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them before thee  ; thou shalt smite them , and utterly destroy them  ; thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor shew mercy unto them :
translation.kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u aiti ïa kine ki briew ha phi bad phi jop ïa ki , phi dei ban pynïap lut ïa ki baroh . Wat ïateh jutang bad ki bad wat leh-isynei ïa ki .

translation.en: The heavens declare his righteousness , and all the people see his glory .
translation.kha: Ki bneng ki pynbna ïa ka hok jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh ki ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .

translation.en: Many times did he deliver them  ; but they provoked him with their counsel , and were brought low for their iniquity .
translation.kha: Bunsien U  Trai  u pyllait ïa ki briew jong u , hynrei ki jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ngam kham jylliew ha ka pop .

translation.en: So David would not remove the ark of the  Lord  unto him into the city of David : but David carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
translation.kha: Kumta u la rai ban ym leit shim ïa ka bad u sha Jerusalem ; pynban , u phai noh na lynti bad u lam ïa ka sha ka ïing jong u Obed Edom , u traishnong jong ka nongbah Gath .

translation.en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ , as though God did beseech you by us : we pray you in Christ s stead , be ye reconciled to God .
translation.kha: Hangne ngi don , namarkata , da kaba kren na ka bynta U Khrist , la kumba U Blei hi da lade u kyrpad lyngba jong ngi . Ngi kyrpad na ka bynta U Khrist : To ai ba U Blei un pynkylla ïa phi na ki nongshun sha ki paralok jong u !

translation.en: Hear , ye that are far off , what I have done  ; and , ye that are near , acknowledge my might .
translation.kha: Ai ba uwei pa uwei uba hajan bad uba hajngai un ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba nga la leh bad pyndem ha ka bor jong nga .

translation.en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them , and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them , a leopard shall watch over their cities : every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces : because their transgressions are many , and their backslidings are increased .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki sing na khlaw kin pynïap ïa ki , ki suri na ka ri shyiap kin tar lyngkhot ïa ki , bad ki  labasa kin ïaid apthap lyngba ki shong jong ki . Lada kito ki briew ki mih shabar , yn tar lyngkhot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba bun bad na ka por sha ka por ki la phai dien noh na U Blei .

translation.en: And , ye masters , do the same things unto them , forbearing threatening : knowing that your Master also is in heaven ; neither is there respect of persons with him .
translation.kha: Phi ki kynrad , to leh ha kajuh ka rukom ïa ki mraw jong phi bad keiñ noh ki jingbyrngem . To kynmaw ba ma phi bad ki mraw jong phi , phi long ki jong ujuh U Kynrad uba ha bneng , uba bishar ïa baroh da kajuh ka jingthew .

translation.en: And he spake unto the children of Israel , saying , When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean these stones ?
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli ïa phi aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,

translation.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him , and smote him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ap phira ïa U Jisu ki la krenbeiñ ïa u bad ki la shoh ïa u .

translation.en: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: U Lamekh u la im sa sanspah khyndaiphew san snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way : but wickedness overthroweth the sinner .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïada ïa kiba lui lui ; ka pop ka long ka jingkyllon noh ki bymman .

translation.en: And ye shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand : and he that cometh within the ranges , let him be slain : and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ap phira ïa u syiem Joash ryngkat bad ki waitlam ba la sei lypa bad don ryngkat bad u kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba wan sha jan jong phi u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you , that I may lay my hand upon Egypt , and bring forth mine armies , and my people the children of Israel , out of the land of Egypt by great judgments .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shahshkor ïa me , kam pher katno kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei ba nga leh ha ka ri Ijipt . Nangta ngan wallam ka jingpynshitom kaba tyngeh ha ka Ijipt bad ngan ïalam ïa ki jait jong ki briew jong nga na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha , saying , Thy servant my husband is dead  ; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the  Lord  : and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei jong u dkhot ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ka la leit sha u Elisha bad ka ong ,  Kynrad , u tnga jong nga u la ïap ! Kumba phi tip , u dei u briew uba sheptieng ïa U Blei , hynrei mynta u briew uba ai ram ïa u , u la wan ban shim noh ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong nga ban long ki mraw kum ka jingsiew ïa ka ram u tnga jong nga .

translation.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments , and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki nongleh myntor ki ïaleh kumjuh da ki buit myntor jong ki , bad ki ruh ki pynmih ïa ki jakoid ha ka ri .

translation.en: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush , and seize upon the city : for the  Lord  your God will deliver it into your hand .
translation.kha: Nangta , phin wan mih na ka jakarieh bad kurup ïa ka nongbah . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: O God , be not far from me : O my God , make haste for my help .
translation.kha: Wat shong jngai eh , A Blei ; A Blei jong nga , to pynkloi ban ïarap ïa nga !

translation.en: The  Lord  shall go forth as a mighty man , he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war : he shall cry , yea , roar  ; he shall prevail against his enemies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u leit mih ban ïaleh kum u riewkieng atiar ; u long uba la kloi bad kwah eh ban ïaleh thma , u kyang-thma , u pyrta ban ïaleh thma ; u pyn-i ïa la ka bor pyrshah ïa la ki nongshun .

translation.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom ; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord .
translation.kha: Ka khubor jong U Khrist ha ka jingdap pura jong ka baroh , ka dei ban im hapoh ki dohnud jong phi . To hikai bad kyntu iwei ïa iwei pat da ka jingstad baroh . To rwai ki salm , ki jingrwai , bad ki jingrwai bakyntang ; to rwai sha U Blei da ka jingainguh ha ki dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Master , we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly , neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly :
translation.kha: Kine ki nongsyntiat ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko nonghikai , ngi tip ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba dei . Ngi tip ba mem khmih ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon jong U Blei na ka bynta u briew .

translation.en: Oh that my grief were thoroughly weighed , and my calamity laid in the balances together !
translation.kha: Lada ïa ki jingjynjar bad ki jingkthang mynsiem jong nga la thew ha ki tarajur ,

translation.en: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death ? did he not fear the  Lord  , and besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them ? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym la pynïap ïa u Mikah . Pynban , u Hesekaïah u la pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  bad u la pyrshang ban pynïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u . Bad U  Trai  u la kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam ha ki . Mynta ngi la jan wallam ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei halor jong ngi hi .

translation.en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water , there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the  Lord  , even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel : then shall the people of the  Lord  go down to the gates .
translation.kha: Sngap ! Ki paid ba sawa sawdong ki pukri um Ki pynbna ïa ki jingjop jong U  Trai  , Ki jingjop jong ki paid Israel ! Nangta ki briew jong U  Trai  ki ïaid arsut na ki nongbah jong ki

translation.en: And shall say , Cast ye up , cast ye up , prepare the way , take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban wan phai sha nga . Bret noh ïa ki jingpynwit baroh na ki lynti ïaid jong ki ! Shna ïa ka surok bad pynkhreh ïa ka !

translation.en: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him , and returned to the castle :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki shipai ïaid kjat ki la leit phai sha ka kut shipai bad ki la iehnoh ha ki shipai shong kulai ban leit bad u .

translation.en: Rejoice not against me , O mine enemy : when I fall , I shall arise  ; when I sit in darkness , the  Lord  shall be a light unto me .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi kim don daw ban risa beiñ halor jong ngi . Ngi la kyllon noh , hynrei ngin khie pat . Ngi don ha ka jingdum mynta , hynrei U  Trai  un ai jingshai ïa ngi .

translation.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba shun ïa nga u shun ïa U Kpa jong nga ruh .

translation.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries , Will they now commit whoredoms with her , and she with them ?
translation.kha: Bad nga ong ha lade ba ki pynlong ïa ki kum ka nuti ïa ka briew kaba la ngam ha ka jingklim .

translation.en: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds , with the captains and the guard , and brought them to him into the house of the  Lord  , and made a covenant with them , and took an oath of them in the house of the  Lord  , and shewed them the king s son .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba peit ïa ki nongai jingïada ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad u ong ïa ki ban wan sha ka Templ , ha kaba u la pynlong ïa ki ban mynjur da kaba smai ïa kaei ba u thmu ban leh .

translation.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh . For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth , much more shall not we escape , if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven :
translation.kha: Te , to sumar bad wat kyntait ban shahshkor ïa uta uba kren . Kita kiba kyntait ïa uta uba ïathuh ïa ka khubor ba kynja bneng ha pyrthei kim shym lait im . Sa katno tam ma ngi , ngin ïohlait im , te , lada ngi phai noh na uta uba kren na bneng .

translation.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u la long syiem , bad u la synshar sawphew snem .

translation.en: And Kattath , and Nahalal , and Shimron , and Idalah , and Beth–lehem : twelve cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Kattath , ka Nahalal , ka Shimron , ka Idalah , bad ka Bethlehem : khat-ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise , as some men count slackness  ; but is longsuffering to us-ward , not willing that any should perish , but that all should come to repentance .
translation.kha: U Trai um pyntud ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular , kumba don kiba pyrkhat . Pynban , u long uba ïaishah slem bad phi , namar um kwah ïano ïano ban jot noh , hynrei u kwah ba baroh kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: He that receiveth you receiveth me , and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ïa phi u pdiang ïa nga , bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa nga , u pdiang ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Meekness , temperance : against such there is no law .
translation.kha: Ym don ka hukum pyrshah ïa kiba kum kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: There is one lawgiver , who is able to save and to destroy : who art thou that judgest another ?
translation.kha: Dei tang U Blei uba long u nongai hukum bad u nongbishar . Dei tang ma u hi uba lah ban pynim bad ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phi dei uei , ban bishar ïa la u parabriew ?

translation.en: If a man say , I love God , and hateth his brother , he is a liar : for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen , how can he love God whom he hath not seen ?
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ong ba u ieit ïa U Blei , hynrei u isih ïa la u parabriew , u long uba lamler . Naba um lah ban ieit ïa U Blei , ïa uba um shym ïohi , lada um ieit ïa la u parabriew ïa uba u ïohi .

translation.en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , on the morrow after that day , even a thousand bullocks , a thousand rams , and a thousand lambs , with their drink offerings , and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki pynïap ïa ki jingri kum ki jingkñia , da kaba pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai  , bad nangta ki ai ïa ki ha ki briew ban bam . Shuh shuh , ki la kñia shihajar tylli ki masi lyngraw , shihajar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad shihajar tylli ki khunlangbrot , ïa kiba ki la thang tylli halor ka duwan . Ki la wanrah ruh ki jingainguh waiñ .

translation.en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem , and into the temple : and when he had looked round about upon all things , and now the eventide was come , he went out unto Bethany with the twelve .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la rung sha Jerusalem , u la leit sha ka Templ , bad u la khmih sawdong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Hynrei namar ba ka la dier eh ha kata ka sngi , u la mih bad leit sha Bethania ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .

translation.en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah , and said unto him , Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria , and not relied on the  Lord  thy God , therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hanani lyngdoh u leit sha u syiem Asa bad ong ,  Namar ba me la shaniah ha u syiem Syria ban ïa kaba shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong me , ka kynhun shipai u syiem Israel ka la lait phet na me .

translation.en: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen , being understood by the things that are made , even his eternal power and Godhead ; so that they are without excuse :
translation.kha: Naduh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ki jinglong bym lah ban ïohi jong u , ka bor bymjukut bad ka jinglong ba kynja Blei jong u , la ïohi shai kdar ; la ïohi ïa ki ha kiei kiei kiba U Blei u la thaw . Kumta kito ki briew kin ym lait satia !

translation.en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life : for there is no matter hid from the king , and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u Absalom , u syiem un ïohsngew shaphang kata — namar u ïohsngew shaphang kaei kaei baroh — bad phin ym ïada satia ïa nga .

translation.en: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai , which is beside Beth–aven , on the east side of Beth–el , and spake unto them , saying , Go up and view the country . And the men went up and viewed Ai .
translation.kha: U Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah na Jerikho sha Ai , ka nongbah sha ka phang mihngi na Bethel , hajan ka Bethaben , lem bad ki hukum ïa ki bad swar ïa ka jaka . Haba ki la dep leh kumta ,

translation.en: And now , behold , Adonijah reigneth  ; and now , my lord the king , thou knowest it not :
translation.kha: Hynrei u Adonijah u lah da long syiem , bad phim tip ei ei shaphang kata .

translation.en: I said , I shall not see the  Lord  , even the  Lord  , in the land of the living : I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ha kane ka pyrthei jong kiba im , ba ngan ym ïohi shuh ïa U  Trai lane ïa uno uno u briew uba im .

translation.en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee s children with her sons , worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka tnga jong u Sebedi ka la wan sha U Jisu lem bad ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka , ka la nguh dem ha khmat jong u , bad ka la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei .

translation.en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide , that David arose from off his bed , and walked upon the roof of the king s house : and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself  ; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , haba la kham janmiet , u Dabid u la khie na kaba thiah shipor bad u la leit shalor ka tnum ïing jong ka ïingsyiem . Katba u dang ïaid sawdong hangta , u la ïohi ïa ka kynthei kaba dang sum . Ka long kaba bhabriew shikatdei .

translation.en: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath , and commandedst them precepts , statutes , and laws , by the hand of Moses thy servant :
translation.kha: Me hikai ïa ki ban sumar khuid ïa ki sngi Sabbaton , bad lyngba u shakri jong me u Moses me ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Praise the  Lord  from the earth , ye dragons , and all deeps :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na ka pyrthei , phi ki mrad duriaw baheh bad baroh ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw-bah ;

translation.en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour , and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me : come therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa phi da ka jingai burom kaba khraw bad leh ïa kano kano kaba phi ong . Sngewbha wan bad tim ïa kine ki briew na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And the patriarchs , moved with envy , sold Joseph into Egypt : but God was with him ,
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la bishni ïa u Joseph u para jong ki bad ki la die ïa u ban long u mraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei U Blei u la don lem bad u bad u la pyllait ïa u na ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .

translation.en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up , and the clouds drop down the dew .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad jong u , ka pynlah ïa ki wah ban tuid bad ïa ki lyoh ba kin pynhap slap ha ka khyndew .

translation.en: And , behold , immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was , sent from Caesarea unto me .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki lai ngut ki rangbah ïa kiba la phah sha nga na Kaisaria ki la wan poi ha ka ïing ha kaba nga la sah .

translation.en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country : they may be redeemed , and they shall go out in the jubilee .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki ïing ha ki nongrit ki bym shym la ker kynroh yn leh kumba leh ïa ki lyngkha ; u trai uba nyngkong u don ka hok ban thied pat ïa ki , bad yn pynphai pat ïa ki ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee , and thy backslidings shall reprove thee : know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter , that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , and that my fear is not in thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ka jingsniew jong me hi kan pynshitom ïa me , bad ka jingphai noh jong me na nga kan pynrem ïa me . Men ïoh tip haduh katno kaba kthang bad kaba bakla ka long ban iehnoh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , bad mem shym long shuh uba ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

translation.en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords , he drove them all out of the temple , and the sheep , and the oxen  ; and poured out the changers  money , and overthrew the tables  ;
translation.kha: Te u la thaw ïa u jingsympat da ki tyllai jingteh bad u la beh noh shabar ka Templ ïa ki mrad baroh , ki langbrot bad ki masi ruh ; u la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ pisa bad u la pynsaphred ïa ki pisa sbai ;
